# 2016: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 5,233 Wikipedia event assertions across 366 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2016.sqlite](2016.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `e2a0b239a6aabfd1dff9ed5106d905670da044f3816ad38a1f1c43431480a703`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.1`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 26. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 11; partial: 15; without a full-event review: 5,207. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2016-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1128628231](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20January%201&oldid=1128628231>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A shooting takes place at a pub in Tel Aviv, Israel, leaving two dead and eight injured. The gunman managed to escape and possibly killed his accomplice, an Arab taxi driver, whose body was found nearby. The police identified the shooter as 30 year old muslim Nisa'at Melkham from Ar'ara and searched his home.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/1.694926>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new 28-foot tall statue of Jesus, dubbed "Jesus de Greatest," is unveiled on New Year's Day outside St. Aloysius Catholic Church in Abajah village, Nigeria's Imo state, which is described as the tallest Jesus statue in Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/12/31/new-giant-jesus-statue/78122392/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** About one thousand houses in Manila's Tondo district in the Philippines are set ablaze following New Year's Eve firecracker festivities that left one dead and 380 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.ctvnews.ca/world/firecrackers-spark-blaze-in-manila-that-leaves-1-dead-380-injured-1.2720303>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-01-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The EU-Ukraine Free Trade deal officially comes into force, coinciding with a Russian food embargo on Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/eu-ukraine-free-trade-deal-comes-in-effect/27461508.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The two-child policy takes effect in China, allowing couples in the country to have at most two children, replacing the controversial one-child policy. The change in law was announced by the ruling Communist Party on October 29 and passed the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on December 27, five days prior to its effect.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/china-s-new-two-child/2391832.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-01-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson, who has been the President of Iceland for 20 years, announces in his new-year speech that he will not seek reelection for a sixth term when presidential elections will be held in June.

Source citations (as archived): [Visir](<http://icelandmag.visir.is/article/olafur-ragnar-grimsson-president-iceland-will-not-seek-re-election-a-sixth-term-2016>).

### 2016-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091613212](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20January%202&oldid=1091613212>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Terrorism in India / 2016 Pathankot attack.

**Archived source account.** Heavily armed terrorists, reportedly members of Jaish-e-Mohammed, attack an Indian Air Force base in Pathankot, Punjab; three security force personnel and four of the terrorists are reported to have been killed.

Source citations (as archived): [DNA](<http://www.dnaindia.com/india/live-terrorists-launch-attack-on-iaf-base-in-pathankot-fierce-gunbattle-on-2161442>).

<a id="event-2016-01-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War, List of politicians killed in the Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Gisela Mota Ocampo, mayor of Temixco in Mexico's Morelos state is assassinated by gunmen at her home, less than a day after taking office. Morelos Governor, Graco Ramírez, attributed Mota's killing to organized crime, without citing a particular drug cartel or gang.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3382244/Mexico-mayor-slain-day-taking-office.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Occupation of the Malheur National Wildlife Refuge.

**Archived source account.** Armed militiamen, including members of the Bundy family of Nevada, take over and occupy the headquarters of the Malheur National Wildlife Refuge near Burns, Oregon following a peaceful rally in support of Dwight and Steve Hammond, who were convicted of arson in 2012 for setting fires on public land adjacent to their property.

Source citations (as archived): [Oregon Live](<http://www.oregonlive.com/pacific-northwest-news/index.ssf/2016/01/drama_in_burns_ends_with_quiet.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-01-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Sheikh Nimr, 2011–12 Saudi Arabian protests.

**Archived source account.** The Saudi Arabian government executes 47 people, including Sheikh Nimr al-Nimr, a prominent Shia Muslim cleric and leader of the anti-government Shia opposition group. His execution generated negative worldwide reactions from politicians, Muslim religious figures, and Shia people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35213244>); [The Nation](<http://nation.com.pk/international/02-Jan-2016/saudi-arabia-executes-sheikh-nimr-al-nimr>); [Indian Express](<http://indianexpress.com/article/world/world-news/saudi-arabia-executes-47-terrorists-including-shiite-cleric-sheikh-nimr-al-nimr/>); [Reuters](<http://mobile.reuters.com/article/idUSKBN0UG03B20160102>).

<a id="event-2016-01-02-1-2"></a>

Context: Sheikh Nimr, 2011–12 Saudi Arabian protests.

**Archived source account.** Iranian protesters ransack and set fire to the Saudi Arabian embassy in Tehran, in response to the Saudi execution of Nimr al-Nimr.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/01/03/world/middleeast/saudi-arabia-executes-47-sheikh-nimr-shiite-cleric.html?_r=0>).

### 2016-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076150482](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20January%203&oldid=1076150482>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for a suicide bomb attack on an Iraqi Army base (Camp Speicher, now known as Tikrit Air Academy), near the town of Tikrit, north of Baghdad, that killed at least 15 and injured 22.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-violence-idUSKBN0UH07F20160103?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>).

<a id="event-2016-01-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in India / 2016 Pathankot attack.

**Archived source account.** Gunfire and loud explosions are heard at an Indian Air Force base in Pathankot, Punjab, as anti-terrorist operations continue. A further two militants, for a total of six, are reported to have been killed; seven military and paramilitary personnel are reported to have been killed, with up to 20 other security personnel wounded.

<a id="event-2016-01-03-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

### 2016-01-04

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/two-sunni-mosques-bombed-muezzin-killed-in-iraq-police>).

<a id="event-2016-01-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Killing of captives by ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) releases a video showing the killing of five men accused of committing espionage on the militant group for the United Kingdom. The British Foreign and Commonwealth Office released a statement saying that they are examining the content of the video.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://news.abs-cbn.com/global-filipino/world/01/04/16/is-threatens-britain-in-new-executions-video>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/isis-threatens-uk-in-new-execution-video/>).

<a id="event-2016-01-04-0-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Pathankot attack.

**Archived source account.** Five of the terrorists who attacked an Indian Air Force base in Pathankot, Punjab are reported to have been killed; mopping-up and search operations continue. National Security Guard officials state the operations will continue until the air base is made safe.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Express](<http://indianexpress.com/article/india/india-news-india/live-terror-attack-at-pathankot-air-force-base-2-terrorist-killed/>).

<a id="event-2016-01-04-0-7"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant's branch in Libya attacks the Libyan oil port of Sidra, which is Libya's largest oil depot. Two members of the Petrol Facilities Guard militia, which is defending Sidra, were reportedly killed in clashes. Islamic State militants were reportedly pushed back from the port, but the group now says it controls the town of Bin Jawad, 30km west of Sidra on the road from its stronghold in Sirte.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-35220281>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-01-04-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Chinese stock market crash.

**Archived source account.** Trading on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange are suspended for the day after stock indices plummeted by 6.85% and 8.1% respectively.

<a id="event-2016-01-04-1-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Chinese stock market crash.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, the Dow Jones industrial average closes 275 points down due to concerns over the Chinese economy.

<a id="event-2016-01-04-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nokia, the telecommunications giant based in Finland, announces that it has gained control of French counterpart Alcatel-Lucent, and sets the date for formal consolidation as January 14.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/alcatel-lucent-m-a-nokia-corp-idUSKBN0UI0RK20160104>).

#### International relations

Context: Foreign relations of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Sudan and Bahrain follow Saudi Arabia's lead and cut diplomatic relations with Iran, and the United Arab Emirates downgrades diplomatic ties.

<a id="event-2016-01-04-3-2"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia will end all air traffic and trade links with Iran, and demands that Iran must "act like a normal country" before it would restore severed diplomatic relations.

<a id="event-2016-01-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Syria's political opposition in-exile urges all Arab countries to sever diplomatic ties with Iran. The Turkey-based Syrian National Coalition declared its support for Riyadh's move, calling on "all Arab and Islamic countries to take a similar step", and criticized what it said was Iran's support for Shia militias in Syria and Iraq.

**Archived source account.** In efforts to control an influx of migrants, Denmark introduces ten days of identity checks on its southern border with Germany, while Sweden introduces similar measures on the Øresund Bridge between itself and Denmark. All three countries are subject to the Schengen Agreement on the free movement of people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35222015>).

Taiwan President Ma Ying-jeou applauded this step toward normalizing relations between the two states. Taiwan's opposition party expressed concern that Beijing is trying to interfere with the country's January 16, 2016, presidential and legislative elections.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-01-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Reform of the People's Liberation Army in China:.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The Rocket Force replaced the Second Artillery in a formation announcement on December 31, 2015.

Editorial date: 2016-01-05. Checked: 2026-10-22. The transformation is supported, but its placement under January 5 is not an independently supported formation date. Keep the archival date; a cross-year editorial relocation needs a separate migration.

Evidence: [Japan National Institute for Defense Studies](<https://www.nids.mod.go.jp/english/publication/east-asian/pdf/2016/east-asian_e2016_04.pdf>).

Original source account: The Second Artillery Corps is re-organized into the People's Liberation Army Rocket Force.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2016-01-05-4-2"></a>

Context: Reform of the People's Liberation Army in China:.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The December 31, 2015 announcement established the Strategic Support Force, with Gao Jin as commander and Liu Fulian as political commissar.

Editorial date: 2016-01-05. Checked: 2026-10-22. Leadership is supported; January 5 placement does not establish a January 5 founding. Keep the source date and text; do not relocate into a different annual edition.

Evidence: [Japan National Institute for Defense Studies](<https://www.nids.mod.go.jp/english/publication/east-asian/pdf/2016/east-asian_e2016_04.pdf>).

Original source account: The People's Liberation Army Strategic Support Force is founded, with Gao Jin as its inaugural commander and Liu Fulian as Political Commissar.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2016-01-05-4-3"></a>

Context: Reform of the People's Liberation Army in China:.

The conclusion reached by the lawmakers will not be binding on the UK government.

A member of his cabinet was reportedly due to resign over the issue within 24 hours.

**Archived source account.** Texas state trooper Brian Encinia is charged with perjury in connection with the death of Sandra Bland.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160108131914/http://www.fox32chicago.com/news/local/69787642-story>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-01-06-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Major League Baseball, Ken Griffey Jr. and Mike Piazza are elected to the Hall of Fame by the Baseball Writers' Association of America. Griffey was named on all but three of the 440 ballots received, surpassing Tom Seaver for the highest voting percentage in Hall history. Griffey and Piazza will be formally inducted on July 24.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/sports/ken-griffey-jr-mike-piazza-inducted-baseball-hall-fame-n491631?cid=eml_nbn_20160106>).

### 2016-01-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1237845501](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20January%207&oldid=1237845501>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-07-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / Zliten truck bombing.

**Archived source account.** At least 60 people are killed after a truck bomb hit a police training center in the Libyan town of Zliten.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-idUSKBN0UL0XE20160107>).

<a id="event-2016-01-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire on tourists at a hotel close to the Giza pyramids. There were no casualties in the attack, which caused some damage to the hotel, and the attackers were arrested shortly afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35251258>).

<a id="event-2016-01-07-0-6"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Iran says last night, Saudi warplanes bombed its embassy in the Yemeni capital, Sana'a, wounding several of its guards. The Associated Press reports there is no visible damage to the building. A Saudi-alliance spokesman promises to investigate the accusations.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/328156-iran-saudis-embassy-airstrike/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/iran-claims-saudi-airstrike-on-yemen-embassy-amid-deepening-tensions/2016/01/07/fc6131ae-b52f-11e5-a76a-0b5145e8679a_story.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8c809e01cbe34319af3b42e7d2d52d89/iran-says-saudi-led-airstrike-hit-iranian-embassy-yemen>); [Reuters](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8c809e01cbe34319af3b42e7d2d52d89/iran-says-saudi-led-airstrike-hit-iranian-embassy-yemen>).

<a id="event-2016-01-07-0-7"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Saudi-led coalition airstrikes today reportedly hit the presidential palace and a mountain military base to the south of Sana'a, causing children and teachers in several schools to flee. There were no immediate reports of casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-idUSKBN0UL0OQ20160107>).

<a id="event-2016-01-07-0-9"></a>

Context: Occupation of the Malheur National Wildlife Refuge.

**Archived source account.** Tribal chair Charlotte Rodrique of the local Burns Paiute Tribe has joined in asking the occupiers to leave saying "The protesters have no claim to this land". Rodrique further cites a treaty, never ratified by the United States Congress, giving ownership of the land to the tribe.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160110064651/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/go-vegan-and-go-home-occupiers-under-siege-from-peta-native-tribe/ar-AAgtkDr?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2016-01-07-0-11"></a>

Context: January 2016 Paris police station attack.

**Archived source account.** French police shoot dead a knife-wielding man, who was shouting "Allahu Akbar", outside a police station in Goutte d'Or, located in the 18th arrondissement of Paris. A piece of paper with an Islamic State flag and claim for the attack written in Arabic was found on his body. The incident is noted for taking place on the anniversary of last year's Charlie Hebdo shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35250344>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-01-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints announces the formation of three new missions, each in Vietnam, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria.

<a id="event-2016-01-07-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Chinese stock market crisis.

**Archived source account.** Trade is suspended on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and Shenzhen Stock Exchange for a second time in a week after share prices tumble following the devaluation of the yuan.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com.au/chinas-currency-rout-is-rocking-markets-again-2016-1?wt=2>).

Context: 2015–16 Chinese stock market crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese securities regulator introduces legislation limiting the sale of shares by shareholders.

<a id="event-2016-01-07-2-3"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Chinese stock market crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Dow Jones Industrial Average declines by just under 400 points as a result of concerns over the Chinese economy.

<a id="event-2016-01-07-3-1"></a>

Context: 2009–16 Oklahoma earthquake swarms.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, a swarm of 30 (and counting) earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 or greater struck Oklahoma from Wednesday evening through Thursday mid-afternoon. The biggest, a magnitude 4.8, happened yesterday at 10:27 p.m. CST, 32 kilometers (20 miles) northwest of Fairview, Oklahoma.

Context: 2016 North Korean nuclear test.

**Archived source account.** South Korea says it will resume cross-border propaganda broadcasts and limit entry to the Kaesong Industrial Region in response to yesterday's nuclear test at the North's Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site. North Korea considers the propaganda broadcasts to be "an act of war".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jan/07/north-korea-nuclear-test-japan-and-south-korea-unite-against-serious-threat>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/1.696054>); [news.com.au](<http://www.news.com.au/world/middle-east/saudi-arabia-strikes-irans-embassy-in-yemen-as-iran-bans-all-saudi-imports/news-story/47a36eb9ebf72a62d3e1a5824dc71dd1>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-08-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** Three people are unaccounted for and at least 135 structures are destroyed, including the historic Yarloop Workshops, following a bushfire in the small Western Australian town of Yarloop. Reports coming out of the area suggest the town of Yarloop has been almost completely destroyed with one local official, Murray Cowper, saying, "A big fireball came through and there was no way they were going to stop it. This could well be the end of the town".

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** At least 51 people are reportedly killed in an attack on a shopping centre in Iraq's capital, Baghdad, and a car bombing outside an illegal casino in Miqdadiyah, east of Baghdad, with the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claiming responsibility for both attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35285605>); [AAP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2016/01/12/least-48-killed-iraq-attacks-claimed>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-violence-idUSKCN0UP1R420160111>).

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/01/11/politics/us-bombs-millions-isis-currency-supply/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-11-0-5"></a>

Context: Occupation of the Malheur National Wildlife Refuge.

**Archived source account.** Armed militiamen, also known as the Citizens for Constitutional Freedom, who are occupying the USFWS administered Malheur National Wildlife Refuge in Harney County, Oregon, tear down a part of a fence that they claim was erected by the federal government in order to allow privately owned cattle to graze on the adjacent public land. USFWS condemns the actions through a written statement which states that, "Removing fences, damaging any refuge property, or unauthorized use of equipment would be additional unlawful actions by the illegal occupiers. Any movement of cattle onto the refuge or other activities that are not specifically authorized by \[the Fish and Wildlife Service\] constitutes trespassing."

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2016/jan/12/bundy-militia-fence-oregon-wildlife-refuge-protest-escalates>); [The Oregonian](<http://www.oregonlive.com/oregon-standoff/2016/01/oregon_standoff_bundy_militant.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-01-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Arch Coal, the second largest coal-mining concern in the United States, files for chapter 11 protection because it has been hit hard by the collapsing market demand for that commodity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-arch-coal-restructuring-idUSKCN0UP0MR20160111>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-01-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Metropolitan Fire Brigade in the Australian city of Melbourne warn residents about haze from a large industrial fire burning in the suburb of Broadmeadows.

Source citations (as archived): [Melbourne Age](<http://www.theage.com.au/victoria/mfb-warn-residents-to-close-doors-and-windows-as-thick-smoke-blankets-broadmeadows-following-industrial-fire-20160110-gm31y1.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-11-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Great Britain and Ireland floods.

**Archived source account.** Philip Dilley, chairman of the UK's Environment Agency resigns after receiving heavy criticism for not returning from a family holiday in Barbados during the recent heavy floods in Northern England and Scotland.

Source citations (as archived): [Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/uk/environment-agency-boss-dilley-quits-after-barbados-holiday-row-34353840.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-01-11-3-1"></a>

Context: New Year's Eve sexual assaults in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protesters in Leipzig demonstrate against a record refugee influx they blame for mass sexual violence at New Year's Eve events in Cologne and other German cities. Many chanted 'We are the people', 'Resistance\!' and 'Deport them\!'. The rally was organized by a local chapter of PEGIDA (Patriotic Europeans Against the Islamisation of the Occident). Six Pakistani men and one Syrian man were also attacked by so-called vigilantes in Cologne, following calls on social media for "revenge" in the wake of the New Year's Eve assaults.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3393543/Two-Pakistanis-Syrian-man-injured-gang-attacks-Cologne.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-01-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In association football, Lionel Messi of FC Barcelona and Argentina wins the 2015 FIFA Ballon d'Or, for his fifth time. Barça manager Luis Enrique is named FIFA World Coach of the Year for Men's Football. Carli Lloyd of the Houston Dash and the USA is named FIFA Women's World Player of the Year, and USA coach Jill Ellis is named FIFA World Coach of the Year for Women's Football.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.sportsfan.com.au/lionel-messi-wins-5th-world-player-award/tabid/91/newsid/185748/default.aspx>).

<a id="event-2016-01-11-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Australian football, 34 current and former players with the Essendon Football Club are banned from playing in the Australian Football League during the 2016 AFL season after the Court of Arbitration for Sport finds that they took the banned substance thymosin-beta 4.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP and The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/sport/afl/essendon-doping-scandal-reaction-to-cas-verdict/news-story/30ec9fe4cecc6551990029a66369cd1f>).

<a id="event-2016-01-11-4-3"></a>

Context: 2016 College Football Playoff National Championship.

**Archived source account.** In American football, the Alabama Crimson Tide defeat the Clemson Tigers 45-40 to win the College Football Playoff National Championship.

Source citations (as archived): [NCAA](<https://www.ncaa.com/news/football/article/2016-01-11/college-football-playoff-alabama-vs-clemson-live-updates>).

### 2016-01-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091688797](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20January%2012&oldid=1091688797>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-12-0-1"></a>

Context: January 2016 Istanbul bombing.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people are killed and 15 injured, mostly German tourists, following an explosion in Istanbul's Sultanahmet Square. A Syrian suicide bomber, an ISIL member, is responsible, according to Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu.

Source citations (as archived): [Nine MSN](<http://www.9news.com.au/world/2016/01/12/19/47/explosion-rocks-popular-tourist-square-in-istanbul>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35290760>); [Reuters](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/top-stories/2016/01/12/explosion-rocks-central-istanbul-square.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/01/13/world/europe/explosion-in-istanbul-tourist-district-kills-at-least-10.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/01/12/europe/turkey-istanbul-explosion/>).

<a id="event-2016-01-12-0-2"></a>

Context: January 2016 Istanbul bombing.

**Archived source account.** Sixty alleged Islamic militants are arrested in Turkey with twenty one people arrested in the city of Sanliurfa.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/story/2016-01-12/is-suicide-bomber-kills-at-least-10-in-istanbul/>).

<a id="event-2016-01-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Latakia offensive (2015-present).

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army, backed by Russian airstrikes, retakes control of the strategic town of Salma in the northern Latakia Governorate. The town had been mostly under rebel (FSA) and jihadist (Al-Nusra Front) control since 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/syrian-army-enters-rebel-bastion-latakia-province-monitor-110734427.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-12-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** United Nations War Crimes Commission investigators are gathering information about conditions in the western town of Madaya, where an aid convoy just brought the first food and medical relief for three months. The city has been under a siege by Syrian government forces since July. Doctors Without Borders is treating 250 people with severe acute malnutrition.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idUSKCN0UP0VM20160113>); [Médecins Sans Frontières](<http://www.msf.org/article/syria-siege-and-starvation-madaya-immediate-medical-evacuations-and-medical-resupply>).

<a id="event-2016-01-12-0-8"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram militants shoot and kill 7 people and burn down 10 houses in Madagali, Adamawa.

Source citations (as archived): [ENCA](<https://www.enca.com/africa/7-killed-nigeria-attack>).

<a id="event-2016-01-12-1-0"></a>

Context: 2016 Pacific hurricane season.

<a id="event-2016-01-12-4-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-01-12-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In accordance with a major point of a nuclear agreement reached with several world powers, Iran removed a plutonium core and filled with concrete the Arak nuclear reactor, setting the stage for the removal of sanctions against Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/iran-pours-concrete-into-nuclear-reactor-expects-sanctions-relief/2016/01/11/67011cda-b8a1-11e5-b682-4bb4dd403c7d_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-12-4-3"></a>

Pentagon spokesman, Peter Cook, told Associated Press that Iran has assured the United States that the crew and vessels will be returned promptly.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/78c98f06474d4481bcb9c50f43d0cb0a/pentagon-2-us-navy-boats-held-iran-will-be-returned>).

Badawi is to appear in court on Wednesday, according to Amnesty International. Both her brother, Raif Badawi, publisher of the "Free Saudi Liberals" blog, and former husband, Waleed Sami Abulkhair, are currently imprisoned.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/01/12/middleeast/samar-badawi-arrest-saudi-arabia/>); [Amnesty International](<http://www.amnestyusa.org/news/press-releases/arrest-of-human-rights-defender-samar-badawi-in-saudi-arabia-latest-attempt-to-intimidate-activists>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jan/12/samar-badawi-sister-blogger-raif-badawi-arrested-saudi-arabia>).

<a id="event-2016-01-13-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Subtropical Storm Alex is located 785 miles (1,260 km) south-southwest of the Azores. Alex is one of just four tropical or subtropical storms to occur in January since 1851, the first year records were kept. The hurricane season begins on June 1 of each year. Alex is expected to hit the Azores on Friday with average rain accumulations of 3 to 5 inches.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/capital-weather-gang/wp/2016/01/13/its-january-and-a-tropical-storm-has-formed-in-the-atlantic-ocean/>); [NHC](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCDAT1+shtml/132032.shtml?>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Glenn Frey, a founding member of the Eagles, dies of complications arising from rheumatoid arthritis, colitis and pneumonia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-35349025>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-01-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports that Xiao Gang, the head of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has offered to resign after a sharp sell-off in two of China's stock exchanges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-stocks-regulator-exclusive-idUSKCN0UW0WQ>).

<a id="event-2016-01-18-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tata Steel is to cut 1,050 jobs in the United Kingdom, with the majority going in South Wales. The Indian multinational steel-making company announced there will be 750 job losses at its Port Talbot Steelworks in Port Talbot, Wales while another 300 jobs will go at its plants in Corby and Hartlepool in England.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-01-18/tata-steel-cuts-more-jobs-in-blow-to-u-k-s-shrinking-industry>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-01-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Modane avalanche.

**Archived source account.** At least five French Foreign Legion soldiers are killed and six injured in an avalanche while on a training exercise in the Alps, close to the Italian border. The soldiers were members of the 2nd Foreign Engineer Regiment.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35346453>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-01-18-4-1"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** A man linked to the Paris attacks is arrested in Mohammedia, Morocco.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1625074/paris-attacks-suspect-arrestd-in-morocco>).

<a id="event-2016-01-18-4-3"></a>

Context: MASSOB.

**Archived source account.** Biafran separatists claim that police killed 8 protesters calling for independence. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://wtop.com/africa/2016/01/nigerian-separatists-claim-police-kill-8-in-biafra-protest/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-01-18-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Russian Duma rejects a Communist Party bill banning homosexual expression.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-parliament-rejects-antihomosexual-expression-bill/27494613.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-18-5-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The British Parliament debates a petition, signed by more than 560,000 people, calling for the Home Secretary to ban, because of 'hate speech,' United States Republican Party presidential candidate Donald Trump from entering the United Kingdom. Almost all of the 50 MPs (member of parliament), of the 650-member legislative body, present criticized Trump -- especially his comments on Muslims -- but few supported an entry ban.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/01/19/politics/uk-parliament-trump-debate/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2016/jan/18/donald-trump-should-be-banned-from-uk-for-inflaming-hate-mp-says>).

### 2016-01-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1295480778](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20January%2019&oldid=1295480778>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-19-0-1"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** At least 9 people are killed and 35 injured after a suicide bomber strikes near a security checkpoint near Peshawar, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Geo TV](<http://www.geo.tv/latest/100406-Five-killed-several-injured-in-blast-near-Peshawar-checkpost>); [AFP](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2016/0119/761199-pakistan/>).

<a id="event-2016-01-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights claims that scores of Syrian Army troops have been killed in fighting with the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant over the past few days with the fiercest battles near the city of Deir ez-Zor.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Fighting-between-Syrian-army-Islamic-State-kills-scores-442009>).

<a id="event-2016-01-19-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** ISIL confirms the death of militant Jihadi John in an airstrike in November.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-35358101>).

<a id="event-2016-01-19-0-6"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Commission on Human Rights releases a report stating that at least 18,802 civilians have been killed and another 36,245 wounded between 1 January 2014 and 31 October 2015. Of these, 3,855 civilians were killed and 7,056 wounded between 1 May and 31 October 2015, with approximately half of these deaths occurring in Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [United Nations](<http://www.ohchr.org/EN/NewsEvents/Pages/DisplayNews.aspx?NewsID=16964&amp;LangID=E>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-01-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistan lifts a three-year ban on YouTube after Google launches a local version that allows the government to demand removal of material it considers to be offensive. Similar systems have existed in China for many years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://finance.yahoo.com/news/pakistan-lifts-ban-youtube-launch-050557383.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-01-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The price of oil drops below $28 a barrel, the lowest since 2003.

Source citations (as archived): [The Huffington Post](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160121202309/http://www.msn.com/en-us/money/markets/gas-selling-for-47-cents-a-gallon-as-oil-prices-drop-sharply/ar-BBonBNb?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-01-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The roof of the renovated Hôtel Ritz in Paris is damaged by fire just weeks before the planned re-opening.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35351013>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-fire-ritz-idUSKCN0UX18S>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-01-19-4-1"></a>

Context: OIC and Iran-Saudi relations.

**Archived source account.** Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister has left Tehran for Saudi Arabia for participation in the Organization of Islamic Cooperation ministerial meeting in Jeddah which was called for by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to discuss the consequence of attack at Saudi Embassy in Tehran following the execution of Shia Muslim cleric Sheikh Nimr. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\} \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [IRIB World Service](<http://english.irib.ir/news/world/west-asia/item/221643-iran-deputy-fm-to-attend-oic-meeting-in-saudi-arabia>); [OIC](<http://www.oic-oci.org/oicv2/topic/?t_id=10815&amp;t_ref=4253&amp;lan=en>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-01-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court agrees to hear an appeal that may redefine the boundaries of insider trading in U.S. law and regulation, especially as it relates to tips shared among family and friends.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<http://www.bloombergview.com/articles/2016-01-19/justices-will-know-insider-trading-when-they-see-it>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-01-19-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Former Governor of Alaska, vice presidential candidate (2008), and Tea Party activist Sarah Palin endorses Republican Party presidential candidate Donald Trump for President of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/01/19/politics/donald-trump-endorsement-sarah-palin/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-01-19-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search announces the discovery of the latest largest known prime number, a Mersenne prime with 22,338,618 digits equal to 274,207,281-1.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/alexs-adventures-in-numberland/2016/jan/19/largest-prime-number-yet-discovered-has-22-million-digits>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-01-19-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to a report in The Japan Times, Major League Baseball is investigating Texas Rangers pitcher Yu Darvish as to whether he had any links with an illegal gambling ring allegedly operated by his brother Sho, who was arrested in October 2015 in Osaka on gambling charges. The ring was alleged to have taken bets on MLB and Nippon Professional Baseball games.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/2016/01/19/baseball/mlb/mlb-confirms-probe-darvish-gambling-case/#.Vp8PB1MrK1v>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-20-0-2"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan / Bacha Khan University attack.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen attack a university in Charsadda, Pakistan. At least 21 people are reportedly killed.

<a id="event-2016-01-20-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

<a id="event-2016-01-20-0-6"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), Destruction of cultural heritage by ISIL.

<a id="event-2016-01-20-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-01-20-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Moldova's parliament approves a new government despite ongoing protests calling for snap elections.

<a id="event-2016-01-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration announce that 2015 was the hottest year on record since the beginning of meteorological records in 1890.

Source citations (as archived): [NASA](<http://www.giss.nasa.gov/research/news/20160120/>).

<a id="event-2016-01-20-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of astronomers at Caltech infer the existence of a potential new planet (Planet Nine) in the outer Solar System.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/speaking-of-science/wp/2016/01/20/new-evidence-suggests-a-ninth-planet-lurking-at-the-edge-of-the-solar-system/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-01-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Douglas Borough Council announces that the Douglas Bay Horse Tramway, at Douglas, Isle of Man, ran for the last time at the end of the 2015 season.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-isle-of-man-35380961>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-01-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Steve Zadesky, who has been running the electric car project for Apple Inc. for two years, will leave that company soon for personal reasons, according to the Wall Street Journal.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/apple-veteran-overseeing-electric-car-project-leaving-company-1453505241?tesla=y>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-01-22-2-1"></a>

Context: January 2016 United States blizzard.

**Archived source account.** Millions of people in the Mid-Atlantic states brace for a winter storm.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-35374741>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/01/21/us/winter-snowstorm-washington-blizzard/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-01-22-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United States government implements new restrictions to its visa waiver program which now requires, with limited exceptions, European, Japanese and Australian travelers to the United States who either have been visitors in the last five years to or are dual-citizens of Iran, Iraq, Syria and Sudan to obtain a travel visa. The new visa policies were mandated by legislation which was passed, in the aftermath of November 2015 Paris attacks, by Congress on the grounds of national security.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/01/21/politics/visa-waiver-program-change-isis-syria/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/01/22/us/politics/us-tightens-visa-rules-for-some-european-visitors.html?_r=0>); [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/us-enforcing-new-visa-rules-iran-iraq/27502955.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-22-4-1"></a>

Context: La Loche shootings.

**Archived source account.** A former La Loche Community School student shot and killed two brothers at home, and two females, one a teacher, at the school in La Loche, Saskatchewan, Canada, while injuring others. A suspect has been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/saskatchewan/la-loche-community-school-lock-down-jan22-1.3416143>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-shooting-idUSKCN0V02KT>).

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1901323/wei-hong-governor-chinas-sichuan-province-under>).

### 2016-01-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1349243773](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20January%2023&oldid=1349243773>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-01-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Deir ez-Zor offensive (January 2016).

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes on Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant-controlled areas in Syria's eastern Deir ez-Zor Governorate, leaves at least 47 civilians dead, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

<a id="event-2016-01-23-1-1"></a>

Context: January 2016 United States blizzard.

**Archived source account.** This potentially record storm, which is predicted to generate blizzard conditions through a third day on Sunday, has caused at least 10 deaths, knocked out power to hundreds of thousands, led to more than 8,300 canceled flights, stranded many travelers on major highways and, with up to 70 mph winds, produced record-high tides along the Delaware and New Jersey shores.

<a id="event-2016-01-25-1-0"></a>

The shut off will allow the replacement of two 115-year-old pedestrian stone bridges that are unsafe for the public.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1629277/niagara-falls-could-be-shut-off-to-fix-bridges>).

<a id="event-2016-01-25-2-5"></a>

Alabama (2012)), had to be applied retroactively, potentially affecting 1300 to 2300 cases nationally.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-01-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Moldova–Romania relations.

**Archived source account.** Romania offers neighboring Moldova a $65 million (60 million euros) loan to help stave off economic collapse and keep the former Soviet Republic on a pro-European course, provided the Moldovan government implements major reforms. Government funds were needed to cover more than $1 billion that "disappeared" from three Moldovan banks in November 2014. In the frigid capital Chișinău, 15,000 people from both the pro-European and pro-Russian sides of the political divide, protested on Sunday against the current government and demanded new elections. Prime Minister Pavel Filip, who took office last week, is the country's sixth PM in a year.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_ROMANIA_MOLDOVA?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-romania-moldova-politics-idUSKCN0V41JK>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/01/26/world/europe/oppositions-groups-in-moldova-unite-to-protest-new-government.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-01-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Malaysia Najib Razak is cleared of corruption by the Attorney-General of Malaysia Apandi Ali after returning US$607 million worth of donations to his personal account from the Saudi Royal Family.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/pm-najib-cleared-after/2458506.html>).

<a id="event-2016-01-26-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in the People's Republic of China say that Wang Baoan is under suspicion for "serious violation of discipline" (a phrase usually associated with corruption charges) as the head of that country's powerful National Bureau of Statistics.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-35410963>).

<a id="event-2016-01-26-5-3"></a>

Context: Occupation of the Malheur National Wildlife Refuge.

**Archived source account.** U.S. federal authorities arrest militia leader Ammon Bundy and several of his followers following an exchange of gunfire at a traffic stop on U.S. Route 395 in Harney County, Oregon. One person, LaVoy Finicum, a rancher from Arizona and spokesman for the militia, was killed in the shootout.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/01/26/us/oregon-wildlife-refuge-siege-arrests/index.html>); [Oregon Live](<http://www.oregonlive.com/oregon-standoff/2016/01/bundys_in_custody_one_militant.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/two-killed-three-wounded-shooting-seattle-s-jungle-homeless-camp-n504931>); [seattlepi.com](<http://www.seattlepi.com/local/crime/article/As-homeless-crisis-continues-2-dead-at-notorious-6786591.php>).

<a id="event-2016-01-26-5-7"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2016/01/27/milwaukee-man-arrested-after-allegedly-plotting-mass-shooting-we-will-eliminate-everyone/>); [Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](<http://www.jsonline.com/news/crime/fbi-thwarts-mass-shooting-at-milwaukee-masonic-temple-b99659005z1-366609371.html>); [FBI](<http://www.justice.gov/usao-edwi/pr/federal-bureau-investigation-arrests-milwaukee-man-who-planned-mass-shooting-man>).

This is challenging the ability of Western democracies to help and also challenging the very structures underlying the idea of Europe".

Editorial date: 2016-02-06. Checked: 2026-10-22. The award is confirmed. The racial first and McNair shared-award chronology were not established by the opened team announcement and remain unsubstantiated in this review.

Evidence: [Carolina Panthers](<https://www.panthers.com/news/cam-newton-named-nfl-mvp-16796069>).

Original source account: Carolina Panthers quarterback Cam Newton is named MVP. Newton becomes the first black quarterback to win the award outright (Steve McNair shared the award in 2004 with Peyton Manning).

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2016-02-06-6-5"></a>

### 2016-02-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1093735153](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%207&oldid=1093735153>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-02-07-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Taiwan earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from yesterday's earthquake in Taiwan rises to at least 29, with at least 120 trapped under collapsed buildings in Tainan, while 198 people have been rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/2fd6d480622e44599c7f95e4b281df0d/5-dead-hundreds-rescued-and-injured-quake-rattles-taiwan>); [Taipei Times](<http://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2016/02/08/2003639061>).

<a id="event-2016-02-07-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man is killed and three other employees are injured following a suspected meteorite strike in a garden outside the Bharathidasan Engineering College in Tamil Nadu, India. Witnesses say they saw a mysterious object fall from the sky. If confirmed, this would be the first recorded fatality from a meteorite strike.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<http://metro.co.uk/2016/02/07/one-dead-after-meteorite-crashes-to-earth-in-college-gardens-5667122/>); [The Indian Express](<http://indianexpress.com/article/india/india-news-india/tamil-nadu-one-killed-three-injured-in-blast-at-engineering-college/>).

<a id="event-2016-02-07-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and six others injured in an explosion at JCG Farms, an American feed mill near Atlanta, Georgia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/875ae173a4694c4cb90c1580a4409beb/1-person-killed-plant-explosion-georgia>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-02-07-1-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea launches a long range rocket that critics claim is a test of banned technology for a long range missile that could hit the United States. South Korea's military says the rocket released an object into orbit.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/seoul-north-korea-fires-rocket-seen-as-covert-missile-test/2016/02/06/826e42ee-cd33-11e5-b9ab-26591104bb19_story.html?wpisrc=al_alert-COMBO-world%252Bnation>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/02/06/asia/north-korea-rocket-launch-window/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-satellite-idUSKCN0VG00H>).

<a id="event-2016-02-07-1-2"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** Japan's NHK news reports the rocket passed over the southern Japanese island of Okinawa. Japanese Prime Minister, Shinzō Abe, condemns the launch and says, "We absolutely cannot allow this. We will take action to totally protect the safety and well-being of our people". The Japanese government says no rocket debris fell on Japanese territory and there are no reports of damage. The rocket reportedly falls into waters southwest of Jeju Island.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160208031945/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/latest-japan-tv-shows-missiles-ready-launch-36762575>); [Yonhap](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160210015432/http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2016/02/07/0200000000AEN20160207001500315.html?input=www.tweeter.com>).

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2016/02/07/0200000000AEN20160207007100315.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-07-1-4"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council condemns North Korea's long-range missile launch, a violation of numerous U.N. resolutions.

<a id="event-2016-02-09-2-4"></a>

Context: Bad Aibling rail accident.

**Archived source account.** Two passenger trains collide in the German town of Bad Aibling in the state of Bavaria. At least ten people are dead, one person is missing and presumed dead, about 80 are injured, and 17 are seriously or critically injured. The rescue is difficult – resembling a mountain-type rescue – because of a nearby river and a steep incline and a curve in the tracks; rescue helicopters had to be used. It is one of Bavaria's and Germany's deadliest-ever railroad accidents. Human error is being examined as a possibility.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35530538>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/02/09/europe/germany-train-collision/>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/election-us-2016-35526323>).

<a id="event-2016-02-09-4-4"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, New Hampshire primary.

**Archived source account.** New York businessman Donald Trump wins the Republican Party primary while Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders wins the Democratic Party primary. This makes Sanders the first Jewish and the first self-described democratic socialist to win a U.S. presidential primary. Barry Goldwater, the 1964 Republican presidential nominee, was the first winner of Jewish heritage, but was a Christian.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2016-election/trump-sanders-sweep-victory-new-hampshire-primaries-nbc-news-n515191?cid=eml_nbn_20160209>); [The Week](<http://theweek.com/speedreads/604757/bernie-sanders-becomes-first-jewish-nonchristian-candidate-win-primary>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/02/04/politics/bernie-sanders-jewish-new-hampshire-primary/>); [The Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/bernie-sanders-wins-new-hampshire_us_56ba4d2ce4b08ffac122ff50>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/02/04/politics/bernie-sanders-jewish-new-hampshire-primary/index.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

A Tobruk-based military source said the pilot survived having parachuted to safety, but his whereabouts were not immediately clear.

<a id="event-2016-02-12-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Cairo, thousands of doctors protest against police impunity following the assault, allegedly by Egyptian police officers, of two doctors in a hospital last week. Protests here are rare since enactment of a law limiting demonstrations to those with prior police approval. Another protest is planned across all hospitals for February 20.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-protests-police-idUSKCN0VL21O>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-12-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Stuart Robert representing the Liberal Party, Australia's Minister for Veterans' Affairs and for Human Services, resigns for breaching ministerial standards during his 2014 business trip to China while Assistant Minister for Defence.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/3b6325d03237462aa56d33e0f9d0ab7c/australian-minister-resigns-breaching-code-conduct>).

<a id="event-2016-02-12-6-2"></a>

Context: South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Salva Kiir, the President of South Sudan, appoints rebel leader Riek Machar as Vice President in a bid to end a two year civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-02-12/south-sudan-president-kiir-appoints-rebel-leader-as-his-deputy>).

<a id="event-2016-02-12-6-4"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Jim Gilmore suspends his campaign for the Republican Party nomination.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2016/feb/12/us-presidential-election-2016-campaign-live-clinton-sanders-trump-cruz>).

<a id="event-2016-02-12-6-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate confirms the nominations of the ambassadors to Norway and Sweden, and of two State Department officials once Senator Ted Cruz lifted his months-long hold on the nominations because of his objection to the Iran nuclear deal (JCPOA).

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/ambassadors-sweden-norway-confirmed-sen-cruz-lifts-hold-n517671>); [St. Paul Pioneer Press](<http://www.twincities.com/2016/02/12/minneapolis-lawyer-ambassador-norway/>); [Iranian.com](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160215093734/http://iranian.com/posts/iranian-born-american-azita-raji-the-designated-us-ambassador-to-65781>); [State](<http://www.state.gov/secretary/remarks/2016/02/252468.htm>).

### 2016-02-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1093788238](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2013&oldid=1093788238>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia is sending troops and fighter jets to Turkey's Incirlik Air Base ahead of a planned ground invasion of Syria. Turkey's Minister of Foreign Affairs Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu confirmed the deployment in Adana near the Syria–Turkey border, but said the numbers had not been confirmed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/saudi-arabia-sends-troops-and-fighter-jets-to-military-base-in-turkey-ahead-of-intervention-against-a6871611.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says its military shelled Kurdish PYD positions in Azaz, in northern Syria. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports the Menagh Military Airbase and a nearby village, recently captured by the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces group, were also hit.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/mideast-crisis-syria-turkey-shelling-idINKCN0VM0QB>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government forces, backed by Russian air strikes, capture another rebel-held village near Aleppo, according to a Russian source. In the last two days, the Syrian Army captured positions at the Hama and Raqqa provincial border, and is set to move against the Islamic State in the Raqqa Governorate, according to a Syrian military source.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/mideast-crisis-syria-idINKCN0VN03B>); [AP](<http://www.observer-reporter.com/20160213/syria_truce_hopes_dim_as_fighting_rages>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Asked to assess the chances of the ceasefire deal succeeding, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov says 49 percent while German Foreign Minister Frank-Walter Steinmeier says 51 percent

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/mideast-crisis-syria-idINKCN0VN03B>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Several Sangin security force members are killed by Taliban suicide attacks, using captured military Humvee vehicles, in the southern Afghan province of Helmand.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/afghanistan-taliban-idINKCN0VM0UH>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** Ansar Dine, a militant Islamist group linked to Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb claims responsibility for yesterday's attack on a United Nations base in Kidal, northern Mali, that killed six UN peacekeepers, all from neighboring Guinea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-attacks-idUSKCN0VM09U>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-02-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Taiwan earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the earthquake rises to 113 with four people still in the rubble of the Weiguan Golden Dragon high-rise tower in Tainan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160214084330/http://www.philly.com/philly/news/nation_world/20160212_ap_4f0465e739aa4976805948b3daaec577.html#ULp1a2KsjD4q751E.99>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A huge fire engulfs the under-construction Abu Dhabi Plaza in Astana, Kazakhstan.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/332323-abu-dhabi-fire-astana/>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A dangerous cold snap hits the northeastern United States with the city of Boston, Massachusetts, to face its coldest Valentine's Day in four decades.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-weather-idUSKCN0VM0O6?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and more than 50 hospitalized from a 50-plus-car pileup amid strong winds and a whiteout along, the now closed, I-78 near Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, in the U.S. More than 70 people are in a shelter at Jonestown Fire Station.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/pileup-involving-dozens-cars-shuts-pennsylvania-interstate-amid-strong-winds-n518066>); [Philadelphia Inquirer](<http://www.philly.com/philly/news/breaking/20160214_More_than_50_vehicles_in_crash_on_I-78_in_Berks.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Geological Survey reports a magnitude 5.1 earthquake strike in Oklahoma, the state's third strongest quake, northwest of Oklahoma City. No damage or injuries are reported. Oklahoma has recently experienced a surge in seismic activity, leading to calls for the governor to make changes to oil- and gas-drilling regulations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-oklahoma-quake-idUSKCN0VM0ST>); [USGS](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160216003803/http://www.usgs.gov/blogs/features/usgs_top_story/magnitude-5-1-earthquake-in-oklahoma/?from=title>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-02-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Cold War II.

**Archived source account.** At the 52nd Munich Security Conference in Germany, NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg says that NATO and Russia are "not in a cold-war situation but also not in the partnership that we established at the end of the Cold War" while the Russian Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev says tensions between Russia and NATO have sent the world spiralling into a "new Cold War", blaming U.S. and European leaders for the souring of relations with Russia. He also rejected accusations that Russian warplanes have bombed civilians in Syria, saying it is "just not true".

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1641413/world-in-new-cold-war-says-russian-pm>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35569094>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-2-3"></a>

Context: India–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** India summons the U.S. Ambassador to India Richard Verma over the U.S. decision to sell more F-16 fighter jets to Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/us-sale-of-f16s-to-pakistan-india-expresses-disappointment-says-such-arms-transfers-will-help-combat-terrorism/article8231832.ece>).

<a id="event-2016-02-13-2-5"></a>

Context: Holy See–Mexico relations.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis's apostolic journey to Mexico is February 12 to 18. On the first full day in Mexico, the pope addresses political leaders at the National Palace, speaks to bishops at the Mexico City Metropolitan Cathedral, and celebrates Mass at the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic World News](<http://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/en/travels/2016/outside/documents/papa-francesco-messico-2016.html>).
