Context: ASEAN Summit.

**Archived source account.** United States President Barack Obama hosts a two-day summit in Rancho Mirage, California with leaders of the ASEAN member states, including democratically-elected Benigno Aquino III of the Philippines and Joko Widodo of Indonesia as well as autocratic rulers such as Hun Sen of Cambodia and Najib Razak of Malaysia.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/asia/la-fg-asean-summit-qa-20160215-story.html>); [White House](<https://www.whitehouse.gov/the-press-office/2016/02/15/remarks-president-obama-opening-session-us-asean-summit>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister of Israel Ehud Olmert starts a 19-month prison sentence for bribery and obstructing justice. In the last decade, he was found or admitted guilty in four different corruption investigations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/israels-olmert-denies-wrongdoing-heads-prison-063018941.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-15-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two German intelligence officers are suspected of having given money to Al Qaeda in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputniknews](<http://sputniknews.com/europe/20160215/1034773754/germany-agents-al-qaeda.html>); [Berliner Morgenpost](<http://www.morgenpost.de/incoming/article207041801/Bundesanwaelte-ermitteln-gegen-Verfassungsschuetzer.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-15-5-1"></a>

Context: Central African general election, 2015–16.

**Archived source account.** Officials are counting ballots from Sunday's presidential election. The final results of the run-off are not expected for several weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Special Broadcasting Service](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2016/02/16/counting-begins-central-african-republic-vote>).

### 2016-02-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1093789281](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2016&oldid=1093789281>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-16-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Three Americans abducted last month in Baghdad are freed by the Iraqi National Intelligence Service.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.ocregister.com/articles/iraqi-704313-iraq-government.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-02-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The jewels of former Philippine First Lady Imelda Marcos are to be auctioned. Valued at $21 million (USD), they were seized by the government when her husband Ferdinand Marcos was overthrown.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/02/16/luxury/imelda-marcos-jewelery-auction/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-35583699>).

<a id="event-2016-02-16-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** After more than 200 years, Mozart's and Salieri's lost cantata Per la ricuperata salute di Ofelia is discovered in Prague.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-czech-mozart-idUSKCN0VP1PQ>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/mozart-wolfgang-amadeus-antonio-salieri-lorenzo-da-ponte-libretto-a6873481.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35589422>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-02-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Cuba sign an agreement restoring commercial air traffic between the two countries for the first time in 50 years. The U.S. Department of Transportation immediately opened bidding for as many as 110 U.S.-Cuba flights per day to Havana and nine other destinations. Travel from the U.S. is permitted in 12 authorized categories, which does not include tourism.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/38bd18dd7e8449cebdcece9115962457/us-cuba-sign-deal-commercial-flights>); [AFP](<http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/news/US-authorizes-up-to-110-daily-flights-to-Cuba>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four American journalists are charged by Bahrain for "unlawful obstruction of vehicles and attending unlawful gatherings." The state-run Bahrain News Agency said all were released "pending further investigations." Freelance reporter Anna Day and a film crew, who were covering the fifth anniversary of the Arab Spring uprisings, are scheduled to fly to Dubai tonight.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/bahrain-charges-releases-anna-day-3-other-american-journalists-n519291>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/american-journalists-arrested-bahrain-charged-released-article-1.2533077>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Philippine Senate election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Filipino Senate candidate and boxer Manny Pacquiao calls LGBT people "less than animals" when asked about his opposition to same-sex marriage, prompting condemnation from prominent Filipino LGBT figures such as Aiza Seguerra, John Lapus and Vice Ganda. Pacquiao later apologizes.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/02/16/466922420/manny-pacquiao-apologizes-for-comparing-homosexuals-to-animals>); [The New York Times](<http://mobile.nytimes.com/2016/02/17/sports/manny-pacquiao-apologizes-for-calling-gays-worse-than-animals.html?referer=https://www.google.com/>); [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/entertainment/news/122633-celebrities-manny-pacquiao-same-sex-marriage>).

### 2016-02-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1298960812](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2017&oldid=1298960812>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-17-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills at least 13 recruits at a Yemeni Army base run by forces loyal to ousted President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi in the southern port city of Aden. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claim responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-idUSKCN0VQ0Y0>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-0-3"></a>

Context: February 2016 Ankara bombing.

**Archived source account.** Military vehicles explode outside a Turkish Armed Forces barracks in Ankara, Turkey, killing at least 28 people and injuring 61 others. Authorities believe a car bomb caused the blast. A senior Turkish security source says initial signs indicate that the outlawed Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) are responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35599323>); [Time](<http://time.com/4227608/ankara-turkey-explosion/>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/1.703936>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/02/17/asia/turkey-ankara-explosion/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi authorities are searching for 10 grams of iridium-192, a radioactive material stolen from a Weatherford International oilfield services facility near Basra in November 2015. Authorities are concerned about its potential use by Islamic State, or the like, to develop a dirty bomb weapon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-radiation-idUSKCN0VQ22F>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-0-6"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** An Iraqi Air Force helicopter is shot down by ISIL near Amiriyah Fallujah, Al Anbar Governorate, killing at least one crew member and injuring another.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2016/02/17/-ISIS-shoots-down-Iraqi-army-helicopter-killing-one-Officials-.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) reports three people are found alive in the rubble of a hospital in northwest Syria hit by Russian airstrikes Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/02/17/Three-rescued-from-rubble-of-destroyed-MSF-hospital-in-Syria/3021455710106/?spt=hts&amp;or=8>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-02-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Experts confirm the discovery of a lost Spanish settlement in Florida from an expedition led by Tristan de Luna.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160219224928/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/sleuth-finds-a-lost-spanish-settlement-in-florida-panhandle/ar-BBpBxob?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-02-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran says that it plans to increase its crude oil output until it achieves pre-sanction levels, although that contravenes OPEC efforts to restrain output.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-opec-oil-iran-idUSKCN0VQ17P>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canadian multinational aerospace and transportation company Bombardier Inc. is to cut 7,000 jobs worldwide over the next two years, including over a thousand jobs in the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2016/feb/17/bombardier-7000-job-losses-worldwide>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-02-17-3-1"></a>

Context: South Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Four U.S. F-22 stealth fighters, escorted by other U.S. and South Korean jets, flew low over the Osan Air Base in a show of force following North Korea's recent rocket launch. The Yonhap news agency reported two of these stealth planes will be deployed in South Korea "for a while."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35593009>); [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/national/2016/02/17/71/0301000000AEN20160217006700315F.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-3-3"></a>

Context: Hungary–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán meets with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. Orbán used the meeting to call for Russia's relations with the EU to "return to normal", saying "We all are interested in normalizing relationship between Russia and Europe" while Putin described Hungary as an "old and faithful partner".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-hungary-eu-idUSKCN0VQ1AF>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/332749-putin-orban-meeting-moscow/>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-3-5"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** A report by the Taiwanese Defense Ministry states that China has placed surface-to-air missiles on the disputed Woody Island. Taiwanese President-elect Tsai Ing-wen called on all parties to "exercise self-control based on the principle of peaceful resolution of disputes in the South China Sea," while Harry B. Harris Jr., commander of the US Pacific Fleet, said that such a move would be "a militarization of the South China Sea in ways" that Mainland China's leader Xi Jinping had pledged not to make.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-35592988>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/02/16/asia/china-missiles-south-china-sea/>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-3-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Germany calls for a no-fly zone in northern Syria which could, among other things, reduce the number of displaced Syrians. Similar requests have been made by Turkey and others throughout the 5-year-old war. Russia rejects this strategy without Syria's consent.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/syria-aid-convoys-prepare-to-head-to-besieged-areas/2016/02/17/c111830c-d559-11e5-a65b-587e721fb231_story.html>); [Macau Daily Times](<http://macaudailytimes.com.mo/german-leader-renews-call-for-syria-no-fly-zone.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Royal Air Force Typhoons intercept two Russian Tupolev Tu-160 strategic bombers heading towards UK airspace over the North Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1643693/raf-jets-scrambled-to-intercept-russian-bombers>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-3-10"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia's Finance Ministry sues Ukraine in London's High Court of Justice over a $3 billion debt. Payment was due December 21, 2015. Negotiations between Kiev and Moscow have not reached an agreement. Over the last 6 months Ukrainian government officials repeatedly stated they refuse to pay the debt.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/02/17/Russia-sues-Ukraine-over-debt-repayment-in-London-court/3241455738661/?spt=rln&amp;or=2>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-17-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Maldives jails opposition leader Sheikh Imran Abdulla for terrorism. It is claimed that he urged the overthrow of the government in a speech.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35593011>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc. says it will appeal a court order to create a backdoor for an iPhone 5C belonging to Syed Farook who conducted the 2015 San Bernardino attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Tech Crunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2016/02/17/tim-cook-apple-wont-create-backdoor-to-unlock-san-bernardino-attackers-iphone/>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-4-3"></a>

Context: Transgender and schools.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, the South Dakota legislature passes a bill requiring students, even those identifying as transgender, to use the school bathroom corresponding to their sex at birth. It now moves to Governor Dennis Daugaard for his approval or veto.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/south-dakota-passes-bill-bathrooms-transgender-students/>); [The Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Politics/2016/0217/South-Dakota-lawmakers-move-to-ban-transgender-bathrooms>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egyptian authorities order the closure of the Egyptian branch of the International Rehabilitation Council for Torture Victims (IRCT), a prominent NGO that documents alleged human rights abuses and treats torture victims. Amnesty International condemns the closure of the Nadeem centre, saying the NGO gives a lifeline to hundreds of victims of torture and families of people subjected to enforced disappearances.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-egypt-rights-idUKKCN0VQ23F>).

<a id="event-2016-02-17-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian authorities are investigating the discovery of at least 100 dismembered bodies in a sewer system underneath La Modelo prison in Bogotá. Officials say the practice of killing, dismembering, and tossing body parts into drains might have also happened at prisons in other cities, e.g., Popayán, Bucaramanga and Barranquilla. The victims include inmates, visitors, and others.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/02/18/americas/colombia-prison-bodies/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Ugandan general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Ruhakana Rugunda says tomorrow’s presidential and parliamentary elections will be peaceful, and urges all registered citizens to vote. Seven candidates are vying to unseat President Museveni, who has been in office since 1986.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160217084044/http://www.voanews.com/content/uganda-prime-minister-assures-citizens-of-peaceful-election/3194352.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-02-17-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UEFA Europa League.

**Archived source account.** UEFA charges Dmitri Tarasov and his football club Lokomotiv Moscow with improper conduct after Tarasov, following Lokomotiv Moscow's loss to Fenerbahçe S.K., pulled off his team's jersey to reveal an undershirt that was emblazoned with a picture of Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35593324>); [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/bottles-thrown-lokomotiv-team-bus-turkey-093425053.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-18-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-02-18-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis indicates that contraceptives could be allowed, as the "lesser of two evils" vis-à-vis the sin of abortion, in addressing the life-threatening problem the Zika virus presents. He noted that Pope Paul VI, "in a difficult situation in Africa, permitted nuns to use contraceptives in cases of rape".

<a id="event-2016-02-18-4-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea's National Intelligence Service warns that North Korea is currently planning a "terrorist attack" on South Korea, saying Kim Jong-un himself gave the order to North Korea's State Security Department to make preparations for attacks. <a id="event-2016-02-18-6-1"></a>

Context: Philippine Senate election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Nike, Inc. drops Manny Pacquiao as an endorser after his remarks about LGBT people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/boxing/35600341>); [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/kurtbadenhausen/2016/02/17/nike-drops-manny-pacquiao-for-a-second-tim-after-anti-gay-comments/#379531335fab>).

**Archived source account.** Voters in Uganda go to the polls for a general election to elect a new President of Uganda as well as for parliamentary and local elections. <a id="event-2016-02-18-6-4"></a>

Context: Ugandan general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The government shuts down social media at the request of the electoral commission which says it is a security matter. Many Ugandans access Twitter and Facebook via a Virtual private network (VPN) which masks a user's location.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Times](<http://www.dailytimes.com.pk/foreign/19-Feb-2016/voting-in-uganda-plagued-by-delays-social-media-shut-down>); [Quartz](<http://qz.com/619188/ugandan-citizens-say-twitter-and-facebook-have-been-blocked-as-the-election-gets-underway/>).

Context: Ugandan general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Kizza Besigye, the main opposition presidential candidate, is "briefly" arrested after the polls close in Naguru, trying to get into a police command center in the capital Kampala. Besigye, who's challenged President Musveni in the last three elections, has been repeatedly arrested, roughed up, or confined to house arrest during that time.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/world/africa/2016/02/19/uganda-candidate-arrested-after-voting.html>); [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/ugandan-president-bans-social-media-arrests-rival-during-election/article28806058/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/02/19/world/africa/top-opposition-candidate-in-uganda-is-arrested-on-election-day.html?_r=0>).

**Archived source account.** Łukasz Kamiński, head of the Institute of National Remembrance says a newly found document, seized this week from the house of Poland's last communist-era interior minister, Czesław Kiszczak, suggests that former Polish President Lech Wałęsa was an informant for the Polish People's Republic's secret security service during the 1970–76 period.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-02-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Zealand Prime Minister John Key says his country is willing to accept some asylum seekers from the Middle East and Asia, currently in detention camps on impoverished Pacific island nations. Presently, 267 refugees in Australia for medical treatment, some accompanied by a relative, are set to be returned to Nauru’s detention camp. Australia is hesitant about the offer, concerned that it could encourage people smugglers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/new-zealand-offers-to-take-australias-unwanted-refugees/2016/02/18/2cedca8a-d6af-11e5-a65b-587e721fb231_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-19-5-4"></a>

Context: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-19-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Justice files a motion to compel Apple Inc. to comply with a court order to help the FBI hack a phone used by an attacker in the 2015 San Bernardino attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2016/02/19/doj-files-motion-to-compel-apple-to-comply-with-fbi-order.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-19-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** John McAfee, creator of the anti-virus software McAfee, Inc. and former CEO, offers to unlock an iPhone that belonged to San Bernardino attacker Syed Farook for the FBI for free after Apple Inc. refused to comply with a court order asking it to unlock the device. McAfee said "It will take us three weeks," with access to a super-computer in an article published by the Business Insider.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/john-mcafee-ill-decrypt-san-bernardino-phone-for-free-2016-2>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-35611763>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-19-7-1"></a>

Context: Ugandan general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Opposition leader Kizza Besigye is arrested again just before a planned press conference. Police raid Besigye's Forum for Democratic Change party headquarters and fire tear gas at the FDC supporters. Partial results from the electoral commission show a lead for incumbent president Yoweri Museveni.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-africa-35518162>).

<a id="event-2016-02-19-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kosovo opposition lawmakers twice disrupt today's session of parliament by tossing tear gas into the chamber to protest recent changes giving the country's Serb minority greater powers, and demanding the government’s resignation and snap elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<http://www.arabnews.com/world/news/883191>); [AFP](<http://www.globalpost.com/article/6735229/2016/02/19/kosovo-mps-stage-new-tear-gas-protest-parliament>).

<a id="event-2016-02-19-7-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to Indian Police, at least one person is killed and up to 20 people injured during, what became violent, protests by the Jat agricultural community in Rohtak, India, for a 10 percent increase in the number of their caste quota (affirmative action).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/1-dead-as-protests-for-caste-benefits-turn-violent-in-india/2016/02/19/380eff5a-d705-11e5-a65b-587e721fb231_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-19-7-5"></a>

Context: United States congressional elections, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Following the United States Supreme Court's denial of North Carolina's request to use the current district map, the state's legislature meets the deadline for a court-ordered reapportionment of its congressional voting districts. Congressional primaries are rescheduled to June 7, 2016, from March 15.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-politics-north-carolina-idUSKCN0VT04N>); [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-north-carolina-congressional-map-redistricting-20160219-story.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-02-22-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 South Pacific cyclone season / Cyclone Winston.

<a id="event-2016-02-22-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** German Interior Minister Thomas de Maizière strongly criticizes Austria's decision to put a daily cap on the number of refugees the country can accept. Austria has set a limit of dealing with 80 asylum applications a day, while letting thousands of others transit to Germany. Maiziere said this sends "the wrong signal" and is "unacceptable".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/german-interior-minister-hits-unacceptable-austrian-asylum-cap-233249722.html>).

**Archived source account.** The United States and Russia broker a truce which is due to come into effect on midnight 27 February.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35634695>).

Context: Jat reservation agitation.

**Archived source account.** Jat protesters reach an agreement with the Indian government on increased reservations similar to those authorized for economically disadvantaged lower castes. Authorities say at least 19 people have been killed in the three-day demonstrations. Protest leaders call for reopening blockaded roads in the northern state of Haryana. Water restrictions, implemented after protesters damaged the water station's New Delhi feed, remain in effect while engineers repair the equipment.

<a id="event-2016-02-22-5-9"></a>

Context: Comorian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Comoros authorities are counting ballots from Sunday's incident-free, presidential primary on Grande Comore island. The presidency rotates between the nation’s three semi-autonomous islands, which also held gubernatorial elections. Provisional results are due Wednesday. Then, on April 10, 2016, the three leading candidates will vie in a runoff.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-02-22/comoros-islands-begin-counting-ballots-after-presidential-vote>).

<a id="event-2016-02-24-5-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hungary is to hold a referendum on whether to accept mandatory EU quotas for relocating migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35652655>).

<a id="event-2016-02-24-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea's opposition holds a parliamentary filibuster, the first in the National Assembly since 1969, to block the current anti-terrorism bill that would expand National Intelligence Service powers. The opposition plans to continue until March 11, when the session is scheduled to end.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/asia/la-fg-south-korea-parliament-filibuster-terror-bill-20160224-story.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3463220/S-Korea-lawmakers-filibuster-block-anti-terror-bill.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-02-24-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 FIFA corruption case.

**Archived source account.** Former President of FIFA Sepp Blatter and suspended President of UEFA boss Michel Platini lose their appeals against being banned from all football related activities but the period of the ban is reduced from eight to six years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/35655454>).

<a id="event-2016-02-24-6-2"></a>

Context: 2015 FIFA corruption case.

**Archived source account.** FIFA's Court of Arbitration for Sport denies presidential candidate Prince Ali bin Al Hussein of Jordan's request to postpone Friday's presidential election. Ali's request for transparent booths was rejected last week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/soccer-fifa-ali-idINKCN0VX2CJ>).

### 2016-02-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1349255602](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2025&oldid=1349255602>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-25-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian military retakes control of the strategic village of Shyrokyne.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukraine Today](<http://uatoday.tv/politics/ukrainian-military-reinstates-control-over-shyrokyne-598584.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Two ISIL suicide bombers attack a Shiite mosque in Baghdad, killing at least 15 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-blast-idUSKCN0VY2AH>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army, backed by Russian airstrikes, recaptures the town of Khanasir from ISIL militants in the Aleppo Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160226095310/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/syrian-army-recaptures-town-aleppo-province-group-37183639>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-02-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Celebrations are held to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the People Power Revolution in the Philippines that led to the downfall of dictator Ferdinand Marcos' 21-year reign, and the rise of President Corazon Aquino.

Source citations (as archived): [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/02/25/1556601/1986-people-power-philippiness-gift-world>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-02-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brookfield Asset Management, a Canadian asset manager, agrees to buy the U.S. REIT Rouse Properties for about $2.8 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-rouse-m-a-brookfield-asset-idUSKCN0VY1NN>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nikkei reports that Japan's Sharp Corporation has accepted a 700 billion Japanese yen ($6.2 billion) takeover bid from Taiwan's Foxconn Technology Group.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-02-25/sharp-agrees-to-6-2-billion-bailout-from-foxconn-nikkei-says>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian electronics retailer Dick Smith, placed in administration by creditors in January, will close 301 stores in Australia and 62 in New Zealand with nearly 3000 people to lose their jobs.

Source citations (as archived): [News Limited](<http://www.news.com.au/finance/business/retail/dick-smith-to-close-chain-to-shut-down-after-receivers-fail-to-win-acceptable-offers/news-story/4c0c9122f24d9ba6db04ddf40880037c?from=public_rss>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-02-25-3-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 South Pacific cyclone season / Cyclone Winston.

**Archived source account.** Fiji's known casualties are 42 dead, one missing, and more than 100 injured. Authorities say five percent of the country (45,245 people) is staying in evacuation centers and about 80 schools have been damaged. UNICEF reports at least 120,000 of Fiji's children have been affected. The current identified destruction is more than $1 billion. About 80 percent of the plantations were damaged, especially sugar fields. However, tourism's infrastructure has escaped serious damage.

Source citations (as archived): [La Prensa de San Antonio](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160227110814/http://www.laprensasa.com/309_america-in-english/3648122_at-least-120-000-children-affected-by-cyclone-winston-says-unicef.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3463347/Death-toll-Fiji-rises-44-10-month-old-baby-presumed-dead-catastrophic-Cyclone-Winston-tore-country-wiping-village.html>); [Fijivillage.com](<http://fijivillage.com/news-feature/5-of-Fijis-population-in-evacuation-centres-rsk259>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people of the same family are killed and 14 injured in a house explosion after a child accidentally set fire to the explosive material in Khuzdar district, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1241662/seven-of-a-family-die-in-khuzdar-house-blast>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-02-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016 North Korean nuclear test.

**Archived source account.** The United States will present the draft resolution, resulting from yesterday's meeting with China, to the United Nations Security Council expanding sanctions on North Korea over its nuclear program.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/US-says-to-present-draft-UN-sanctions-resolution-on-North-Korea-446038>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-nuclear-usa-idUSKCN0VY0ET>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-4-3"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** At an event hosted by Center for Strategic and International Studies, Foreign Minister Wang Yi expresses China's concerns that the planned deployment of the THAAD missile defense system and the X band radar for which the South Korea and the United States have started talks to secure its approval in order to counter the growing threat of North Korea's weapons capabilities could jeopardize the country's "legitimate national security interests." At the Pentagon, Harry Harris, the commander of U.S. forces in the Pacific, said that if China wanted to prevent consideration of the THAAD system's deployment, it should lean on Pyongyang saying, "If China wanted to exert a lot of influence on somebody to prevent THAAD from being considered going into Korea, then they should exert that influence on North Korea."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-north-korea-idUSKCN0VY2C9>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-02-25/china-questions-reach-of-potential-u-s-radar-system-in-s-korea>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-4-5"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Saudi Arabia, Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament adopts a resolution calling for the introduction of an arms embargo against Saudi Arabia, saying the United Kingdom, France and other EU governments should no longer sell weapons to a country accused of targeting civilians in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/eu-saudi-arms-idUKL8N164377>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-4-7"></a>

Context: Austria–Greece relations.

**Archived source account.** Greece recalls its ambassador to Austria in response to Austria's hosting of a meeting with Balkan states, to which Greece was not invited, about European migrant crisis policies that would make it harder for migrants to head north across Europe. Greece's foreign ministry called the move an "unfriendly act." More than 100,000 migrants have entered the EU illegally so far in 2016, nearly all of them arriving in Greece.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35658776>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-greece-austria-idUSKCN0VY1OP>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-4-9"></a>

Context: Morocco–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** Morocco suspends contact with the European Union over a European court ruling that invalidates the bloc's farm trade deal with Rabat, and saying it should exclude the disputed Moroccan-controlled territory of Western Sahara.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-eu-morocco-westernsahara-idUKKCN0VY273>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Jimmy Savile sexual abuse scandal.

**Archived source account.** A report by Dame Janet Smith finds that management at the BBC staff knew of complaints against Jimmy Savile but did not advise senior management due to a "culture of fear".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-35658398>).

<a id="event-2016-02-25-5-3"></a>

Context: Hesston shootings.

**Archived source account.** A series of shootings in and near the American town of Hesston, Kansas, results in at least four deaths, including the shooter, at an Excel Industries building, with up to 20 people injured. The shooter is Cedric Ford, a convicted felon. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [KWCH](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160226090216/http://www.kwch.com/news/local-news/police-responding-to-shooting-at-excel-industries-in-hesston/38197242>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2016/02/25/reports-2-dead-hesston-kansas-workplace-shooting/80954886/>); [KAKE](<http://www.kake.com/home/headlines/Woman-charged-with-transferring-firearms-to-Hesston-gunman-370325291.html?llsms=1292481&amp;c=y>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-25-6-1"></a>

Context: Jamaican general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Jamaica go to the polls for a general election, with the Jamaican Labour Party, led by Andrew Holness, winning a narrow victory.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-02-24/five-things-you-need-to-know-about-jamaica-s-elections>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-jamaica-election-idUSKCN0VZ09C>).

### 2016-02-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131710109](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2026&oldid=1131710109>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro Conflict, Operation Enduring Freedom – Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Philippine security forces kill as many as 42 ISIL-linked militants, and captures their stronghold in the predominantly Muslim Lanao del Sur province. Three Philippine Army soldiers were also killed during the fighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-militants-idUSKCN0VZ0J3>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab militants storm a Somali Youth League hotel in Mogadishu. At least 14 are reportedly killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/mogadishu-hotel-attack-live-updates-al-shabaab-islamists-somalia-a6898481.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/02/27/world/africa/at-least-14-dead-as-shabab-gunmen-attack-hotel-in-somalia.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Seven Libyan National Army soldiers are killed fighting ISIL militants in Benghazi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security-idUKKCN0VZ2V5>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-02-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dow Chemical agrees to pay $835 million to settle a decade-long, price-fixing, class-action dispute. Dow states that the uncertainty about the U.S. Supreme Court makeup following Justice Antonin Scalia's death means there is an "increased likelihood for unfavorable outcomes for business involved in class action suits." The urethane chemicals case, from 2005, was against a number of companies; Dow had been the only defendant not to settle.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-classactions-idUSKCN0VZ2TF>); [Reuters](<http://www.winnipegsun.com/2016/02/26/dow-chemical-settles-price-fixing-case>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A federal appeals court rules in favor of Samsung on several issues arising out of that company's long-running patent dispute with Apple, overturning a $120 million jury verdict in Apple's favor in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/apple-samsung-elec-appeal-idUSKCN0VZ27R>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-02-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Air Kasthamandap Flight 9N-AJB, from Nepalgunj headed to the Jumla District, crashes in a field in the Kalikot District mountains in northern Nepal, killing the two pilots and injuring all nine passengers, one seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/02/26/asia/second-nepal-plane-crash/>); [The Kathmandu Post](<http://kathmandupost.ekantipur.com/news/2016-02-26/air-kastamandap-plane-crash-lands-at-kalikots.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-02-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Because of the risk of Zika virus infection, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends pregnant women consider not traveling to Brazil for the 2016 Summer Olympics in August, and/or for the 2016 Summer Paralympics the following month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-zika-olympics-idUSKCN0VZ32K>); [CDC](<http://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/alert/2016-summer-olympics-rio>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2016-02-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian cessation of hostilities truce is in effect, as of midnight, Saturday, local Syrian time (10:00 p.m. UTC Friday/5:00 p.m. EST Friday).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-cessation-idUSKCN0VZ2Z6>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-4-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War peace process.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council, via resolution 2268, endorses the truce which has been agreed to by nearly 100 rebel factions. The ceasefire does not apply to military actions against terrorist organizations, such as ISIL and Jabhat al-Nusra (al-Qaeda in Syria).

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/333784-un-security-syria-resolution/>); [text](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160315104320/http://www.state.gov/r/pa/prs/ps/2016/02/253115.htm>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War peace process.

**Archived source account.** United Nations special envoy Staffan de Mistura says, assuming the ceasefire holds, he will reconvene formal peace talks in Geneva, Switzerland, on Monday, March 7.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/12175668/Syrian-peace-talks-to-resume-if-ceasefire-holds.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven prison inmates are killed in Papua New Guinea while trying to break out of Buimo jail in Lae as part of a 90 person jail break.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35666273>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following yesterday's Constitutional Court of Turkey ruling that their rights had been violated, two Turkish journalists, jailed on terrorism charges, are released after 92 days in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.globalpost.com/article/6738253/2016/02/25/jailed-opposition-journalists-rights-violated-turkey>); [Journal of Turkish Weekly](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160227122232/http://turkishweekly.net/2016/02/26/news/arrested-turkish-journalists-released-after-92-days-in-prison/>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gunman from a rural area near Belfair, Washington (U.S.), kills four members of his family, including two children, and, after a multi-hour standoff with police, also kills himself. A 12-year old girl, who was not shot, is alive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<http://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/crime/officials-investigating-mans-claim-he-shot-4-people-in-belfair/>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The University of California, Berkeley alerts 80,000 people of a cyber-attack on a system that stores Social Security and bank account numbers. There is no evidence the hacker(s) took any personal information.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sanfrancisco-cyber-idUSKCN0VZ2RL>).

#### Politics and election

<a id="event-2016-02-26-6-1"></a>

Context: Iranian elections, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Iran go to the polls for an Islamic Consultative Assembly and Assembly of Experts elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/02/26/world/middleeast/iran-elections-q-and-a.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-6-3"></a>

Context: Irish general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Ireland go to the polls for a general election. Exit polls indicate that the ruling coalition of Fine Gael party led by Enda Kenny and the Labour Party will fall short of re-election with 34% of the vote between them.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35652423>); [AAP](<http://www.news.com.au/world/breaking-news/irish-pm-falls-short-of-re-election-poll/news-story/5d8bcce66c6034fb885adda129d3d16e?from=public_rss>).

<a id="event-2016-02-26-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hashim Thaçi is elected the President of Kosovo by the Parliament amid violent protests.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35674917>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-02-26-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Air Force unveils the Northrop Grumman B-21 long-range strategic bomber at the Air Force Association’s annual Air Warfare Symposium in Orlando, Florida. The B-21 is designed to replace the aging fleet of B-1 Lancer and B-52 bombers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/checkpoint/wp/2016/02/26/air-force-releases-first-image-of-its-new-long-range-bomber/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-02-26-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Officials of FIFA meet in Zürich for the 2016 FIFA Extraordinary Congress to select a new President of FIFA to replace Sepp Blatter. Gianni Infantino is elected with a majority of votes in the second round of voting.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/35654894>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/sports/sportsnow/la-sp-sn-fifa-election-20160226-story.html>).

### 2016-02-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1093910169](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2027&oldid=1093910169>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A truce is in effect, as of midnight. Russian Air Force attacks on opposition positions were reported to have been intensified before the truce took effect.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35674908>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills at least 26 and injures nearly 50 in Afghanistan's eastern Kunar Province near the border with Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.news.com.au/world/breaking-news/suicide-bomber-kills-11-at-afghan-compound/news-story/53af4814d4fe82818f0e0601e77379ba?from=public_rss>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/02/28/world/asia/suicide-bombing-in-eastern-afghanistan-kills-at-least-12.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-0-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present) / Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are killed in an airstrike on a market near the Yemeni capital Sana'a.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35678326>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are stabbed, including one person critically wounded, and several people are arrested after a Ku Klux Klan (KKK) rally in Anaheim, California turns violent.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-klan-rally-in-anaheim-erupts-in-violence-one-man-stabbed-20160227-story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-27-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in South Carolina go to the polls for the Democratic Party primary. Hillary Clinton won.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/live-south-carolina-democratic-primary-exit-poll-analysis/story?id=37241467>); [AL.com](<http://www.al.com/news/index.ssf/2016/02/south_carolina_democratic_prim.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2016/feb/27/south-carolina-democratic-primary-hillary-clinton-bernie-sanders-campaign-live>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-2-3"></a>

Context: Irish general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Counting begins of the votes cast yesterday with exit polls indicating that the existing coalition will not gain enough votes to govern without reaching a deal with other parties.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35674465>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-2-5"></a>

Context: Elections in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Counting of votes begins in Iran after polling hours in yesterday's election were extended by six hours due to a heavy turnout. Reports indicate that reformist candidates are doing well in the early count.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160228103959/http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/iran-starts-election-count-to-set-post-sanctions-power-balance/41984890>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/64a1faf3db0247fb9e03d5cee27eae12/iran-reformists-performing-well-early-election-results>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-2-6"></a>

Context: Elections in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Preliminary results shows that Pervasive Coalition of Reformists has won a majority in Tehran district and some other big cities, as Principlists Coalition won seats in smaller cities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-election-vote-idUSKCN0VZ0E7>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-2-7"></a>

Context: Elections in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Early Assembly of Experts results show that Principlists won the majority, as Reformists won 14 out of 16 seats in Tehran, although some of them also had the support of conservatives.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/irans-rouhani-top-ally-rafsanjani-lead-assembly-experts-135559253.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-2-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands, including some from Australia, protest in London, England, against the renewal of the United Kingdom's Trident nuclear deterrent system, the largest anti-nuclear rally since 1983. Leader of the Labour Party Jeremy Corbyn, Scottish National Party leader and First Minister of Scotland Nicola Sturgeon, the Welsh Plaid Cymru Party, and the Green Party participated in the march. A parliamentary vote on renewing Trident is expected this year.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/rally-london-against-trident-nuclear-deterrent-system-draws-thousands-2326327>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/feb/27/cnd-rally-anti-nuclear-demonstration-trident-london>).

<a id="event-2016-02-27-2-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** A large rally, with estimated counts ranging from 7,500 to 100,000, honors former deputy prime minister and opposition leader Boris Nemtsov on the first anniversary of his assassination near the Kremlin.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-nemtsov-idUSKCN0W00M4>).

### 2016-02-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1351872123](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2028&oldid=1351872123>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-02-28-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Two police officers are killed after a bomb explodes in Helmand Province.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-02-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korean opposition lawmakers' anti-terrorism bill filibuster, which stops all other legislative business, extends its world record to 115 hours Sunday afternoon, easily besting Canada's 58-hour session in 2011. The major issue is giving South Korea's intelligence agency powers to monitor private communications. This parliamentary session is set to end March 11, with elections on April 13.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-politics-filibuster-idUSKCN0W103V>).

<a id="event-2016-02-28-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swiss citizens vote on four referenda, including one, proposed by the right-wing Swiss People's Party, that would automatically expel foreigners who commit two minor crimes. Current law calls for deportation of non-citizens convicted of murder or sexual violence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35680760>); [AFP](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/feb/28/switzerland-votes-on-expelling-foreigners-for-minor-crimes>).

### 2016-02-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1093910622](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20February%2029&oldid=1093910622>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** At least 40 people are killed and 58 others injured following a suicide bombing at a Shi'ite funeral in the city of Miqdadiyah, Diyala Governorate. ISIL claim responsibility for the attack.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-02-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China says it expects to lay off 1.8 million state workers in the coal and steel sectors, or about 15 percent of the industries' workforce, as part of efforts to reduce industrial overcapacity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-economy-employment-idUSKCN0W205X>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-02-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person has died and hundreds of people have been evacuated after heavy rain in the Indonesian capital Jakarta.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Post](<http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2016/02/29/hundreds-evacuate-one-toddler-dies-after-heavy-rain-jakarta.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-02-29-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Macedonian police use tear gas after hundreds of migrants frustrated with long delays broke a gate on the border with Greece and temporarily cross the border.

Source citations (as archived): [Press Association](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/refugees-rip-down-barb-wire-and-break-through-macedonia-border-fence-using-homemade-battering-ram-34497933.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-29-3-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Immigration Minister John McCallum says Canada has reached its target of resettling 25,000 Syrian refugees under its program started in November 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4242467/canada-refugee-target/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-02-29-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistani authorities hang Mumtaz Qadri for his role in the murder of reformist Punjab governor Salmaan Taseer in 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/pakistan-blasphemy-taseer-qadri/27579651.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-29-4-2"></a>

Context: Calais migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Clashes break out inside the Calais jungle camp in the port city of Calais between migrants and riot police as officials attempted to evict hundreds of migrants from the southern section of the camp. Several tents and wooden shacks were set on fire by migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/europe/france/12177718/Calais-jungle-Migrants-set-tents-on-fire-as-riot-police-attempt-to-evict-them.html>).

<a id="event-2016-02-29-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, a 14-year-old shoots two students, who were hospitalized in stable condition, in the Madison Local School cafeteria. Two other teenagers are injured, none seriously. The southwestern Ohio school, which had practiced for such an event, immediately went into lockdown; Tuesday classes are cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://auburnpub.com/news/national/hurt-as-student-opens-fire-in-ohio-school-cafeteria/article_d5e4b5e9-126b-5a7f-878b-bce6ffd1655e.html>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/02/29/Four-students-wounded-in-Ohio-school-shooting-14-year-old-suspect-arrested-charged/2971456793626/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>); [School website](<http://www.madisonmohawks.org/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.theage.com.au/world/mahathir-mohamad-quits-malaysia-ruling-umno-party-protesting-corruption-20160229-gn6t4o.html>).

## March

### 2016-03-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1292956685](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%201&oldid=1292956685>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-01-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Three soldiers are killed and two others are injured after a Ukrainian military truck was blown up in the eastern part of Luhansk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukraine Today](<http://uatoday.tv/news/military-truck-blown-up-in-luhansk-region-three-killed-two-injured-601879.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** The United States Army's elite Delta Force captures their first suspected ISIL operative during a raid in northern Iraq. The detainee is being interrogated by the U.S. and is expected to be turned over to Iraqi officials in the coming days.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/03/01/politics/special-ops-captures-isis-detainee-iraq/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Faulty readings from a GPS system apparently resulted in two Israeli soldiers driving into the Qalandiya refugee camp in the occupied West Bank. Israeli forces sent in on a rescue mission, engaged armed Palestinians. One 22-year-old Palestinian man was killed with 10 others wounded, one seriously, in the ensuing gun battle. At least 10 Israeli soldiers were wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/battles-erupts-after-israeli-soldiers-follow-apparent-gps-error-into-palestinian-zone/2016/03/01/940307ef-503f-4a98-8abb-01cf6357a850_story.html>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/israel/12179149/Israeli-soldiers-accidentally-follow-GPS-into-a-Palestinian-refugee-camp-and-spark-night-of-rioting.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 18 people are killed and 16 others injured in a multi-vehicle accident involving a bus near Nahdah in northwestern Oman. Six of the dead were from Oman, four from Saudi Arabia, two from Pakistan, and one from Yemen. Five others are unidentified.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160301094531/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/oman-police-18-killed-14-injured-bus-crash-37298878>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Peruvian Army is deployed on the country's northern and southern coasts to help cope with El Niño-related floods that have killed at least two people and left thousands homeless.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/03/01/peru-sends-in-army-to-deal-with-floods-blamed-on-el-nino/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Residents from more than 50 homes in Ripley, New York, are evacuated following the derailment of a 34-car Norfolk Southern train carrying hazardous materials in the southwestern part of the state. Ethanol leaked from two of the 16 derailed cars. A third car carrying propane crashed but did not leak.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-new-york-derailment-idUSKCN0W418C>); [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/03/02/train-carrying-hazardous-materials-derails-in-upstate-new-york.html>).

#### Health

Context: 2015–16 Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The first Zika virus case is confirmed in the U.S. state of New Hampshire.

Source citations (as archived): [WMUR](<http://www.wmur.com/health/first-case-of-zika-virus-confirmed-in-new-hampshire/38279260>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 North Korean nuclear test.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council vote on the United States-China draft resolution on North Korea is rescheduled to 10:00 a.m. EST Wednesday. Russia requests more time to review the text.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-nuclear-un-idUSKCN0W34QN>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-3-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** United Nations refugee agency spokesperson Adrian Edwards warns that Europe is on the verge, "... of a largely self-induced humanitarian crisis,..." if the rapid build-up of migrants continues at the northern borders of an already over-stretched Greece. There are at least 24,000 there now, including 8,500 at Idomeni, the site of yesterday's incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/unhcr-warns-of-humanitarian-crisis-in-greece-as-influx-rises-116030101311_1.html>); [Kathimerini](<http://www.ekathimerini.com/206505/article/ekathimerini/news/europe-on-cusp-of-self-induced-humanitarian-crisis-unhcr-says>).

Context: South China Sea disputes.

**Archived source account.** Filipino fishermen say China has deployed up to five ships around the disputed Quirino Atoll, also known as Jackson Atoll, in the South China Sea, preventing them from accessing traditional fishing grounds.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/filipino-fishermen-say/2564476.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A grand jury in the U.S. state of Pennsylvania reports that hundreds of children were sexually abused by about 50 priests in the Altoona-Johnstown Diocese over four decades.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pennsylvania-sexcrimes-idUSKCN0W35NI>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ukraine bans government officials from publicly criticizing the work of state institutions and their colleagues, after damaging disclosures last month that highlighted slow progress in fighting corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-censorship-idUSKCN0W351A>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Transgender and schools, LGBT rights in South Dakota.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, South Dakota Governor Dennis Daugaard vetoes House Bill 1008 that would have required transgender students to use bathrooms, locker rooms, and other facilities based on their gender at birth in state public schools. The bill would have been law at midnight if the governor had not acted.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Sun-Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160303105435/http://national.suntimes.com/national-world-news/7/72/2679253/south-dakota-anti-trans-bill-veto/>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/03/01/468732723/south-dakota-s-transgender-bathroom-bill-hits-deadline-for-governor>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-4-4"></a>

Context: Transgender and schools, LGBT rights in South Dakota.

**Archived source account.** The primary sponsor of the legislation asks fellow lawmakers not to override the governor’s veto.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/the-latest-civil-rights-activists-celebrate-governors-veto/2016/03/01/21554cd8-e00b-11e5-8c00-8aa03741dced_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-01-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** In California, two current and one former San Franciscan sheriff deputies, are charged with organizing an inmate "fight club" on the seventh floor of the city's Hall of Justice jail.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-sf-deputies-charged-20160301-story.html>); [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/03/02/2-california-sheriffs-deputies-charged-with-organizing-inmate-fight-club.html>).

### 2016-03-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185131209](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%202&oldid=1185131209>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One Chinese national is killed and three others injured in a possible militant attack on a Chinese-invested company in Laos, the official Xinhua News Agency reports.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-laos-china-attacks-idUSKCN0W40K4>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinian teenagers, from the nearby village of Qaryout, got into a Jewish settlement and stabbed an Israeli settler at his home in the Eli settlement near Nablus in the occupied West Bank. They were stopped and killed by the army. The injured settler was taken to a hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0W40I8>); [AFP](<http://www.i24news.tv/en/news/israel/diplomacy-defense/104762-160302-west-bank-two-palestinian-terrorists-killed-after-attempted-attack>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Jordan says an overnight raid on an ISIL cell in the city of Irbid has left seven militants and one security officer dead, with five others injured. Those killed were planning to blow up civilian and military targets in the country, according to the General Intelligence Directorate (GID).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/magazine-35701841>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed in an attack on the Indian consulate In Jalalabad, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/india-news/9-killed-in-attack-on-indian-consulate-in-afghanistans-jalalabad-1283335>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-0-8"></a>

Context: Libyan Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** The Tunisian Army kills five suspected ISIL militants near the town of Ben Gardane after they infiltrated across the border from neighboring Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-tunisia-security-idUKKCN0W42OR>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-03-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mining company Samarco agrees to pay $4.4bn reais (£804m) in compensation to victims of the Bento Rodrigues dam disaster in Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-35713165>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraqi engineers warn that the Mosul Dam could collapse at anytime, resulting in a catastrophic flash flood that could kill up to one million people along the Tigris, with the major Iraqi cities of Mosul, Tikrit, Samarra and Baghdad all at risk. The U.S. embassy in Baghdad has urged American citizens to leave the area.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/02/mosul-dam-engineers-warn-it-could-fail-at-any-time-killing-1m-people>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Sumatra earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency of Indonesia (BMKG) and the Australian Bureau of Meteorology (BOM) issue tsunami warnings, after an undersea 7.9 magnitude earthquake strikes southwest of Sumatra, in the Indian Ocean.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/334279-quake-strikes-off-indonesia/>); [BOM](<http://www.bom.gov.au/tsunami/national.shtml#nationalBulletin0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-02-3-1"></a>

Context: South China Sea disputes.

**Archived source account.** Philippines Foreign Secretary Albert del Rosario says Chinese coast guard ships that were sighted two weeks ago near the disputed Jackson Atoll in the northeast Dangerous Ground are no longer there today. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Hong Lei said ships were dispatched to the area in late 2015 to salvage a fishing vessel that posed a risk to navigation. Chinese ships, “... persuaded fishing boats to leave the waters in an effort to ensure safety conditions for normal navigation," Hong said. In addition to China and the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Taiwan, and Brunei also lay claim to the Spratly Islands waters.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/philippines-spots-suspected-chinese-ships-at-disputed-atoll/2016/03/01/e03b65fa-e02f-11e5-8c00-8aa03741dced_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Union launches a new aid program worth an initial 700 million euros (US$760 million) to address the growing refugee crisis in Greece. EU Humanitarian Aid Commissioner Christos Stylianides says the so-called Emergency Assistance Instrument will be used to help migrants trapped in Greece and, if needed, in other countries on the migration route front lines. Approval by a majority of EU members is required. The next EU meeting is scheduled for Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/03/world/europe/eu-aid-migrants-greece.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-eu-idUSKCN0W41DB>); [Kathimerini](<http://www.ekathimerini.com/206539/article/ekathimerini/news/eu-eyes-spending-700-million-euros-for-refugee-crisis>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Gulf Cooperation Council formally designates Lebanon's Hezbollah militia a terrorist organization. The GCC member states are Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/saudi-led-bloc-declares-iran-backed-hezbollah-terror-group/2016/03/02/7f660092-e06f-11e5-9c36-e1902f6b6571_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-02-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council adopts the toughest sanctions on North Korea in twenty years due to continued efforts to develop a nuclear weapons program.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/03/02/un-approves-toughest-sanctions-on-north-korea-in-20-years.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** The conservative People's Party (PP) and the left-wing Podemos party, which together hold 192 seats in Spain's 350-seat parliament following December's election, confirm they will vote against Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) leader Pedro Sánchez's candidacy to form a new government.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/spain-parliament-set-to-vote-down-socialist-govt-bid/2016/03/02/c0dbe992-e05b-11e5-8c00-8aa03741dced_story.html>).

### 2016-03-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1093912813](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%203&oldid=1093912813>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-03-0-1"></a>

Context: DHKP/C insurgency in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Istanbul police, after a standoff, shoot and kill two women from the Revolutionary People’s Liberation Army-Front suspected of ambushing a riot police station in the Bayrampaşa neighborhood on the city’s European side. Two policemen were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/istanbul-security-forces-kill-2-women-suspected-in-police-attack/2016/03/03/4e07cacc-e131-11e5-8d98-4b3d9215ade1_story.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A nationwide power outage hits Syria. The Syrian government says shortly before the power outage, militants had hit part of a power-generating station with rockets in the city of Hama, though it hasn't said whether this damage was linked to the nationwide outage. Also, it isn't clear how many people are affected by the power outage as many cities outside of the government's control already weren't being served by the government-run power grid.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/03/03/middleeast/syria-war/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-03-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 31 people are killed in Kwekwe, Zimbabwe, when a bus, with a blown front tire, switches lanes and slams into an oncoming public transport minibus.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/03/05/at-least-31-killed-in-zimbabwe-bus-crash.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-03-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** South Korea claims that North Korea has launched several short range missiles into the Sea of Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2016/03/03/0200000000AEN20160303005400315.html?input=www.tweeter.com?47cb6080>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/north-korea-fires-short-range-missiles-un-sanctions-014829039.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-03-2-2"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korean leader Kim Jong Un orders nuclear weapons to be ready for use at any time.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/world/asiapacific/2016/03/04/north-korea-fires-shots-after-un-sanctions.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-03-2-4"></a>

Context: Taliban insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Sartaj Aziz, a top foreign affairs adviser for Pakistan, publicly admits for the first time that the Afghan Taliban's leadership is living in the country and that Islamabad has "considerable influence" over them.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/pakistan-admits-afghan-taliban-leaders-living-there/27586816.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-03-2-6"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in Ukraine (2014–present).

**Archived source account.** The United States extends sanctions against Russia over its military intervention in Ukraine.
