<a id="event-2016-03-03-2-8"></a>

Context: Jordan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States delivers eight UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters to Jordan to help the Jordanian Armed Forces defend the country from the threat of ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-jordan-usa-idUSKCN0W5230>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Honduran indigenous environmental activist Berta Cáceres is assassinated in her home in La Esperanza in Intibucá Department.

Source citations (as archived): [Telesur](<http://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Honduras-Indigenous-Leader-Berta-Caceres-Assassinated-in-Home-20160303-0010.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-03-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A riot at a prison in Guyana's capital Georgetown leaves at least 16 people dead. The riot began when inmates angered by a search that led to the confiscation of mobile phones set fires in one part of the prison.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-guyana-riot-idUKKCN0W52KW>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-03-4-1"></a>

Context: New Zealand flag debate.

**Archived source account.** Voting begins for the second stage of New Zealand's flag referendum with the current flag going up against the design chosen on the first stage of the referendum. Voting will end on March 23 with polling showing the current flag is favoured to win.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35704127>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/03/02/asia/new-zealand-flag-referendum/index.html?eref=edition>).

<a id="event-2016-03-03-4-3"></a>

Context: 2014–16 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** Violence breaks out in the Venezuelan city of San Cristóbal between students and police after a supreme court ruling curtailed the power of the opposition-controlled National Assembly to review government appointments of Supreme Court justices.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-35716100>).

<a id="event-2016-03-03-4-5"></a>

Context: Republican Party presidential debates, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The eleventh Republican Party presidential debate of the election cycle takes place at the Fox Theatre in downtown Detroit, Michigan, airing live on Fox News Channel. The debate features four Republican candidates, Donald Trump, Ted Cruz, Marco Rubio and John Kasich. Ben Carson was also invited to the debate but he said that he would not be attending. An estimated 16.9 million viewers watched the debate, 5.5 million of them adults aged 25-54, making it the most watched debate since December 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/live-coverage/fox-news-gop-debate>); [CBS Local](<http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2016/03/03/gop-debate-detroit/>); [Hollywood Reporter](<http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/tv-ratings-fox-news-gop-872681>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-03-03-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers use the Hubble Space Telescope to discover GN-z11, the remotest galaxy yet discovered.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-03-04/hubble-space-telescope-observes-most-remote-galaxy-ever-seen/7219846>).

### 2016-03-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1342529197](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%204&oldid=1342529197>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Libyan spokesperson says two Italian hostages are freed by local fighters from Islamic State custody in Sabratha, Libya. He also confirms that two other Italian hostages were recently killed during local forces clashes with IS militants.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160305103909/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/italians-freed-islamic-state-western-libya-37391358>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Gunmen storm a retirement home in Yemen, run by a charity established by Mother Teresa, killing 16 people, including four Catholic nuns.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/03/04/world/middleeast/ap-ml-yemen.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Dissident Irish Republican campaign (1998–present).

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes under a vehicle in Belfast injuring a prison officer; Dissident republicans have claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/northern-ireland/belfast-bomb-further-attacks-highly-likely-as-dissidents-want-to-mark-easter-rising-centenary-by-killing-security-forces-live-updates-34510925.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-0-7"></a>

Context: PKK rebellion (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Two Turkish police officers are killed and at least 14 others including several civilians are injured by a car bomb attack on a police station in the town of Nusaybin, near the Syria–Turkey border. The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) are blamed for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35723733>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says Syrian rebels have seized control of the al-Tanf border crossing on the Iraq–Syria border from ISIL militants. The rebel fighters who took the crossing reportedly entered Syria through Jordan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-al-tanf-idUKKCN0W62MW>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-03-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An app called “Click to pray” is launched, which allows users to pray daily for Pope Francis and his monthly intentions through a mobile network.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-new-prayer-video-focuses-on-needy-families-96598>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Electricity is gradually being restored across Syria from a nationwide blackout that began early Thursday afternoon. Syria's Electricity Ministry says the electrical grid is expected to return to normal capacity by midnight. There is no immediate word on the cause. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [WireUpdate.com](<http://www.wireupdate.com/2016/03/04/power-coming-back-on-in-syria-after-massive-blackout/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people, including an 18-month-old baby, are missing from an Indonesian ferryboat traveling from Bali to East Java that sank in the Bali Strait; 76 people have been rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Globe](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160306100447/http://jakartaglobe.beritasatu.com/news/76-rescued-five-missing-bali-ferry-capsizes/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-04-3-1"></a>

Context: South China Sea disputes.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Navy dispatches a carrier strike group containing the \{\{Sclass\|Nimitz\|aircraft carrier\|0\}\} nuclear-powered supercarrier USS John C. Stennis to the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/checkpoint/wp/2016/03/03/navy-aircraft-carrier-group-moves-into-contested-south-china-sea-pentagon-says/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations, Relocation of Marine Corps Air Station Futenma.

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe agrees to suspend work to expand the U.S. military base on Okinawa Island. Abe says his government will follow the court recommendation and settle several lawsuits over landfill work carried out to prepare for new runways.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-03-04/japan-to-suspend-work-at-controversial-u-s-base-in-okinawa>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-3-5"></a>

Context: France–Germany relations.

**Archived source account.** Germany wants France to shut down the Fessenheim Nuclear Power Plant near its border as soon as possible following media reports the April 9, 2014, incident was more serious than reported.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160305101635/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/germany-demands-closure-french-nuclear-plant-border-37392778>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/reports-fessenheim-nuclear-accident-played-down-by-authorities/a-19093477>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-3-7"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission proposes an end-of-year target date for lifting internal border checks and restoring the 26-nation, passport-free Schengen Area.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-schengen-idUSKCN0W613U>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-03-04/eu-weighs-year-end-target-for-lifting-internal-border-controls>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-04-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian police raid the home of ex-President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in relation to the Petrobras scandal. Lula is brought in for questioning.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-35725415>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-4-2"></a>

Context: Media freedom in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** A Turkish court places the influential Zaman newspaper under state control. Zaman is closely linked to the Gülen movement of influential U.S.-based cleric Fethullah Gülen, a former ally of Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35729114>).

<a id="event-2016-03-04-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Supreme Court, with only Justice Clarence Thomas dissenting, blocks implementation of a Louisiana law that could have forced all but one of the state's abortion clinics to close, and restores an earlier judicial ban on enforcing the 2014 law. Last week, a federal appeals court said the law could be enforced.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-court-louisiana-abortion-20160304-story.html>); [AFP](<http://www.globalpost.com/article/6742171/2016/03/04/supreme-court-blocks-louisiana-abortion-restrictions>).

**Archived source account.** Voters in Samoa go to the polls for a general election.

Context: 2016 Serbian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Serbian President Tomislav Nikolić, at the request of Serbian Prime Minister Aleksandar Vučić, dissolves Serbia's parliament and calls for early elections to take place on April 24.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2016-election/ben-carson-suspends-2016-campaign-cpac-n532056>).

Presidential spokesman, Manolo Quezon, said the 6,830-tonne cargo ship would not be allowed to leave the Port of Subic, Luzon, where it has been docked for three days, and that its crew would be deported.

Context: Republican Party presidential primaries, 2016, Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Bernie Sanders wins the Democratic Party contests in Kansas and Nebraska while Hillary Clinton wins in Louisiana.

Context: Slovak parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Slovakia choose representatives for all 150 National Council seats. While anti-migrant Prime Minister Robert Fico's Smer party is expected to lose its parliamentary majority, it should be in position to lead a coalition government.

### 2016-03-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131710449](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%206&oldid=1131710449>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills at least 60 people and wounds 70 others after ramming his explosives-laden truck into a security checkpoint at one of the entrances to the Iraqi city of Hillah, south of Baghdad. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-blast-idUSKCN0W80G3>); [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/03/06/at-least-11-killed-in-baghdad-suicide-attack.html>); [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/iraq-suicide-attack-kills-least-11-south-baghdad-104807422.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016).

**Archived source account.** At least nine civilians are killed and dozens are injured after rockets and mortars hit the mainly Kurdish neighborhood of Sheikh Maqsood in the city of Aleppo. The neighborhood is controlled by the People's Protection Units (YPG).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-aleppo-idUKKCN0W80S2>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-03-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former First Lady of the U.S. Nancy Reagan dies at age 94.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/nancy-reagan-dead-94-n532871>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve coal miners are killed following a gas leak in a mine near the Chinese city of Baishan in Jilin province.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2016/03/07/12-killed-gas-leak-china-coal-mine>).

<a id="event-2016-03-06-2-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 25 migrants, including 10 children, drown after their wooden boat capsizes in the Aegean Sea near the seaside town of Didim, Turkey. The Turkish Coast Guard was able to rescue 15 people.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/least-25-migrants-drown-after-boat-capsizes-turkish-coast-2331267>); [AFP](<https://au.news.yahoo.com/world/a/31027765/migrant-boat-sinks-off-turkey-18-dead/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-06-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea threatens a pre-emptive nuclear strike against South Korea and the United States in response to the two nations' annual joint military exercise which Pyongyang considers is a pretext for an invasion.

<a id="event-2016-03-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Robert Fico's Smer party won 28.3 percent of the vote, but with just 49 seats, lost its majority in the 150-member parliament. The Freedom and Solidarity party won 21 seats (12.1%), and the Ordinary People party took 19 seats (11.0%).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002-present).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-security-idUSKCN0W90J6>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/tunisia-ben-gardane-clashes-160307070914234.html>); [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3480104/Three-civilians-19-dead-Tunisia-fighting.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-07-0-3"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A Taliban suicide bomber hits a court complex in the town of Shabqadar killing at least 13 people and injuring 36. Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, a Pakistani Taliban faction, says the attack is retaliation for Mumtaz Qadri's execution last week.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160307170738/http://www.voanews.com/content/taliban-suicide-bomber-pakistan/3222653.html>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/03/07/Pakistan-suicide-bomber-kills-13-after-execution-of-assassin/9391457357685/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-07-0-5"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** According to the Pentagon, more than 150 al-Shabaab fighters are reportedly killed Saturday by U.S. manned and unmanned aircraft strikes targeting a training camp near the central Somali town of Buloburde.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/03/07/us-drone-strike-kills-more-than-150-al-shabaab-fighters-pentagon-reveals.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/08/world/africa/us-airstrikes-somalia.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-07-0-6"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** The Royal Australian Navy seizes a large cache of weapons from a fishing vessel near Oman's coast, that was bound for Somalia. The Australian Navy, which patrols waters around the Indian Ocean as part of an international maritime force, said it has seized nearly 2,000 AK-47 rifles, 100 rocket-propelled grenade launchers, 49 PKM machine guns, 39 PKM spare barrels and 20 mortar tubes from the stateless vessel. 20 tonnes of weaponry in total.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-security-idUSKCN0W918C>).

<a id="event-2016-03-07-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Syrian Arab Air Force or Russian airstrike reportedly kills a dozen people at a market selling diesel fuel in the rebel-held Idlib Governorate. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says the death toll is likely to rise.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idUSKCN0W91JQ>).

<a id="event-2016-03-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany's BASF SE, the largest chemical producer in the world, is pursuing a counterbid for DuPont that could short circuit the Delaware-based company's announced merger with fellow American firm, Dow Chemical Company.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-ebooks-idUSKCN0W91LQ>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2016-03-07/apple-rejected-by-u-s-high-court-in-450-million-e-book-case>); [AppleInsider](<http://appleinsider.com/articles/16/03/07/how-to-find-out-if-you-are-included-in-apples-450m-e-book-settlement>).

The crash shuts down service along the ACE system through Tuesday.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-08-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The deceased American is Taylor Force, a West Point graduate and former U.S. Army officer from Lubbock, Texas, who was in the first year of an MBA program at Vanderbilt University. Force was part of a 33-person Vanderbilt group that was in Israel to study global entrepreneurship.

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-03-08-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization cautions pregnant women against traveling to areas where there is ongoing transmission of Zika virus, echoing earlier alerts from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and other health agencies in areas where virus infection has been prevalent. Director General Margaret Chan says evidence strongly suggests sexual transmission is more common than previously assumed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2016/03/08/stronger-zika-links-to-sexual-transmission-birth-defects-who-says/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Export restrictions placed by the commerce department of the United States against China's state-owned ZTE for alleged violations of U.S.-imposed export controls on Iran takes effect.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zte-usa-china-idUSKCN0W80AV>); [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/us-hits-chinese-telecom-firm-zte-sanctions-selling-to-iran-high-goods/27596680.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-08-3-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Enlargement of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Union and Turkey agree on broad principles for a plan to ease the migration crisis which includes returning thousands of migrants to Turkey. For this, the EU will swiftly ease visa requirements for Turks and speed up Ankara's EU accession talks. A final agreement is to be ready for next week's two-day EU summit in Brussels, Belgium.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160309104509/http://www.voanews.com/content/european-union-turkey-agree-details-migrant-accord/3224260.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35749837>); [March 17-18, 2016, EU agenda](<http://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/meetings/european-council/2016/03/17-18/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-08-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Enlargement of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations and human rights groups warn the tentative EU deal with Turkey that would return irregular migrants in exchange for political and financial rewards could be illegal. U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees Filippo Grandi says it's unclear whether migrants, set to be returned, would be afforded the refugee protection as stated in international law. Amnesty International's Gauri van Gulik says this is outsourcing Europe's refugee responsibility. "The EU is treating Turkey as the only solution it has to the refugee crisis," van Gulik added.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-idUSKCN0WA1D4>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/europe/la-fg-europe-turkey-migrants-20160309-story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-08-3-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea imposes direct sanctions against North Korea that blacklists dozens of Northern companies and people for the first time, and bans ships that have visited North Korean ports in the previous 180 days from its waters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/south-korea-imposes-new-sanctions-on-north-tells-pyongyang-it-must-change/2016/03/08/15b0d29e-490a-4697-9742-3c81dde5eb5f_story.html>); [AP](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/03/08/south-korea-unilateral-sanctions/81468684/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-08-3-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Palestine relations.

**Archived source account.** A Pew Research Center survey of Jewish and non-Jewish Israelis, via face-to-face interviews from October 2014 through May 2015, finds deep divisions in Israeli society – not only between Israeli Jews and the country’s Arab citizen minority, but also among the religious subgroups that make up Israeli Jewry. An overwhelming majority (98%) of Israeli Jews agree all Jews should have the right to move to Israel and receive immediate citizenship. Close to half (48 percent) support the expulsion or transfer of Arabs from Israel, yet most secular Jews disagree (58%) with this, as do 54 percent of those in the center politically (more so from the left). Meanwhile, Israeli Arabs, currently about one-in-five of the country's adults, generally do not think Israel can be a Jewish state and a democracy at the same time. Fewer Arabs (down 24 points) think a peaceful, two-state solution is possible, from 74% in 2013 to 50% now. Both groups are skeptical of the peace process: Israeli Arabs question the sincerity of the Israeli government in seeking a peace agreement, while Israeli Jews are equally skeptical about the sincerity of Palestinian leaders. (Pew is a non-partisan American think tank based in Washington, D.C.)

Source citations (as archived): [Pew Research Center](<http://www.pewforum.org/2016/03/08/israels-religiously-divided-society/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-08-3-8"></a>

Context: Israel–Palestine relations.

**Archived source account.** Israeli President Reuven Rivlin says the Pew study brings up troubling challenges that need to be dealt with immediately. The finding that 48 percent of Jewish Israelis believe Arabs should be transferred out of Israel is particularly troubling to Rivlin. MK Yousef Jabareen, chair of the Knesset Lobby for Jewish-Arab Coexistence, said, "The transfer of citizens, for whatever reason, is a crime against humanity, and I am frightened to see that half of those polled support such a step." Human rights organizations, such as Amnesty International Israel and the Anne Lindh Foundation's Association for the Advancement of Civic Equality in Israel, denounced Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for the results of the study.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/You-cant-have-democracy-just-for-Jews-Rivlin-said-in-wake-of-Pew-poll-447319>).

<a id="event-2016-03-08-3-10"></a>

Context: Australia–United States relations, Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military is in discussions with Australian officials about the possibility of basing long-range bombers, whose striking distance would include the South China Sea, in Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southchinasea-australia-usa-idUSKCN0WB05Q>).

### 2016-03-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1270161018](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%209&oldid=1270161018>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-09-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban militants attack government offices in the southern Helmand Province of Afghanistan, with at least 10 killed, including seven of the attackers.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/afghanistan-militants-attack-helmand/27599826.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-09-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** U.S. special forces, landing in two helicopters, stage an overnight raid on the al-Shabaab-controlled town of Awdhegele in Somalia's Lower Shebelle region. Al-Shabaab spokesman, Sheik Abduasiz Abu Musab, confirmed the raid saying "The helicopters landed outside town and the ground forces entered, there was heavy fighting and they were forced to flee"."They were masked and spoke foreign languages which our fighters could not understand," Abu Musab told Reuters. "We do not know who they were but we foiled them."

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/special-forces-stage-helicopter-raid-somalias-shebab-083932693.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-attacks-islamist-idUSKCN0WB0MT>).

<a id="event-2016-03-09-0-5"></a>

Context: North Caucasus clashes.

**Archived source account.** A group of nine human rights activists and journalists, heading to Grozny, Chechnya, in a small bus, are attacked on the Kavkaz federal highway near the Ordzhonikidzovskaya settlement at the Ingushetia border. About 20 masked men assaulted the group, confiscated some mobile phones, and set their vehicle on fire. Two of the journalists, the NGO lawyer, and the bus driver were hospitalized. A Committee to Prevent Torture representative said this is the first press tour that was not organized by the Chechen government.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.wsoctv.com/news/russian-group-journalists-attacked-near-chechnya-border/153075154>); [AFP](<https://sg.news.yahoo.com/journalists-attacked-chechnya-press-tour-rights-group-191625652.html>); [Telegraph Agency of the Soviet Union](<http://tass.ru/en/society/861307>).

<a id="event-2016-03-09-4-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

The decision came after Slovenia barred access to migrants transiting the country. There are around 13,000 migrants now stranded at the Macedonia-Greece border.

Saudi Foreign Minister Adel al-Jubeir said the lull was important to deliver aid and medical supplies to people in northern regions of Yemen. Yesterday, a Houthi delegation was in Saudi Arabia for talks to end the war. Al-Jubeir and his Yemeni counterpart noted formal negotiations to end the fighting can only take place under the auspices of the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/yemen-security-iran-idINKCN0WB1YS>); [Asharq Al-Awsat](<http://english.aawsat.com/2016/03/article55348327/saudi-arabia-houthis-swap-prisoners-raising-hopes-peace-talks>).

<a id="event-2016-03-09-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Shahbaz Taseer, the son of Pakistani Punjab governor Salmaan Taseer who was murdered in 2011 for criticizing the country's blasphemy laws, is reunited with his family four-and-a-half years after his kidnapping. Tuesday, Shahbaz was rescued by Pakistani secret service and counter-terrorism operatives in Kuchlak, Balochistan Province. He had been abducted in Lahore in August 2011, seven months after his father's murder by bodyguard Mumtaz Qadri. Qadri was executed on February 29, 2016. His death was claimed as the reason for the deadly Taliban suicide bombing in Shabqadar two days earlier.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/pakistan-kidnapping-idINKCN0WB19A>); [GEO TV Lahore](<http://www.geo.tv/latest/101971-Shahbaz-Taseer-being-flown-back-to-Quetta-ISPR>); [The Express Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/1061730/shahbaz-taseer-recovered-from-balochistan-after-five-years/>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/egypt-drafts-bill-to-ban-niqab-veil-in-public-places-a6920701.html>).

Witnesses claim the attackers shouted "Allahu Akbar" ("God is \[the\] greatest") during the gunfire. Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb (AQIM) claim responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/03/13/africa/ivory-coast-attack/index.html?eref=edition>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/africaandindianocean/cotedivoire/12192667/Ivory-Coast-hotel-shooting-Gunmen-open-fire-and-kill-11-in-beach-resort-Grand-Bassam-latest.html>); [Daily Nation](<http://www.nation.co.ke/news/africa/Al-Qaeda-affiliate-claims-Ivory-Coast-attack/-/1066/3115890/-/yht1kxz/-/index.html>).

Context: Syrian Civil War / Second Battle of Maarat al-Nu'man.

**Archived source account.** The al-Nusra Front, an al-Qaeda affiliate, assaults the Free Syrian Army's 13th Division in Maarrat al-Nu'man, killing seven FSA fighters with 40 captured. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says Nusra seized anti-tank missiles, armored vehicles, a tank, and other arms from the U.S.-backed division.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160314182430/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/al-qaida-seizes-weapons-bases-us-backed-syrian-37612542>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-15-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** A senior Iraqi intelligence official, who is also a Syrian activist leader, says Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant commander Omar al-Shishani (Omar the Chechen, real name Tarkhan Tayumurazovich Batirashvili) died of wounds suffered in a March 4 U.S. airstrike near the Syrian town of Al-Shaddadah. The U.S. State Department offered up to $5 million for information on his whereabouts. Amaq news agency, which supports ISIL, says Shishani is neither dead nor hurt.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/15/world/middleeast/omar-chechen-isis-killed-us-airstrike-syria.html?ribbon-ad-idx=3&amp;rref=world&amp;module=ArrowsNav&amp;contentCollection=Middle%20East&amp;action=keypress&amp;region=FixedRight&amp;pgtype=article>); [Chicago Tribune](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160315115337/http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-islamic-state-leader-dead-20160315-story.html>); [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160317211014/http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/reuters/islamic-state-s-shishani-unhurt---amaq-news-agency/42023042>).

Roads have been blocked off in the Belgian capital's southern suburb of Forest as one or more gunmen remain at large.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/brussels-anti-terror-raid-shooting-a6932326.html>); [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/brussels-on-high-alert-after-anti-terrorism-raid-leaves-one-dead-1.2573973>).

<a id="event-2016-03-15-7-6"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** North Carolina's controversial voter ID law is in effect for the first time. Voters without these new ID credentials, including voters with a “reasonable impediment” to obtaining an ID, can cast a provisional ballot. Citizens (2,567) faced this problem during early voting, including U.S. Senator Richard Burr who, because his driver's license was stolen, was without ID. In addition, votes for congressional candidates for House seats don't count because the state's congressional district map was redrawn after the ballots were printed. The actual congressional primary is scheduled for June 7.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Washington Metro, a commuter rail system which transports nearly 1 million passengers across the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area per day, shuts down to allow for an emergency inspection of 600 electrical cables, following two fires occurring over the past 14 months. Officials say the system is scheduled to resume service by the following morning, though individual Metro lines or stations could remain closed indefinitely if problems are identified.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/trafficandcommuting/washington-braces-for-full-day-of-metro-shutdown-to-deal-with-safety-concerns/2016/03/16/42324598-eb3f-11e5-b0fd-073d5930a7b7_story.html?hpid=hp_rhp-top-table-low_metro-620a%3Ahomepage%2Fstory>); [The Washington Times](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2016/mar/15/metrorail-close-all-day-wednesday/>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/dc-commuters-facing-subway-shutdown-metromageddon/>).

Context: Zika virus outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Cuban officials announce they have detected the first case of the Zika virus transmitted inside the country: a 21-year-old Havana woman who had not traveled abroad. Cuba has reported a handful of travel-associated Zika cases, all believed imported from Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Medical Xpress](<http://medicalxpress.com/news/2016-03-cuba-case-zika-transmitted-island.html>); [Outbreak News Today](<http://outbreaknewstoday.com/cuba-local-transmission-of-zika-reported-in-havana-67102/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-16-5-7"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** In the Missouri Primary, media outlets have held off calling yesterday's races due to the extremely close results. Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton lead in their party's vote, but by just two-tenths of 1 percent ahead of Ted Cruz and Bernie Sanders, respectively. Missouri law states a recount may be requested if the margin is less than half a percentage point. Either Cruz or Sanders or both can request a recount. These results are unofficial, until they’re certified by the Missouri Secretary of State, which reportedly could take up to four weeks. Trump leads by about 1,700 votes and Clinton's edge is about 1,500. The state also needs to count the remaining absentee and provisional ballots; the deadline for overseas ballots is noon Friday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/blogs/ballot-box/presidential-races/273266-close-results-in-missouri-primary-could-lead-to-recounts>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/16/politics/super-tuesday-missouri-delegates/index.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-03-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Radar scans at the tomb of Tutankhamun, Pharaoh of Ancient Egypt, reveal two chambers adjoining the tomb, raising prospect of finding the resting place of Queen Nefertiti.

<a id="event-2016-03-17-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vatican is replacing Italian Archbishop Carlo Maria Viganò, the Apostolic Nuncio to the U.S., with French-born Archbishop Christophe Pierre, currently the Apostolic Nuncio to Mexico. Viganò, who is 75, the statutory retirement age, in 2015 arranged the unexpected meeting between Pope Francis and controversial Kentucky clerk Kim Davis, who refused to follow her state's law on same-sex marriage.

<a id="event-2016-03-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tribune Publishing, an American company whose Southern California media holdings include the Los Angeles Times and The San Diego Union-Tribune, wins an auction for bankrupt newspapers, Orange County Register, published in Santa Ana, and The Press-Enterprise, headquartered in Riverside, for $56 million, subject to judicial approval. A federal bankruptcy court hearing is scheduled for Monday. The U.S. Justice Department has warned that a Tribune purchase could violate antitrust laws.

Context: Republican Party presidential candidates, 2016.

**Archived source account.** A group of about 40 rabbis is planning to boycott Trump’s speech Monday at the annual conference of the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) because of the candidate's behavior and rhetoric on the campaign trail. Organizers of the push to boycott the speech said they are worried that Trump could gain legitimacy through the event. An AIPAC spokesperson declined to comment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/rabbis-call-for-boycott-of-trumps-speech-to-pro-israel-group/2016/03/17/8e2f2ea6-ea14-11e5-a6f3-21ccdbc5f74e_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

<a id="event-2016-03-17-6-7"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Bernie Sanders concedes the Missouri primary to Hillary Clinton, who led by 1,531 votes, 0.2 percent of those counted. Sanders says he will not ask for a recount, an option he had because the result is under the state's requirement, 0.5 percent — one-half of one percent. The Republican contest is too close to call as Donald Trump leads Ted Cruz by a similar 0.2 percent.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160321064116/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics/sanders-concedes-missouri-democratic-primary-clinton-wins/ar-BBqy8m9?li=BBnbcA1>).

### 2016-03-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1118692611](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2018&oldid=1118692611>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present).

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram and al-Qaeda kill four security force personnel in two separate attacks in Niger.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35842300>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-18-1-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff and a U.S. defense official report that North Korea fired two ballistic missiles from the South Pyongan Province. One flew 800 kilometers (497 miles) into the Sea of Japan. The other disappeared at an altitude of about 17 kilometers (10.5 miles).

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1662062/north-korea-fires-ballistic-missile-into-sea>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/17/asia/north-korea-missile-launch/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-1-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** European Union leaders offer Turkey a detailed package of cash and incentives to agree that all migrants attempting to cross the Aegean Sea by raft or boat would be sent back to Turkey which, in effect, becomes the region's migrant holding center. A number of stumbling blocks remain, such as raising the amount of aid from 3 billion euros to at least 6 billion euros; reducing the "72 arduous conditions" the Turks must meet to implement visa-free travel for Turkish citizens; Europe agrees to accelerate talks with Ankara on its EU bid; etc. Human Rights Watch protests the proposed fast-track collective expulsions that fail to take individual circumstances into account and breach peoples' right to seek asylum.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/europe-offers-deal-to-turkey-to-take-back-migrants/2016/03/18/809d80ba-ebab-11e5-bc08-3e03a5b41910_story.html>); [Journal of Turkish Weekly](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160323003153/http://www.turkishweekly.net/2016/03/18/news/eu-will-reach-deal-with-turkey-says-eu-s-schulz/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-1-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** European Union and Turkish officials agree on how to handle the flood of refugees. The deal, to return irregular migrants to Turkey, includes acceleration of the country's long-stalled bid for membership in the union; billions of euros in extra aid, 3 billion euros now, another 3 billion by 2018; and, visa-free travel for Turks once the country satisfies the EU criteria. Europe will be taking in thousands of Syrian refugees directly from Turkey. Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) strongly condemns the deal as "ugly and illegal." The agreement is set to go into effect Sunday, March 20, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/18/europe/eu-turkey-refugees/index.html>); [Middle East Eye](<http://www.middleeasteye.net/news/eu-agrees-migration-deal-position-put-turkey-545791271>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-turkey-davutoglu-idUSKCN0WK0QQ>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-03-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swiss research, published in the medical journal The Lancet, found that paracetamol -- sold as Tylenol and as a generic, acetaminophen, in the United States -- was not effective at reducing pain or improving movement in patients with osteoarthritis of the knee or hip. The analysis examined 74 randomly-selected trials published between 1980 and 2015 with 58,556 patients who had osteoarthritis. The study did find the prescription drug diclofenac, sold in the U.S. as Cataflam or Voltaren, is the most effective NSAID available. McNeil Consumer Healthcare, the makers of Tylenol, disagree with the study's conclusions.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/acetaminophen-tylenol-doesnt-work-fore-osteoarthritis-study-finds/>); [The Lancet](<http://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736%2816%2930002-2/abstract>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States Elizabethkingia outbreak.

**Archived source account.** A rare bacterial infection from bacterium Elizabethkingia anophelis may have contributed to the deaths of 17 people since November 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Patch](<http://patch.com/illinois/chicago/rare-bacterial-infection-linked-deaths-wisconsin-michigan-0>); [Star Tribune](<http://www.startribune.com/scientists-search-to-unravel-mystery-behind-blood-infection-outbreak-in-wisconsin/372610031/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-18-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Geert Wilders, the leader of the Dutch far-right political party Party for Freedom, goes on trial again for making anti-Islam remarks. He is being accused of inciting hatred against the Moroccan-Dutch minority.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/18/dutch-far-right-leader-geert-wilders-goeson-trial-for-inciting-hatred>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-3-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels police raids.

**Archived source account.** Salah Abdeslam, the alleged suspect and primary perpetrator of the November 2015 Paris attacks is shot and arrested by Belgian authorities in a Brussels raid.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/18/paris-attacks-suspect-salah-abdeslam-wounded-in-brussels-terror-raid-reports>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-3-4"></a>

Context: Censorship in China.

**Archived source account.** Jia Jia, a columnist for China's Tencent media company is reported missing after not being heard from since Tuesday, when he was on his way to Hong Kong. He was last heard from when he tried to warn a friend about publishing an anonymous letter calling for China's paramount leader Xi Jinping's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-35828918>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-3-6"></a>

Context: Donald Trump presidential campaign, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The FBI's Joint Terrorism Task Force, United States Secret Service and New York City Police Department are investigating a letter containing a suspicious white powder and a threatening note which was sent to the home of Eric Trump, son of Donald Trump, in New York City. The handwritten note within the letter said: "If your father does not drop out of the race, the next envelope won't be a fake." It was signed "X".

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/suspicious-letter-white-powder-donald-trumps-son/story?id=37738571>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-3-8"></a>

Context: Bollea v. Gawker.

**Archived source account.** A Florida jury awards Hulk Hogan $115m after the gossip news website Gawker published a sex tape of the retired professional wrestler. Mr Hogan's legal team argued that the New York City-based website violated his privacy and that the video wasn't newsworthy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-35849140>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-3-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Apple says it will bring two key personnel to a hearing next week, subjecting them to government cross-examination regarding the issues raised by its locked iPhone: its Chief Privacy Engineer and its Global Law Enforcement Officer.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-apple-encryption-hearing-idUSKCN0WK2A1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-18-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President Pervez Musharraf travels to Dubai for medical treatment of his back and leg, before moving on to either the U.S. or U.K. for additional treatment, spokesperson Aasia Ishaque said. Musharraf, 72, will return to Pakistan to face all pending legal cases. Earlier this week, Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif’s government implemented the Supreme Court ruling, and lifted the 2013 ban that barred Musharraf from international trips.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-03-18/musharraf-leaves-pakistan-for-treatment-after-travel-ban-lifted>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iain Duncan Smith resigns his position as the United Kingdom's Secretary of State for Work and Pensions, in opposition to cuts in disability benefit proposed by George Osborne, the Chancellor of the Exchequer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-35848687>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-4-3"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil, Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes rules Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva should be stripped of a ministerial role in President Dilma Rousseff's Cabinet so he can be investigated in connection with the state oil company Petrobras's alleged kickback scheme. Earlier today, injunctions suspending Lula's appointment as chief of staff were overturned at Attorney General José Eduardo Cardozo's request for a Supreme Court ruling on the motions.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/brazilian-protesters-hit-with-water-cannons-tear-gas-as-impeachment-session-starts/article29288144/>); [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2016/03/18/brazil-impeachment-gains-speed-as-lulas-job-challenged-in-court.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-4-4"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil, Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's lower house of Congress, which yesterday overwhelmingly approved (433-1) a 65-member investigatory, presidential impeachment committee, was in session today -- unusual since lawmakers are generally away from the capital on Fridays. The charge alleges President Rousseff broke budget rules to boost public spending in the run-up to her re-election in 2014. The president has 10 lower house sessions to present her defense. Friday's session means that clock has started and she now has nine sessions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-idUSKCN0WK1IF>); [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160323035554/http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/reuters/brazil-lower-house-launches-impeachment-process-for-rousseff/42029958>).

<a id="event-2016-03-18-4-5"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil, Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Supporters of the governing Workers’ Party took to the streets, in a sense answering the massive anti-government gatherings since Sunday, in all of Brazil’s 26 states. Organizations from both sides of the protests have called for people opposed to the Workers’ Party to stay home Friday to avoid a repeat of Thursday's clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/big-crowds-demonstrate-in-brazil-in-solidarity-with-embattled-government/2016/03/18/a893a9ca-ed11-11e5-a9ce-681055c7a05f_story.html>); [Fox News Latino](<http://latino.foxnews.com/latino/news/2016/03/18/turmoil-on-streets-brazil-as-pro-and-anti-government-protesters-face-off/>).

### 2016-03-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1098392421](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2019&oldid=1098392421>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-19-0-1"></a>

Context: March 2016 Istanbul bombing.

**Archived source account.** An explosion occurs in Taksim Square in Istanbul, Turkey, kills five people, including two dual citizenship Israeli-Americans and one Iranian citizen, and injures several dozen others.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik International](<http://sputniknews.com/europe/20160319/1036574734/turkey-istanbul-blast.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/istanbul-taksim-square-area-hit-explosion-160319091702737.html>); [Hürriyet Daily News](<http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/breaking-explosion-in-istanbuls-taksim-injuries-reported.aspx?pageID=238&amp;nID=96661&amp;NewsCatID=341>); [AP](<http://www.muskokaregion.com/news-story/6398403-3-foreigners-among-5-killed-in-istanbul-suicide-bomb-attack/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Palmyra offensive (March 2016).

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes by Syrian or Russian warplanes on ISIL's de facto capital Al-Raqqah in northern Syria, leaves at least 39 people dead, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights. Airstrikes on the city of Palmyra and nearby villages are said to have killed at least 18 ISIL militants, as the Syrian Army advance on the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-raqqa-idUSKCN0WL0IW>).

<a id="event-2016-03-19-0-5"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–present).

**Archived source account.** A United States Department of Defense official says a U.S. soldier was killed in the town of Makhmur, Erbil Governorate, by a rocket fired by ISIL. "It was a lucky strike by ISIS," according to the official.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/03/19/american-soldier-killed-in-isis-rocket-attack-in-northern-iraq-official-says.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-19-0-7"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** At least 13 Egyptian policemen are killed after a security checkpoint in the city of Arish, North Sinai Governorate, came under attack by militants. Ambulances were reportedly subjected to heavy gunfire as they attempted to reach the wounded. The Islamic State's Sinai branch claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-violence-idUSKCN0WL0VD>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Flydubai Flight 981.

**Archived source account.** Flydubai Boeing 737-800 Flight FZ981, en route from Dubai for about four hours, crashes during landing in the Russian city of Rostov-on-Don, killing all 62 on board. It appears the jet crashed in poor visibility, some 50–100 meters left of the runway, during the second approach. Rostov-on-Don Airport will remain closed until at least 9:00 am Moscow time.

Source citations (as archived): [RT'](<https://www.rt.com/news/336185-boeing-crash-dubai-rostov/>); [Airways News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160322062441/http://airwaysnews.com/blog/2016/03/18/flydubai-flight-981-crash/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-crash-idUSKCN0WL036>).

<a id="event-2016-03-19-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine Cuban migrants die and 18 others are rescued by the Royal Caribbean's Brilliance of the Seas cruise ship in the Gulf of Mexico, 130 miles west of Marco Island, Florida. The group had been sailing for 22 days in a 30-foot long "rustic" boat. The survivors were severely dehydrated and in poor condition. Those who had died were buried at sea. The cruise ship is taking the migrants to its next stop, the Mexican island of Cozumel.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.pressherald.com/2016/03/19/nine-cuban-migrants-die-18-rescued-off-florida/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former United Nations official and head of the UN mission for the Ebola outbreak Anthony Banbury accuses the UN of “colossal mismanagement,” saying it had failed to uphold the principles for which it was established. He cited the organization's “Orwellian admonitions and Carrollian logic” of the UN bureaucracy and minimal accountability regarding the widespread rape and sexual abuse by UN peacekeepers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/19/former-un-official-accuses-world-body-of-colossal-mismanagement>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-19-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** A survey conducted by Datafolha shows a majority of Brazilians now favor the impeachment or resignation of President Dilma Rousseff. The poll showed 68 percent of respondents favor Rousseff's impeachment by Congress, while 65 percent think the president should resign. The president's approval ratings have been hammered by Brazil's worst recession in decades and its biggest ever corruption probe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-brazil-politics-poll-idUKKCN0WL0Y0>).

<a id="event-2016-03-19-3-3"></a>

Context: Republican Party presidential candidates, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Two dozen protesters park their cars in the middle of Shea Boulevard, and block the main road to the Phoenix suburb of Fountain Hills, Arizona, where Donald Trump's campaign rally with former Arizona Governor Jan Brewer, and controversial sheriff Joe Arpaio was held. For hours, traffic was backed up for miles. The road was eventually cleared. Three protesters were arrested and two cars were towed from the boulevard.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/9aae82a47c234340b0ce5c16d8937552/protesters-block-main-road-trump-rally>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/19/politics/donald-trump-arizona-joe-arpaio/>); [KPHO-TV](<http://www.cbs5az.com/story/31516829/anti-trump-protesters-block-streets-in-fountain-hills?autostart=true>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-03-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian speed skaters Pavel Kulizhnikov, Semion Elistratov and Ekaterina Konstantinova test positive for Meldonium and are provisionally suspended by the International Skating Union. Kulizhnikov faces a potential lifetime ban while Elistratov and Konstantinova face up to four years.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russian-champion-speedskaters-face-long-bans-for-doping/27622667.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-19-4-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Six Nations Championship.

**Archived source account.** In rugby union, England, which had already clinched the championship, defeat France 31–21 to claim their 13th Grand Slam.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2016/mar/19/france-v-england-six-nations-live>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/rugby-union/35821697>).

### 2016-03-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1098393086](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2020&oldid=1098393086>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-20-0-1"></a>

Context: March 2016 Istanbul bombing.

**Archived source account.** Turkish authorities name a Turkish man with alleged ties to the Islamic State responsible for this weekend's suicide bombing in Istanbul.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/turkey-alleges-istanbul-bomber-was-a-member-of-the-islamic-state/2016/03/20/8b890b9c-eebd-11e5-a2a3-d4e9697917d1_story.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-03-20-1-1"></a>

Context: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in Utah.

**Archived source account.** Dallin H. Oaks dedicates the Provo City Center Temple, the 150th LDS temple and the second temple converted from an LDS tabernacle.

Source citations (as archived): [The Salt Lake Tribune](<http://www.sltrib.com/home/3685690-155/mormons-rejoice-as-apostle-oaks-dedicates>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-20-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States-based Sherwin-Williams Company agrees to acquire rival U.S. paint company Valspar Corporation in an all-cash deal valued at about $9.3 billion (8.2 billion euros).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/usa-sherwin-williams-valspar-idUSL2N16S0CK>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Erasmus bus crash.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen are killed and 34 others injured after a bus carrying Erasmus exchange students returning from the renowned Falles fireworks festival in Valencia, crashes near Freginals, Spain. The regional government of Catalonia said in a statement that, "... according to the latest data, the ill-fated bus had students from Hungary, Germany, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Italy, Peru, Bulgaria, Poland, Ireland, Japan, Ukraine, Holland, Belgium, France, Palestine, Turkey, (and) Greece."

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-bus-crash-coach-carrying-university-students-crashes-near-barcelona-a6942316.html>); [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/03/20/at-least-14-dead-after-bus-carrying-students-crashes-in-spain/>); [AP](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-03-20/urgent-spain-some-killed-injured-in-bus-crash-on-coastal-highway>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 6.6 magnitude earthquake strikes off the eastern coast of Kamchatka Peninsula in Russia's Far East. Shaking was felt throughout large parts of the peninsula, but there were no immediate reports of damage or casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160322182339/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id3900>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian military helicopter crash shortly after takeoff from Poso kills 13 passengers. Their mission was to try to capture Indonesia's most wanted militant, Abu Wardah Santoso, leader of the Islamic State affiliate East Indonesia Mujahidin network.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5d377dc7b80c4531a9ee80ba2403032c/indonesian-military-helicopter-crashes-killing-12>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-20-4-1"></a>

Context: United States–Cuban Thaw.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama and the First Family begin their three-day visit to Havana, Cuba, to mark the end of 54 years of tensions in Cuba–United States relations. Obama is the first sitting U.S. president to visit the country since Calvin Coolidge in 1928.

Source citations (as archived): [Havana Times](<http://www.havanatimes.org/?p=117493>); [Jamaica Observer](<http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/news/OBAMA2016-03-20T13-29-54>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-4-2"></a>

Context: United States–Cuban Thaw.

**Archived source account.** Before the President's arrival, Cuban authorities arrest more than 50 Ladies in White human rights activists. The group marches after every Sunday Mass at a church in the Miramar suburb of Havana, and usually get arrested and detained for hours or days. They had hoped President Obama's visit would change that routine.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/03/20/cuba-dissidents-protesters-arrested-president-obama-visit/82048950/>); [Havana Times](<http://www.havanatimes.org/?p=117493>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A retired Pennsylvania state trooper's attempted robbery of a fare collection vehicle at the Pennsylvania Turnpike's Fort Littleton toll plaza, 65 miles west of the capital Harrisburg, results in three deaths -- a toll collector, a security guard, and himself.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160323131735/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/turnpike-employee-worker-suspect-killed-robbery-attempt-37796138>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-1"></a>

Context: Beninese presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voting for the second round of Benin's election begins with current President Thomas Boni Yayi stepping down after completing two terms.

Source citations (as archived): [Townhall](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160329002034/http://townhall.com/news/politics-elections/2016/03/20/benin-rivals-face-off-in-hotly-contested-presidential-runoff-n2136728>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-3"></a>

Context: Cape Verdean parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Cape Verde go to the polls for an election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35854768>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-5"></a>

Context: Kazakhstani legislative election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voting is underway in today's parliamentary election in the former Soviet republic. President Nursultan Nazarbayev's Nur Otan party is expected to win easily, and retain control of the 107-seat Mazhilis, the lower house of parliament. The recent crackdown on political activists and media dims chances this election will be the first judged free and fair by Western observers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://siouxcityjournal.com/news/world/asia/voting-in-parliamentary-election-begins-in-kazakhstan/article_4f0ef6a6-1e2a-5a10-a14f-d13661f70273.html>); [Townhall.com](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160329100626/http://townhall.com/news/politics-elections/2016/03/20/kazakhstans-election-could-yield-clue-to-succession-n2136691>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-7"></a>

Context: Laotian parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** An election is held in Laos, with voter turnout expected to be low. The only legal party in Laos is the Lao People's Revolutionary Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Vida Latina](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160326094955/http://www.vidalatinasd.com/news/2016/mar/20/laos-holds-national-assembly-elections/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-9"></a>

Context: Nigerien general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** A run-off election begins in Niger with current President Mahamadou Issoufou highly favored to win as his main opponent Hama Amadou, who was earlier jailed, was flown out of the country for medical reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-niger-election-idUSKCN0WM08N>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-11"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The second leg of the presidential debates was held in Cebu City.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2016/03/21/asia-pacific/philippine-presidential-debate-erupts-heated-exchanges-gets-personal/#.Vu-d9tJ96t9>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-13"></a>

Context: Republic of the Congo presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Republic of the Congo go to the polls with current President Denis Sassou Nguesso expected to extend his 32-year rule. Telephone, internet and SMS services have been shut down in what has been called a "media blackout."

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/congo-media-blackout-presidential-elections-160320044041238.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-15"></a>

Context: Senegalese constitutional referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** A referendum is underway in Senegal where voters will vote on whether or not to reduce presidential term limits from seven to five years. Senegal's referendum also calls for a strengthened National Assembly, better representation for Senegalese abroad, greater rights for the opposition and participation of independent candidates in elections among the 15 changes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2016/Mar-20/343128-senegal-votes-on-referendum-to-reduce-presidential-term.ashx>).

<a id="event-2016-03-20-6-17"></a>

Context: Tanzanian general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** A rerun of Zanzibar's presidential election takes place amid an opposition boycott. The election originally occurred at the same time as Tanzania's general election in 2015 but was annulled because of supposed fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Nation](<http://www.nation.co.ke/news/africa/Zanzibar-holds-presidential-election-amid-rising-tension/-/1066/3123290/-/g7dkln/-/index.html>).

### 2016-03-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1098801284](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2021&oldid=1098801284>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-21-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man detonates a grenade inside a bakery in Belgrade, Serbia, killing himself. No other casualties were reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/serbia-belgrade-grenade-bakery/27626225.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-21-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen attack a European Union military training operation housed in a converted hotel in the Mali capital, Bamako. There are no casualties among the mission personnel. One suspect is killed and two are arrested. No group has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-attack-idUSKCN0WN234>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The competition regulators of the European Union have halted their investigation into a prospective acquisition of Baker Hughes by Halliburton, effectively freezing any such combination between two giant providers of oilfield services.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bakerhughes-m-a-halliburton-eu-idUSKCN0WN11J>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Erasmus bus crash.

**Archived source account.** A Catalan official says the 13 exchange students killed in Sunday's accident were 19-to-25-year-old women, seven from Italy, two Germans, an Austrian, a woman from France, a Romanian and an Uzbek. Twenty-four people are being treated in hospital with one student in critical condition, and six people, including the driver, in serious condition. Reports from officials indicate the driver lost control of the coach and crashed to the other side before running into an oncoming car. The bus driver, who passed alcohol and drug tests, is being investigated for possible negligent homicide as police seek to determine the cause of the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/spain-7-of-13-student-bush-crash-victims-were-italian/2016/03/21/e5fcf894-ef45-11e5-a2a3-d4e9697917d1_story.html>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/7-italians-2-germans-among-spain-coach-crash-082422852.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-21-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** A South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff official reports North Korea launched five short-range missiles from the eastern city of Hamhung into the Sea of Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160324090809/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/n-korea-fires-five-short-range-missiles-into-sea/ar-BBqICNc?li=BBnb7Kz>).

<a id="event-2016-03-21-3-3"></a>

Context: United States–Cuban Thaw.

**Archived source account.** At a 55-minute joint press conference, following their two-hour closed-door meeting, United States President Barack Obama and Cuban President Raúl Castro agreed this “new day” of openness between the two countries benefits the entire hemisphere as well. Each acknowledged more needs to be done. Obama said he spoke frankly about human rights, free expression, and democracy; Castro said the U.S. needs to remove the military base at Guantanamo Bay, and completely end the U.S. embargo. Obama's experience gave him an advantage when journalists delved into sensitive areas.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/on-first-full-day-in-cuba-obama-to-meet-with-castro-and-address-the-public/2016/03/20/931e4ff6-eef5-11e5-89c3-a647fcce95e0_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/22/world/americas/obama-and-raul-castro-to-meet-in-pivotal-moment-for-us-cuba-thaw.html?em_pos=large&amp;emc=edit_nn_20160322&amp;nl=morning-briefing&amp;nlid=11553763&amp;_r=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Tea tape scandal.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand Prime Minister John Key settles a defamation case with freelance cameraman Bradley Ambrose, acknowledging comments he made about the man caused him professional and personal harm.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/e33d9ce1ff87423cb951d646eab31b47/new-zealand-premier-settles-defamation-case-journalist>).

<a id="event-2016-03-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Criminal Court finds ex-Vice President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo Jean-Pierre Bemba guilty of war crimes. Bemba is accused of not taking steps to stop his militia from committing mass murder, rape and pillage in neighbouring Central African Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/21/icc-finds-ex-congolese-vice-president-jean-pierre-bemba-guilty-of-war-crimes>).

<a id="event-2016-03-21-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Supreme Court, in a 6-2 ruling, essentially upholds the state of Colorado's legalization of marijuana, turning down complaints by the neighboring states of Nebraska and Oklahoma that, by federal and their state law, Colorado's statutes allow "illegal marijuana" to pour into their states. Last year, the justices asked the federal government to weigh in; in December, Solicitor General Donald Verrilli Jr. urged the court to turn away the lawsuit. Justices Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito dissented.

Source citations (as archived): [(San Francisco Chronicle](<http://www.sfgate.com/nation/article/Supreme-Court-rejects-challenge-to-Colorado-pot-6929460.php>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/u-s-supreme-court-declines-referee-state-disputes-over-marijuana-n542551>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2015/12/16/feds-ask-supreme-court-stay-out-lawsuit-over-colorado-marijuana/77457652/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's new parliament, in its first legislative act, votes (611-3) to eliminate 15 government ministries. President-elect Htin Kyaw says by eliminating the ministers' salaries, the nation will save $4 million over five years. No civil servants will lose their jobs.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/4c8c2d58f58b475b9a690f3190f03465/myanmar-parliament-votes-reduce-number-ministries>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-03-21-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two possibly-twin near-Earth objects, 252P/LINEAR and P/2016 BA14, will safely pass by Earth at relatively close distances today and Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/Science/2016/0319/Twin-comets-will-buzz-by-Earth-but-not-too-close>); [Science Alert](<http://www.sciencealert.com/two-comets-will-make-the-closest-flyby-of-earth-since-1770-this-week>); [NASA](<https://www.nasa.gov/feature/jpl/a-tail-of-two-comets>); [Virtual Telescope Project](<http://www.virtualtelescope.eu/webtv/>).

### 2016-03-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1349257635](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2022&oldid=1349257635>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-22-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Three explosions in the Brussels Airport and Maalbeek metro station kill at least 34 people and wound at least 170 more, according to Belgian media. Belgian federal Prosecutor Frederic Van Leeuw cautions it is too soon to know exactly how many people died in the bombings. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35869254>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/22/europe/brussels-explosions/>); [CNN²](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/22/europe/brussels-explosions/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/23/world/europe/brussels-airport-explosions.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes near the Yemeni port city of Al Mukalla, Hadhramaut Governorate, reportedly kill at least 30 Al-Qaeda militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-strikes-idUSKCN0WO2TV>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** German tax authorities are investigating Citigroup over its use of a "dividend stripping" strategy, which allowed both the buyer and seller of a stock to claim the tax credits.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-citigroup-germany-taxes-idUSKCN0WO127>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-1-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** In light of the Belgian attacks, Warner Bros. cancels the red carpet but will hold the European premiere of the highly-publicized film, Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice, at London's Leicester Square tonight.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/film/batman-v-superman-dawn-of-justice/premiere-london-cancelled-brussels/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 35 people are killed after consuming poisonous liquor in Hyderabad, India and Tando Muhammad Khan, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1247288/at-least-35-die-after-consuming-spurious-liquor-in-tando-mohammad-khan>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry holds a meeting with leaders of FARC in a sign of encouragement in ending Colombia's half-century old conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/22/john-kerry-unprecedented-peace-talks-colombia-farc-rebels-havana>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-3-3"></a>

Context: Finland–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Finland and Russia agree to impose temporary restrictions at two Arctic border crossing points on the Finnish–Russian border following an increased flow of asylum seekers from Russia to Finland. Under a deal clinched by Russian President Vladimir Putin and Finnish President Sauli Niinistö in Moscow, crossings at two popular entry points, Salla and Raja-Jooseppi, will be reserved only for Finnish, Russian and Belarusian citizens and their family members for a period of 180 days.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-finland-russia-idUSKCN0WO32P>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-3-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations, Syrian peace process, War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry leaves for Moscow for talks on Syria and Ukraine with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov on Wednesday. Kerry is also expected to discuss the case of Ukrainian pilot Nadiya Savchenko, who today was sentenced to 22 years in prison in the city of Donetsk.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160324032528/http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/kerry-off-russia-syria-talks-brussels-attacks-loom-37850028>); [The Moscow Times](<http://www.themoscowtimes.com/article/563143.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35873683>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in southern Russia finds Ukrainian pilot Nadiya Savchenko guilty of being complicit in the killing of two Russian journalists, killing civilians and illegal border crossing and is sentenced to 22 years in prison and a fine of 30,000 rubles. Savchenko denies all the charges and the Ukrainian government said that they would continue to press for her release.
