Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russian-court-resumes-reading-savchenko-verdict/27627982.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-4-2"></a>

Context: FBI–Apple encryption dispute.

**Archived source account.** A federal judge postpones Tuesday's hearing at the government's request. The FBI says a third party demonstrated a way to access Syed Rizwan Farook's iPhone. Melanie Newman, U.S. Department of Justice spokeswoman, says officials are cautiously optimistic a test of this method will allow access to the phone without compromising the data.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/03/21/471353161/fbi-says-it-may-be-able-to-access-shooters-iphone-without-apples-help>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Technology/us-government-apples-encryption-case/story?id=37838682>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Supreme Court, in a 6-2 ruling written by Justice Anthony Kennedy, upholds the 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals' $5.8 million class action judgment against Tyson Foods Incorporated filed by workers at an Iowa pork-processing facility who contended they were underpaid.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-tyson-foods-idUSKCN0WO1Y1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-22-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the U.S. states of Arizona, Idaho, Utah and the overseas territory of American Samoa head to the polls for Republican and Democratic Party primaries and caucuses.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.co.uk/everything-you-need-know-about-22-march-races-arizona-idaho-utah-1550652>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-5-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump wins the Arizona primary.

Source citations (as archived): [Decision Desk HQ](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160325005800/http://www.decisiondeskhq.com/results/2016/primary/gop/president/arizona/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Toronto city councillor and former mayor Rob Ford dies after an 18-month battle with liposarcoma, a rare and aggressive cancer. It was first diagnosed in the midst of his 2014 bid to be re-elected mayor. He was 46.

Source citations (as archived): [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/gta/2016/03/22/rob-ford-former-toronto-mayor-dead-after-battle-with-cancer.html>); [BlogTO](<http://www.blogto.com/city/2016/03/former_toronto_mayor_rob_ford_has_died/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-22-5-5"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil President Dilma Rousseff says she will not resign under any circumstances because she hadn't committed a crime, and equated a bid to impeach her to a coup d'état against democratic rule. A congressional impeachment committee has started hearings. Rousseff could be suspended if the Chamber of Deputies approves the motion to impeach. The president urged the Supreme Court to remain impartial in this political crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-idUSKCN0WO2LU>); [Yahoo\! News](<https://au.news.yahoo.com/world/a/31149721/brazils-lula-victim-of-intimidation-campaign-foundation/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-03-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indian Wells (California) CEO and tennis tournament director Raymond Moore resigns following reactions of outrage, including by top-ranked Serena Williams and retired legend Martina Navratilova, to his comment that top-level women's players rode "on the coattails of the men" and were "very, very lucky" to have equal prize money. This is the event's second controversy involving female players. Serena and her sister Venus boycotted the tournament (also known as the BNP Paribas Open) until 2015 following verbal abuse directed toward the sisters in the 2001 open.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tennis-indianwells-moore-idUSKCN0WO0F8>); [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160326202108/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/sexist-remark-costs-indian-wells-raymond-moore-his-director-job/articleshow/51510559.cms>); [Time](<http://time.com/3694659/serena-williams-indian-wells/>).

### 2016-03-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1098802350](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2023&oldid=1098802350>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-23-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Belgian federal prosecutor Frederic Van Leeuw says two brothers of Belgian nationality, Khalid and Brahim el-Bakraoui, were responsible for yesterday's suicide bombings. Khalid bombed the subway station while Ibrahim bombed the airport, he added. A third suspect, who died at the airport, is identified as Najim Laachraoui, says De Standaard. A fourth suspect seen in the airport photo, who left a massive bomb at the airport that did not detonate, is unidentified and still at large.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/03/23/Belgian-prosecutor-confirms-Brussels-bombing-brothers-identities-describes-note-left-by-one/8501458722374/?spt=hts&amp;or=1>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/europe/la-fg-suspect-in-brussels-attacks-is-sought-20160323-story.html>); [De Standaard](<http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20160322_02197048>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-0-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Van Leeuw says 31 people died and 271 are injured in the bombings.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/03/23/Belgian-prosecutor-confirms-Brussels-bombing-brothers-identities-describes-note-left-by-one/8501458722374/?spt=hts&amp;or=1>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-0-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Referring to the Brussels bombings, Poland abandons a pledge to shelter Syrian migrants under a European Union relocation agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belgium-blast-poland-idUSKCN0WP1D1>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-0-5"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present), War on Terror.

**Archived source account.** At least 50 militants are reportedly killed in a U.S. air strike on an Al-Qaeda training camp in southern Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-yemen-strike-idUSKCN0WO37I>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Labor Department releases a long-awaited rule, the so-called persuader rule that was first proposed in 2011. The regulation requires companies to disclose when they seek advice about countering union campaigns. The final rule will apply to contracts beginning on July 1, 2016. Several business groups, such as the National Retail Federation, the Associated Builders and Contractors, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and the National Association of Manufacturers, object because the rule limits employers' free speech rights to counter union organizing, it could interfere with attorney-client privilege, etc. Court challenges are expected.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-labor-persuader-idUSKCN0WP2GX>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/regulation/pending-regs/274022-dol-unveils-persuader-rule>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-23-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 North American winter / Late March 2016 North American blizzard.

**Archived source account.** A powerful blizzard sweeping Denver, Colorado, forces authorities to close Denver International Airport, Interstate 70, Interstate 25 and leaves more than 100,000 people without power. The Colorado Army National Guard has been deployed to help rescue those stranded by the storm.

Source citations (as archived): [The Denver Post](<http://www.denverpost.com/weathernews/ci_29674648/denver-under-blizzard-warning-between-6-12-inches>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-2-3"></a>

Context: 2015–16 North American winter / Late March 2016 North American blizzard.

**Archived source account.** Denver International Airport reopens at 7 pm (Mountain Daylight Time). Over 1,300 flights were canceled. Just a few flights are expected to arrive or depart through the night. The National Weather Service estimates that parts of Denver received 19.5 inches of snow as of 3:59 pm (MDT).

Source citations (as archived): [The Denver Post](<http://www.denverpost.com/weathernews/ci_29674737/blizzard-causes-250-flight-cancellations-power-outages-at>); [The Denver Post²](<http://www.denverpost.com/weathernews/ci_29674842/colorado-snow-totals-march-23-2016?source=pkg>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-23-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) and the UN refugee agency, UNHCR, announce they are withdrawing from the so-called hotspots on the Greek islands because of the new EU-Turkey deal. UNHCR's Melissa Fleming says, "Under the new provisions, these sites (hotspots) have now become detention facilities." MSF's Marie Elisabeth Ingres says, “We will not allow our assistance to be instrumentalized (sic) for a mass expulsion operation, and we refuse to be part of a system that has no regard for the humanitarian or protection needs of asylum seekers and migrants.”

Source citations (as archived): [Vox Media](<http://www.vox.com/2016/3/23/11291612/eu-greece-refugee-inhumane>); [New Europe](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160326014841/http://neurope.eu/article/unhcr-msf-withdraw-hotspots-calling-prisons/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-23-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Passengers are evacuated from the south domestic terminal at Hartsfield–Jackson Atlanta International Airport in the U.S. state of Georgia after a suspicious package is found. The package is declared safe by a bomb squad.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.news24.com/news24/World/News/suspicious-package-at-atlanta-airport-cleared-20160323>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States, which currently has just eight justices, today heard the case brought by the Roman Catholic Diocese of Pittsburgh (Zubik v. Burwell, which includes similar ones by other religious organizations) that challenges the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act provision that employer-paid health insurance plans provide women with access to contraceptives at no additional out-of-pocket cost, and challenges the federal government accommodation offered in 2014 that would have a third-party provide the coverage with costs paid by the federal government. The plaintiffs state that both are unconstitutional because they violate the free exercise of religion. The decision is expected in June. If the result is a split decision (4-4), there would be no national precedent and each case's final decision would be the one made in court before the case was forwarded to the Supreme Court. In the group of cases presented today, all but one appeals court upheld the government mandate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-contraception-idUSKCN0WP0A9>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2016/03/23/supreme-court-little-sisters-religious-freedom-contraceptive-mandate/82135678/>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2016/03/23/471599946/supreme-court-takes-up-birth-control-access-yet-again>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-23-5-1"></a>

Context: Nigerien general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Nigerien President Mahamadou Issoufou wins re-election in a second round of voting, receiving 92 percent of the vote in an election that was boycotted by the opposition.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/niger-president-issoufou-scores-landslide-election-win-160323053403939.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-5-3"></a>

Context: Senegalese constitutional referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Senegal approve a series of constitutional reforms, which include a reduction of presidential terms from seven to five years, with 63 percent of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35885465>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-5-6"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election / Tuesday, March 22 primaries/caucuses.

**Archived source account.** Front runners Hillary Clinton and Donald Trump each won the Democratic and Republican primary in Arizona, respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/election-us-2016-35869785>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-5-7"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election / Tuesday, March 22 primaries/caucuses.

**Archived source account.** Bernie Sanders and Ted Cruz each won their party's votes in Idaho and Utah

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/election-us-2016-35869785>).

<a id="event-2016-03-23-5-8"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election / Tuesday, March 22 primaries/caucuses.

**Archived source account.** The early results for Tuesday's GOP caucus in American Samoa -- nine uncommitted. The Democratic caucus was held on March 1, 2016, with Hillary Clinton getting eight delegates and Bernie Sanders three.

Source citations (as archived): [caffeinatedthoughts.com](<https://caffeinatedthoughts.com/2016/03/four-takeaways-gop-western-tuesday-arizona-utah/>); [The Green Papers](<http://www.thegreenpapers.com/P16/AS-D>).

### 2016-03-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1098802714](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2024&oldid=1098802714>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-24-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Starboard Value LP, an activist hedge fund, begins a proxy contest to oust the entire board of directors of internet pioneer Yahoo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yahoo-starboard-proxy-idUSKCN0WQ0D7>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lebanese daily newspaper As-Safir ("The Ambassador" in Arabic) is to cease print and online operations after over 40 years, citing falling revenues and Lebanon's political environment and sectarian problems as reasons for its closure. The newspaper has close ties to Hezbollah.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/lebanon-newspapers-idUSL5N16O36I>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-24-1-1"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

**Archived source account.** Australian infrastructure and transport minister Darren Chester says in a statement that debris recovered this month in Mozambique was highly likely to be from the missing Malaysia Airlines flight.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-airlines-idUSKCN0WQ041>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** England international footballer Adam Johnson is sentenced to six years in prison for child grooming and child sexual activity.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-35891143>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Judges at the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia find former President of the Republika Srpska Radovan Karadžić guilty of committing genocide and crimes against humanity in Bosnia during the Bosnian War and is sentenced to 40 years in prison. Karadžić is found to be "criminally responsible" for the Srebrenica massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/bosnian-serb-leader-karadzic-faces-hague-courts-verdict/27632392.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/24/radovan-karadzic-criminally-responsible-for-genocide-at-srebenica>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Toronto, Jian Ghomeshi is acquitted on all charges of sexual assault and choking. The judge found the claimants had "lied, had been manipulative and hid pertinent information" from the court and this created reasonable doubt. Protests against due process emerged immediately afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<http://news.nationalpost.com/toronto/jian-ghomeshi-ruling>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In New York, an appeals court upheld a lower court's decision to dismiss a lawsuit trying to keep Ted Cruz off the ballot in the U.S. Presidential contest on the ground of his Canadian birth.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-cruz-citizenship-idUSKCN0WQ27D>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's parliament approves Nobel Peace Prize laureate Aung San Suu Kyi and 17 other nominees to positions in the incoming government's cabinet. Which ministry each will head was not announced.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-03-24/myanmar-s-parliament-approves-suu-kyi-for-cabinet-position>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-3-2"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International urges Suu Kyi and her National League for Democracy party make release of political prisoners, and rescinding laws that made incarceration possible, a top priority when they take office next Friday, April 1, 2016. Amnesty International adds it knows of almost 100 political prisoners still behind bars, with hundreds of others in detention. AI's Jasmine Heiss says, "The incoming government must take bold steps to show that human rights abuses are a problem of the past.”

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/amnesty-to-suu-kyi-government-break-cycle-of-repression/2016/03/24/33f6bdfe-f181-11e5-a2a3-d4e9697917d1_story.html>); [USA Tday](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/03/24/myanmar-amnesty-international-report-political-prisoners/82171192/>); [Amnesty International](<http://www.amnestyusa.org/news/press-releases/new-government-in-myanmar-must-break-vicious-cycle-of-repression-and-political-arrests>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-3-4"></a>

Context: New Zealand flag debate.

**Archived source account.** New Zealanders vote to retain the current flag over the proposed design in the nation's flag referendum. More than 2 million people vote in the referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [NZ Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=11611333>); [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/national/299860/nz-flag-results-current-flag-to-stay>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/24/new-zealand-votes-to-keep-its-flag-in-referendum>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-3-6"></a>

Context: Republic of the Congo presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Current President of the Republic of the Congo Denis Sassou Nguesso is reelected with 60 percent of the vote amid tight security and a communications blackout. Opposition leaders say that they will not accept the outcome.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/congo-president-denis-sassou-nguesso-wins-election-160324040212900.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-03-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch iconic professional footballer and manager Johan Cruyff dies from lung cancer at the age of 68.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/03/24/football/football-johan-cruyff-death/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-24-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six Russian athletes are to be stripped of the medals they won at World and European championships in 2010 and 2011 and the 2012 Summer Olympics following a ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport. The athletes affected are Sergei Balukin, Valeriy Borchin, Vladimir Kanaikin, Olga Kaniskina, Yulia Zaripova and Sergey Kirdyapkin. The ruling means Kirdyapkin is set to lose his gold medal won at the 2012 Olympics.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-athletes-stripped-of-medals-2012-gold/27633205.html>).

### 2016-03-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626674](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2025&oldid=1104626674>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Six suspects are arrested in the Brussels Schaerbeek district.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35897417>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/03/25/europe/brussels-investigation/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Belgian officials confirm 24-year-old suicide bomber Najim Laachraoui, who also used the pseudonym Soufiane Kayawas, was suspected of being the bomb-maker who supplied suicide vests for the November 13, 2015, Paris attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/brussels-attacks/suspected-paris-bomb-maker-najim-laachraoui-was-brussels-attacker-n545521>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Nigerian Army claims to have rescued more than 800 hostages from Boko Haram while performing a "clearance operation" in the Northeastern part of Nigeria with fighting killing 22 insurgents.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/nigeria-army-800-boko-haram-hostages-rescued-160325061847145.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-6"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The Pentagon announces the death of Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant finance minister and deputy leader, Abu Ala al-Afri.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/03/25/politics/isis-no-2-in-command-killed-u-s-believes/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Palmyra offensive (March 2016).

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army and allies make major advances near Palmyra against ISIL as the group start pulling out its equipment from the town.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35898995>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/26/world/middleeast/syrian-army-said-to-be-closer-to-retaking-palmyra.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-12"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / Iskandariya suicide bombing.

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are killed in a suicide attack on a football stadium south of Baghdad, Iraq. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for attack.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/03/25/suicide-blast-kills-29-at-iraq-football-stadium-isis-claims-responsibility.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-15"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present) / 2016 Aden car bombing.

**Archived source account.** At least 22 people are killed following three suicide bombings in the Yemeni port city of Aden. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for the bombings.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35901733>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-0-17"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The body of Ukrainian lawyer Yurij Grabovsky, who defended two ex-Russian soldiers charged in Eastern Ukraine with terrorism and waging an aggressive war against the country, is found on the grounds of a former farming collective in Zhashkiv, Ukraine. Grabovsky went missing from Kiev on March 9. Information from one of two men being held in this case led police to the remains.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-lawyer-death-idUSKCN0WR0WF>); [Jurist](<http://www.jurist.org/paperchase/2016/03/ukraine-lawyer-for-russia-soldiers-found-dead.php>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Callaway train crash.

**Archived source account.** The evacuation order for the 200-person town of Callaway, Minnesota, which was emptied after a Canadian Pacific train crashed with a propane truck, is lifted. None of the train cars were carrying hazardous materials.

Source citations (as archived): [Valley News Live](<http://www.valleynewslive.com/home/headlines/Train-crash-with-propane-truck-closes-Highway-59--373392491.html?device=phone&amp;c=y>); [KMSP-TV](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160326165654/http://www.fox9.com/news/113247655-story>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve Portuguese nationals, who were residents of Fribourg, Switzerland, are killed in a head-on collision between their minibus and a truck, on a highway 300 kilometers (185 miles) south of Paris, France. The only survivor from the bus is the driver; the two Italian occupants of the truck are slightly injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Post-Bulletin](<http://www.postbulletin.com/news/world/portuguese-killed-in-bus-crash-in-central-france/article_580da7d2-b2d2-5806-b967-3c4b63e8da87.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-25-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An air ambulance helicopter crashes in Iran's southern Fars Province, killing everyone on board. The official Islamic Republic News Agency (IRNA) put the death toll at 10.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-helicopter-crash-idUSKCN0WR1GE>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Japan–Russia relations, NATO–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia announces it will deploy state-of-the art missile defense systems to the far eastern Kuril Islands where they and Japan have rival territorial claims dating to the end of the Second World War. Russian Defence Minister Sergey Shoygu also says that Russia will form new defence units in the country's Western Military District in response to NATO's recent deployment of forces to member states near its border.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-new-weapons-west-pacific/27635405.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United States federal district judge rules unconstitutional a provision in an Alabama state law that requires doctors who perform abortions to have admitting privileges at a local hospital. A Florida law enacted today contains a comparable provision to Alabama's. The U.S. Supreme Court heard arguments a few weeks ago on the constitutionality of similar abortion restrictions in Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-alabama-abortion-idUSKCN0WR1IL>); [Alabama Media Group](<http://www.al.com/news/index.ssf/2016/03/judge_strips_admitting_privile.html>); [AP](<http://www.heraldcourier.com/news/judge-rules-state-abortion-restriction-unconstitutional/article_ae9f3c15-ae31-5a0a-babd-9e6701f31bae.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-03-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Netflix acknowledges it's been slowing its video transmission on wireless mobile carriers around the world, including Verizon and AT&amp;T, for five years to "protect consumers from exceeding mobile data caps." Last week, these carriers were accused of this. The company told The Wall Street Journal that T-Mobile or Sprint users weren't affected because, "historically those two companies have had more consumer-friendly policies." In May, Netflix plans to shift some of that control to viewers themselves.

Source citations (as archived): [PC Magazine](<https://www.pcmag.com/news/343220/netflix-throttling-video-streams-for-most-mobile-users>).

### 2016-03-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076145524](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2026&oldid=1076145524>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Palmyra offensive (March 2016).

**Archived source account.** Syrian troops advance into Palmyra on multiple fronts with the help of Russian airstrikes and take several neighbourhoods, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights. However they were unable to encircle the city.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35903375>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-03-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British rock band The Rolling Stones performs in Havana, Cuba, playing an open-air free concert in the country, in what has been called a "historic moment." Western music used to be banned in Cuba as being "ideologically divergent."

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/music/2016/mar/26/rolling-stones-enjoy-historic-cuba-gig-havana-obama>).

<a id="event-2016-03-26-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tribeca Film Festival co-founder Robert De Niro announces the film, Vaxxed: From Cover-Up to Catastrophe, will not be screened at the 2016 Festival as previously announced. “Grace \[Hightower\] and I have a child with autism and we believe it is critical that all of the issues surrounding the causes of autism be openly discussed and examined," Mr. De Niro said. "... (our) Tribeca Film Festival team and others from the scientific community... do not believe (this film) contributes to or furthers the discussion (about autism) I hoped for," the actor/producer said.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/movies/2016/03/26/festival-robert-de-niro-pull-anti-vaccination-film/82311576/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British newspaper The Independent publishes its last print edition.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1667395/independent-newspaper-prints-final-edition>).

<a id="event-2016-03-26-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports, based on an unnamed "person familiar with the situation," that Microsoft executives are lining up financing for a possible acquisition of troubled dotcom pioneer Yahoo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-microsoft-yahoo-idUSKCN0WS067>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** All four on board are killed when a medical services helicopter, transporting a patient from a car accident, crashes in a wooded area in Coffee County, Alabama. The helicopter pilot, a nurse, a medic, and the patient were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-alabama-helicopter-idUSKCN0WT04J>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-03-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Zika virus outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Chile confirms its first case of sexually transmitted Zika virus. The case involves a 46-year-old woman whose partner was infected while in Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-zika-chile-idUSKCN0WT00Q>).

<a id="event-2016-03-26-4-2"></a>

Context: Zika virus outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention advises women exposed to Zika, which means traveling to South American (or other) countries where the disease is rampant, have protected sex for at least two months before attempting to get pregnant. Men exposed should not have unprotected sex for at least six months.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Health_News/2016/03/26/Women-shouldnt-attempt-conception-for-2-months-after-Zika-exposure-CDC/7911459026299/?spt=hs&amp;or=hn>).

<a id="event-2016-03-26-4-4"></a>

Context: Flint water crisis.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Federal Emergency Management Agency extends the federal disaster declaration for Flint, Michigan, so water deliveries can continue through mid-August.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/03/26/FEMA-extends-water-deliveries-in-Flint-Mich-through-August/4741459020200/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>).

<a id="event-2016-03-26-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A study, published in The American Journal of Sports Medicine, finds high school athletes who focus on a single sport may be at increased risk for knee and hip injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Health_News/2016/03/26/Injuries-More-Common-in-Teens-Who-Focus-on-Single-Sport/8341458998305/?spt=rln&amp;or=3>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Joseph Dunford makes a proposal to President Barack Obama to increase the number of American troops in Iraq, so as to help the Iraqi Army with advisors closer to the front lines and to recapture Mosul, which fell to ISIL in June 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/pentagon-proposing-add-more-us-troops-iraq/27636550.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-26-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the U.S. states of Alaska, Hawaii, and Washington gather for Democratic Party caucuses.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Times](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2016/mar/26/bernie-sanders-seeks-caucus-trifecta-win-close-del/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-26-6-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Senator Bernie Sanders is the projected winner in Alaska, Washington and Hawaii.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/us/articles/2016-03-26/the-latest-bustling-caucus-sites-in-washington-state>).

### 2016-03-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1098803846](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2027&oldid=1098803846>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Palmyra offensive (March 2016).

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army takes full control of Palmyra after heavy fighting with ISIL forces, according to a Syrian military source.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1667695/syrian-troops-retake-all-of-palmyra-from-is>).

<a id="event-2016-03-27-0-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Lahore suicide bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber from a Pakistani Taliban faction kills at least 60 people and injures 300 others at a park in Lahore, Pakistan, and the group claimed responsibility for the attack, saying it intentionally targeted Christians celebrating on Easter Sunday. An official says the explosion took place close to Gulshan-e-Iqbal Park's children's rides.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/27/asia/pakistan-lahore-deadly-blast/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-blast-idUSKCN0WT0HR>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/deadly-blast-hits-pakistan-lahore-160327143110195.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/72e6954d7c1a4c259e2ab1ee5879d658/latest-bomb-blast-pakistan-park-kills-44-wounds-91>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-03-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people in Dublin, Ireland, attend the Irish government's commemoration of the 1916 Easter Rising against British rule.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/27/easter-rising-centenary-to-be-marked-in-dublin-gpo-amid-heavy-security>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 12 Algerian Army soldiers are killed in a military helicopter crash near the town of Reggane, in Algeria's southern Adrar Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-crash-idUSKCN0WT0RJ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-27-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel's Supreme Court blocks the government's plan, signed last December by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with the U.S. Noble Energy and the Israeli Delek Group companies, to develop Israel's offshore gas deposits. The court found the so-called "stability clause," that would prevent Israel from making significant regulatory changes for the next 10 years, undemocratically restricts the Knesset's power. The government has one year to come up with an alternative arrangement or the plan will be canceled.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/518f246087d34784956bd01c77010dbc/israels-supreme-court-shoots-down-gas-deal>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4783787,00.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-natgas-court-idUSKCN0WT0J6>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Senior General Min Aung Hlaing, Myanmar's military chief, pledges to work with the new civilian government that takes over the Southeast Asian country next week, after 54 years of direct or indirect rule by the military.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5a282a96ec7a4a05950583e3f17cc611/myanmars-military-vows-join-hands-civilian-leaders>).

<a id="event-2016-03-27-4-3"></a>

Context: 2014–16 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** According to a new poll, two-thirds of Venezuelans think President Nicolás Maduro should end his presidency this year or be removed via a recall referendum amid a worsening economic crisis. In the event of a referendum, 52.1 percent of Venezuelans would vote to remove him from office, up from 44.5 percent in January, according to the poll.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politic*s-idUSKCN0WS0JO>).

<a id="event-2016-03-27-4-5"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Moldova.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people rally in the streets of Chișinău, the capital of Moldova, demanding reunification with Romania. The rally is meant to mark the 98th anniversary since the former Romanian province of Bessarabia was unified with the Kingdom of Romania on March 27, 1918. The protesters say unification with Romania is the way for corruption-ridden Moldova to move forward and join the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/moldova-rally-romania-unification/27638163.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-27-4-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Police in Brussels, Belgium, forcibly break up an apparent far-right demonstration with water cannons after they joined a crowd of people paying tribute to the victims of the bombings. The demonstrators claim to have marched against terrorism but police intervened when the demonstrators confronted Muslim women and made Nazi salutes.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/03/27/brussels-police-use-water-cannon-against-far-right-demonstrators/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35907469>).

### 2016-03-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1190675440](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2028&oldid=1190675440>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-28-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban fighters fire explosives at Afghanistan's Parliament while it is in session. Members of Parliament said no one was wounded while a Taliban spokesperson claims it caused heavy casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/taliban-fires-explosives-afghanistan-parliament-compound-160328074227812.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** At least 115 Al-Shabaab militants are killed and a further 110 are captured following heavy fighting with pro-government forces in the Galmudug region of Somalia, according to the regional government. There has been no independent confirmation of this claim.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35910675>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Belgian prosecutors release Faycal C., a man charged in connection with last week's deadly Brussels bombings. The prosecutor's office says the evidence which led to his arrest has not been backed up by the ongoing investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belgium-blast-charges-idUSKCN0WU0M6>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-0-7"></a>

Context: 2016 Lahore suicide bombing.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan officials tell Reuters its forces will launch a paramilitary crackdown on Islamist militants in Punjab. Sunday's attack was Taliban-affiliated Jamaat-ul-Ahrar's fifth bombing since December.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-blast-idUSKCN0WT0HR>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In response to the $13.6 billion cash-and-stock offer by the Marriott International to purchase Starwood Hotels and Resorts Worldwide, Anbang Insurance Group raises its bidding offer to $14 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/6f8bc9df96724ddebae77b9623cfcc0e/starwood-receives-sweetened-15b-bid-anbang-led-group>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-starwood-m-a-anbang-idUSKCN0WU11V>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/2016/03/21/Starwood-agrees-to-increased-136B-merger-deal-with-Marriott/7721458570373/?spt=sec&amp;or=bn>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/capitalbusiness/marriott-gets-outbid--again--for-starwood-hotels/2016/03/28/496cb012-f4f1-11e5-8b23-538270a1ca31_story.html?hpid=hp_local-news_no-name%3Ahomepage%2Fstory>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UK and Ireland windstorm season.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Met Office warns of major travel disruption due to heavy rain, flooding and "damaging" high winds as Storm Katie moves in from the Atlantic Ocean bringing winds of up to 75mph.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1667780/storm-katie-threatens-easter-monday-misery>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Alaska village of Nelson Lagoon is coated in volcanic ash after an especially vigorous and ongoing eruption of Mount Pavlof.

Source citations (as archived): [Alaska Dispatch News](<http://www.adn.com/article/20160328/volcanic-eruption-covers-alaska-village-ash-launches-lava-sky>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-2-3"></a>

Context: The Alaska village of Nelson Lagoon is coated in volcanic ash after an especially vigorous and ongoing eruption of Mount Pavlof..

**Archived source account.** Alaska Airlines cancels 41 flights to and from six cities across the state, Barrow, Bethel, Fairbanks, Kotzebue, Nome, and Prudhoe Bay, due to Pavlof's "massive ash cloud." The carrier announces flights will remain grounded pending Tuesday's assessment of flying conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [KTUU-TV](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160329001845/http://www.ktuu.com/news/news/pavlof-eruption-alaska-village-covered-in-ash-20-flights-cancelled/38732402>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2016-03-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Senkaku Islands dispute, China–Japan relations.

**Archived source account.** As part of its wider military build up along the Japanese archipelagos in the East China Sea, Japan activates a new radar station on the island of Yonaguni that is close to the disputed Senkaku Islands.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-china-eastchinasea-idUSKCN0WT0QZ>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A Saudi coalition says it's traded 109 Yemeni prisoners for nine captive Saudis.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/4e356e6451154410b8a3fb5e17cac388/saudi-arabia-says-109-yemenis-traded-9-saudis-amid-war>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A three-year-old girl is decapitated in an apparently random killing by a man with a cleaver in Taipei, Taiwan. The man was arrested shortly afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/28/three-year-old-girl-decapitated-by-man-with-cleaver-taipei-taiwan>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Capitol in Washington, D.C. is on lockdown following reports of shots fired at the Capitol Visitor Center. The White House, in what appears to be an unrelated incident, was briefly locked down this afternoon.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/28/politics/u-s-capitol-and-white-house-on-lockdown/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-2"></a>

Context: The United States Capitol in Washington, D.C. is on lockdown following reports of shots fired at the Capitol Visitor Center. The White House, in what appears to be an unrelated incident, was briefly locked down this afternoon..

**Archived source account.** Police lift the lockdown. An armed man was shot by police, is in police custody, and is undergoing surgery at MedStar Washington Hospital Center. A female bystander suffers what appears to be a minor injury.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/gunshots-reported-at-us-capitol-complex/2016/03/28/f1b961ba-f515-11e5-8b23-538270a1ca31_story.html?hpid=hp_rhp-top-table-main_no-name%3Ahomepage%2Fstory>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-4"></a>

Context: FBI–Apple encryption dispute.

**Archived source account.** Federal prosecutors drop the case against Apple Inc., concerning encrypted data on an iPhone belonging to one of the San Bernardino shooters, claiming the FBI has found a means to access the data without compromising any information on the phone.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-fbi-drops-fight-to-force-apple-to-unlock-san-bernardino-terrorist-iphone-20160328-story.html>); [Los Angeles Times²](<http://documents.latimes.com/government-no-longer-requires-apples-help-iphone-case/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. federal district court, in a case filed by retailer Wal-Mart Stores. Inc., strikes down a Puerto Rican tax increase for on-island companies, with more than $2.75 billion in revenues that buy goods from off-island "related parties," because the levy clearly discriminates against interstate commerce.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/wal-mart-puertorico-idUSL2N1701MV>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Secret Service says only law enforcement officers will be allowed to have guns inside the Republican National Convention to be held in the Cleveland, Ohio, arena on July 18–21, 2016; responding to an online petition demanding Quicken Loans Arena revoke its ban on open carrying of firearms.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/onpolitics/2016/03/28/secret-service-no-gunsrepublican-convention/82348324/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The American Civil Liberties Union and Lambda Legal file a federal lawsuit against a new North Carolina law that bars transgender people from choosing bathrooms consistent with their gender identity, arguing the measure is discriminatory and threatens individuals' personal safety.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-carolina-transgender-idUSKCN0WU15H>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-4-9"></a>

Context: Ferguson unrest.

**Archived source account.** A Missouri court strikes down parts of a law, meant to address concerns raised after the police shooting of Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri, that limit cities' ability to profit from traffic tickets and court fines. The judge wrote the law unconstitutionally targeted St. Louis-area municipalities with caps on revenues from traffic fines that were lower than other cities in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0d3eb4e5ca934c8ba6c6370ef598f2a1/court-strikes-down-law-passed-after-doj-report-ferguson>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protestors rally in front of the Parliament of Pakistan in Islamabad in support of Mumtaz Qadri, the killer of reformist Punjab governor Salmaan Taseer in 2011 who was subsequently executed last February. The Pakistan Army was called in to control the situation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35909716>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/pro-blasphemy-protesters-clash-police-pakistan-160327142503305.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Governor Nathan Deal, of the American state of Georgia, vetoes a religious liberties bill that would have protected people whose religious beliefs don't include same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [The Atlanta Journal-Constitution](<http://politics.blog.ajc.com/2016/03/28/breaking-nathan-deal-will-veto-georgias-religious-liberty-bill/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2016/03/28/georgia-governor-to-veto-religious-freedom-bill-criticized-as-anti-gay/?hpid=hp_rhp-top-table-main_georgia-1045am%3Ahomepage%2Fstory>); [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nfl/story/_/id/15082904/georgia-gov-nathan-deal-veto-house-bill-757-aiding-atlanta-falcons-super-bowl-hopes>).

<a id="event-2016-03-28-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** New York Governor Andrew Cuomo signs an order banning all non-essential travel to North Carolina, i.e., travel not necessary for the enforcement of New York state law, public health, and/or safety, following the state's passage of a law blocking local governments from passing anti-discrimination ordinances.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2016/03/28/cuomo-north-carolina-travel/>).

### 2016-03-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1274097399](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20March%2029&oldid=1274097399>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2016-03-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Belgium officials lower the official death toll from 35 to 32, with nearly 100 still hospitalized.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/03/29/Brussels-May-take-weeks-for-airport-to-fully-reopen-death-toll-lowered-to-32/8081459256059/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-0-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Brussels Zaventem International Airport CEO Arnaud Feist says the airport will reopen at less than a quarter capacity Wednesday, as ongoing tests determine which flights can resume. It could take months for the airport to return to full capacity, Feist added.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/03/29/Brussels-May-take-weeks-for-airport-to-fully-reopen-death-toll-lowered-to-32/8081459256059/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-03-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court's even split among the current eight justices turns down a group of California teachers' challenge to agency fees public-sector unions representing government employees charge employees for collective bargaining costs, whether or not they choose to join the union. Twenty-four other states and the District of Columbia have a similar provision. The ninth circuit federal appellate court ruling in the union's favor stands. Employees challenging the law may bring the appeal again, once the vacancy on the nation's highest court is filled.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston Herald](<http://www.bostonherald.com/news/columnists/kimberly_atkins/2016/03/atkins_split_court_gives_unions_a_win>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. National Labor Relations Board files an official complaint against a California warehouse after finding evidence it violated workers' rights to organize. The allegations of wrongdoing submitted by a worker group against California Cartage Company, LLC, which serves Amazon.com, Inc., Lowe's Companies. Inc., New Balance, and Sears Holdings Corp., will be heard by an NLRB administrative law judge in June 2016. None of the retailers were named in the NLRB complaint.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-labor-warehouse-idUSKCN0WW01G>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alaska Airlines cancels additional flights, due to the ongoing eruption of Mount Pavlof on the Alaska Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [Alaska Dispatch News](<http://www.adn.com/article/20160329/more-flights-canceled-tuesday-pavlof-volcano-eruption-slows>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Aero Teknic MU-2 crash.

**Archived source account.** Seven people die in a plane crash on the Magdalen Islands in the Canadian province of Quebec. Former minister Jean Lapierre was one of the people on board the plane.,

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/magdalen-islands-plane-crash-1.3510975>); [CTV News](<http://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/tva-former-mp-jean-lapierre-six-others-killed-in-quebec-plane-crash-1.2836751>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United States Air Force F-16 crashes during takeoff from Bagram Airfield in Afghanistan. The pilot ejected safely and was recovered by coalition forces, according to a U.S. military statement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-crash-idUSKCN0WV266>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-03-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Terminix, in the U.S. District Court in St. Thomas, Virgin Islands, admits it "knowingly" applied fumigants including methyl bromide, which the EPA banned for residential use in 1984, at a resort in St. John that seriously sickened a family of four, and agrees to pay $10 million in fines and restitution.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/terminix-pay-10-million-using-banned-pesticide-sickened-family-n547566>); [NBC News²](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/family-four-sickened-u-s-virgin-islands-resort-after-fumigation-n336401>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** New research, published in Circulation: Cardiovascular Quality and Outcomes, finds women who have endometriosis, the abnormal growth of uterine tissue outside the uterus, may face a 60 percent higher risk of developing heart disease than women without the disorder. The potential risk was especially high for women 40 or younger. At least 10 percent of women of reproductive age suffer from endometriosis (endo) says Dr. Stacey Missmer of Brigham and Women's Hospital, who co-authored the study.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Health_News/2016/03/29/Endometriosis-linked-to-heart-disease-in-study/4411459284938/?spt=rln&amp;or=4>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/health/womens-health/endometriosis-increases-risk-heart-disease-young-women-n547381>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Falkland Islands sovereignty dispute.

**Archived source account.** A United Nations commission rules in favour of Argentina to expand its maritime territory in the South Atlantic Ocean by 35% to include the Falkland Islands and beyond despite Argentina and the United Kingdom still having an unresolved dispute over the islands.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2016/mar/29/falkland-islands-argentina-waters-rules-un-commission>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-4-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States State Department and the Pentagon order families of U.S. diplomats and military personnel to leave posts in southern Turkey due to "increased threats from terrorist groups" in the country. This order comes two days before Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's arrival in the U.S. for security meetings.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://nypost.com/2016/03/29/us-orders-diplomatic-military-families-out-of-south-turkey/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-4-5"></a>

Context: Iran and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports the United States and its European allies have notified the UN that Iran's launching of nuclear-capable missiles violated United Nations Security Council resolution 2231 which endorsed the Iran deal, i.e., the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), last year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-missiles-idUSKCN0WV2HE>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian foreign ministry says 10 Indonesian nationals are being held hostage after their tug boat and coal barge was hijacked in Philippine waters. Islamist militant group, Abu Sayyaf is demanding a ransom.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/9e1fdb4fc3d448cfb91e33dbf2f26057/indonesia-says-10-nationals-held-hostage-after-ship>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-2"></a>

Context: EgyptAir Flight 181.

**Archived source account.** A hijacked EgyptAir flight lands in Cyprus. All hostages have been released, and the hijacker has no evident ties to any terrorist organizations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/29/hijacked-egyptair-passenger-plane-lands-in-cyprus-reports>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Corey Lewandowski, campaign manager for U.S. presidential candidate Donald Trump, is charged with battery for allegedly grabbing former Breitbart News journalist Michelle Fields on March 8.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/30/us/politics/trump-campaign-manager-corey-lewandowski.html>); [The Palm Beach Post](<http://www.palmbeachpost.com/news/news/local/trump-aide-charged-with-misdemeanor-battery-on-ex-/nqtkY/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-5"></a>

Context: Transgender rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of chief executive officers of major U.S. technology, biotech, and financial companies urge North Carolina to repeal a new state law forcing transgender people to use rest-rooms and changing-rooms according to the gender on their birth-certificate.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160402095255/http://wbt.com/the-latest-ceos-urge-repeal-of-new-state-transgender-law/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-6"></a>

Context: Transgender rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** North Carolina Attorney General Roy Cooper (D) says he will not defend the new state law in court. This year, Cooper is the state Democratic Party's candidate for governor. Republican Senate Leader Phil Berger says the attorney general should resign if he will not defend the law.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160402095255/http://wbt.com/the-latest-ceos-urge-repeal-of-new-state-transgender-law/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-7"></a>

Context: Transgender rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The NC Values Coalition, which worked to get Charlotte's nondiscrimination ordinance overturned by the state legislature, says hundreds of North Carolina businesses support the new state law, though fear retaliation if they make that support public. The coalition did list 17 businesses willing to be identified as supporting the new law.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160402095255/http://wbt.com/the-latest-ceos-urge-repeal-of-new-state-transgender-law/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-9"></a>

Context: Obamacare constitutional challenges, Zubik v. Burwell.

**Archived source account.** In a move designed to head off a 4–4 decision, the U.S. Supreme Court directs lawyers for the Obama administration, and for the religious groups who challenge it, to submit written briefs on a possible remedy to the case: whether coverage could be provided through the group's insurance companies without any actual notice to the government. A 4–4 decision would not set a national precedent, and would let stand the preceding decision in each case. In these seven cases, the appeals court in six upheld the government mandate.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/supreme-court-raises-new-obamacare-questions-n547421>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Samuel Moreno Rojas, the former mayor of the Colombian capital Bogota, is jailed for 18 years for taking bribes to award ambulance contracts.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160407040531/http://townhall.com/news/politics-elections/2016/03/29/exmayor-of-colombias-capital-jailed-18-years-for-graft-n2140740>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** El Salvador declares a state of emergency in seven prisons and transfers 299 prisoners in a crackdown on gang violence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/mar/29/el-salvador-state-of-emergency-prisons-gang-violence>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-03-29-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** A legal request has been filed to impeach Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff for obstructing justice and fiscal accounting tricks, the second impeachment request against her. In response to the request, Minister of Tourism Henrique Eduardo Alves turned in a resignation letter while the Brazilian Democratic Movement Party is expected to hold a party vote on whether or not to leave Rousseff's coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/brazil-rousseff-faces-impeachment-coalition-collapse-160329044900462.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-6-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian Democratic Movement Party, the country's largest party, decides unanimously to leave President Rousseff's governing coalition. While Rousseff will remain in office, it's likely she could be impeached in a matter of months, which would make Vice President Michel Temer president.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-idUSKCN0WU1AC>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-6-3"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Chief of staff Jaques Wagner says President Rousseff will announce a new governing coalition before the end of the week. The President has an opportunity to form a new coalition for her remaining two years and nine months in office, Wagner added.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-coalition-idUSKCN0WV2NF?mod=related&amp;channelName=worldNews>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-6-5"></a>

Context: 2015 Tanzanian general election.

**Archived source account.** The Millennium Challenge Corporation, a United States foreign aid agency, pulls $472m of funding for a Tanzanian electricity project after concluding that the election held in Zanzibar "was neither inclusive nor representative". Zanzibar, a semi-autonomous part of Tanzania, held a rerun of its election that was boycotted by the opposition after it was previously annulled because of supposed fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35917339>).

<a id="event-2016-03-29-6-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, the Tennessee state Senate will vote on a bill, which narrowly passed the House last year, to declare the Holy Bible the official book of Tennessee. Governor Bill Haslam (R) was among those who opposed the bill in 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-03-30/foxconn-group-says-taking-control-of-sharp-in-reduced-buyout>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thailand and neighbouring countries suffer from the worst drought in decades as an El Niño-induced water shortage reduces reservoirs to critical levels.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/thailand-hit-worst-drought-decades-160330102123735.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-30-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are injured in severe storms that spawned multiple tornado touchdowns in northeastern Oklahoma and sections of the Southwestern United States. One patient is in critical condition; the others suffered serious injuries, according to the Emergency Medical Services Authority. Parts of Texas, Louisiana, and Arkansas are also impacted. A flash flood watch has been issued through Thursday evening. Two (2) to 4 inches of rain is expected, with perhaps 6 inches in some locations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b78151f352eb4965bda2402dc1bc6b85>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-03-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new study by researchers at McGill University and the University of California, Los Angeles, finds that each additional month a woman has paid maternity leave is associated with decreased infant mortality by more than 10 percent. Researchers noted that paid maternity leave reduces stress because of the guarantee of income and job security, increases the chances for breastfeeding and other infant care, and allows a mother to seek more medical attention for herself.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Health_News/2016/03/30/Study-Longer-maternity-leave-linked-to-better-infant-health/4971459363627/?spt=hs&amp;or=hn>); [PLOS Medicine](<http://journals.plos.org/plosmedicine/article?id=10.1371/journal.pmed.1001985>).

<a id="event-2016-03-30-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Food and Drug Administration announces it has relaxed its official requirements regarding the use of the abortion drug Mifeprex (RU-486). The current guidelines were based on 1990s medical evidence. Changes include reducing the number of physician visits required by abortion-seeking women, reducing drug dosage, and allowing women to take the drug for three weeks longer -- now a total of 70 days.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/03/30/FDA-revises-instructions-for-use-of-abortion-drug-Mifeprex-womens-health-advocates-hail-victory/4721459361592/?spt=hts&amp;or=2>).

<a id="event-2016-03-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Air pollution in Mexico City.

**Archived source account.** Mexico City, facing the capital's worst air-quality crisis in over a decade, issues a temporary order that all cars remain idle one day a week. Today, authorities report a pollution index of 108 (bad) after low readings during Holy Week. Vehicles will also be forced from the roads one Saturday a month. The measure will begin next Tuesday, April 5, and run until Thursday, June 30, 2016. Starting July 1, improved technology will be in place at smog-check centers where all vehicles must be tested every six months.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/03/30/mexico-city-temporarily-restricts-all-cars-after-smog-alert.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Wallenberg family files an application to formally declare Swedish diplomat Raoul Wallenberg (born in 1912) to be dead. Wallenberg saved the lives of thousands of Jews in World War II only to disappear at the hands of the Soviet forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/raoul-wallenberg-to-be-officially-declared-dead-by-sweden/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-30-4-2"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian parliament votes to ban all Russian films released after January 1, 2014, saying the move is aimed at improving “national security"; more than 430 Russian films and TV series fall under the new measures. Last month, the State Committee in Television and Radio-broadcasting in Ukraine removed 15 Russian TV channels from being broadcast in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/337728-ukraine-bans-russian-movies/>).

<a id="event-2016-03-30-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.K. Prime Minister David Cameron, at the upcoming Nuclear Security Summit in Washington, D.C., will announce a three-way deal with the United States and Euratom, the European Union nuclear agency, to turn nuclear waste into medical isotopes to help fight cancer.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-03-30/cameron-to-announce-moves-to-boost-nuclear-industry-security>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Bangladesh Court issues an arrest warrant, the second one so far, for former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia and 27 opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party members over political violence, mostly petrol-bomb attacks, that occurred during anti-government protests last year that killed at least 120 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/bangladesh-arrest-warrant-issued-pm-160330125529350.html>).

<a id="event-2016-03-30-5-2"></a>

Context: EgyptAir Flight 181.

**Archived source account.** A Larnaca, Cyprus, court orders that 59-year-old Seif Eddin Mustafa, who was arrested by Cypriot police yesterday, remain in local police custody for eight days to assist Cyprus's own investigation. Mustafa faces charges of hijacking, illegal possession of explosives, kidnapping, and threats to commit violence. It's unclear if Mustafa had any explosives; the bomb belt he wore was fake, and officials are waiting for testing results on unidentified liquids found among his possessions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.kelownadailycourier.ca/news/world_news/article_12660d73-51c7-5805-b5c4-8dec3074a343.html>).

Protests have broken out in the capital and other cities ever since Mumtaz Qadri was executed last February for his role in killing Punjab governor Salmaan Taseer in 2011 because he opposed Pakistan's blasphemy laws.

The Constitution states a recall referendum can be held once the president has served half of his six-year term (Maduro became President on April 19, 2013) and at least 20 percent of registered voters sign the petition.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-03-31-0-1"></a>

Context: 2015–2016 wave of violence in Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli security forces arrest 16 Palestinian suspects on the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Security-forces-arrest-16-Palestinian-suspects-in-West-Bank-sweeps-449826>).

<a id="event-2016-03-31-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber in Somalia’s Puntland region detonates while hugging Saeed Ali, the treasurer of Galkayo, killing him and several police officers guarding him. Islamic militant group Al-Shabaab claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/terrorism-somalia-al-shabab-suicide-bomber-hugs-puntland-official-detonating-2346055>); [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFKCN0WX0V3>).

<a id="event-2016-03-31-0-5"></a>

Context: PKK rebellion, Turkey–ISIL conflict.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb, targeting an armored vehicle transporting police personnel, explodes close to a bus terminal in the Bağlar district of Diyarbakır, Turkey, killing at least seven police officers and wounding 27 more people, including 13 officers, according to a joint statement by Turkish officials and the police. The attack comes one day before Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu's scheduled visit to the city. There has been no claim of responsibility. CNN points out both Kurdish rebels and ISIL militants have claimed similar recent incidents.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/03/loud-explosion-rocks-turkey-diyarbakir-160331142831391.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/03/31/europe/turkey-violence/index.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/e0fcaea56a3843b3ae9708d7c9083052>); [Arab News](<http://www.arabnews.com/news/903911>).

Context: Syrian Civil War.

<a id="event-2016-03-31-1-0"></a>

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-03-31-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Kolkata overpass collapse.

**Archived source account.** At least 21 people are killed, 70 injured and up to 150 people are feared trapped after a half-built overpass collapses in the Indian city of Kolkata.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-03-31-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Nuclear Security Summit.

**Archived source account.** More than 50 heads of state as well as representatives from international organizations attend the annual Nuclear Security Summit in Washington, D.C., with the notable exception of Russia, which declined to attend. The main agenda of the two-day gathering is the discussion of North Korea and the threat it poses with its nuclear weapons and the possibility of ISIS extremists getting a nuclear weapon.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/nuclear-summit-washington-islamic-state-north-korea/27645847.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-03-31-4-1"></a>

Context: Yugoslav Wars.

**Archived source account.** Former Deputy Prime Minister of Serbia and nationalist politician, Vojislav Šešelj, is acquitted of all nine charges of committing atrocities in Bosnia and Croatia during the early 1990s by the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/law/2016/mar/31/serb-nationalist-vojislav-seselj-acquitted-war-crimes-crimes-against-humanity-icty-the-hague>).

<a id="event-2016-03-31-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. official announces that The Pentagon plans to transfer about a dozen inmates from the Guantanamo Bay detention camp to at least two countries that have agreed to take them, in the latest move in Barack Obama’s final push to close the facility. The official declined to name the countries ready to take them in.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2016/mar/31/guantanamo-prisoner-transfer-cuba-pentagon-obama-close-gitmo>).

<a id="event-2016-03-31-4-4"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

**Archived source account.** A Malaysian court dismisses Malaysia Airlines's bid to throw out a lawsuit filed by relatives of three people who went missing on Flight 370. The company argued that the disappearance of MH370 on March 8, 2014, occurred before the company came into existence as Malaysia Airlines Berhad (MAB) on September 1, 2015, and therefore has no liability to relatives. The court ruled MAB's liability would be determined in a trial.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/03/31/MH370-Malaysian-court-refuses-to-throw-out-lawsuit-against-airline/5791459423249/?spt=hts&amp;or=4>); [Malay Mail](<http://www.themalaymailonline.com/malaysia/article/court-dismisses-malaysia-airlines-bid-to-strike-out-mh370-suit>).

<a id="event-2016-03-31-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 37-year-old Virginia State Police trooper taking part in a police training mission is killed by a gunman inside the Greyhound bus station in Richmond, Virginia. Two officers standing nearby return fire and fatally strike the suspect. Two civilian women are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [WTVR](<http://wtvr.com/2016/03/31/active-shooter-reported-at-richmond-greyhound-bus-station/>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/trooper-severely-injured-gunman-dead-shooting-greyhound-station-richmond-virginia-n548686>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b67c25180ae04c37a56853f9e8328895/vietnam-elects-first-chairwoman-parliament>).

A small minority in South Korea, such as the think tank Sejong Institute, agree with Trump on this issue, but this is not mainstream policy.

<a id="event-2016-03-31-5-5"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, Republican Party presidential candidates, 2016 / Japan's Prime Minister Shinzō Abe and Foreign Minister Fumio Kishida forcibly reject, as has the White House, candidate Donald Trump's suggestion that the U.S. military be withdrawn from Japan and South Korea with nuclear weapons replacing them. A small minority in South Korea, such as the think tank Sejong Institute, agree with Trump on this issue, but this is not mainstream policy..

U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Mark Lippert says "Seoul pays for 55% of all non-personnel costs."

The approved bill has been forwarded for President Nicolás Maduro's signature.
