**Archived source account.** The Golden State Warriors, with today's win at San Antonio, tie the 1995–96 Chicago Bulls NBA regular season record with their 72nd win this season. The Warriors can still break the record; on Wednesday, they host the Memphis Grizzlies in their final regular season game.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/sports/warriors-tie-1995-96-bulls-72-wins-most-nba-history-n553821?cid=eml_nbn_20160410>); [NBA](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160412051747/http://www.nba.com/2016/news/features/fran_blinebury/04/11/warriors-top-spurs-win-72nd-game/>).

### 2016-04-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131711457](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2011&oldid=1131711457>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-11-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Stavropol bombings.

**Archived source account.** At least three suicide bombers attack a police station in Stavropol, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik News](<http://sputniknews.com/russia/20160411/1037805218/suicide-bombers-russia-stavropol.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Clashes and air strikes are reported in Yemen despite a fragile truce between the government and Houthis taking effect. However, the truce appears to be largely holding as members from the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement are granted unhindered access to give humanitarian aid and personnel across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36011794>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills 12 new police recruits in the Nangarhar Province of Afghanistan. The Taliban claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36012640>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed and seven are wounded following a car bomb attack near a government building in Somalia's capital, Mogadishu. Al-Shabaab claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-36013862>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-04-11-1-1"></a>

Context: 2008 financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** Goldman Sachs agrees to pay $5.06 billion to settle allegations that it sold packages of shoddy mortgages prior to the global financial crisis.. The U.S. Justice Department settlement includes a $2.385 billion civil penalty, and $1.8 billion for distressed borrowers and communities affected by the housing crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/business/wp/2016/04/11/goldman-sachs-pays-5-billion-to-settle-allegations-it-sold-shoddy-mortgages-prior-to-financial-crisis/>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/2016/04/11/Goldman-Sachs-to-pay-5-billion-in-settlement-over-financial-crisis/2151460387785/?spt=sec&amp;or=bn>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-11-2-1"></a>

Context: 2014–16 El Niño event.

**Archived source account.** A severe heat wave grips Malaysia as much of Southeast Asia struggles with unusually hot and dry weather created by the El Niño season. Temperatures in Malaysia soared above 37°C, prompting more than 250 schools to close.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/severe-heatwave-grips-malaysia-160411102328907.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-11-3-1"></a>

Context: G7 foreign ministers meeting.

**Archived source account.** John Kerry, along with the other Group of Seven (G7) foreign ministers, laid wreaths at Japan's Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum to the victims of the 1945 U.S. nuclear attack. Kerry is the first Secretary of State to visit the memorial. Then-U.S. Speaker of the House of Representatives Nancy Pelosi was previously the highest-ranking U.S. official to visit the memorial, in 2008. The Hiroshima foreign ministers meeting is part of the preparations for the 42nd G7 summit the end of next month at Japan's Kashiko Island, Shima, Mie Prefecture.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-g7-japan-idUSKCN0X802S>); [Channel NewsAsia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/hiroshima-in-focus-as-top/2681586.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-3-3"></a>

Context: Houthi insurgency in Yemen, Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed, the United Nations special envoy for Yemen, says he welcomes the tentative truce that started at midnight Yemen time. The truce opens unhindered access for relief aid to all of Yemen. Peace talks are set to start later this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-envoy-idUSKCN0X80B3>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-3-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations, North Korean defectors.

**Archived source account.** South Korea announces that a colonel from North Korea's military spy agency defected to the south last year. Senior-level defections are rare, most being low level operatives.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fa7f22f77f8243cb93be838237d6c3cc/seoul-senior-north-korea-military-officer-defects-south>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-3-7"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Italian Coast Guard rescues 1,850 in the Strait of Sicily.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2016/Apr-11/346873-italy-rescues-1850-migrants-in-strait-of-sicily.ashx>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** CIA Director John Brennan, in an exclusive interview to air on NBC News tonight, says the United States intelligence agency will not use harsh, enhanced interrogation techniques, including waterboarding, even if ordered by a future president. Presidential candidates Donald Trump and Ted Cruz have discussed using waterboarding if elected.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170207223244/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/cia-director-no-waterboarding-even-if-commanded-by-future-president/ar-BBrArSf?ocid=spartanntp>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/director-brennan-cia-won-t-waterboard-again-even-if-ordered-n553756>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-4-2"></a>

Context: Kollam temple fire.

**Archived source account.** Five workers from the company that supplied fireworks to the Puttingal Temple have been detained by Indian police with the death toll rising to 106.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/11/asia/india-temple-fire/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-4-4"></a>

Context: 2015–2016 wave of violence in Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli security forces arrest 18 Palestinians on the West Bank for alleged terrorism related offences.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Security-forces-arrest-18-Palestinians-in-West-Bank-overnight-450848>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-11-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of arrests are reported in the U.S. Capitol in response to the Democracy Spring protests.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/04/11/politics/democracy-spring-arrests-protests-washington/index.html>); [Democracy Spring](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160420190217/http://www.democracyspring.org/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Kyrgyzstan Temir Sariyev announces he will resign from his post. This comes after several Parliament members accused Sariyev and his cabinet of corruption. The Kyrgyz presidential press service said President Almazbek Atambayev accepted his resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/kyrgyz-prime-minister-sariev-resigns/27666911.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-5-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Darfurian status referendum.

**Archived source account.** Voting for a referendum begins in Darfur, Sudan. Voters will be asked during the three-day referendum to decide on the permanent administrative status of the region. The choices are for the creation of a Darfur Region composed of the States of Darfur, or the retention of the status quo states system. Darfur is currently divided into five states. Voters will decide this week whether the area should go back to being one region, as it was until 1994. However, there are fears of voter apathy and if the referendum will be credible.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/darfur-referendum-held-fears-voter-apathy-160411060337405.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The President of the Georgian breakaway state of South Ossetia Leonid Tibilov announces his plan to hold a referendum on whether to become part of Russia or to keep its de facto independence before August of this year. This comes after South Ossetia signed various agreements further integrating the region with Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<http://tass.ru/en/world/868630>).

<a id="event-2016-04-11-5-6"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil, Impeachment process against Dilma Rousseff.

**Archived source account.** A committee of Brazil's Chamber of Deputies votes 38–27 to recommend the impeachment of President Dilma Rousseff, who faces charges of breaking budget laws to support her re-election in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-idUSKCN0X81ZC>).

### 2016-04-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1193938731](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2012&oldid=1193938731>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-12-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** The Taliban announces its annual spring offensive to be named "Operation Omari".

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160413211640/http://www.voanews.com/content/taliban-launches-anti-government-spring-offensive/3280869.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-0-3"></a>

Context: PKK rebellion (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** A car bomb attack on a Turkish gendarmerie in the town of Hani kills at least two people and injures 50.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-kurds-attack-idUSKCN0X910W?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Air Force Mi-28 attack helicopter crashes near the Syrian city of Homs, killing two pilots.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-36022273>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-0-7"></a>

Context: Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** A French Army soldier is killed and three others are injured after their convoy hit a landmine in northern Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160412170413/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/mine-blast-kills-french-soldier-northern-mali-38335485>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** U.S. officials say unmanned airstrikes in southern Somalia killed about a dozen suspected militants from the al Qaeda-linked group al Shabaab on Monday and Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-somalia-airstrikes-idUSKCN0X9231>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A painting, Judith Beheading Holofernes, believed to be from Italian painter Caravaggio, is discovered in an attic in the French city of Toulouse.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2016/apr/12/lost-caravaggio-causes-rift-in-art-world>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-04-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports that it has seen a draft memorandum generated by the International Monetary Fund that describes the debt owed by Greece to its European partners as "highly unsustainable."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eurozone-greece-imf-review-idUSKCN0X924G>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A massive fire occurs in a textile factory in the Mumbai suburb of Bhiwandi in India's Maharashtra state. Fifty people are feared trapped.

Source citations (as archived): [IBN Live](<http://www.ibnlive.com/news/india/4-floor-building-near-mumbai-catches-fire-many-feared-trapped-1228599.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Pakistani police officer accidentally detonates a grenade in an anti-terrorism court in Karachi, injuring himself and a court assistant. The officer was attempting to demonstrate a grenade detonator to a judge and said the grenade was defused before pulling the pin.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/12/police-officer-accidentally-explodes-grenade-in-pakistan-court>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan accuses China of "extrajudicial abduction" after 45 Taiwanese acquitted of fraud in Kenya were forcibly deported to China.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36023738>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/04/13/world/asia/taiwan-china-kenya.html?_r=0>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/asia/la-fg-taiwan-beijing-deportations-20160413-story.html>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160414141557/http://www.voanews.com/content/china-accuses-taiwanese-nationals-deported-from-kenya-of-fraud/3283587.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-4-3"></a>

Context: North Korea – South Korea relations, North Korean defectors.

**Archived source account.** North Korea accuses South Korea of kidnapping its citizens and demands their immediate return after Seoul's Ministry of Unification said 13 of them had defected to South Korea from China, where they worked in a Pyongyang-operated restaurant. China says that the 13 people, a male manager and 12 young female employees, had legitimate passports and had freely exited China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/north-korea-claims-defectors-were-kidnapped-by-seoul>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-4-5"></a>

Context: Iran – Italy relations.

**Archived source account.** During a visit to Iran, Prime Minister of Italy Matteo Renzi signs various bilateral agreements to enhance relations between the two countries, including plans for cooperation between the Italian electricity and gas company Enel and the National Iranian Oil Company.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/iran-signs-cooperation-agreements-with-italian-prime-minister/27670962.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-4-7"></a>

Context: Bolivia – Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia and Bolivia meet to discuss how Russian defense firms can help the South American nation's long-term rearmament plan.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Security-Industry/2016/04/12/Russia-Bolivia-look-to-strengthen-military-ties/9271460478124/?spt=sec&amp;or=bn>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian 60 Minutes reporter Tara Brown and her crew are reportedly facing kidnapping charges in Lebanon following a bungled child recovery attempt.

Source citations (as archived): [Courier Mail](<http://www.couriermail.com.au/entertainment/television/60-minutes-crew-members-charged-over-botched-child/news-story/c221a05ca4e04fe36a884ed12e2cd6a8?sv=cc314cbc1ac5b7896c567d562e25d9ff>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-5-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** Belgium federal prosecutors say two more men have been charged with terrorist offenses linked to last month's Brussels bombing. Also, three people connected to the last year's Paris attacks are in custody.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belgium-blast-idUSKCN0X90JV>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-5-4"></a>

Context: North Carolina House Bill 2.

**Archived source account.** North Carolina Governor Pat McCrory signs Executive Order 73 that addresses some, but not all, troublesome provisions in House Bill 2 that caused businesses, traveling recording stars, etc., to stay clear of the state. The order does expand the state's anti-discrimination employment policy to include LBGT protection, but reiterates that people use the marked facility consistent with "... their biological sex." The American Civil Liberties Union says the order, "... fall(s) far short of correcting the damage done... (and that)... transgender people are still explicitly targeted by being forced to use the wrong restroom." Equality North Carolina says, "... the order doubles down on the Governor's support for some of the most problematic provisions of HB2."

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/04/12/473982918/n-c-governor-signs-order-that-clarifies-controversial-gender-identity-bill>); [WSOC](<http://www.wsoctv.com/news/read-more-statements-regarding-mccrorys-executive-order-93-on-hb2/212122374>); [WNCN](<http://wncn.com/2016/04/12/mccrory-issues-executive-order-on-house-bill-2/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-5-6"></a>

Context: Panama Papers.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Panama raid law firm Mossack Fonseca, the source of the data leaked about offshore companies.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.rappler.com/world/regions/latin-america/129261-authorities-raid-panama-papers-scandal-firm-mossack-fonseca>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-5-8"></a>

Context: Bad Aibling rail accident.

**Archived source account.** A German train controller, who was operating the tracks where two trains collided on February 9 near the town of Bad Aibling, Bavaria, is arrested on possible manslaughter charges. Prosecutors say the controller had been playing a game on his mobile phone, which led to his making signalling errors. The crash resulted in 11 deaths and 85 injuries, 24 serious.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/04/12/Controller-in-deadly-German-train-crash-was-playing-game-on-his-phone-officials-say/5911460483138/?spt=rln&amp;or=2>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-12-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people take to the streets of Handwara, Jammu and Kashmir after Indian Army soldiers shot dead at least two people during a protest against an alleged case of sexual harassment by an army soldier against a young woman.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/rage-kashmir-killing-youths-indian-army-160412130941763.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-6-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Paul Ryan, Speaker of the United States House of Representatives, rules out seeking or accepting the Republican Party nomination in 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2016/04/12/ryan-to-rule-out-2016-bid-once-and-for-all-source-says.html?intcmp=hpbt1>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-6-4"></a>

Context: Brazil impeachment process, 2016.

**Archived source account.** President Dilma Rousseff, speaking with teachers and students, says Vice President Michel Temer and Chamber of Deputies Speaker Eduardo Cunha are jointly plotting her downfall. The two men are in line to succeed her if she is impeached.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/congress/brazil-congressional-committee-votes-in-favor-of-impeachment/2016/04/11/9d27fbac-0046-11e6-8bb1-f124a43f84dc_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-6-5"></a>

Context: Brazil impeachment process, 2016.

**Archived source account.** In a 13-minute audio tape he released Monday, Vice President Temer outlines his administration in the event that President Rousseff is impeached. Temer says he unintentionally sent the tape to lawmakers through an instant messenger app.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-04-11/brazil-s-vp-practices-national-unity-speech-in-leaked-audio>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/congress/brazil-congressional-committee-votes-in-favor-of-impeachment/2016/04/11/9d27fbac-0046-11e6-8bb1-f124a43f84dc_story.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-04-12-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A British brain scan study of Lysergic acid diethylamide shows LSD may be useful in treating mental disorders such as major depressive disorder.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://www.bbc.co.uk/newsbeat/article/36022065/what-lsd-does-to-your-brain>); [Nature](<http://www.nature.com/news/brain-scans-reveal-how-lsd-affects-consciousness-1.19727>).

<a id="event-2016-04-12-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** British cosmologist Stephen Hawking and Russian venture capitalist and physicist Yuri Milner announce "Breakthrough Starshot", a $100 million effort to plan a trip to the sun's closest stellar neighbor, Alpha Centauri, via developing nanotechnology that would put the craft within the star system roughly 20 years after leaving Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2016/04/12/Yuri-Milner-and-Stephen-Hawking-announce-Breakthrough-Starshot/7031460489701/?spt=rln&amp;or=2>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-04-12-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In rugby union, Allister Coetzee is named as the new coach of the South Africa national rugby team.

Source citations (as archived): [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/sport/rugby/springboks/coetzee-named-new-bok-coach-2008260>).

### 2016-04-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355079799](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2013&oldid=1355079799>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Moro Conflict / Battle of Tipo-Tipo.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for clashes between militants linked to the group and the Philippine Army that claimed 23 lives.

Context: War in Donbass.

<a id="event-2016-04-13-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-04-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed and 20 injured following a road accident in the Pakistani city of Faisalabad.

<a id="event-2016-04-13-3-2"></a>

Context: April 2016 Myanmar earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.9 earthquake strikes Myanmar 396 kilometers (246 miles) north of the capital, Naypyidaw, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.

<a id="event-2016-04-13-3-5"></a>

Context: 2014–16 El Niño event.

**Archived source account.** Indian officials report, with 24 deaths today, the heatwave in the eastern state of Odisha has killed 135 people. Temperatures of 105.5°F (40.8°C) were recorded yesterday at 19 locations across the state. Meteorologists say the heat, an after-effect of El Niño, has delayed the traditional April rains.

<a id="event-2016-04-13-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Britten-Norman Islander light aircraft crashes in the Papua New Guinea town of Kiunga resulting in the deaths of all twelve people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-14/plane-crash-in-papua-new-guinea-12-people-reported-dead/7325226>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-04-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirms that the Zika virus causes birth defects like microcephaly.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/health/2016/04/13/cdc-says-its-now-clear-that-zika-virus-causes-microcephaly.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations, Cold War II.

**Archived source account.** Two unarmed Russian Air Force Sukhoi Su-24 jets flew simulated attacks on United States Navy destroyer USS Donald Cook in the Baltic Sea on Tuesday, according to a U.S. official, who described it as one of the most aggressive interactions in recent memory. A Russian Kamov Ka-27 naval helicopter also made seven passes around the USS Donald Cook, taking pictures of the warship.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-russia-simulatedattack-idUSKCN0XA1UW>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-13-6-1"></a>

Context: Recognition of same-sex unions in China.

**Archived source account.** A judge rules against a gay couple in China's first same-sex marriage case.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/eec38d8ae3a248fc9cc435e5bd9ff627/judge-rules-against-gay-couple-chinas-first-same-sex>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-6-3"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Three people arrested yesterday in connection with last year's attacks in Paris are released without charge.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP/Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-13/belgium-releases-paris-attacks-suspects-a-day-after-arrest/7324670>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-6-5"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Louisiana Governor John Bel Edwards signs an anti-discrimination order protecting the rights of gay and transgender people that rescinds one his immediate predecessor, Bobby Jindal, signed that sought to limit same-sex marriage rights and the ability of transgender people to choose which public restrooms they may use.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/louisiana-lgbt-anti-discrimination_us_570e7a6be4b0ffa5937dcc96>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-13-7-1"></a>

Context: 2016 South Korean legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in South Korea go to the polls for a legislative election with the ruling Saenuri Party losing seats in a surprise setback.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20190909230706/http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_SOUTH_KOREA_PARLIAMENTARY_ELECTION?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-04-14/south-korea-s-ruling-party-chief-resigns-over-election-loss>).

Context: 2016 South Korean legislative election.

**Archived source account.** The opposition Minjoo Party of Korea wins the most seats in the Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36033773>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-7-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Syrian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in mostly government-controlled areas of Syria will head to the polls to elect 250 members to the People's Council of Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/333290-syria-assad-general-election/>); [TeleSUR](<http://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Syria-Parliamentary-Elections-in-Assad-Controlled-Areas-20160411-0039.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-7-6"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** The Progressive Party announces it is leaving President Dilma Rousseff's coalition government and that its 47 politicians would support her impeachment.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/brazil-dilma-rousseff-loses-coalition-partner-160413134906687.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-7-8"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Massive demonstrations in support of the Free Papua Movement take place in various cities in the Indonesian provinces of Papua and West Papua. The demonstrations voice support for the Liberation Movement to become a full member of the Melanesian Spearhead Group.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/301427/mass-demos-in-support-of-papua-liberation-movement>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-7-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** A number of people were injured in clashes between police and several thousand protestors in Skopje, Macedonia, with demonstrators breaking into President Gjorge Ivanov's offices.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/339488-macedonia-protests-clashes-arrests/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-04-13-8-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 NBA season.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the 2015–16 Golden State Warriors team sets a new NBA record for regular season wins with 73 wins this season. The 1995–96 Chicago Bulls previously held the record with 72.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/sports/wp/2016/04/14/golden-state-warriors-break-1995-96-chicago-bulls-wins-record/?wpisrc=al_alert-COMBO-sports%252Bnation>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-8-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 NBA season.

**Archived source account.** Kobe Bryant plays his last game in the NBA for the Los Angeles Lakers. He sets a new points record for a final match scoring 60 against the Utah Jazz.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/wizards/the-latest-ex-bulls-c-wennington-not-pulling-for-warriors/2016/04/13/7f336192-01d4-11e6-8bb1-f124a43f84dc_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-13-8-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Anti-Doping Agency advises that WADA-accredited laboratories are currently conducting studies on meldonium excretion rates since existing data is lacking. Meldonium became a banned substance on January 1, 2016. A large number of athletes, including grand-slam tennis champion Maria Sharapova, had taken the medication in the past, and have tested positive this year. The new data will address how long meldonium stays in the body and determine if athletes were provided a reasonable amount of time to adhere to the new restrictions prior to testing. The drug was used by many Soviet-bloc athletes since the 80s.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/doping-wada-meldonium-idINKCN0XA0WO>); [WADA](<https://www.wada-ama.org/en/media/news/2016-04/wada-statement-on-meldonium-notice-issued-to-stakeholders>).

### 2016-04-14

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-14-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban militants kill eight people, including a police commander, in an ambush in northern Afghanistan.

<a id="event-2016-04-14-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian wielding an ax attacks an Israeli soldier near Hebron and is shot dead while two 12-year-old Palestinians in Jerusalem are arrested by Israeli Police with three knives concealed in their coats on suspicion of planning to carry out a stabbing attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-kids-arrested-with-knives-in-jerusalem/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-14-1-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/ukraine-recovers-4-stolen-dutch-paintings/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-14-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Kumamoto earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes near Kumamoto, Japan, collapsing several buildings killing at least four people and injuring 400. However, no tsunami warning was issued and local nuclear power plants reported no problems.,,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-quake-idUSKCN0XB1K6>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/14/asia/japan-earthquake/>); [Japan Today](<http://www.japantoday.com/category/national/view/strong-quake-hits-kyushu-region-4-dead-400-injured>).

<a id="event-2016-04-14-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 18 people are killed after an 80-tonne crane collapses on a temporary structure during a thunderstorm in the city of Dongguan, China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/china/Crane-collapse-at-Chinese-construction-site-kills-18/articleshow/51820938.cms>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-14-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea deploys one or two intermediate-range ballistic missiles on its east coast, possibly preparing for launch on or around Friday, the anniversary of the birth of the country's founder Kim Il-sung, according to South Korea's Yonhap news agency.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/newswires/3180165-north-korea-seen-moving-intermediate-range-ballistic-missiles-yonhap/>).

**Archived source account.** The People's Republic of China announces that it will prosecute 357 people for the illegal sale of vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-36041918>).

<a id="event-2016-04-14-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. company Microsoft has sued the United States, alleging that it has been prevented from disclosing warrants to the company's customers in violation of the company's constitutional rights.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/04/15/technology/microsoft-sues-us-over-orders-barring-it-from-revealing-surveillance.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=first-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-14-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Verkhovna Rada appoints Volodmyr Groysman as the Prime Minister of Ukraine, replacing Arseny Yatseniuk.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160520043627/http://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKCN0XB0O1>).

<a id="event-2016-04-14-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Jammu and Kashmir impose a curfew around the capital of Srinagar, Handwara, and neighbouring villages as protests turn violent. People began to protest last Tuesday when allegations were circulated by residents in Handwara that an Indian Army soldier tried to sexually assault a teenage schoolgirl.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/clashes-curfew-tense-kashmir-army-killings-india-160413173103704.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-14-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong's June 4th Museum, the first museum dedicated to the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, is to close down. Organizers say they believe they are being targeted for political reasons. It comes at a time when concerns are growing in Hong Kong that Beijing is tightening its grip on the city.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/14/worlds-first-tiananmen-museum-close-hong-kong>).

<a id="event-2016-04-14-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of opposition supporters rally in Harare, Zimbabwe, against President Robert Mugabe and the deteriorating economy. The rally was banned by the police, however, it went ahead after a ruling by the High Court sanctioned the protest.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36047601>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-04-14-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the WNBA draft is held in Uncasville, Connecticut. The top pick is Connecticut's Breanna Stewart, followed by her college teammates Moriah Jefferson and Morgan Tuck. This marks the first time in any major North American sports draft that a single school produced the top three selections.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/wnba/story/_/id/15206002/wnba-draft-breanna-stewart-selected-seattle-storm-no-1-overall-pick>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A battle rages in the Kunduz Province of Afghanistan as the Taliban launches its spring offensive to capture the city of Kunduz. According to a Taliban spokesperson, several outposts already fell to them but this could not be verified immediately while a police chief says that the security forces were keeping "the situation under control".

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-15-1-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missile-idUSKCN0XC010>).

<a id="event-2016-04-15-3-4"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** Chinese state media condemn the action saying that saber-rattling will "lead the country to nowhere".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/15/north-korea-missile-launch-fails-as-kim-il-sung-birthday-honoured>).

<a id="event-2016-04-15-3-6"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** John Kerry informs Russia that under the rules of engagement the plane that flew over the USS Donald Cook on April 13th could have been shot down.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160418091352/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/us-could-have-shot-down-russian-jet-that-buzzed-destroyer-kerry/ar-BBrN72g?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2016-04-15-3-8"></a>

Context: Poland–Russia relations, NATO–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Polish Foreign Minister Witold Waszczykowski, during a visit to Slovakia for talks on the future of NATO, says Russia is more dangerous than the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL). “By all evidence, Russia’s activity is a sort of existential threat because this activity can destroy countries,” Waszczykowski told reporters in Bratislava. He described ISIL as a very serious threat but said “it is not an existential threat for Europe”.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/15/russia-more-dangerous-isis-polish-foreign-minister-witold-waszczykowski>).

<a id="event-2016-04-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Rwanda jail former politician Léon Mugesera for life. Mugesera was known for describing Tutsis as "cockroaches" and called for their extermination in a speech in 1992 and is said to be a precursor to the Rwandan genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36057575>).

<a id="event-2016-04-15-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two firefighters are shot, one fatally and the other is in critical condition, during a welfare check in Temple Hills, Maryland.

<a id="event-2016-04-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The New York Post, a daily newspaper controlled by media magnate Rupert Murdoch, makes a u-turn and endorses Donald Trump for President of the United States.

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

Context: Impeachment process against Dilma Rousseff.

<a id="event-2016-04-15-5-9"></a>

However, this change must still win cabinet approval before the foreign ministry can lodge the name with the United Nations for it to become the country’s official short name.
