### 2016-04-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099020129](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2016&oldid=1099020129>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-16-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** According to a police chief, at least 40 Taliban fighters are killed after launching an offensive against Afghan security forces to seize the strategic northern city of Kunduz while four security force personnel are also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/taliban-fighters-launch-attack-afghanistan-kunduz-160415133525370.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** AMISOM soldiers kill four Somali civilians in the town of Bulla Marer, southwest of Mogadishu. The AU Mission said scared soldiers opened fire when the car the civilians were driving failed to stop at a roadblock.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36063753>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Philippine officials report four Indonesian sailors were kidnapped last night off the Philippines' southernmost town of Sitangkai, Tawi-Tawi, near Malaysia's Sabah state. Seven gunmen in a blue speedboat attacked two Indonesian-flagged tugboats. Six other sailors, including one who was shot, were not taken by ISIL-linked Abu Sayyaf militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/philippines-militants-indonesians-idINKCN0XD0E5>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government airstrikes, and rockets from Islamist insurgents, hit many neighborhoods in Aleppo. Fatalities are reported on both sides of the city. This continued fighting threatens the truce and peace talks being held in Geneva, Switzerland. UN envoy Staffan de Mistura says he will meet the government delegation Monday, and will sit down with the main opposition High Negotiations Committee later in the week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-aleppo-idUSKCN0XD0QY>); [AFP](<http://www.thanhniennews.com/world/aleppo-battles-cast-shadow-over-syria-peace-talks-61287.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ethiopia claims that members of South Sudan's Murle people have killed 140 people and abducted 39 children.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36064710>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** German police report an apparent deliberate explosion at a Sikh temple in Essen while a wedding was being celebrated, has injured three people, one in serious condition. Police say there is no indication this was a terrorist incident.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/af0001c5bb16469cbe9ec2c408992a51/explosion-injures-3-sikh-temple-western-germany>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Army approves 22 soldiers requests to become the service's first female infantry and armor unit officers. Thirteen women will enter the armor branch, and nine others will enter infantry as second lieutenants.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/04/16/Army-approves-22-women-as-infantry-armor-officers/3741460808615/?spt=rln&amp;or=4>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** A second earthquake hits southern Japan with a magnitude of 7.1 killing at least 32 people with the death toll from both earthquakes rising to 42. The new quake traps even more people. In Kumamoto a landslide occurs as well as a bridge collapse. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://in.news.yahoo.com/japan-quake-kills-one-sparks-212410223.html>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20190909231059/http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_JAPAN_EARTHQUAKE_THE_LATEST_ASOL-?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [AP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/twin-quakes-kills-least-29-051640797.html?ref=gs>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** A new aftershock with a magnitude of 5.4 hits southern Kyushu island. A Japanese spokesman says 1,500 people have been injured, 80 seriously, since Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1e9c481b9b9f4282a439c4c1660fd215/latest-abe-warns-rains-may-bring-more-misery>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/04/15/aftershocks-rock-japan-after-magnitude-65-quake/83072544/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** Japan's Mount Aso in the Kumamoto Prefecture erupts sending ash about 100 meters (300 feet) into the air. The Japan Meteorological Agency kept its alert level at 2 on a scale of 5 for Aso following the eruption. It is unclear if the eruption is related to Saturday’s Kumamoto quake.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2016/04/16/national/small-eruption-seen-on-mount-aso-after-latest-quakes/#.VxGgE3pRJFQ>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** Saturday's earthquake forces Sony to close its plant in the Kumamoto Prefecture. Toyota, Honda, and Nissan also stop work at several plants in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/2016/04/16/Japan-quake-causes-Sony-others-to-shut-down-plants-in-region/2711460834197/?spt=hts&amp;or=1>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A helicopter crashes near Baltimore–Washington International Airport in Baltimore, Maryland. However, no fatalities are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.euronews.com/newswires/3181334-helicopter-crash-reported-near-baltimore-washington-airport/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are dead and five are in hospital after taking ecstasy at an Argentine version of the Time Warp Festival featuring electronic music acts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/five-dead-five-hospital-argentine-electronic-music-festival-200518464.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll rises to seven from Thursday's building collapse in the Canary Islands' southern coastal town of Los Cristianos on the island of Tenerife.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1c85e76aafc5455e98ec626c486c3b92/death-toll-canary-islands-building-collapse-climbs-6>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-9"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes off the coast of Ecuador, near the town of Muisne. The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center issues a tsunami alert for coastal areas of Ecuador and Colombia. At least 42 people are reported dead with deaths reported in the cities of Manta, Guayaquil and Portoviejo.

Source citations (as archived): [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160419002347/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id4133>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us20005j32#general>); [Reuters](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/7-8-magnitude-earthquake-hits-near-ecuador-s-coast-usgs-n557181>); [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/17/at-least-28-killed-in-powerful-magnitude-7-8-earthquake-ecuador-vice-president-says.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-10"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A state of emergency is declared in six provinces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36065551?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-2-11"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Later, the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center announces the threat has largely passed. The United States Geological Survey reports the 7.8 magnitude quake was preceded, 11 minutes earlier, by a 4.8 earthquake. Production at the 110,000 barrel-per-day Esmeraldas refinery is suspended as a precautionary measure.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/world/americas/powerful-74-earthquake-rocks-ecuador-usgs>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-16-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis arrives on the Greek island of Lesbos. Francis is expected to visit the Moria detention facility, where he will have lunch with some of the 3,060 men, women, and children there.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/pope-francis-arrives-on-lesbos-in-visit-intended-to-prick-europes-conscience/2016/04/16/b0a66c08-fd09-11e5-813a-90ab563f0dde_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-3-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis offers refuge to a dozen Syrian Muslims, three families with six children, who faced deportation from Lesbos. The refugees accompanied the Pope on his return trip to Rome.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/16/pope-francis-flies-to-lesbos-to-highlight-humanitarian-crisis-in-europe>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-3-4"></a>

Context: Iran–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** EU Foreign policy chief Federica Mogherini holds the highest-level talks between the EU and Iran in decades to mark a new phase in relations between the two. Both sides are keen to focus on trade, energy and the environment as possible areas of cooperation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36061664>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States announces that it will transfer nine Yemeni detainees from the Guantanamo Bay detention camp to Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/16/politics/guantanamo-detainees-transfer/index.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/f05bfc64420e4d68bfbd318ed55e69bb/us-frees-9-guantanamo-prisoners-sends-them-saudi-arabia>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-3-7"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations, Cold War II.

**Archived source account.** A United States Air Force Boeing RC-135 reconnaissance aircraft was intercepted and threatened by a Russian Sukhoi Su-27 fighter jet in international airspace over the Baltic Sea on Thursday (April 14), according to the United States European Command (EUCOM).

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/16/russian-jet-threatens-u-s-reconnaissance-aircraft.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** General Salvador Cienfuegos Zepeda, Mexico's Secretary of National Defence, apologises for an incident in which two soldiers and a policewoman torture a woman. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20160416-mexican-army-apologizes-womans-torture?ns_campaign=reseaux_sociaux&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_linkname=editorial&amp;aef_campaign_ref=partage_aef&amp;aef_campaign_date=2016-04-16&amp;dlvrit=66745>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraq's Parliament cancels its third session in a week to discuss political reforms as some MPs dispute the legitimacy of speaker Salim al-Jabouri to chair the meeting. Also, protesters gathered in the streets of Baghdad to protest the growing political deadlock in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/iraq-political-crisis-160416105131271.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-5-2"></a>

Context: Macedonian parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** As protesters continue to take to the streets of Skopje, Macedonia, lawmakers confirmed that a snap election will take place on June 5 despite the protesters being angry at President Gjorge Ivanov’s decision to halt investigations into more than 50 public figures, including top politicians embroiled in a wire-tapping scandal. Zoran Zaev, the main opposition leader, vowed to boycott the election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/16/protests-amid-crisis-after-macedonia-calls-snap-elections-for-june>).

<a id="event-2016-04-16-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Veteran President of the Republic of the Congo Denis Sassou Nguesso is sworn in for another term after a contentious election.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3543677/Veteran-Congo-leader-Sassou-Nguesso-sworn-disputed-election.html>).

### 2016-04-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099020413](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2017&oldid=1099020413>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-17-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Heavy fighting continues in the north of Afghanistan as Taliban fighters intensify their attacks in several districts around Kunduz in their bid to retake the city. According to a police chief, militants overnight attacked several police checkpoints in the southwest outskirts of the city while government forces repelled a major attack to the east of Kunduz.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/afghanistan-fighting-kunduz-taliban/27680062.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-17-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Saturday night's earthquake in Ecuador rises to 262 with more than 2,500 people injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/17/at-least-41-killed-after-powerful-7-8-magnitude-earthquake-strikes-ecuador.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36065551#>); [AFP/Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-18/ecuador-earthquake-leaves-hundreds-dead/7333472>); [AP²](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160418233154/http://www.miamiherald.com/news/business/article72314847.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying members of the Bharati Gananatya opera troupe crashes into a gorge in India's Odisha state resulting in 25 people killed and 11 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-18/bus-carrying-indian-opera-troupe-plunges-into-gorge/7333560>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A drone collides at London's Heathrow Airport with an Airbus A320 carrying 132 passengers and five crew, with no injuries reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/plane-may-have-collided-with-drone-at-heathrow-lands-safely-bbc-20160417-go8k6k.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Members of OPEC meet in Doha, Qatar, amid uncertainty in the markets and the outcome of the meeting. Since 2014, the price of oil has dropped dramatically. Analysts hope that an agreement to freeze output will reassure global energy markets that the recent recovery in prices is sustainable.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/uncertainty-grips-markets-opec-meeting-160416093429469.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-2-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Israel Benjamin Netanyahu vows that the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights, recognized as part of Syria, will forever stay in the country's hands and called on the international community to recognize Israeli sovereignty over the area.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36067643>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-2-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Foreign Ministry condemns the Israeli cabinet meeting held on occupied Syrian-territory and, in letters to both the Security Council and the Secretary-General of the United Nations, calls on the U.N. to condemn Israel's action.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2016/Apr-18/347891-netanyahu-vows-golan-will-remain-israels-forever.ashx>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-2-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Su-27 jet intercepts a United States Air Force RC-135 reconnaissance plane while in international airspace over the Baltic Sea. U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry says, "We condemn this kind of behavior. It is reckless. It is provocative. It is dangerous."

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.straitstimes.com/world/united-states/close-call-as-russian-jet-intercepts-us-recon-plane>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** The President of Myanmar Htin Kyaw pardons 83 political prisoners. A total of 282 people accused of political crimes have been released or had charges dropped since the new National League for Democracy government gained power on April 1.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20160417051807-tpd0x>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/myanmars-new-president-htin-kyaw-to-continue-releasing-prisoners/a-19193761>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-17-4-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Presidential frontrunner Rodrigo Duterte jokes about an Australian woman being raped and murdered in Davao City.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/politics/elections/2016/129784-viral-video-duterte-joke-australian-woman-rape>); [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-17/philippines-presidential-candidate-condemned-for-joke-about-rape/7333300>); [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/philippines-rodrigo-duterte-condemned-for-comments-on-rape-of-australian-missionary-20160417-go8j7b.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36067011#>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-4-3"></a>

Context: Italian oil drilling referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Italian referendum proposes repealing the law that allows oil drilling concessions extracting Hydrocarbon within 12 nautical miles of the Italian coast to be prolonged until the exhaustion of the useful life of the fields.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/04/12/italian-referendum-on-drilling-for-oil-could-shape-the-country-s-energy-policy/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-4-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2016 Brussels bombings.

**Archived source account.** At least 7,000 people take to the streets of Brussels, Belgium, in a march "against terror and hate." However, turnout was less than half of what was hoped for by organizers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36067404>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests continue in Skopje, Republic of Macedonia, against President Gjorge Ivanov's decision to suspend an investigation into the alleged corruption of a number of politicians.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sofia Globe](<http://sofiaglobe.com/2016/04/17/protests-in-macedonia-against-ivanov-continue/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-4-8"></a>

Context: Impeachment process against Dilma Rousseff.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's Chamber of Deputies votes overwhelmingly (367-137) in favor of impeachment procedures against President Dilma Rousseff.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://ca.news.yahoo.com/brazils-rousseff-loses-crucial-impeachment-vote-congress-015138598--business.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-17-4-10"></a>

Context: United States presidential election in California, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Los Angeles Times reports that close to 500,000 California voters, who wanted to register as an Independent but checked the American Independent Party box instead, may be ineligible to vote in the state's Democratic and Republican primaries.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://static.latimes.com/american-independent-party-california-voters/>); [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/california-voter-primary-american-independent-party-449077?google_editors_picks=true>).

### 2016-04-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131711771](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2018&oldid=1131711771>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian rebels launch new offensives against government forces in the country's Latakia Governorate and Hama Governorate. Several rebel groups earlier announced they were launching a new battle against government forces in response to claimed violations of the cease-fire agreement, further putting a strain on the Syrian peace process.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/syria-rebels-attack-government-positions/27681803.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rockets fired by ISIL from northern Syria hit the Turkish town of Kilis killing four people, most of them children.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36077052>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-0-5"></a>

Context: 2015–2016 wave of violence in Israeli–Palestinian conflict / 2016 Jerusalem bus bombing.

**Archived source account.** A bomb explosion in Jerusalem set two buses on fire and injured 21 people with ball bearing and nails. Israeli police say they believe the incident was a suicide bombing but no group has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/04/18/israeli-radio-reports-explosion-on-bus-in-jerusalem-20-casualties/>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4793280,00.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-0-7"></a>

Context: Ethnic violence in South Sudan, Sudanese nomadic conflicts.

**Archived source account.** According to the government of Ethiopia, the death toll from a raid carried out by attackers from South Sudan has risen to 208 from a figure of 140 a day earlier, with 108 children being kidnapped in the process. Ethiopian forces killed 60 of the attackers and says it would cross the border into South Sudan to pursue the assailants if necessary.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/ethiopia-attack-200-people-dead-100-children-missing-160418045025770.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Pulitzer Prizes.

**Archived source account.** The Associated Press wins the Pulitzer Prize for Public Service for documenting the use of slave labor in Southeast Asia to supply seafood to American tables.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_PULITZERS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-1-2"></a>

Context: Pulitzer Prizes.

**Archived source account.** Lin-Manuel Miranda wins the Pulitzer Prize for Drama for the musical Hamilton based on the life of American founding father Alexander Hamilton.

Source citations (as archived): [Buzzfeed](<https://www.buzzfeed.com/davidmack/hamilton-the-musical-just-won-a-pulitzer-prize-for-lin-manue#.onWw9JEkD>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-04-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The meeting in Doha, Qatar, of the world's top oil producers, from both OPEC and non-OPEC countries, fails to agree on an output freeze. Oil analysts say the failure was due to Iran's non-participation, and Saudi Arabia linking its cooperation to Iran's inclusion. Oil prices drop in early Asian trading and on the New York Mercantile Exchange.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/world/937685/oil-prices-plunge-after-doha-output-talks-fail>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2016/04/17/doha-oil-producers-meeting-ends-without-an-agreement.html>); [Oilprice.com](<http://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/The-Complete-Overview-Of-The-Doha-Meeting.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A member of the board of the Bundesbank in Germany says that the European Central Bank ought to crack down on the political practice, in EU's member states, by which banks that are no longer viable are nonetheless kept in business, as so-called Zombie banks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ecb-banks-bundesbank-idUSKCN0XF1NP>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-2-3"></a>

Context: Cuba-United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Carnival Cruise Lines says it will postpone its first cruise in 50 years from the United States to Havana, if Cuba does not waive its rule and allow Cuban-Americans passengers. Current Cuban law does not allow those born on the island to return by sea.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/04/18/Carnival-wont-sail-to-Havana-if-Cuban-born-passengers-banned/2551460998258/?spt=rln&amp;or=4>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160428173304/http://www.cnbc.com/2016/04/18/carnival-may-delay-cuba-cruise-over-discrimination-concerns.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-18-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** The Japanese Red Cross says that 250,000 people have been asked to leave their homes due to further tremors.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36069405>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-3-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Aid starts to flow in after an earthquake kills over 270 people in Ecuador.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/17/at-least-28-killed-in-powerful-magnitude-7-8-earthquake-ecuador-vice-president-says.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36067380>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-3-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** More than 400 migrants, mostly from Somalia, drown in the Mediterranean Sea while traveling from Egypt to Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/04/18/400-migrants-feared-dead-after-boat-capsizes-in-mediterranean/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Violent storms cause floods across Uruguay with seven people killed and more than 2,000 left homeless. Four of those were killed by a tornado that struck Dolores. Four million people in the Chilean capital of Santiago were left without tap water as heavy rains triggered landslides. This led to the fouling of the city's water supply.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/violent-storms-floods-chile-uruguay-160418093821810.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-3-8"></a>

Context: 2016 Houston floods.

**Archived source account.** Heavy rain of more than 1 ft causes major flooding in Houston, Texas, affecting 1,000 homes, causing five deaths and causing power outages for over 100,000 residents.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/04/18/us/houston-texas-flooding/index.html>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation-now/2016/04/18/texas-rain-flooding/83176532/>); [Time](<http://time.com/4298661/houston-flooding-weather-rain-flash-floods/?xid=homepage>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-3-9"></a>

Context: 2016 Houston floods.

**Archived source account.** Texas Governor Greg Abbott declares nine counties in the southeastern part of the state disaster areas.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/04/18/Texas-governor-declares-disaster-in-9-counties-amid-punishing-rain-flooding-several-dead/7441460988705/?spt=rln&amp;or=2>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Australia–Philippines relations, Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Australian Ambassador to the Philippines Amanda Gorely criticizes Philippine presidential frontrunner Rodrigo Duterte regarding his remarks about the rape of an Australian citizen.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/politics/elections/2016/129888-australia-rodrigo-duterte-rape-joke>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/04/18/world/asia/ap-as-philippines-australia-rape-remark.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-4-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** During a visit to Baghdad, U.S. Defense Secretary Ash Carter announces that the United States will be sending more troops to the country to help in the fight against ISIL. The U.S. also plans to give Kurdish Peshmerga forces, which are fighting ISIL on the ground, more than $400m (£280m; €350m) in assistance.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-36075452>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-18-5-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** A Ukrainian court sentences two Russian nationals to 14 years in prison each on charges of fighting alongside Russian-backed separatists in eastern Ukraine. Moscow contends that the two Russians were no longer employed by the state when they were captured.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/ukraine-russian-soldiers-guilty-waging-war/27681865.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-18-6-1"></a>

Context: Philippine general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Bongbong Marcos, the son of dictator Ferdinand Marcos and top vice presidential candidate, defends Duterte's remarks about rape.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/780058/marcos-duterte-joke-inappropriate-but>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-6-3"></a>

Context: Italian oil drilling referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The referendum fails to exceed the 50% turnout level necessary to make the results binding; turnout was recorded at 31.2%.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-oildrilling-idUSKCN0XE086>).

<a id="event-2016-04-18-6-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Macedonian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests against President Gjorge Ivanov continue in Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, after his decision to pardon politicians involved in a scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<http://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/macedonia-enters-second-week-of-anti-government-protests/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-04-18-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 30,000 runners participate in the 120th running of the Boston Marathon. Two Ethiopian runners win. Adriana Haslett and Patrick Downes, survivors of the 2013 bombing who each lost a leg in the blast, were in the field.

Source citations (as archived): [The Boston Globe](<https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/specials/boston-marathon/2016/04/18/boston-marathon/c1Ep6NCpnnPwbqEzUENKlL/story.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/04/18/474710728/boston-marathon-results-ethiopian-runners-shut-kenyans-out-of-top-spots>).

### 2016-04-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099021277](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2019&oldid=1099021277>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-19-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / April 2016 Kabul attack.

**Archived source account.** A large explosion is reported in the Afghan capital Kabul a week after the Taliban declared the start of their annual spring offensive. The target was an Afghan government security compound with at least 28 people reported killed and more than 200 others injured.,

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/Heavy-explosion-rocks-Kabul/articleshow/51889024.cms>); [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/19/latest-taliban-launches-attack-on-afghan-govt-agency.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / April 2016 Kabul attack.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council condemns today's attack in Kabul by the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/the-latest-taliban-launches-attack-on-afghan-govt-agency/2016/04/19/5cac171a-0605-11e6-bfed-ef65dff5970d_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-0-5"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber explodes his vest next to a government building in Mardan, Pakistan, killing one person and critically wounding three more.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/pakistan-suicide-blast-mardan/27683442.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-0-7"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi officials, following arrested IS militants' directions, uncover two mass graves with bodies of about 40 people in Ramadi.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/19/iraqi-police-find-2-mass-graves-in-islamic-state-free-ramadi.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes that were likely carried out by Syrian government forces kill around 40 people in a crowded market in rebel territory in Syria's Idlib Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-usa-idINKCN0XG2KQ>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Saturday's earthquake has risen to at least 480 with 1,700 missing. Another 2,500 have been injured. President Rafael Correa states it is the worst disaster in Ecuador in seven decades, and the reconstruction will have a "huge economic impact" on the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36079014>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/death-toll-nears-500-from-ecuador-earthquake/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Sweden–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Swedish deputy prime minister Åsa Romson is criticized after referring to the September 11 attacks in New York as mere "accidents". Romson made the comments on public television while discussing the resignation of housing minister Mehmet Kaplan who had compared Israel's treatment of Arabs to the Nazis' treatment of Jews during the Holocaust.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3547291/Sweden-s-deputy-PM-sparks-outcry-describing-9-11-Twin-Towers-attack-September-11-accidents.html>); [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.se/20160419/swedens-deputy-pm-defends-911-accident-gaffe>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-2-3"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Under pressure from the Chinese delegation, Belgian Deputy Prime Minister Kris Peeters ejects the Taiwanese delegation from a symposium of the OECD Steel Committee; it was the first such incident since Taiwan joined the OECD Steel Committee in 2005.

Source citations (as archived): [Focus Taiwan](<http://focustaiwan.tw/news/aipl/201604190009.aspx>); [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3547411/Taiwan-protests-ejection-OECD-steel-talks-blames-China.html>); [AFP](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2016/Apr-19/348104-taiwan-protests-after-officials-barred-by-china-at-oecd-meet.ashx>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Union offers to help the fledgling new UN-backed Libyan unity government with assistance in its security sector, managing migration, border management and police capacity building. This comes after Libyan Prime Minister Fayez al-Sarraj appealed to foreign governments for help in fighting ISIL and aid to rebuild the country.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/19/libya-offered-security-help-by-european-union-fayez-seraj>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-2-6"></a>

Context: India–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** In response to an ongoing Supreme Court case regarding the ownership of the Koh-i-Noor diamond, the government of India said it should not try to reclaim it from the United Kingdom. The government argues that the diamond was given to the British as a gift and was not stolen. However, the Supreme Court says it will continue with the case.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-36079644>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in China sentence Huang Yu, a computer technician from Sichuan who worked for a government department which handled state secrets, to death for leaking more than 150,000 classified documents to an unidentified foreign power. The documents in question covered secrets ranging from the ruling Communist Party to military and financial issues.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/19/chinese-man-sentenced-to-death-for-leaking-150000-classified-documents>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lutz Bachmann, the leader of the German far-right and anti-Islam Pegida movement, goes on trial in Dresden on charges of hate speech.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36079533>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-3-3"></a>

Context: Transgender rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** An American federal appeals court in Richmond, Virginia, rules a transgender high school student who was banned from the boys' bathroom can proceed with the lawsuit against the school board.

Source citations (as archived): [Richmond Times-Dispatch](<http://www.richmond.com/news/virginia/article_7ec45a28-5b5f-585f-a200-b7aba2cdd940.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-3-4"></a>

Context: Transgender rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Yesterday, the U.S. Commission on Civil Rights issued a statement that North Carolina House Bill 2, a so-called bathroom bill, "...jeopardizes not only the dignity, but also the actual physical safety, of transgender people."

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2016/04/19/u-s-civil-rights-commission-says-north-carolinas-bathroom-law-jeopardizes-the-physical-safety-of-transgender-people/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-3-6"></a>

Context: Kidnapping and murder of Mohammed Abu Khdeir.

**Archived source account.** A Jerusalem district court rejects an insanity plea and convicts Yosef Chaim Ben-David as the ringleader of the terrorist kidnapping and murder of the 16-year-old Palestinian. In November, the court convicted Ben-David's two accomplices, both minors, of murder.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/1.715189>); [Al Bawaba](<http://www.albawaba.com/news/killer-teenager-abu-khdeir-convicted-murder-830778>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** While South Korea prepares for the 2018 Winter Olympics, the Associated Press reports the country has covered up widespread human rights violations, including rapes and murders, when it swept so-called vagrants off the streets in the years prior to the 1988 Games in Seoul. Thousands of victims have received no compensation, nor public recognition nor an apology. The AP says two early attempts to investigate were suppressed by senior officials and the current government refuses to revisit the case and is blocking a push by an opposition lawmaker.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/urn:publicid:ap.org:c22de3a565fe4e85a0508bbbd72c3c1b>).

<a id="event-2016-04-19-3-9"></a>

Context: Flint water crisis.

**Archived source account.** According to government officials, Michigan Attorney General Bill Schuette tomorrow will announce criminal charges against two state regulators and a Flint employee in connection with the city's lead-tainted water crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/04/20/three-to-face-charges-in-flint-water-crisis-officials-say.html>).

Context: 2016 United States presidential election / Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2016, Republican Party presidential primaries, 2016.

<a id="event-2016-04-19-4-4"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election / Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2016, Republican Party presidential primaries, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Hillary Clinton gains a decisive win (57.6 percent to 42.4 percent) over Bernie Sanders in the Democratic Party primary.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/new-york>); [Five Thirty Eight](<http://fivethirtyeight.com/live-blog/new-york-primary-presidential-election-2016/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/strong-showing-by-clinton-in-defeat-of-sanders-in-new-york-primary/2016/04/19/0c0c5c72-0621-11e6-b283-e79d81c63c1b_story.html>).

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Rodrigo Duterte apologizes for making remarks about rape.

<a id="event-2016-04-19-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of the Australian external territory of Norfolk Island announces it is going to take its governance issue to the United Nations. Former and final Chief Minister of the island Lisle Snell said he seeks to have Norfolk Island added on the UN's list of Non-Self-Governing Territories and be given the rights that are accorded under the terms and conditions of being on the list. In 2015, the Australian government terminated Norfolk Island's self-governing status in response to serious financial issues but without the islanders' or government's consent.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/301873/norfolk-island-to-take-its-governance-issue-to-the-un>).

<a id="event-2016-04-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and the United States agree to carry out joint naval patrols to prevent Iranian arms shipments reaching Yemen, the Gulf bloc's secretary general Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani said on Wednesday, following a meeting with United States Secretary of Defense Ash Carter. Iran denies it supplies weapons to the Houthis in Yemen.

However, it is still unclear how fast the liberalization process will be dealt with in the European Parliament and European Council, where some EU member states might want to slow down the process.

Context: Panama Papers.

**Archived source account.** In a letter to the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists, the United States Department of Justice announces it is opening a criminal investigation into tax avoidance schemes exposed by the Panama Papers with U.S. attorney Preet Bharara asking the ICIJ for help.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-36091549>).

<a id="event-2016-04-20-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are burned alive amid xenophobic riots in Lusaka, Zambia. The riots started after rumours spread that Rwandans were behind recent ritual killings in the city. More than 250 people have been arrested after more than 60 Rwandan-owned shops were looted in two days of violence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36092917>).

<a id="event-2016-04-20-4-11"></a>

Context: Drug policy of Canada.

**Archived source account.** Canada's Minister of Health Jane Philpott says federal legislation to legalize marijuana will be introduced in spring of 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/philpott-un-marijuana-legislation-legalize-1.3544554>).

<a id="event-2016-04-20-4-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Supreme Court rules that almost $2 billion in frozen Iranian assets must be turned over to American families of people killed in attacks blamed on Iran, including the 1983 bombing of a U.S. Marine Corps barracks in Beirut, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-iran-idUSKCN0XH1R6>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yasri Khan, a senior member of Swedish Green Party (part of the ruling coalition), who was refusing to shake hands with a female reporter on grounds that it violated his Muslim faith, announces that he is quitting politics.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.se/20160420/swedish-politician-quits-after-refusing-to-shake-womens-hands>).

<a id="event-2016-04-20-5-2"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Philippine presidential candidate Rodrigo Duterte reneges on his apology and denies a statement by his party, PDP-Laban, which said he was sorry for his rape comments.

Source citations (as archived): [The Manila Bulletin](<http://www.mb.com.ph/duterte-denies-apology-statement-released-by-pdp-laban/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-20-5-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Macedonian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue against President Gjorge Ivanov in Skopje, Macedonia. Opposition leader Zoran Zaev said he will only take part in EU-brokered negotiations with the government if certain conditions are met.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/eu-s-macedonia-crisis-talks-in-doubt-as-protests-grow-1.2617837>).

### 2016-04-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099136892](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2021&oldid=1099136892>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Sudanese nomadic conflicts, Ethnic violence in South Sudan.

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian Army crosses the border into South Sudan with the latter's approval in search of more than 100 children who were kidnapped and spirited across the border in a surprise attack by unknown assailants that also killed 208 people a few days ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/ethiopia-army-enters-sudan-hunting-kidnapped-children-160421055058522.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** Ansar Dine, an Islamic extremist group claims responsibility for kidnapping three International Committee of the Red Cross staffers this weekend in Abeïbara in northeastern Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1c13736ea7234591a6e9c3376456b063/extremists-kidnap-intl-red-cross-staff-north-mali>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International says the Nigerian Army killed 350 members of the Islamic Movement and secretly buried them in mass graves in the city of Zaria in Kaduna State.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/22/nigerian-army-killed-350-secretly-buried-bodies-amnesty-says>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Elizabeth II, queen regnant of the United Kingdom and Head of the Commonwealth of Nations, celebrates her 90th birthday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/video_and_audio/headlines/36094511>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bongbong Marcos admits that his family is blocking forfeiture of 200 masterpiece paintings sought by the government saying that the works were not subject of a court order case. The artworks, accumulated during the administration of his father, Philippine dictator Ferdinand Marcos are believed to be part of the family's alleged ill-gotten wealth.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<http://news.abs-cbn.com/nation/04/21/16/bongbong-admits-blocking-forfeiture-of-200-missing-artworks>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Bunyadi, a London pop-up restaurant where diners will be encouraged to eat in the nude, has a reservation waiting list of more than 13,000 people for its June opening. The restaurant will operate for three months.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Odd_News/2016/04/21/London-restaurant-to-encourage-nude-dining-in-Pangaea-like-atmosphere/8671461253486/?spt=hs&amp;or=on>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Musician Prince dies at his home at Paisley Park in the Minneapolis suburb of Chanhassen, Minnesota.

Source citations (as archived): [News Limited](<http://www.news.com.au/entertainment/celebrity-life/prince-dead-at-57-report/news-story/dd669dc072fc063bdfb028a2338437db>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-04-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** Volkswagen reaches a deal with the United States government that includes vehicle buybacks and cash compensation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/leisure/2016/04/21/volkswagen-to-offer-buybacks-compensation-to-diesel-owners/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vatican suspends PricewaterhouseCoopers' audit of its finances over questions whether proper procedures were followed when the December 2015 contract, reportedly worth $3 million, was enacted. Analysts say this move exposes the rift between the church’s old guard and supporters of financial reform, and raises questions about the Catholic Church’s commitment to cleaning up its finances.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vatican-finances-auditor-idUSKCN0XI2G4>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/21/vaticans-suspension-of-major-pwc-audit-exposes-internal-rift-george-pell>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35018430>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 100 are feared dead in an early summer heatwave in India which has forced the closure of schools.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-heatwave-idUSKCN0XI0R8>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 24 people are killed, 136 others injured, and eight workers still missing from yesterday's blast at the major Clorados 3 petrochemical plant of Petroquimica Mexicana de Vinilo. Nineteen people remain hospitalized, with 13 in serious condition. The plant is run by Mexichem under agreement with Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex), the national petrochemical company, in Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz, Mexico, on the country's southern Gulf of Mexico coast. Pemex had an earlier fire at the same facility in February 2016 that killed one worker; also that month, an offshore Pemex Gulf platform fire killed two and injured eight.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-pemex-idUSKCN0XH2N2>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/2fc052b98c0d407081c9749158f75a01/24-dead-mexico-petrochemical-plant-blast-8-still-missing>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed after an oceanfront stretch of an elevated bike lane in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, collapses when it was hit by a strong wave. Two other people were rescued alive, while another may be missing. The bike lane was among the projects built in preparation for the 2016 Summer Olympics. No Olympic event will be held on the path.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c6782f6aeee84005a1b2d8ac621e596a/bike-lane-brazil-built-ahead-olympics-collapses>); [AP²](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/brazil-bicycle-lane-collapse-olympics-host-city-rio-de-janeiro/>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/world/elevated-bike-lane-for-rio-olympics-collapses-killing-at-least-2/story-WrfggNlpf4mzCr4A14dBGI.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Australia–Philippines relations, Philippines–United States relations, 2016 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Presidential candidate Rodrigo Duterte said that Australia and the United States should go ahead and cut their ties with the Philippines if he was elected president, following critical comments of their ambassadors on his rape remarks.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/politics/elections/2016/130271-duterte-cut-ties-australia-us>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Gulf Cooperation Council Summit.

**Archived source account.** United States President Barack Obama, at the Gulf Cooperation Council Summit in Saudi Arabia, says the United States will continue to deter and confront aggression against Gulf Arab states; joins others in warning the fragile cease-fire in Syria is on the verge of collapse; pledges vigilance about Iran's destabilizing activities in the Middle East; wants Gulf allies to offer more democratic reforms and improve human rights; and, says the U.S. and its Gulf partners should wait to see whether Iraq can resolve its political crisis before committing more financial aid which is impeding the fight against ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/9bd3e46e93214e63b7fefc3090200d81/obama-gulf-allies-meet-saudi-arabia-discuss-security>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-gulf-obama-summit-idUSKCN0XI0UB>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-4-5"></a>

Context: Syrian peace process.

**Archived source account.** Staffan de Mistura, U.N. envoy to Syria, says there has been "real but modest" progress in the country's humanitarian situation, despite the shaken ceasefire. Aid convoys have reached 560,000 people in hard-to-reach and besieged areas; six areas still remain off limits. Yesterday, the Syrian Arab Red Crescent medically evacuated 515 people from four communities—Zabadani, Madaya, Kfarya, and Foua—besieged by government and rebel groups.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8be11d7d41074425b32fbaf6949bac17/nato-chief-syria-cease-fire-best-basis-peace>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-4-7"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama, in an op-ed in London's Daily Telegraph, urges Britons to keep the U.K. in the European Union. Tomorrow, Obama is scheduled to have lunch with Prince Philip and Queen Elizabeth, who celebrated her 90th birthday today. He then will hold talks with Prime Minister David Cameron.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-obama-idUSKCN0XH2U6>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2016-04-21/obama-praises-eu-in-london-op-ed-aimed-at-swaying-brexit-vote?cmpid=google>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/04/21/as-your-friend-let-me-tell-you-that-the-eu-makes-britain-even-gr/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-4-9"></a>

Context: Philippines–United Kingdom relations, Philippines–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and the United Kingdom issue travel alerts for their citizens to avoid the Sulu Archipelago in the southwestern Philippines where a wave of kidnappings by Abu Sayyaf militants has occurred.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c8cd8bd4e674446c88881732bc4d87d4/us-britain-warn-citizens-stay-south-philippine-area>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Crime in El Salvador.

**Archived source account.** The government of El Salvador unveils and deploys a new heavily armed special forces unit to fight criminal gangs in rural areas of the country. Officials say it will target gang leaders who left the cities because of a government crackdown.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36098486>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six high ranking Pakistan Army officers, including a lieutenant-general and major-general, are sacked by Chief of Army Staff Raheel Sharif amid corruption allegations within the army. Sharif said corruption had to be uprooted to fight terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36099794>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-21-6-1"></a>

Context: Philippine general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Philippine presidential candidate Rodrigo Duterte says he shot a fellow law student at San Beda College. The victim, Octavio Goco, who was also a Lex Talionis fraternity brother of Duterte, survived the assault. Duerte was not allowed to participate in his graduation ceremony.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/politics/elections/2016/130284-duterte-shot-bully-san-beda-student>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/780836/law-student-duterte-shot-frat-brod-on-campus-in-72>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-6-3"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian President Petro Poroshenko signs legislation banning all Russian films made after January 1, 2014. The legislation also bans movies produced by Russia after 1991 if they "glorify the work of government bodies" of Russia, citing such movies to be a threat to national security.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/ukraine-bans-russian-movies-national-security/27688221.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-6-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Macedonian protests.

**Archived source account.** The European Union cancels mediation talks on resolving the political crisis in Macedonia after that country's main political opposition, led by Zoran Zaev, declined to take part.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/eu-cancels-macedonia-crisis-talks-vienna/27688808.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-6-7"></a>

Context: Chadian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The incumbent President of Chad Idriss Deby is reelected for a fifth term amid allegations of fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160423122704/http://www.voanews.com/content/incumbent-chadian-president-wins-fifth-term-amid-fraud-allegations/3297918.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-04-21-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Solar Impulse 2, a plane powered only by the sun, takes off from Kalaeloa, Hawaii, USA, on the ninth leg of its around-the-world journey. This portion of the trip will cover 2,542 nautical miles and, in about three days, is scheduled to touch down in Mountain View, California. The journey originated in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, on March 9, 2015, and, after another 8,130 nmi, will complete the circle when it lands in Abu Dhabi.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/2cae34c09e754fd39833492dbbc2a0fa/crew-prepares-fly-solar-plane-hawaii-california>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-04-21-8-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Summer Olympics.

**Archived source account.** The Olympic flame is lit outside the Temple of Hera in Olympia, Greece, by Greek actress Katerina Lehou. Brazilian volleyball legend Giovane Gávio starts the relay that will reach the capital Brasilia on May 3 for transport throughout the South American country by 12,000 torchbearers, arriving at Maracanã Stadium in Rio de Janeiro on August 5.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170510101243/http://www.abc2news.com/sports/flame-lit-in-greece-for-rio-olympics?google_editors_picks=true>).

<a id="event-2016-04-21-8-3"></a>

Context: Zika virus outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Some Miami Marlins and Pittsburgh Pirates baseball players, who are scheduled to play a two-game series the end of May in San Juan, Puerto Rico, to honor Pirates Hall of Famer Roberto Clemente, are concerned about being exposed to the Zika virus. About 400 cases have been confirmed in the Commonwealth. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://espn.go.com/mlb/story/_/id/15288667/players-voice-zika-fears-puerto-rico-games>); [The Sporting News](<http://www.sportingnews.com/sport-news/4702761-marlins-pirates-zika-virus-mosquitoes-puerto-rico-series>); [Yahoo\! Sports](<https://sports.yahoo.com/news/sources--zika-has-pirates--marlins-players-worried-about-series-in-puerto-rico-001018572.html#>).

### 2016-04-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099223557](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2022&oldid=1099223557>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** The U.K. Foreign Office and the U.S. State Department issue travel advisories regarding the Philippine island of Mindanao and the Sulu Archipelago after a recent kidnapping near Davao City.

Source citations (as archived): [Sun Star Cebu](<http://www.sunstar.com.ph/manila/local-news/2016/04/22/uk-issues-travel-advisory-vs-philippines-469376>); [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/130363-us-warning-americans-mindanao>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that airstrikes have killed at least seven people in Aleppo.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/M/ML_SYRIA?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills at least nine people at a Shi'ite mosque in southwestern Baghdad. A second attacker was shot dead by security forces before he could detonate his explosives.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-bomb-idUSKCN0XJ18Y>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States admits it has killed 20 civilians and wounded 11 others in airstrikes in Syria and Iraq between September 10, 2015, and February 2, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/04/22/US-military-admits-killing-20-more-civilians-in-airstrikes/7921461351760/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Eurovision Song Contest 2016, Romania in the Eurovision Song Contest 2016.

**Archived source account.** Romania is expelled from this year's Eurovision Song Contest in Stockholm, Sweden, after its national broadcaster, Romanian Television (TVR) failed to pay outstanding debts dating back to 2007. Ovidiu Anton was due to perform the song "Moment of Silence" at the contest.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1683433/romania-expelled-from-eurovision-song-contest>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Carver County, Minnesota Sheriff's office conducts an autopsy on Prince to determine cause of death.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-people-prince-autopsy-idUSKCN0XJ1RG>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-04-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Creditors, including 800 sacked workers, vote to place Queensland Nickel into liquidation allowing creditors to pursue its owner, Australian politician Clive Palmer, for costs.

Source citations (as archived): [Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-22/clive-palmer-queensland-nickel-creditors-vote-to-liquidate/7349930>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fiat Chrysler announces plans to withdraw 1.1 million vehicles worldwide due to problems with the gearshift confusing drivers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-36117557>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Valeant, a Canada based pharmaceutical company, says it has received new notices of default from its bondholders.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-valeant-lenders-idUSKCN0XJ2R6>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A passenger train derails near the South Korean city of Yeosu resulting in the death of a railroad engineer and eight people being injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20160422034519-cqc7q>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A warehouse storing chemicals and fuel catches fire in the Chinese city of Jingjiang resulting in an unknown number of casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/chemical-blast-rocks/2722022.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people have been killed in a landslide in the Tawang District in India's Arunachal Pradesh state.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/15-killed-in-landslide-in-Arunachal-Pradesh/articleshow/51938553.cms?>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-3-4"></a>

Context: 2015–16 South Pacific cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** The Samoan Islands and Wallis and Futuna brace for the impact of Cyclone Amos as the Fiji Meteorological Service upgrades the cyclone to a category three storm, with sustained winds as high as 140 km/h at its centre.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/302138/samoas-and-wallis-brace-for-an-intensifying-cyclone-amos>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** State oil company Petroleos Mexicanos reports the death toll has risen to 28 from Wednesday's explosion at Petroquimica Mexicana de Vinilo's Clorados 3 petrochemical plant in the Gulf port city of Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz. Some workers are still missing while 18 others remain hospitalized. Officials say the explosion came from an unspecified leak. The plant produces the hazardous industrial chemical vinyl chloride.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/00720428b3f5418a92427e196adb9a6d/death-toll-28-mexico-petrochemical-plant-explosion>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-22-4-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Mayor of London and cabinet member Boris Johnson says that U.S. President Barack Obama is "inconsistent and hypocritical" in persuading the British people to remain in the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sun](<http://www.thesun.co.uk/sol/homepage/news/politics/7095695/UK-and-America-can-better-friends-than-ever-Mr-Obama-if-we-LEAVE-the-EU-says-Boris-Johnson.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-4-3"></a>

Context: Taiwan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House Committee on Foreign Affairs unanimously passes a resolution reaffirming the Taiwan Relations Act and the Six Assurances.

Source citations (as archived): [Taipei Times](<http://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2016/04/22/2003644523>); [Focus Taiwan](<http://focustaiwan.tw/news/aipl/201604210009.aspx>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-4-5"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** A record 175 states sign the United Nations climate agreement in New York on opening day. The agreement will enter into force once 55 countries representing at least 55 percent of global emissions formally join it.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-22/what-happens-after-this-paris-climate-deal-is-signed/7350506>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c43a6ba78bd44903873174d451e83060/170-states-poised-sign-landmark-climate-agreement>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-4-7"></a>

Context: NATO–Russia relations, Cold War II.

**Archived source account.** U.S. General Curtis Scaparrotti, the incoming head of the United States military forces in Europe, says he supports a permanent brigade-sized presence of U.S. combat troops in Eastern Europe to deter Russia’s expanded and assertive actions.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/scaparotti-nato-commander-russia-ukraine/27689193.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-4-9"></a>

Context: Belizean–Guatemalan territorial dispute.

**Archived source account.** Belize accuses Guatemala of "amassing" troops on the disputed Belize–Guatemala border following the death of a teenage Guatemalan boy in a shooting incident apparently involving Belize Defence Force soldiers. Guatemalan President Jimmy Morales called the shooting a "cowardly and excessive attack" that merits the "total condemnation of the Guatemalan state".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/belize-guatemala-amassing-troops-border-areas-38595188>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former chair of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change Rajendra K. Pachauri is to face a court in Delhi, India on charges of sexual harassment. Pachauri is accused of stalking, intimidation and sexual assault of a former employee.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/22/rajendra-pachauri-court-delhi-sexual-assault-charges>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-5-2"></a>

Context: Pike County, Ohio, shootings.

**Archived source account.** Eight family members are murdered in four different locations in Pike County, Ohio. Three children, including a four-day-old baby, survived the killings.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/04/22/shooting-reportedly-kills-7-at-ohio-home.html>); [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-04-22-US--Ohio%20Shootings/id-de31e5d00f7e493e9cc1d09294a14300>); [AP²](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c3f22bbf68d5427c97a40e6e212e7d61/shootings-multiple-fatalities-reported-southern-ohio>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people have been killed in two separate shootings in the American town of Appling, Georgia.

Source citations (as archived): [Atlanta Journal-Constitution](<http://www.ajc.com/news/news/national/5-reported-dead-after-2-shootings-appling-georgia/nq9p4/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-5-5"></a>

Context: Felony disenfranchisement.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, Virginia Governor Terry McAuliffe signs an executive order restoring the rights of an estimated 200,000 convicted felons to vote and run for office.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/cb3f95e0180d4d9bac4c7916cd5f33ad/virginia-governor-restores-voting-rights-200k-felons>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-22-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Macedonian protests.

**Archived source account.** The European Union announces it is considering imposing sanctions on Macedonia's leaders for reneging on an agreement last year to investigate corruption in the ruling class and issuing an amnesty instead to those involved.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/european-union-considers-sanctioning-macedonian-leaders-over-president-ivanov-amnesty-for-politicals/27689799.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Sudanese students take to the streets around the University of Kordofan in Khartoum and other parts of the country to protest the recent killing of students last Monday. Security forces opened fire on a peaceful protest, killing many students after they attempted to nominate pro-opposition candidates for their campus elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/22/sudan-student-killing-abubakar-hassan-protests>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-6-4"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War, War on Drugs.

**Archived source account.** Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto proposes legalizing marijuana for medical purposes and easing limits for personal use of the drug. He said he would be sending a bill to the Congress to increase the amount users can legally carry from the current five grams to 28 (0.18-1oz). The news comes just two days after he addressed the United Nations General Assembly at a special session on drug policy and is seen as a chance to re-think the current strategy of fighting drug-trafficking, especially in Mexico where the fighting has killed tens of thousands of people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36107947>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-04-22-7-1"></a>

Context: Amazon Reef.

**Archived source account.** Oceanographers discover an extensive reef system near the Amazon River, estimated to span an area of 3600 mi2.

Source citations (as archived): [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/science/archive/2016/04/scientists-discover-a-new-coral-reef-at-the-amazons-mouth/479259/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2016/apr/22/huge-coral-reef-discovered-at-amazon-river-mouth>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/science/sciencenow/la-sci-sn-coral-reef-amazon-river-20160422-story.html>); [Phys.org](<http://phys.org/news/2016-04-scientists-reef-mouth-amazon-river.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/23/world/amazon-river-coral-reef-irpt/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** China's National Space Administration says it is working on a program to land a rover on Mars by 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_CHINA_SPACE?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-7-4"></a>

Context: Energy development.

**Archived source account.** The Alaska SeaLife Center (Seward, Alaska) announces that 98 percent of the center's heating and cooling now comes from low-cost, alternative energy derived from seawater.

Source citations (as archived): [Tech Times](<http://www.techtimes.com/articles/153176/20160424/alaska-sealife-center-replaces-fossil-fuel-with-renewable-seawater-system.htm>).

<a id="event-2016-04-22-7-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists discover the quantum tunneling of water molecules.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys. Rev. Letters](<http://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.116.167802>); [Phys.org](<http://phys.org/news/2016-04-state-molecule.html>); [Tech Times](<http://www.techtimes.com/articles/153288/20160425/new-tunneling-state-of-water-molecules-is-a-rulebreaker.htm>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-04-22-8-1"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** President of FIFA Gianni Infantino says a new independent committee will be set up to monitor working conditions at Qatar's 2022 World Cup venues. The move is an attempt by the world football's governing body to ease fears of human rights abuses in the state, where organizations like Amnesty International documented multiple cases of poor working conditions and abuses against migrant workers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/36109276>).
