#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-23-0-1"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistani Taliban claims the killing of a Sikh lawmaker, Soran Singh.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/04/23/world/asia/ap-as-pakistan.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims to have shot down a Syrian Arab Air Force MiG-23, southeast of Damascus, and captured its pilot. Amaq News Agency, which supports ISIL, gave the pilot’s name as Azzam Eid, from Hama. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says it was not clear whether the plane had been shot down or crashed because of mechanical failure.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3555073/ISIS-captures-Syrian-Air-Force-pilot-terror-group-claims-shot-MiG-23-outside-Damascus.html>); [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/is-claims-capture-of-syrian-pilot-after-shooting-down-plane/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government airstrikes kill 25 people, mostly civilians, in attacks on rebel-held areas near the capital Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/04/23/world/middleeast/ap-ml-syria-.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-0-6"></a>

Context: Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Yemeni government forces along with Popular Resistance militia kill dozens of Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula fighters in clashes in southern Yemen. A drone strike kills two others further north, near Ma'rib.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-qaeda-idUSKCN0XK07R>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-0-8"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two separate car bombs kill at least 12 people in Iraq's capital, Baghdad. The Islamic State claims responsibility for the blast at the security checkpoint in a northern district that killed nine and injured 28 others. Three people are killed and 11 injured at the second bombing in southern Baghdad that targeted an army convoy; no group has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-blast-idUSKCN0XK0M6>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The continuing influence of English dramatist William Shakespeare is celebrated on the 400th anniversary of his death in Stratford-upon-Avon.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4303852/shakespeare-life-video/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Spain commemorates the 400th anniversary of the death of its most famous author Miguel de Cervantes.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20160423-spain-marks-400th-anniversary-cervantes-death-don-quixote?ns_campaign=reseaux_sociaux&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_linkname=editorial&amp;aef_campaign_ref=partage_aef&amp;aef_campaign_date=2016-04-23&amp;dlvrit=66745>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 South Pacific cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Samoan authorities prepared for Severe Tropical Cyclone Amos which is forecast to make landfall later tonight.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather Zone](<http://www.weatherzone.com.au/news/tropical-cyclone-amos-intensifies-on-approach-to-samoa/494096>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Russian oil tanker catches fire in the Caspian Sea, killing at least one crew member. A total of 10 crew members were evacuated from the ship, which was in the territorial waters of Turkmenistan when the fire broke out. It was unclear what caused the blaze.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russian-tanker-catches-fires-caspian/27692808.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-2-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the earthquake passes 650 with over 50 people missing. It is now the deadliest earthquake in South America this century.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160425120525/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/death-toll-ecuador-earthquake-tops-650-38626337>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-23-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea is reported to have launched a submarine-launched ballistic missile for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missile-idUSKCN0XK08U?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** President of Russia Vladimir Putin accuses the United States of reneging on a 16-year-old deal that called for reducing Russia's and the United States' stockpiles of weapons-grade plutonium. He accused Washington of trying to preserve its ability to turn some of its plutonium stockpile back into a form usable for nuclear weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/putin-swipes-us-plutonium-disposal/27692331.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-3-5"></a>

Context: Syrian peace process.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports the Friday afternoon truce between Kurdish Asayish forces and pro-Syrian government forces, declared following a three-day outbreak of violence that killed at least 26 people, is holding.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-qamashli-idUSKCN0XK05I>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-3-7"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Angela Merkel, European Council President Donald Tusk, and European Commission Vice-President Frans Timmermans meet with Syrian refugees at a camp in the southeastern Turkish town of Nizip prior to talks with a delegation led by Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu. Davutoğlu stresses the importance of implementation of European Union visa liberalization for Turkish citizens in assuring the success of Europe's migrant readmission agreement with his country. Tusk announces that the EU will spend 1 billion euros ($1.1 billion) this summer on projects to improve the lives of Syrian migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [Hürriyet Daily News](<http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/merkel-eu-officials-arrive-in-turkeys-gaziantep-to-discuss-migrant-crisis.aspx?pageID=238&amp;nID=98236&amp;NewsCatID=341>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/europe-migrants-turkey-germany-idINKCN0XK0JN>); [Journal of Turkish Weekly](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160424115303/http://turkishweekly.net/2016/04/23/news/no-migrant-readmission-agreement-without-visa-liberalization-turkish-pm/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-3-9"></a>

Context: North Korea-United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Foreign Minister Ri Su-yong says North Korea is ready to halt nuclear tests if the United States suspends its annual military exercises with South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://time.com/4305800/north-korea-will-to-halt-nuclear-tests-if-u-s-stops-military-exercises-with-south-korea-minister-says/?xid=homepage>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** Professor Rezaul Karim Siddique is killed in the Bangladeshi city of Rajshahi in an ISIL attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/world/professor-hacked-to-death-near-home-in-bangladesh-in-latest-attacks/story-spHgh3C0iaxtEqkP6mpbAN.html>); [AFP](<http://finance.yahoo.com/news/group-claims-responsibility-killing-bangladesh-professor-150151288.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Böhmermann affair.

**Archived source account.** During a rally in support of German comedian Jan Böhmermann, outside the Turkish embassy in Berlin, Bruno Kramm, head of the Berlin branch of Germany's Pirate Party, is arrested for “insulting a representative of a foreign state” by quoting a line from the comic’s satirical poem about Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/340691-pirate-party-leader-arrest-erdogan/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-4-5"></a>

Context: Panama Papers.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Pakistan Nawaz Sharif bows to opposition demands that he ask Pakistan's chief justice to set up an independent commission to investigate offshore accounts linked to his family. Sharif said he would accept the commission's findings and even resign if called upon.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/pakistani-premier-sharif-says-will-resign-if-independent-commission-inquiry-finds-wrongdoing/27692007.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-4-6"></a>

Context: Panama Papers.

**Archived source account.** European Union finance ministers approve a series of measures to tackle tax-evading methods that were exposed by the Panama Papers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/23/tax-avoidance-eu-finance-ministers-approve-measures-netherlands>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Federal agents are combing three states for 32 cases of commercial grade explosives, about 500 pounds of 2½ to 5 inch aerial shells, stolen from a CSX train traveling from Chicago, Illinois, through Ohio that arrived in Detroit, Michigan, on Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/more-than-500-pounds-of-explosives-stolen-from-train/>); [Detroit Free Press](<http://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/detroit/2016/04/22/train-arrives-detroit-missing-32-cases-explosives/83413864/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-23-5-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Human rights activists, lawyers, labor rights groups and other advocates endorse Leni Robredo for vice president.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/politics/elections/2016/130498-lawyers-human-rights-defenders-advocates-leni-robredo>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-5-3"></a>

Context: South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rebel leader Riek Machar misses an international deadline to return to the capital Juba to take the post of Vice President. Machar was offered the position by President Salva Kiir Mayardit in the hopes of putting an end to the civil war but has repeatedly delayed his return.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/south-sudan-riek-machar-return-deadline-160423095440810.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people protest in the German city of Hanover against the proposed Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership deal. They say the deal would drive down wages, and weaken environmental protection and labour rights.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36120560>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-5-6"></a>

Context: Darfurian status referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** According to the Sudanese electoral commission, more than 97% of voters in Darfur choose to remain as five states rather than form a single region. However, The vote was held amid ongoing insecurity and many of Sudan's 2.5 million displaced people were not registered to vote, with the U.S. State Department warning that the referendum could not be considered credible "under current rules and conditions".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36120926>).

<a id="event-2016-04-23-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Congo President Denis Sassou Nguesso names former opposition leader Clément Mouamba as prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-politics-idUSKCN0XL005?il=0>).

#### Science and Technology

<a id="event-2016-04-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Solar-powered aircraft Solar Impulse 2 lands in Mountain View, California after a 62-hour flight across the Pacific Ocean from Hawaii.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/tech/innovation/solar-impulse-2-s-pacific-crossing-going-smoothly-it-nears-n560946>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-36122618>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-24-1-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea reportedly deploys 300 new multiple launch rocket systems along the Korean Demilitarized Zone.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170510093542/http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2016/04/24/0200000000AEN20160424001100315.html?input=www.tweeter.com>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-1-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama rules out deploying U.S. ground troops in Syria and says military efforts alone cannot solve the country's problems. He also said he did not think that ISIL would be defeated in his last nine months of office.

<a id="event-2016-04-24-1-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. officials report President Obama will announce plans to send as many as 250 more U.S. troops to Syria to help fight ISIL militants. The troops are likely to include special operations forces and medical or intelligence support personnel, an official added. The decision is scheduled to be announced around noon tomorrow in Hanover, Germany, during the President's farewell tour of Europe.

Context: North Korea-United States relations.

**Archived source account.** President Barack Obama says the United States isn't taking North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Su-yong's proposal to halt nuclear activity seriously. Pyongyang would "have to do better than that," he added.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ebru Umar, a Dutch journalist of Turkish descent, is arrested in Kuşadası, Turkey, for tweets deemed critical of President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan. This comes as a political storm erupted this week over reports that the Turkish consulate asked Turkish organizations in the Netherlands to forward emails and social media posts which insult Erdoğan or Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/24/dutch-journalist-ebru-umar-arrested-in-turkey-for-criticising-erdogan>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-2-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Following an appeal, 12-year-old Dima al-Wawi is freed from an Israeli prison. She is believed to be the youngest female Palestinian ever imprisoned. Israeli civil law, which does not allow anyone under 14 to go to jail, did not affect her imprisonment. Palestinian residents in the occupied territories are subject to military law that can sentence suspects as young as 12 to prison.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160424201544/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/israel-frees-youngest-palestinian-prisoner-38632971>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Austrian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Austrians vote in the first round of electing the next president. Preliminary estimates indicate FPÖ's Norbert Hofer won the first round with 36 percent of the vote. Greens' Alexander Van der Bellen, who is supported by the Green Party, garnered 20%, and another independent, Irmgard Griss, took 18.5 percent. President Heinz Fischer was not eligible to be re-elected. Candidates representing the two leading parties, that have ruled for the past 70 years, were eliminated. Hofer and Van der Bellen will compete in the runoff election on May 22, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-04-24/austria-s-right-wing-freedom-party-tops-presidential-first-round>); [Election website](<http://www.bundespraesidentschaftswahl.at>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/presidential-election-exposes-austrian-angst/a-19207311>); [Euro News](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/04/24/far-right-fpo-candidate-norbert-hofer-leads-in-austrian-presidential-election/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Equatorial Guinean presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Equatorial Guinean voters go to the polls with incumbent Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo expected to win as the opposition boycotts the election.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<http://m.voanews.com/a/equatorial-guinea-goes-to-the-polls-sunday/3299721.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/equatorial-guinea-election-160424044551251.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese House of Representatives by-elections, 2016: By-elections were held for two seats controlled by the ruling Liberal Democratic Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2016/04/24/national/politics-diplomacy/voting-under-way-for-lower-house-seats-in-hokkaido-kyoto/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-5"></a>

Context: Japanese House of Representatives by-elections, 2016: By-elections were held for two seats controlled by the ruling Liberal Democratic Party..

**Editorial account; source review partial.** TV Asahi reports LDP candidate Yoshiaki Wada defeating independent Maki Ikeda in the Hokkaido fifth-district by-election.

Editorial date: 2016-04-24. Checked: 2026-10-22. The winner and opponent are supported. The 14-to-2 percent margin comparison and evaluation of the benefit to Abe are not verified by this report and remain open.

Evidence: [TV Asahi](<https://news.tv-asahi.co.jp/news_politics/articles/000073387.html>).

Original source account: Hokkaido 5th district by-election, 2016: LDP candidate Yoshiaki Wada staved off the competition from independent candidate Maki Ikeda. Despite the LDP's winning margin decreasing from 14% (in 2014) to 2%, this win is seen as a boost for Prime Minister Shinzo Abe in the upcoming upper house election.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-6"></a>

Context: Japanese House of Representatives by-elections, 2016: By-elections were held for two seats controlled by the ruling Liberal Democratic Party..

**Editorial account; source review partial.** TV Asahi reports Democratic Party candidate Kenta Izumi winning the Kyoto third-district by-election after the LDP incumbent resigned.

Editorial date: 2016-04-24. Checked: 2026-10-22. The party, winner and former-member status are supported. The opened report does not give the numerical landslide margin or independently establish the new-party characterization; LDP did not field a candidate.

Evidence: [TV Asahi](<https://news.tv-asahi.co.jp/news_politics/articles/000073381.html>).

Original source account: Kyoto 3rd district by-election, 2016: The newly formed Democratic Party wrested back the seat from the LDP after their candidate and former MP for the district Kenta Izumi won by a landslide.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-8"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016..

**Archived source account.** The final leg of the Philippine presidential debate series is held in Dagupan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Manila Bulletin](<http://www.mb.com.ph/get-ready-for-the-last-pili-pinas-2016-presidential-debate/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-10"></a>

Context: Serbian parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Serbians elect a new parliament under the backdrop of its accession to the European Union. Preliminary results indicate the incumbent, pro-EU populists sweeping the election.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-04-23/ex-milosevic-ally-poised-for-easy-win-in-serbian-snap-elections>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/serbias-general-election-tests-eu-bid-amid-far-right-surge/2016/04/24/f3b4275c-09ec-11e6-bfed-ef65dff5970d_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-12"></a>

Context: 2015–16 protests in Moldova.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue in Moldova as thousands of anti-government protesters demonstrate in the capital Chișinău despite concessions given to the protesters last month by the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/moldova-antigovernment-protest/27693857.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-24-3-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 1,000 people stage a rare public protest in the Kazakh city of Atyrau, rallying against the government's decision to sell land in auctions amid a heavy police presence, though they did not forcibly disperse the rally.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/kazakhstan-atyrau-protests-land-sales-to-foreigners/27693843.html>).

### 2016-04-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284602667](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2025&oldid=1284602667>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Two Turkish soldiers are killed and four are wounded in an attack by Kurdish militants in southeastern Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3557390/Two-Turkish-soldiers-killed-4-wounded-Kurdish-militant-attack.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) warns Turkey it is preparing to intensify its fight.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36081204>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least eight people are reportedly killed as a car bomb explodes at a checkpoint south of Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2016-04/25/c_135310365.htm>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-6"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** The President of the United States Barack Obama announces that the U.S. will send an additional 250 troops to fight ISIL in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2016/apr/25/barack-obama-us-soldiers-islamic-state-syria>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-8"></a>

Context: Burundian unrest (2015–2018).

**Archived source account.** A senior Burundian Army general, Athanase Kararuza, an ethnic Tutsi and security advisor to Burundi Vice-President Gaston Sindimwo, is shot dead by heavily armed men in the capital Bujumbura.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3557388/Tutsi-general-killed-Burundi-attack.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-9"></a>

Context: Burundian unrest (2015–2018).

**Archived source account.** The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights announces that the International Criminal Court will conduct a preliminary examination of the violence in Burundi over the past year that has killed hundreds, and forced hundreds of thousands to flee abroad.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/icc-to-investigate-past-years-deadly-violence-in-burundi/2016/04/25/48b8af66-0b14-11e6-a6b6-2e6de3695b0e_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-11"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Mexican police come under attack in a two-hour gunfight in the city of Acapulco, killing one gunman. At the same time, a separate group of gunmen attacked a federal police base in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36127224>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-13"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Yemeni and Saudi-led coalition forces recapture the port city of Al Mukalla from al-Qaeda militants.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36128614>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-15"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Abu Sayyaf militants, who threatened to kill three foreigners kidnapped from a "high-end" Philippine resort in September 2015, unless they were paid 900 million pesos (17 mil Euros) by midnight today (15:00 UTC), have beheaded one of the hostages, Canadian John Ridsdel. Philippine President Benigno Aquino III had ordered an all-out effort to rescue the hostages, including a Philippine woman, kidnapped by the Daesh-linked group.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/philippine-militants-behead-one-of-three-foreigners-taken-from-resort-identity-of-dead>); [Journal of Turkish Weekly](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160426134137/http://www.turkishweekly.net/2016/04/25/news/philippines-all-out-effort-demanded-to-free-hostages/>); [Reuters](<http://www.euronews.com/newswires/3185281-philippines-says-severed-head-found-as-captives-ransom-deadline-passes/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36132382>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-0-17"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** Xulhaz Mannan, a Bangladeshi employee of a U.S. charity (USAID), who is also an editor for the country's only LGBT magazine, and a friend are hacked to death in Dhaka, Bangladesh, by suspected Islamist militants. Guards at the building were also injured.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News with Reuters](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/bangladesh-charity-worker-friend-hacked-death-latest-attack-n561741>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/people-hacked-death-bangladesh-capital-160425141155758.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-04-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British department store chain British Home Stores (BHS) collapses into administration after a last-minute rescue deal fails. The collapse of the retailer, which employs 11,000 people, is the biggest failure on the UK's high street since the collapse of Woolworths in 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2016/apr/25/bhs-heading-for-administration-as-rescue-deal-fails>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia's Council of Ministers announces a broad-based economic reform plan, known as Vision 2030, which will help the oil-reliant state to diversify its economy over the next 14 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/saudi-arabia-announces-major-economic-reforms-160425120839989.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, Gannett Company, Inc., announces that two weeks ago it made an unsolicited, $815 million takeover bid for the Tribune Publishing Company, whose holdings include a number of major newspapers, such as the Chicago Tribune and the Los Angeles Times. Gannett, the publisher of the national American daily USA Today as well as 107 daily newspapers, made the offer public since Tribune had not yet responded. Last month, Tribune Publishing's winning bid for the Orange County Register was blocked by the U.S. Justice Department because of an antitrust challenge.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tribune-publshng-m-a-gannett-idUSKCN0XM17S>); [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-tribune-gannett-offer-0426-biz-20160425-story.html>); [Orange County Register](<http://www.ocregister.com/articles/tribune-708746-court-temporary.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Goldman Sachs, the American multinational investment banking firm, launches an FDIC-insured, Internet-based savings bank. The Wall Street institution, whose investment banking account minimums are in the millions, sets a minimum deposit of $1 dollar for GSBank.com.

Source citations (as archived): [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2016/04/25/goldman-sachs-launches-gs-bank-an-internet-bank-with-a-1-minimum-deposit/>); [GS Bank website](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160705121702/https://www.gsbank.com/en.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Royal Norwegian Air Force F-16 fighter jet, taking part in a mock attack on Tarva on April 12, mistakenly opened fire on a control tower with three officers inside, who survived unharmed, according to the Norwegian military.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/25/whoops-norwegian-fighter-jet-mistakenly-machine-guns-control-tower>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 23 people have died and dozens of others have become sick in Karor Lal Esan, central Pakistan, after eating sweets suspected of being contaminated with pesticides.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/pakistan-tainted-sweets-deaths/27695190.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and seven are injured following an explosion on a bus in Yerevan, Armenia. The cause of the blast is being investigated.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/340889-armenia-blast-bus-yerevan/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-2-4"></a>

Context: Hillsborough disaster.

**Archived source account.** The jury in the second inquest for the victims of the Hillsborough disaster reach their verdicts. These will be given at 11:00 BST tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-36133445>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The People's Republic of China urges North Korea to abide by a United Nations Security Council resolution that bans the North from conducting ballistic missile tests, two days after Pyongyang claimed it conducted a test from a submarine.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2016/04/25/0200000000AEN20160425009300315.html?input=www.tweeter.com?911eea60>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-3-2"></a>

Context: Belarus–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The top U.S. diplomat in Belarus Scott Rauland and Belarusian Foreign Minister Uladzimer Makey said that their countries are ready to discuss the possible return of their ambassadors. Makey told reporters in Minsk that "there is readiness from both sides for a full normalization of our relations." Belarus recalled its ambassador from Washington in 2008 after the United States imposed sanctions against Belarusian oil giant Belneftekhim following tensions between Minsk and the West.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/belarus-united-states-return-of-ambassadors/27695519.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-3-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Ecuador earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations World Food Programme announces it is stepping up assistance to Ecuador’s most vulnerable areas following an earthquake that killed over 650 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/04/25/un-world-food-programme-steps-up-aid-to-ecuador/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-3-6"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan relations, Taliban insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Afghanistan President Ashraf Ghani says Pakistan must take military action against Taliban, operating from Pakistan, who are waging an increasingly deadly insurgency across his country. Otherwise, "... we will be forced to turn to the UN Security Council and start serious diplomatic efforts."

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/04/26/world/asia/afghanistan-pakistan-taliban.html>); [Penske Media Corporation](<http://www.india.com/news/world/afghan-president-ashraf-ghani-demands-anti-taliban-action-from-pakistan-1136832/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-3-8"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says it has deported more than 3,300 foreigners suspected of links to jihadi groups, and barred another 41,000 foreigners from entering the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/6f26d28ceab44f9a9f7b833b957859f2/turkey-says-it-has-deported-3300-suspected-jihadi-fighters>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Shooting of Tamir Rice.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. city of Cleveland, Ohio, agrees to pay $6 million to settle a wrongful death civil rights lawsuit brought by the family of Tamir Rice. Rice was a 12-year-old boy who was walking outside a recreation center holding an air pellet gun when he was shot and killed by a Cleveland Police officer on November 22, 2014. Prosecutor Tim McGinty reported in December 2015 that an Ohio grand jury decided not to indict the police officers.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/04/25/475583746/cleveland-to-pay-6-million-to-settle-tamir-rice-lawsuit>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/28/us/tamir-rice-shooting/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-4-3"></a>

Context: Constitution of Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela's Supreme Tribunal rules that opposition's proposed amendment to change the President's term of office from six to four years can not be applied retroactively, thereby ending this attempt to cut short President Nicolás Maduro's time in office.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36136282>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/7500fe4e4e5c40d685aff626c1af6a64/venezuela-court-blocks-bid-cut-short-presidents-term>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-25-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The presidential campaigns of Texas Senator Ted Cruz and Governor of Ohio John Kasich announce they will now coordinate strategies to stop fellow Republican Donald Trump from becoming the party's nominee. Cruz's campaign will cut campaigning in Oregon and New Mexico to help Kasich, while the Kasich campaign will give Cruz a "clear path" in Indiana.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/election-us-2016-36127175>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-5-3"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election in Arizona.

**Archived source account.** A Maricopa County judge rejects Arizona Attorney General Mark Brnovich's request to throw out a court challenge prompted by major polling problems during the March primary.

Source citations (as archived): [KPNX](<http://www.12news.com/news/politics/elections-fiasco-judge-allows-suit-vs-secretary-of-state/152868265>); [KPNX²](<http://www.12news.com/news/politics/democrats-file-lawsuit-over-arizona-voting-debacle/135283490>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-04-25-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Serie A.

**Archived source account.** Juventus win Italy's association football championship for the fifth consecutive time.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/36133454>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In American football, a three-judge panel of the U.S. Second Circuit Court of Appeals rules that New England Patriots quarterback Tom Brady must serve a four-game suspension imposed by NFL commissioner Roger Goodell in the Deflategate scandal. The suspension had been stayed due to a lower court ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nfl/story/_/id/15353950/tom-brady-new-england-patriots-four-game-suspension-deflategate-reinstated-appeals-court>).

<a id="event-2016-04-25-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the Golden State Warriors, the top seed in the ongoing NBA playoffs, announce that the NBA's reigning MVP, Stephen Curry, will miss at least two weeks with a sprained MCL.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nba/story/_/id/15355486/stephen-curry-golden-state-warriors-least-2-weeks-sprained-mcl>).

### 2016-04-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357886013](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2026&oldid=1357886013>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Syrian government airstrike near Aleppo kills at least five members of the Syrian Civil Defense rescue organisation. Dozens of people have been killed in Aleppo over the past few days from government airstrikes and opposition bombardment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-aleppo-idUSKCN0XN0M3?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** Ansar-al Islam, the Bangladeshi branch of al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent, claims responsibility for yesterday's murder of USAID employee and LGBT activist Xulhaz Mannan and his friend, actor Tanay Majumder.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-04-26-AS--Bangladesh-Attacks/id-0a1ec113ce58423cba59a4913d851bec>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ukraine commemorates the 30th anniversary of the Chernobyl disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160428093203/http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_UKRAINE_CHERNOBYL?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-04-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Collins-class submarine replacement project.

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Australia Malcolm Turnbull announces that French company DCNS has been awarded a $50 billion contract to build a new fleet of submarines for the Royal Australian Navy with the subs to be built in Adelaide.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-26/pm-announces-france-has-won-submarine-contract/7357462>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mitsubishi Motors admits that it has used fuel economy measuring methods that have not complied with Japanese government regulations for 25 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mitsubishimotors-regulations-idUSKCN0XN0DV?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** British doctors go on strike for the first time in the history of the National Health Service.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20190909233251/http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_BRITAIN__DOCTORS_STRIKE?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A massive fire severely damages the National Museum of Natural History in the Indian capital New Delhi.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/massive-fire-guts-natural-history-museum-in-indias-capital/2016/04/26/f0903e6e-0b70-11e6-bc53-db634ca94a2a_story.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-26-4-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** According to South Korea's Yonhap news agency, North Korea appears to be preparing a test-launch of an intermediate-range ballistic missile. This comes after what the United States described as the "fiery, catastrophic" failure of the first attempt a few days prior.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missile-idUSKCN0XN0QQ>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Chile–Germany relations.

**Archived source account.** German Foreign Minister Frank-Walter Steinmeier apologizes that, for decades, German diplomats failed to act on abuses at Colonia Dignidad, the secretive German enclave in Chile whose story is told in the movie Colonia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b3153c91eb5a4699a9d3190d83968f2f/german-foreign-minister-regrets-diplomats-failures-chile>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-4-5"></a>

Context: Romania–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States deploys F-22 Raptor fighter jets to Romania's RoAF 86th Air Base, near the Black Sea, in a show of strength and cooperation against Russia. "The United States and Romania enjoy a very strong partnership," said Hans G. Klemm, the United States Ambassador to Romania.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160427105909/http://www.voanews.com/content/united-states-romania-f22-jets/3303463.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea rules that Australia's detention of asylum seekers on Manus Island breaches the right to personal liberty under the constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-26/png-rules-detention-on-manus-island-illegal/7360078>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An inquest into the Hillsborough Disaster in 1989 when 96 fans of Liverpool FC were killed finds the fans were illegally killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/live/2016/apr/26/hillsborough-disaster-inquest-jury-returns-verdict-live-updates>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** After facing mounting pressure since Russia's annexation of Crimea in 2014, the Supreme Court of Crimea officially brands the Mejlis of the Crimean Tatar People an extremist organization and bans it.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-ukraine-crimean-tatars-mejlis-banned/27699264.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-5-4"></a>

Context: Monte Tchota massacre.

**Archived source account.** Eight soldiers and three civilians are killed at a military barracks in Cape Verde. The government says it suspects a missing disgruntled soldier is responsible for the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/26/reports-11-found-dead-at-military-barracks-in-cape-verde1.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-capeverde-killings-idUSKCN0XN2LA>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the U.S. states of Connecticut, Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania and Rhode Island head to the polls to vote in Democratic and Republican presidential primaries.

Source citations (as archived): [Decision Desk HQ Dem](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160428235926/http://www.decisiondeskhq.com/april-26-dem/>); [Decision Desk HQ GOP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160430032741/http://www.decisiondeskhq.com/april-26-gop/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump is forecast to win the Republican Party primaries in Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, Rhode Island and Connecticut based on exit polls and results.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2016/04/26/trump-is-projected-to-win-in-pennsylvania-and-connecticut/>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/26/politics/primary-election-results-live-updates/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-3"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Hillary Clinton is forecast to win the Democratic Party primary in Maryland, Pennsylvania, Connecticut and Delaware while Bernie Sanders wins Rhode Island. With her victory, Clinton came close to securing the number of delegates she needs to win the nomination.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2016-election/live-blog-battle-delegates-intensifies-east-coast-primaries-n562336>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/26/politics/primary-election-results-live-updates/index.html>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/blogs/ballot-box/dem-primaries/277699-sanders-takes-rhode-island>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/a93d287a6ec44a3195d34cb382a9568f/clinton-pushes-big-wins-primary-quintet>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people, mostly Shi'ites, take to the streets of Baghdad, Iraq in a protest calling for Parliament to vote on a cabinet reshuffle. The protest was called for by powerful Shi'te Muslim critic Muqtada al-Sadr. The proposed cabinet reshuffle is aimed at fighting corruption in the midst of divisions between lawmakers that have hampered the work of the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/iraq-sadr-protesters-baghdad-demand-cabinet-reshuffle/27699129.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-6"></a>

Context: South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rebel leader Riek Machar arrives in the capital Juba and is immediately sworn is as Vice President upon arrival. It is hoped that this appointment will put an end to the civil war that has plagued the country since late 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/sudan-riek-machar-sworn-vice-president-160426142802493.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-8"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Clashes break out between migrants and riot police at the Mòria camp on the Greek island of Lesbos after a policeman reportedly hit a minor. The violence occurred as a Greek migration minister was visiting the center. Several refugees/migrants are reported injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36144267>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/04/26/riot-breaks-out-at-refugee-camp-on-greek-island-of-lesbos/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-10"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Following heavy pressure from world powers, Yemen's warring factions agree on an agenda for U.N.-backed peace negotiations to continue.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-talks-idUSKCN0XN24F>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** After many delays, Venezuela's electoral council releases petition sheets to the opposition alliance that wants to initiate a recall referendum against President Nicolás Maduro. Within three days, the petitioners need to collect about 200,000 signatures (1 percent of registered voters) before proceeding to the next step, the collection of 20 million signatures to get the referendum on the ballot.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ffe3deb9e14543e49ca65de198e533ec/venezuela-paves-way-petition-recall-maduro>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-04-26/venezuelan-opposition-cleared-to-collect-referendum-signatures>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-13"></a>

Context: Slovak parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Slovakia's newly-formed coalition government gains a vote of confidence as the legislature approves its program manifesto, 79-61. The ruling Direction – Social Democracy party, which did not win an absolute majority in March, has joined with the three other parties—Slovak National Party, Most–Híd, and Network—to total 85 of the National Council's 150 seats.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/7afb3e29cbc941818a52bb820e961ae3/new-slovak-government-wins-confidence-vote>); [Reuters](<http://www.streetinsider.com/Reuters/New+Slovak+government+wins+confidence+vote+in+parliament/11542893.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-15"></a>

Context: Spanish general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Spain's King Felipe VI announces an unprecedented, repeat parliamentary election for June 26, 2016, since none of the country's political parties has been able to form a government. The prior election, which was held on December 20, 2015, resulted in a hung parliament. Previously, Spain had been ruled via a two-party system.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/2ff14887f7104e06a0e949a01ac78726/spains-king-parties-hold-final-talks-avoid-new-election>).

<a id="event-2016-04-26-6-16"></a>

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, who previously gave most of the country's 2.8 million state employees Fridays off through May, announces public workers will also have Wednesdays and Thursdays off for at least two weeks as an energy-saving measure. Full salaries will still be paid despite the two-day week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-workers-idUSKCN0XN2YZ>).

### 2016-04-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1249602847](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2027&oldid=1249602847>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Philippine president Benigno Aquino III says that the Abu Sayyaf militants plan to kidnap his sister actress Kris Aquino and boxer Manny Pacquiao.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/philippines-abu-sayyaf-beheaded-canadian-john-ridsdel-manny-pacquiao/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-0-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Bursa bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber blows herself up in the Turkish city of Bursa, injuring at least seven people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://subscribe.washingtonpost.com/acquisition/?prompt=1&amp;promo=digital03_paywall&amp;oscode=RPWH&amp;wpsrc=CM0000446&amp;page=world:article%20-%20db634ca94a2a%20-%2020160427%20-%20the-latest-officials-turkish-city-blast-was-suicide-attack&amp;section=wp%20-%20world&amp;prev=&amp;geo=&amp;ctype=article&amp;signedin=logged%20out&amp;mcount=5&amp;sub=0&amp;ismetered=1&amp;destination=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/the-latest-officials-turkish-city-blast-was-suicide-attack/2016/04/27/1f0a269e-0c91-11e6-bc53-db634ca94a2a_story.html&amp;action=3&amp;sub=0&amp;mtr=1&amp;mtrct=5&amp;mtfn=1&amp;t=10002&amp;st=200&amp;loc=0&amp;mvw=5&amp;wa=3&amp;fr=0&amp;dt=0&amp;mx=0&amp;pwo=1&amp;rwb=0&amp;sgn=0&amp;v=2.3&amp;acq_test=1>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli forces kill two Palestinian assailants at a checkpoint in the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0XO0YB>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-0-7"></a>

Context: 2016 Armenian–Azerbaijani clashes.

**Archived source account.** According to officials from the breakaway region of Nagorno-Karabakh, one of their soldiers was killed overnight by Azerbaijani troops.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/karabakh-separatist-fighter-killed/27701408.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Representatives of the Russian-backed Donetsk People's Republic in Eastern Ukraine say at least five civilians are killed by artillery fire at a checkpoint in the town of Olenivka, with another 10 injured. Kiev denies the accusation. A local border-guard spokesman says there was an explosion at the checkpoint but he saw no artillery fired from either side, suggesting the blast could have been a bomb.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/ukraine-separatists-say-civilians-killed/27701810.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-0-11"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military warns that the Kabul Attack Network, comprised of fighters from various jihadist groups such as the Taliban and Haqqani networks, is planning attacks on people in the Parwan, Khost, Kabul, and Logar Provinces, Afghanistan, and asks for information from the Afghan public.

Source citations (as archived): [The Long War Journal](<http://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2016/04/us-military-searches-for-kabul-attack-network-members.php>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists in Taiwan discover 48 sets of remains unearthed in graves in Taichung. The most striking discovery among them is the 4,800-year-old skeleton of a mother looking down at a child cradled in her arms.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/27/taiwans-oldest-human-fossil-mother-and-baby-from-4800-years-ago>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The German cities of Augsburg and Cologne are testing a scheme of traffic lights embedded in the ground to reduce cell phone-texting pedestrian accidents with vehicles that happen when so-called "smombies" step out into the street against the signal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/cities/2016/apr/29/always-practise-safe-text-the-german-traffic-light-for-smartphone-zombies>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/viral/341053-germany-smartphone-traffic-lights/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-04-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine peso sinks to become the "worst performing currency in Asia" as a result of a volatile and unpredictable presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-04-27/philippine-vote-doubts-sink-peso-as-mayor-likened-to-trump-leads>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-27-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heavy rain pelts earthquake-hit Ecuador causing floods, mostly in the town of Alluriquin in the Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas Province, killing at least four people and injuring several more. About 300 people have been affected by the floods after a local river burst its banks, engulfing the town with water.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/floods-follow-earthquake-ecuador-160427102435940.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-04-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United Kingdom, the Royal College of Physicians reports e-cigarettes are "much safer" than tobacco smoking, and should be widely promoted as an option for smoking cessation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-36139618>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/health/article-3561777/E-cigarettes-widely-promoted-substitute-smoking-benefit-heart-health-help-people-quit.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea Peter O'Neill states that the Manus Island Regional Processing Centre will be closed following the ruling of the Supreme Court and that he will ask the Australian Government to make alternative arrangements for the asylum seekers detained there.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-27/png-pm-oneill-to-shut-manus-island-detention-centre/7364414>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-5-2"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The unrecognized House of Representatives, one of the rival governments based in eastern Libya, ships its first cargo of crude oil in defiance of the U.N.-backed authorities in the capital Tripoli in a move that could deepen divisions within the country. The Tripoli-based government asked the United Nations Security Council yesterday to blacklist the tanker.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/27/renegade-libyan-oil-shipment-sets-sail-at-behest-of-splinter-government>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-5-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government of Austria passes a new law that restricts the right of asylum in the country and allows claimants to be rejected directly at the border, a move criticized by rights groups. Officials say they are also considering building a fence at the main border crossing with Italy at the Brenner Pass.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36152927>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-5-6"></a>

Context: Taliban insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban's Qatar office confirms its leaders are in Pakistan to talk about Afghan refugees and the release of prisoners. The representative did not say if the delegation will discuss the peace process.

Source citations (as archived): [The Nation PK](<http://nation.com.pk/international/27-Apr-2016/afghan-taliban-confirm-leaders-visit-to-pakistan>); [Pakistan Today](<http://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2016/04/27/foreign/reconciliation-afghan-taliban-confirm-presence-of-top-level-delegation-in-pakistan/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Nations Security Council members are considering a draft resolution that would restore the UN mission in Western Sahara to full functionality. Last month, Morocco expelled 75 UN staffers.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.globalpost.com/article/6765727/2016/04/27/un-council-weighs-us-measure-restore-w-sahara-mission>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-5-9"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Senior Kurdish and Shi'ite Muslim leaders agree to withdraw from Tuz Khurmato, Iraq, where recent violence has killed more than 10 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-withdraw-idUSKCN0XO2EW>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two days before the one-year anniversary of the execution of Andrew Chan and Myuran Sukumaran, the ringleaders of the Bali Nine, member Michael Czugaj is discovered to be in possession of drugs in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2016/04/27/bali-9s-czugaj-allegedly-found-drugs>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-6-2"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Belgian prosecutors hand over Salah Abdeslam, a key suspect in the November 2015 Paris attacks, to French authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/belgian-prosecutors-hand-over-key-suspect-in-paris-attacks/2016/04/27/0f064ca8-0c52-11e6-8ab8-9ad050f76d7d_story.html?wpisrc=al_alert-national>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Speaker of the United States House of Representatives Dennis Hastert is sentenced to 15 months in prison for breaking banking laws in order to make payments to cover sexual misconduct from past decades.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/former-u-s-house-speaker-dennis-hastert-sentenced-to-15-months-in-prison-1461777151>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraqi authorities ban Qatar-based satellite television network Al Jazeera from broadcasting in the country and closes its offices in Baghdad, accusing it of violating government guidelines issued in 2014 to regulate media “during the war on terror".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-qatar-aljazeera-iraq-idUSKCN0XO2O8>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-6-6"></a>

Context: Censorship in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran sentences four reformist newspaper journalists to long prison terms for so-called national security crimes. Analysts say this case indicates that President Hassan Rouhani's calls for press freedoms will likey face an unsympathetic hearing from Iran's conservative judiciary.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/04/27/Iran-jails-four-journalists-for-acting-against-national-security-and-aiding-US/6241461778595/?spt=rln&amp;or=3>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-6-8"></a>

Context: Monte Tchota massacre.

**Archived source account.** Cape Verdean police capture a suspect in the murder of eight soldiers and three civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170510134133/http://wtop.com/africa/2016/04/cape-verde-defense-official-police-capture-suspected-killer-of-8-soldiers-3-civilians/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-27-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Iranian asylum seeker self-immolates himself in Nauru to protest Australia's treatment of refugees. The protest coincides with a visit by representatives from the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees to the island. Instead of admitting refugees into the country, Australia has been sending them to Nauru or Papua New Guinea.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/302485/burnt-iranian-in-critical-condition-on-nauru>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of North Korea announces its ruling Workers' Party of Korea will hold a party congress on May 6, the first in nearly 40 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36146887>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-7-3"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, Ted Cruz 2016 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** Texas Senator Ted Cruz names former Republican presidential candidate Carly Fiorina as his vice-presidential running mate.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/27/politics/ted-cruz-carly-fiorina-vice-president/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-7-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bradford West MP Naz Shah is suspended from the opposition Labour Party over comments she made on Facebook about Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-36148704>).

<a id="event-2016-04-27-7-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Angela Merkel's office confirms German Federal Intelligence Service President Gerhard Schindler will be replaced by Bruno Kahl. Schindler has been widely criticized following the disclosure his agency spied for the U.S. National Security Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36148107>).

### 2016-04-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1334920899](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2028&oldid=1334920899>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines agree on joint naval patrols after an increase in kidnappings by the Abu Sayyaf militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Post](<http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2016/04/28/indonesia-malaysia-philippines-join-forces-on-maritime-security-amid-increasing-threats.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A wave of airstrikes on Aleppo, Syria, kills at least 61 people, including children.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/04/28/at-least-27-killed-as-wave-airstrikes-hit-near-hospital-in-contested-syrian-city.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/28/middleeast/syria-aleppo-hospital-airstrike/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / A wave of airstrikes on Aleppo, Syria, kills at least 61 people, including children..

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières claims that victims of a strike on a hospital include 14 patients and doctors.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/world/wp/2016/04/28/doctors-without-borders-14-patients-medical-workers-killed-in-airstrikes/?wpisrc=al_alert-COMBO-world%252Bnation>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to sources from the Turkish military, they returned fire into Syria, killing 11 ISIL militants, after its artillery near the border town of Karkamış was hit by mortars.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-turkey-idUSKCN0XP24O>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Armenian-American community responds with outrage after the The Wall Street Journal publishes an ad denying the Armenian Genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/full-page-wsj-ad-denying-armenian-genocide-spurs-anger-450971>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-04-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Japanese government announces that it will start testing mileage figures of Mitsubishi Motors vehicles following recent revelations that testing data had been manipulated over a 25-year period.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mitsubishimotors-scandal-idUSKCN0XP04G>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Comcast's NBCUniversal acquires DreamWorks Animation for $3.8 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2016/04/28/media/comcast-dreamworks-nbcuniversal/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American billionaire Carl Icahn, in an interview on the cable network CNBC says he has closed his position in Apple. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.cnbc.com/2016/04/28/the-associated-press-carl-icahn-sells-apple-stake-citing-china-worries.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belgium is to provide iodine pills to all its citizens, around 11 million people, to protect against radioactivity in the event of a nuclear accident at either of Belgium's ageing nuclear power plants, the Tihange Nuclear Power Station and Doel Nuclear Power Station, according to Health Minister Maggie De Block. Germany has recently called for the Belgian government to close the nuclear power plants over safety fears.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/belgians-iodine-pills-case-nuclear-accident-114919526.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Refugee rights, Australia–Papua New Guinea relations.

**Archived source account.** Australian Immigration Minister Peter Dutton says Australia and Papua New Guinea will hold emergency talks next week about asylum seekers Australia has been holding on PNG's Los Negros Island in Manus Province. Tuesday, the Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea ruled this detention is illegal, and ordered the PNG and Australian governments to immediately take steps to end it. An Iranian refugee detainee remains in critical condition after setting himself on fire yesterday to protest Australia's treatment of refugees while the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees was visiting the island.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-36156753>); [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/302485/burnt-iranian-in-critical-condition-on-nauru>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Syrian peace process.

**Archived source account.** United Nations envoy for Syria Staffan de Mistura appeals to the United States and Russia to intervene to help revive the failing Syrian peace talks. He stressed fighting needs to decrease for the talks to work, and that won't happen "without some sort of political solution on the horizon."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/7da077a315944fdfbc31b377a380046e/un-envoy-appeals-us-russia-help-syria-peace-talks>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Xi Jinping, the General Secretary of the Communist Party of China and President of China, assures that China will prevent war breaking out between North Korea and South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4310621/china-xi-jinping-north-south-korea-peninsula-war/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-6"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea tries and fails to launch the medium range BM25 Musudan missile.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.themalaymailonline.com/world/article/north-koreas-second-mid-range-missile-test-fails>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-8"></a>

Context: France–Russia relations, International sanctions during the Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** France's National Assembly votes to adopt a non-binding resolution to lift European Union sanctions against Russia, applied after Russia's annexation of Crimea in 2014. Former President Nicolas Sarkozy's Republicans, as well as center-right and far-left groups voted in favor of lifting the sanctions, while the ruling Socialist Party and The Greens voted against the resolution.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-france-idUSKCN0XP1BL>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-10"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe warns that the situation in Eastern Ukraine is worsening. Chief monitor for Ukraine Ertuğrul Apakan says that "during the past weeks, the OSCE has registered the highest number of cease-fire violations in months" and warned that artillery and mortars banned under Minsk II "are being used again in increased numbers."

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/ukraine-osce-fighting-at-worrying-levels/27704264.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-12"></a>

Context: South Sudan–United States relations, South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Special Envoy to South Sudan Donald E. Booth said that the United States would consider imposing sanctions or an arms embargo on South Sudan's leaders if they fail to form and cooperate in a proposed unity government to end the country's civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/sudan-leaders-work-face-sanctions-160428060019607.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-14"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian peace process.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects a French-sponsored international conference to continue peace negotiations that have stalled since 2014 in settling the Israeli–Palestinian conflict, saying that direct talks were the only way to resolve the decades-long conflict. France wants to immediately recognize a Palestinian state without discussion over its borders or security issues.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/28/israeli-prime-minister-binyamin-netanyahu-rejects-french-peace-conference-initiative-palestinians>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-cool-on-french-peace-plan-bilateral-direct-talks-are-only-path/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-4-16"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** In response to the U.N.-backed Government of National Accord's plea, the United Nations Security Council blacklists the tanker shipping crude oil by the unrecognized rival House of Representatives government in eastern Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/28/un-slaps-ban-on-renegade-libyan-oil-shipment>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-28-5-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Colombia.

**Archived source account.** Colombia becomes the fourth state in Latin America to legalize same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36166888>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Filipino domestic helper Mary Jane Veloso commemorates the first anniversary of her being spared from the death penalty in Indonesia for allegedly smuggling controlled substances. A trial to determine her innocence is ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/28/mary-jane-veloso-indonesia-execution-reprieve>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The new government of Kyrgyzstan is sworn in with Prime Minister Sooronbay Jeenbekov taking the oath of office.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/kyrgyzstan-new-government-oath-of-office/27704204.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Mayor of London Ken Livingstone is suspended by the Labour Party for claiming that Adolf Hitler was a Zionist.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/04/28/ken-livingstone-suspended-labour-party-anti-semitism/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Finland holds a debate on whether or not to abandon the Euro as its currency following a petition that garnered enough signatures to force the issue into parliament. This comes as Finland as dealing with a weakening economy but the petition is unlikely to lead to the country leaving the Eurozone.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eurozone-finland-exit-idUSKCN0XP2FP>).

<a id="event-2016-04-28-6-4"></a>

Context: Elections in Equatorial Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Africa's longest serving leader Teodoro Obiang, the President of Equatorial Guinea is declared the winner of the recent election with 93.7 per cent of the vote. His government has been heavily criticised by human rights group.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.tulsaworld.com/news/usworld/ap/africa-s-longest-serving-leader-extends-rule-in-eq-guinea/article_8497b48a-0785-5c9a-b4a0-fcb579d0479b.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-04-28-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** India launches IRNSS-1G, the seventh and final series of satellite for the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (NAVIC).

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/isro-launches-rocket-carrying-india-s-seventh-navigation-satellite-116042800308_1.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-04-28-8-1"></a>

Context: 2016 NFL draft.

**Archived source account.** In American football, the National Football League starts its draft for the 2016 NFL season with the Los Angeles Rams choosing quarterback Jared Goff with the first pick.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/rams/2016/04/28/jared-goff-los-angeles-no-1-pick-nfl-draft/83636112/>).

### 2016-04-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1213434565](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2029&oldid=1213434565>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to Russian ambassador to the United Nations Aleksi Borodavkin, the Syrian Army is preparing to launch an offensive against the ISIL strongholds of Al-Raqqah and the countryside around Deir ez-Zor and that the Russian Air Force will be providing the ground campaign with air support.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-syria-offensive-raqqa-islamic-state/27706074.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes hit the Syrian city of Aleppo, destroying another medical facility and killing two civilians, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/hospital-syria-hit-air-strike-reports-160429103454466.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-04-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to Eurostat, the Eurozone's economy grew by 0.6% in the first three months of 2016, faster than what was originally expected, with unemployment falling to 10.2%. This growth suggest that the eurozone's economy is now bigger than it was before the start of the financial crisis of 2007–08.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-36167289>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 7.0 earthquake hits off the coast of the Vanuatu island of Malakula, prompting the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (PTWC) to issue a tsunami warning for the coasts of New Caledonia, Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands and Vanuatu, which was later cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-29/vanuatu-7-quake-tsunami-alert-cancelled/7369254>); [9 News Australia](<http://www.9news.com.au/world/2016/04/29/05/46/powerful-earthquake-hits-vanuatu>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Turøy helicopter crash.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people were killed when a helicopter carrying offshore workers from Gullfaks B crash landed off the western coast of Norway.

Source citations (as archived): [LA Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/la-fg-helicopter-crashes-in-norway-20160429-story.html>); [VG.no, Norwegian](<http://www.vg.no/nyheter/innenriks/helikopterstyrten-i-hordaland/helikopterstyrt-i-hordaland-11-bekreftet-omkommet/a/23671189/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-2-4"></a>

Context: Kenya flooding.

**Archived source account.** Heavy rain in Nairobi, Kenya, causes floods killing at least four people.

Source citations (as archived): [Standard Media](<http://www.standardmedia.co.ke/article/2000200075/heavy-rains-kill-four-people-in-nairobi-as-floods-cause-havoc>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-2-5"></a>

Context: Kenya flooding.
