**Archived source account.** A six story residential building collapses in Nairobi. At least three people have died and scores are thought to be trapped.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36174505>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/29/africa/kenya-building-collapse/index.html?eref=edition>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people die in a collision between a taxi and truck in the South African city of Bloemfontein.

Source citations (as archived): [Eyewitness News](<http://ewn.co.za/2016/04/29/Several-killed-in-taxi-truck-crash-in-Randfontein>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A mosque under refurbishment in the Somalian capital Mogadishu collapses during Friday prayers resulting in at least 15 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36178414>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2016-04-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Zika virus outbreak (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports the first Zika virus related death in the United States, an elderly man in Puerto Rico.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2016/04/29/first-zika-virus-related-death-reported-in-u-s-in-puerto-rico/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/04/30/health/zika-virus-first-death-in-us-puerto-rico.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Lithuania–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Air Force lands two of its most advanced fighter jets in Lithuania for the first time in a show of support for the Baltic states which have become worried about Russia's actions in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/us-f-22-fighter-jets-land-lithuania-show-of-force-aimed-at-russia/27705665.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-29-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australia commemorates the one-year anniversary of the execution of the ringleaders the Bali Nine.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-04-29/bali-nine-one-year-anniversary-of-sukumaran-and-chan-execution/7369050>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea sentences South Korean-born American businessman Kim Dong Chul to ten years imprisonment for alleged spying.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20160429033508-0g3ox>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in South Africa rules that the decision in 2009 to drop over 750 corruption charges against President Jacob Zuma was irrational and called for a review of them. However, the court ruling does not automatically reinstate the charges against Zuma as a legal team must be set up to decide on whether to charge him or not.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/decision-drop-zuma-corruption-charges-reviewed-160429100841135.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The states of Oklahoma and Nebraska, having recently suffered a loss in their frontal attack on Colorado's state-legal cannabis policy, launch another litigation strategy to the same end.

Source citations (as archived): [Lincoln Journal-Star](<http://journalstar.com/news/local/911/nebraska-oklahoma-mount-new-attempt-to-overturn-colorado-pot-law/article_388e6103-7785-5c1f-9c9a-42cab27790e4.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-29-6-1"></a>

Context: Republican Party presidential primaries, 2016:.

**Archived source account.** Republican front runner Donald Trump says he now has 1001 confirmed delegates for the Cleveland convention in June.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/onpolitics/2016/04/29/cook-political-report-contested-gop-convention-increasingly-unlikely/83711950/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-6-3"></a>

Context: Iranian legislative election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Iran goes to the polls for second round elections in constituencies where no candidate achieved 25 per cent of the vote in February's elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20160429035239-mmey1>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-6-4"></a>

Context: Iranian legislative election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Reformists taking 39 of the 68 seats, which Principlists won 19 seats.

Source citations (as archived): [euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/04/30/iran-election-victory-for-allies-of-reformist-rouhani/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-6-6"></a>

Context: 2014–16 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests erupt in various cities of Venezuela as the country faces increased food and power shortages, forcing the government to ration them, leading to widespread looting and violence. According to the opposition, who control the National Assembly, over a million people support its bid to start a referendum on ousting President Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/04/protests-erupt-venezuela-power-crisis-deepens-160429072951748.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-6-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests in France turn violent as protesters clash with police, injuring over 20 police officers and resulting in over 120 arrests nationwide. The protests are against a labour law being proposed in the National Assembly, saying it will reduce rights and deepen job insecurity for youth.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/29/france-labour-law-protests-turn-violent>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-6-9"></a>

Context: Irish general election, 2016, 2016 Irish government formation.

**Archived source account.** Fine Gael and Fianna Fáil agree to the formation of a Fine Gael-led government.

Source citations (as archived): [Newstalk](<http://www.newstalk.com/Fine-Gael-and-Fianna-Fail-have-signed-off-on-a-deal-to-pave-the-way-for-a-Fine-Gaelled-government>).

<a id="event-2016-04-29-6-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protesters on Norfolk Island, an external territory of Australia, occupy the former Legislative Assembly to protest Australia's termination of the island's autonomy. In July, Norfolk Island is set to become part of the State of New South Wales.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/302652/norfolk-islanders-occupy-grounds-of-former-parliament>).

### 2016-04-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1352775905](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20April%2030&oldid=1352775905>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-04-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / April 2016 Baghdad bombing.

**Archived source account.** A car bombing in southeastern Baghdad kills at least 19 and injures nearly 50 Shi'ite pilgrims. ISIL has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-04-30-ML--Iraq-Bombing/id-1c82f6056888436e98508f88edf0e0ba>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-blast-idUSKCN0XR05X>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights claims that twenty air strikes have hit the northern areas of Aleppo. Bombardments by both sides have killed nearly 250 people since April 22.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-aleppo-idUSKCN0XR08B>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** A Hindu man is hacked to death in Tangail district. He is alleged to have made comments against Prophet Muhammad. Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/bangladesh-hindu-man-hacked-to-death-in-latest-such-attack/2016/04/30/7b5fe53c-0ec6-11e6-bc53-db634ca94a2a_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-attacks-idUSKCN0XR0F1>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-04-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sweden celebrates the 70th birthday of their King Carl XVI Gustaf, whose celebration was attended by fellow European royals, including Denmark's Margrethe II, former King of Spain Juan Carlos I and former Queen of the Netherlands Beatrix.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/04/30/sweden-celebrates-70th-birthday-of-king-carl-xvi-gustaf/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A heatwave in India has claimed 300 lives in April with daytime cooking banned in some parts of the country to prevent fires which have claimed an additional 80 lives.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20190909234111/http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_INDIA_HEAT_WAVE?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Kenya floods.

**Archived source account.** Search and rescue efforts continue in Nairobi after the collapse of a building yesterday. Kenyan police have confirmed seven deaths so far.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3566460/Kenya-police-6-story-residential-building-collapses-rain.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Kenya floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the Kenya floods including the Nairobi building collapse rises to fourteen.

Source citations (as archived): [Capital FM](<http://www.capitalfm.co.ke/news/2016/04/3-people-dead-floods-wreak-havoc-nairobi/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A three-storey building collapses in the Indian city of Mumbai, resulting in six deaths and trapping many others.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai/Building-collapses-in-Mumbai-6-dead-several-trapped/articleshow/52053823.cms>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed by floods in the U.S. state of Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/04/30/woman-4-grandchildren-killed-in-east-texas-flooding.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A mosque under refurbishment in Mogadishu, Somalia, collapses, killing at least 15 people and injuring around 40. Hundreds more are thought to be buried under the rubble.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36178414>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-8"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** According to survivors, at least 70 migrants are missing after their dinghy sank off the coast of Libya. 26 people were rescued by the Italian coast guard.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36178582>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-2-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed in a military plane crash in Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/sudan-airplane-crash-idINKCN0XR0JM>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-04-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China denies a Hong Kong port call by the U.S. Carrier Strike Group 3, which includes the aircraft carrier USS John C. Stennis and accompanying vessels.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/04/29/politics/us-aircraft-carrier-denied-entry-into-hong-kong-port/>); [AP](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/04/30/china-rejects-hong-kong-port-call-us-aircraft-carrier/83741484/>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-3-2"></a>

Context: Destruction of ivory.

**Archived source account.** Kenya burns 105 tonnes of elephant ivory and 1.05 tonnes of rhinoceros horn in order to call for a total ban on the ivory trade.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/kenya-torch-huge-elephant-tusk-stockpile-024749903.html?ref=gs>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to the United States Department of Defense, an airstrike that hit a hospital in Kunduz, Afghanistan, last October did not amount to a war crime because the airstrike was "unintentional" and that those involved would face suspension but not criminal charges. In response to the briefing, a president of the organization which operated the hospital described it as "an admission of an uncontrolled military operation in a densely populated urban area, during which US forces failed to follow the basic laws of war."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-36174047>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-3-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia says it intercepted a U.S. Air Force plane approaching its border over the Baltic Sea on Friday because the aircraft had turned off its transponder which is needed for identification. The Pentagon says the U.S. RC-135 was flying a routine route in international airspace when the Russian SU-27 fighter intercepted it in an "unsafe and unprofessional" way.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-russia-fighters-idUSKCN0XR07V>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-04-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Stuttgart, Germany, arrest at least 400 left-wing demonstrators after they attempted to stop a conference by the Alternative for Germany from being held. The protest grew violent when they began to throw stones and use fireworks against the police.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/apr/30/german-police-arrest-400-protesters-outside-far-right-party-meeting>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt tries 237 activists, who face jail terms of up to three years, arrested for protesting without permits against President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi. Thousands demonstrated this month following the Sisi government's decision to hand over two uninhabited islands in the Straits of Tiran to Saudi Arabia. Human Rights Watch says at least 382 had been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-protests-trial-idUSKCN0XR0KJ>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-04-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The influential Christian sect Iglesia ni Cristo endorses Grace Poe for president and Bongbong Marcos for vice president.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/782467/bongbong-marcos-jumps-gun-on-inc>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-5-3"></a>

Context: Serbian parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Roughly 2,000 people protest in Belgrade against alleged fraud in the country's recent election. The protesters accuse Prime Minister Aleksandar Vučić of manipulating the results in order to prevent the far-right Dveri party from reaching the 5-percent threshold and gaining seats in the National Assembly. A repeat vote is expected on May 4 in locations where voting irregularities have been found.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/serbian-opposition-rallies-against-election-fraud/27708726.html>).

<a id="event-2016-04-30-5-5"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi officials declare a state of emergency for all of Baghdad after protesters loyal to popular Shiite cleric Muqtada al-Sadr stormed into Iraq’s parliament in the Green Zone. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [The News Hub](<https://www.the-newshub.com/international/iraq-declares-state-of-emergency-due-to-shia-protests-in-the-baghdad>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/iraq-turmoil/cleric-al-sadr-supporters-storm-baghdad-s-green-zone-reports-n565266>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/protesters-storm-iraqi-parliament-in-baghdad/2016/04/30/0862fd3a-0ec1-11e6-8ab8-9ad050f76d7d_story.html>).


## May

### 2016-05-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099236576](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%201&oldid=1099236576>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Turkey–ISIL conflict, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War / 2016 Gaziantep bombing.

**Archived source account.** A blast hits a police station in the southern Turkish city of Gaziantep leaving one officer dead and 13 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36181138>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/05/01/europe/turkey-blast-police-gaziantep/index.html?eref=edition>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–ISIL conflict, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War / 2016 Gaziantep bombing.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant is suspected to be behind attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-blast-idUSKCN0XS0VJ>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

**Archived source account.** Three Turkish soldiers are killed and 14 others wounded in an armed attack by Kurdish militants during a military operation in the town of Nusaybin, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-kurds-idUSKCN0XS0US>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Houthi rebels capture the Umaliqa military base in 'Amran Governorate, endangering a shaky ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-idUSKCN0XS0WT>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two car bombs kill at least 32 people and wounded 75 others in Samawa, Iraq. Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-blast-idUSKCN0XS0ZN>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-0-11"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Abu Sayyaf militants release 10 Indonesians the group had kidnapped from their tugboat and barge on March 28.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Globe](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160502115018/http://jakartaglobe.beritasatu.com/news/breaking-ten-indonesians-held-hostage-abu-sayyaf-released-report-says/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-05-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Halliburton Co. and Baker Hughes Inc., the second- and third-largest oilfield service firms, announce the cancellation of their $28 billion merger which has faced opposition from U.S. and European antitrust regulators. Halliburton will reportedly have to pay Baker Hughes a $3.5 billion termination fee if the deal is called off. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-05-01/halliburton-baker-hughes-said-to-call-off-28-billion-merger>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bakerhughes-m-a-halliburton-idUSKCN0XS1KW?il=0>); [Business Wire](<http://finance.yahoo.com/news/halliburton-baker-hughes-announce-termination-000000573.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The historic Serbian Orthodox Cathedral of St. Sava in New York City is almost completely destroyed in a massive four-alarm fire.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-05-02/huge-fire-rips-through-orthodox-cathedral-in-manhattan/7375134>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, 14 of 175 cars of a CSX freight train derail in northeastern Washington, D.C., near a city subway station. There were three leaks; one, sodium hydroxide, is a hazardous material. All leaks, and a nearby gas line that was ruptured, are contained. Officials are unable to say when cleanup will be completed nor when train service will be restored. There were no injuries reported, and there was no residential evacuation. Amtrak and a Baltimore-Washington commuter rail service also use the line.

Source citations (as archived): [WRC-TV](<http://www.nbcwashington.com/news/local/CSX-Train-Derails-Hazardous-Material-Leaking-377725691.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3568169/CSX-train-derails-Washington-DC-possible-hazardous-leak.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/trafficandcommuting/csx-train-cars-derail-in-ne-washington-hazardous-substance-leaking/2016/05/01/568ae3fc-0f97-11e6-8967-7ac733c56f12_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-2-3"></a>

Context: Kenya flooding.

**Archived source account.** Kenyan authorities say the death toll from Friday's collapsed eight-story residential building in Nairobi has risen to 20, with 73 people missing. Rescuers continue searching for survivors. The building had been declared unfit for human habitation by the country's National Construction Authority, but remained standing. Note: the building was originally reported as six stories; flooding had sunk the ground and first floors.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8fe0687fa9a543cbae479f6f6de6a14b/kenya-officials-death-toll-collapsed-building-16>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Punjab, Pakistan, the death toll has risen from 13 to 33 for people who have eaten sweets accidentally tainted with insecticide. The mass poisoning occurred in April.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Times](<http://dailytimes.com.pk/pakistan/02-May-16/death-toll-from-poisoned-sweets-climbs-to-33-in-punjab>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An oil tanker, sent from Eastern Libya by a rival to the internationally recognized Government of National Accord, returns with its cargo to the refinery at Zawiya in western Libya. The United Nations blacklisted the shipment on Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-05-01/tanker-with-disputed-libyan-oil-returns-to-country-for-unloading>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-3-3"></a>

Context: Cuba-United States relations, United States–Cuban thaw.

**Archived source account.** The first cruise ship in more than a half-century bound for Havana from the United States leaves Miami, Florida, at about 4:24 p.m. EDT. Carnival Cruise Line's 704-passenger Adonia was able to set sail for the northern Caribbean country after Cuba, April 22, loosened its policy banning Cuban-born people from traveling to the country by sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/3ed10aa61a894712ab1bd9f15e4f2cc9/after-half-century-wait-us-cruise-leaves-miami-cuba>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two missionaries from the United States are found slain in separate areas of rural St. Mary parish in Jamaica. Randy Hentzel and Harold Nichols both worked for a Pennsylvania-based Christian charity called Teams for Medical Missions.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News with AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/2-us-missionaries-found-dead-in-jamaica-police-say/>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/02/americas/missionaries-killed-jamaica/>); [The Jamaica Observer](<http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/news/Community-grieves-after-2-American-missionaries-found-dead-------_59587>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Philippine general election, 2016 CPP–NPA–NDF rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Jose Maria Sison, who is the leader of the guerrilla Communist Party of the Philippines, says that the presidency of Rodrigo Duterte is "good for national unity."

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://globalnation.inquirer.net/139123/joma-sison-duterte-victory-good-for-national-unity>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands are set for May Day demonstrations across the United States for immigrant and worker rights, and for civility in presidential campaign rhetoric. Organizers and authorities in California are urging participants to remain calm, given the violence this week connected with Presidential campaign protests.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/thousands-plan-may-1-marches-in-us-in-heated-election-year/2016/05/01/55fbe2b2-0f5e-11e6-bc53-db634ca94a2a_story.html>); [KPCC](<http://www.scpr.org/news/2016/04/29/60138/organizers-police-brace-for-heated-emotions-at-may/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-5-4"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Protesters demanding political reform leave Baghdad's Green Zone after camping for 24 hours in the heavily fortified government district. These activists, followers of Shi'ite Muslim cleric Muqtadā al-Ṣadr, support Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi's anti-corruption proposals to replace party-affiliated ministers with technocrats. A grid-locked parliament has been unable to act on these changes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-politics-idUSKCN0XS1BA>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-5-6"></a>

Context: Puerto Rican government-debt crisis.

**Archived source account.** Puerto Rico Governor Alejandro García Padilla says the Commonwealth will default on a $422 million bond payment due Monday. García Padilla says debt payments have been suspended in order to pay for essential services for the 3.5 million American citizens. Congress has been unable to pass a debt restructuring bill for Puerto Rico.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/puerto-rico-to-default-on-370-million-debt-payments/>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-05-01/puerto-rico-will-default-on-government-development-bank-debt>).

<a id="event-2016-05-01-5-8"></a>

Context: Freedom of the press.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian police raid the headquarters of the journalists' association in Cairo, and arrest two journalists with the opposition website Bawabet Yanayer, editor Amr Badr and reporter Mahmud el-Sakka, for alleged incitement to protest in violation of the law.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3568522/Egypt-police-arrest-two-journalists-wanted-incitement.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-rights-idUSKCN0XS1MU>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-01-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 A-League.

**Archived source account.** Adelaide United win their first A-League championship beating the Western Sydney Wanderers 3–1 in the Grand Final at the Adelaide Oval.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Telegraph](<http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/sport/football/a-league/adelaide-united-defeats-western-sydney-wanderers-in-aleague-grand-final-to-win-first-championship/news-story/164d966761df3219796e95022c03e58b>).

### 2016-05-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357885912](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%202&oldid=1357885912>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Three bombings in and around Baghdad kill at least 14, including Shiite pilgrims, and injure more than 30.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20160502101758-l9lrf/>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/iraq-car-bombing-kills-at-least-13-pilgrims-in-baghdad/2016/05/02/2a06a4a0-1056-11e6-a9b5-bf703a5a7191_story.html>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/mideast-crisis-iraq-blast-idINKCN0XT0Q7>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Somalia, War on Terror.

**Archived source account.** The first of seventy British military personnel arrive in Somalia to help combat the threat of Islamist militants. The remaining troops will join the United Nations peacekeepers and AMISOM soldiers in countering Al-Shabaab later on this year. This deployment is part of a greater effort by the United Kingdom to target terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2016/may/02/first-british-troops-arrive-in-somalia-as-part-of-un-mission>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Army troops surround the central prison in Hama after inmates revolted, seizing several guards. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says inmates were protesting against a planned transfer of prisoners from Hama to Sednaya Prison near Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-hama-idUSKCN0XT1FW>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / American-led intervention in Syria, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** Artillery shelling and drone attacks by the U.S.-led coalition strike Islamic State positions in Syria, according to Turkish authorities, killing 63 militants and destroying multiple rocket launcher and gun positions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/49b7499dbafb409799cc27cd21b9cb28/turkey-strikes-islamic-state-group-positions-syria>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-05-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippines stock market suffers the biggest drop since February amid uncertainty about the upcoming elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-05-02/election-jitters-send-philippine-stock-investors-to-sidelines>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian tech entrepreneur Craig Steven Wright claims he is Satoshi Nakamoto, the creator of the Bitcoin currency. There are about 15.5 million bitcoins in circulation. However, questions have been raised as to authenticity of his assertion.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economist](<https://www.economist.com/news/briefings/21698061-craig-steven-wright-claims-be-satoshi-nakamoto-bitcoin>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-36168863>); [The Economist²](<https://www.economist.com/news/briefings/21698066-onus-on-craig-wright-provide-better-evidence-satoshi-nakamoto>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160504124649/http://www.charlotteobserver.com/article75233707.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-1-3"></a>

Context: Puerto Rican government-debt crisis.

**Archived source account.** Puerto Rico defaults on a $422 million debt payment. The Governor of Puerto Rico Alejandro García Padilla calls the situation a "humanitarian crisis". This is the third time Puerto Rico has defaulted on bond payments.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2016/05/02/investing/puerto-rico-default-may-1/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bodies of mountaineer Alex Lowe and photographer David Bridges are found on the Himalayan mountain Shishapangma after being buried in an avalanche in 1999.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/may/02/remains-of-climbing-legend-alex-lowe-found-on-tibetan-mountain>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Moldova–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** About 200 U.S. troops arrive in Moldova from Romania for planned military exercises with the Moldovan military which will last until May 20.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/moldova-us-army-training-exercise/27711042.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Chief of Naval Operations Admiral John M. Richardson says Russian jets in the Baltics buzzing a U.S. military ship and planes are escalating tension between the two nations. Richardson added he doesn't think the Russians are trying to provoke an incident but these actions increase the chance of a "tactical miscalculation."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-navy-chief-asks-russia-to-stop-buzzing-his-ships-and-aircraft/?google_editors_picks=true>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-3-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, EU-Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** On Wednesday, the European Union will propose relaxing visa requirements for Turks as a reward for having reduced the flood of refugees and migrants into Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-eu-turkey-idUSKCN0XT1QB>); [BBC](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-eu-turkey-idUSKCN0XT1QB>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Police in the Indonesian provinces of Papua and West Papua arrest scores of protesters as planned demonstrations to mark the anniversary of the incorporation of the region with Indonesia were to take place today.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/302841/mass-arrests-in-west-papua-ahead-of-demos>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Honduran authorities arrest four men in the March 3 home invasion killing of Goldman Environmental Prize-winning environmental activist Berta Cáceres. One of the suspects was an active duty army officer while the others worked for Desarrollos Energeticos SA, whose hydroelectric project Cáceres had opposed since 2006. The four also face charges on the attempted murder of Mexican environmental activist Gustavo Castro Soto, who was injured in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/109431f864214ad5a7f429c169af3dce/4-arrested-slaying-honduran-environmental-activist>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/may/02/berta-caceres-murder-four-men-arrested-honduras>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United Nations arbitration court rules India must allow an Italian marine, facing charges of murdering two fishermen during an anti-piracy mission in 2012, to return home pending the Permanent Court of Arbitration's decision over jurisdiction. The suspect, who will remain under the authority of the Supreme Court of India, has been staying in the Italian embassy in New Delhi; his co-defendant returned to Italy with health problems in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/italy-india-arbitration-marines-idINKCN0XT0SO>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/Italian-marine-Salvatore-Girone-can-return-home-India/articleshow/52080541.cms>); [Firstpost](<http://www.firstpost.com/india/italian-marine-italy-un-arbitration-tribunal-rules-in-favour-2760774.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Catholic Church in the Philippines urges voters to reject Rodrigo Duterte.

Source citations (as archived): [Manila Standard](<http://thestandard.com.ph/news/headlines/204699/reject-duterte-cbcp-tells-flock.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Somali asylum seeker sets herself alight in Nauru to protest her detention on the island by Australia, one week after an Iranian asylum seeker did the same thing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-36186189>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Venezuela Nicolás Maduro orders clocks in the country to move forward by a half hour from UTC−04:30 to UTC−04:00 in order to save electricity as Venezuela faces an increasing electricity shortage. While gaining a half hour of sunlight, this means Venezuelans will now lose a half hour of sleep.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/may/02/venezuelans-lose-sleep-in-bid-to-curb-electricity-shortage>).

<a id="event-2016-05-02-5-5"></a>

Context: Spanish general election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Spanish politicians fail to meet a deadline to form a government after last year's election so King Felipe VI must dissolve the parliament and call a new election for June 26.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160503115025/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/spain-misses-deadline-government-june-election-set-38827199>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-05-02-6-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Researchers report in the journal Nature the discovery of three potentially habitable, Earth-like exoplanets orbiting TRAPPIST-1, an ultracool dwarf star 40 light-years away in the constellation Aquarius.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/02/health/three-habitable-planets-earth-dwarf-star/>); [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/science/archive/2016/05/astronomers-have-found-planets-in-the-habitable-zone/480690/>); [Nature](<http://www.nature.com/articles/nature17448.epdf?referrer_access_token=iiEdYLP4HdMl6uPKm2T7G9RgN0jAjWel9jnR3ZoTv0MIFXhO48LwbcrnV_fG0uzdTXDH0U-GZiE_QhzwpCK3vvWAYKfh9dBqs7si1lc7aEfLj8EfY1mfB67qKa1pyy8EZbcYsGLGzKGi6-g-aRae6zCv6otzBHGaSV8SdhZT3_-SiNixjmizRm-uSgxwruni9Sa8aVEslAVfuHK3JAtq1A%3D%3D&amp;tracking_referrer=www.cnn.com>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-05-02-7-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Premier League.

**Archived source account.** Following a 2-2 draw between Chelsea F.C. and Tottenham Hotspur F.C. at Stamford Bridge, Leicester City F.C. are confirmed as champions of the Premier League for the first time in their history. Leicester City were 5000-1 outsiders at the beginning of the season.,

Source citations (as archived): [Sky Sports](<http://www.skysports.com/football/news/11712/10267194/leicester-city-confirmed-as-201516-premier-league-champions>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/35988673>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/snooker/36186995>).

### 2016-05-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099237637](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%203&oldid=1099237637>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A rocket attack hits a hospital in the Syrian city of Aleppo, killing three civilians. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights said the attack was part of a bigger shelling that killed 19 more people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/syria-aleppo-hospital-attack-160503101336566.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War, American-led intervention in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** According to the United States Department of Defense, ISIL fighters killed a Navy SEAL near Erbil. The sailor was assisting Kurdish Peshmerga forces in repelling an attack on the area. The SEAL was later identified as Arizona native Charles Keating IV, the son of Charles Keating III, and the grandson of the convicted noted late financier Charles Keating Jr., who was embroiled in the 1980s savings and loan scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2016/may/03/us-soldier-killed-in-northern-iraq>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-05-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Rhode Island Marine Architecture Project claims to have found the wreckage of HMS Endeavour used by Royal Navy Lieutenant James Cook on his voyage to Australia, New Zealand and Tahiti between 1768 and 1771. The ship was scuttled in 1778 in Newport Harbor ahead of the Battle of Rhode Island in the American War of Independence.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-05-03/captain-cook&#x27;s-ship-hms-endeavour-believed-found-in-us/7378086>).

<a id="event-2016-05-03-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Imprisoned Azerbaijani journalist Khadija Ismayilova is announced as the winner of the UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize for 2016 for "her outstanding contribution to press freedom in difficult circumstances."

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/rferl-contributor-ismayilova-jailed-azerbaijan-receive-un-award-may-3/27712522.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-05-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine financial market continues to suffer amid speculation that Rodrigo Duterte may win the upcoming election.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-05-03/the-philippine-election-could-shake-up-rising-tiger-s-economy>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-03-3-1"></a>

Context: May 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire.

**Archived source account.** A mandatory evacuation order for more than 29,000 people remains in place for the Canadian town of Fort McMurray, Alberta, which is threatened by an out of control wildfire.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/alberta/fort-mcmurray-alta-residents-ordered-out-as-wildfire-threatens-city/article29839263/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-03-3-2"></a>

Context: May 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire.

**Archived source account.** By 7 p.m. local time, the entire town of population 80,000 is placed under a mandatory evacuation. The neighbourhood of Beacon Hill, home to about 2,200 people, is 80% destroyed by fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather Underground](<https://www.wunderground.com/news/fort-mcmurray-alberta-wildfire>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire.

**Archived source account.** Alberta Premier Rachel Notley says the wildfire has destroyed about 1,600 structures in Fort McMurray, which is in Canada's oil sands region. No major oil sands facilities are in the fire's path, though two Royal Dutch Shell mines are closing, and a Suncor Energy facility is reducing crude production. The fire is threatening the Alberta Highway 63 bridge across the Athabasca River, the sole route south. The Canadian Red Cross is encouraging people to donate funds rather than clothing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-wildfire-fortmcmurray-idUSKCN0XU2D8>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/05/04/over-80000-evacuated-fires-threaten-canada-town/83912738/>); [Metro](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160507201524/http://www.metronews.ca/news/canada/2016/05/04/red-cross-encouraging-people-to-donate-funds-to-fort-mcmurry.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-04-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people are killed and 53 injured after a bus skids off a bridge while travelling between India's Jharkhand state to Raipur, capital of Chhattisgarh state.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3574022/India-bus-crash-kills-13-injures-53-media.html>).

Context: European migrant crisis, EU-Turkey relations.

The EU says Turkey has met all but five of the 72 criteria included in the agreement in exchange for its efforts to stop asylum seekers from reaching Europe. This visa deal also needs approval from the European Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/591a0b398f8c47b8aaebbf26f070bcd9/eu-countries-could-face-fines-rejected-refugees>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/05/04/EU-proposes-visa-free-travel-for-Turkey-in-migrant-crisis-concession/7721462370040/?spt=rln&amp;or=4>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-05-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire.

**Archived source account.** The western Canadian province of Alberta declares a state of emergency as devastating wildfires, fed by unseasonably hot temperatures and dry conditions, grow to five times their initial size. The mandatory evacuation order expands to include the communities of Anzac, Gregoire Lake Estates, and Fort McMurray First Nation, forcing thousands who had just resettled to move again.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV](<http://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/fort-mcmurray-fire-state-of-emergency-declared-1.2888796>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2016/05/05/raging-wildfire-drives-out-newly-resettled-evacuees/83960660/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-wildfire-fortmcmurray-idUSKCN0XU2D8>).

<a id="event-2016-05-05-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire.

**Archived source account.** Since the fire has intermittently blocked the only route south toward Alberta's major cities, evacuees have had to go north toward oil camps and a few small settlements. The province has airlifted 4,000 people to Edmonton and Calgary as of late Thursday. Roughly 20 percent of Canada's crude oil production, around 680,000 barrels per day, is offline and is expected to increase. There are no known casualties from the fire, which today has grown to 210,000 acres (85,000 hectares), but fatalities are reported in at least one vehicle crash along the evacuation route.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3575125/New-evacuations-fire-struck-Canadian-city-energy-heartland.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-05-2-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports that Alberta Province, which projects a C$10 billion deficit this fiscal year as the prolonged slump in oil prices has reduced tax revenue, last month cut funding for wildfire prevention, including millions for programs created in response to the province's Slave Lake wildfire in 2011, which destroyed more than 300 homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160507132804/http://www.voanews.com/content/canada-fire-hit-as-government-cut-spending-on-prevention-planes/3317951.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Aleppo offensive (May 2016).

**Archived source account.** More than 72 are killed in clashes between Al-Nusra Front and Syrian government forces in Khan Tuman south of Aleppo, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [i24 News](<http://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/middle-east/112298-160506-more-than-70-dead-as-syria-army-battles-jihadists-south-of-aleppo-monitor>); [VOA News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160507124914/http://www.voanews.com/content/jihadists-retake-syrian-village-near-aleppo/3318092.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man is killed, and two others are injured (a man in critical condition and a woman with non-life-threatening injuries), in the parking lot of Westfield Montgomery Mall in Potomac in Montgomery County, Maryland, near Washington, D.C. Soon after, a woman is killed at a grocery store some miles away. Police suspect that the same shooter may be behind both crime scene incidents. Police in both Montgomery County and neighboring Prince George's County are also examining whether this person is the same as the male involved in the fatal shooting the previous day of a woman, Gladys Tordil, who was allegedly shot (a bystander who tried to help was also wounded) by her estranged abusive husband, tentatively identified as Eulalio Tordil, 62, a former Federal Protective Service officer.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160630075159/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/suspect-in-custody-in-shootings-at-mall-grocery-store-high-school/ar-BBsIEyP?ocid=spartanntp>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/06/us/maryland-shootings/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The supporters of presidential candidates Grace Poe and Mar Roxas post petitions and counter-petitions on Change.org urging either candidate to drop-out and give way for the other.

Source citations (as archived): [The Manila Standard](<http://thestandard.com.ph/news/-main-stories/top-stories/204990/poe-roxas-camps-tell-each-other-to-quit.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Vice presidential candidate Leni Robredo thanks supporters for the "Poe-Robredo tandem" pairing her with presidential candidate Grace Poe but insists she is loyal to her running-mate Mar Roxas.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/783400/leni-on-poe-robredo-tandem-roxas-remains-my-partner>); [GMA News](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/story/565179/news/nation/poe-robredo-grateful-to-supporters-of-tandem-but-affirm-loyalty-to-running-mates>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Mar Roxas and current President Benigno Aquino III call on political rivals Jejomar Binay, Miriam Defensor Santiago, and Grace Poe to unite and form a unity coalition in the upcoming elections.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Philippines](<http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2016/05/06/mar-roxas-calls-on-grace-poe-dialogue-unity-alliance.html>); [Channel NewsAsia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/mobile/asiapacific/philippine-president-urge/2762692.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Grace Poe rejects Mar Roxas' offer saying she is not willing to withdraw. Jejomar Binay also rejects calls for him to withdraw.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/politics/elections/2016/132046-grace-poe-reject-mar-roxas-call-talk-duterte>); [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/05/07/1580579/grace-poe-mars-call-whats-there-talk-about>); [ABC News Go](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160507123535/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/candidates-asked-unite-filipino-mayor-likened-trump-38927042>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Leni Robredo thanks a group of activist-farmers from Sumilao, Bukidnon, for their support promising to continue their reforms.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/politics/elections/2016/132060-leni-robredo-vp-bid-sendoff>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Head of Australia's Department of Immigration Mike Pezzullo denies that the detention centre for asylum seekers on Manus Island must be closed. He said there was no crisis that required any closure of the centre despite Papua New Guinea's Supreme Court ruling it to be unconstitutional and ordering the release of the detainees.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/303191/australia-immigration-head-denies-manus-must-be-closed>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Workers' Party of Korea, the ruling party of North Korea, holds its first party congress in nearly 40 years. The meeting comes as the country is facing tougher sanctions for its recent missile launches.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36209843>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-9"></a>

Context: 2016 United Kingdom local elections.

**Archived source account.** London votes Sadiq Khan to succeed Boris Johnson as Mayor of London; Khan is the first Muslim to be elected London's Mayor.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/election-2016-36232392>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-2-10"></a>

Context: 2016 United Kingdom local elections.

**Archived source account.** In Scotland, the Scottish National Party win a historic third term in government with Nicola Sturgeon re-elected First Minister, but fall two seats short of an overall majority.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/election-2016-scotland-36205187>).

<a id="event-2016-05-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully lands another Falcon 9 First stage onto a floating barge for the second time. It was carrying a Japanese communications satellite JCSAT-14, which was successfully put into geostationary orbit.

Source citations (as archived): [Wired](<https://www.wired.com/2016/05/spacex-landed-freaking-rocket-robot-boat-dark/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cameroonian footballer Patrick Ekeng of Romanian club FC Dinamo București dies after collapsing during a match.

Source citations (as archived): [Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/may/06/dinamo-bucharest-patrick-ekeng-dies-collapse>).

Murali Pillai of the People's Action Party emerged as the winner with 61.21% of the valid votes cast. This was the first Singaporean by-election following the 2015 general elections.

<a id="event-2016-05-09-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 FIFA corruption case.

**Archived source account.** UEFA President Michel Platini, who had been suspended by the FIFA Ethics Committee last fall, announces his resignation following the Court of Arbitration for Sport decision that let stand his ban, shortened to four years which corresponds to the duration of his remaining time in office. #### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-05-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Judge Emmet Sullivan blocks the $6.3 billion merger of major office supply companies Staples and Office Depot, finding it would result in reduced competition and higher prices. The companies announce they are abandoning the deal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/business/wp/2016/05/10/federal-judge-blocks-staples-merger-with-office-depot/>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2016-05-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 50 are killed in flooding and landslides triggered by heavy rains in Ethiopia.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/05/10/dozens-killed-in-ethiopia-landslides-flooding-amid-rains.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-10-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire.

**Archived source account.** Alberta authorities update information about the fire. About 2,400 homes and buildings were destroyed, but firefighters saved 25,000 others in the city, including the hospital, municipal buildings, and every functioning school. They expect most of the 88,000 evacuees will return to their homes within two weeks. The fire, which has merged with another blaze, is about 884 square miles (2,090 square kilometers) in size. The majority of Canada's oil sands industry, and a third of the country's total oil output, is offline, though Shell Canada has restarted its Albian Sands mining operations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/60529865cc7e4abbbfae835238af582e/alberta-officials-say-oil-sands-city-saved-fires-worst>).

<a id="event-2016-05-11-0-5"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-11-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The head of Bangladesh’s largest Islamist party, Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, Motiur Rahman Nizami, is executed for his alleged role in acts of genocide and war crimes 45 years ago during the independence war against Pakistan in 1971. Nizami is the fifth senior opposition leader to be executed in connection with the war; a total of 17 people have received the death penalty. Authorities prepare for possibly violent protests.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/home-minister-bangladesh-executes-leader-of-islamist-party/2016/05/10/961a5f50-16e2-11e6-971a-dadf9ab18869_story.html>); [Vice News](<https://news.vice.com/article/bangladesh-hangs-opposition-leader-nizami-may-make-islamic-radicalism-even-worse>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/11/world/asia/bangladesh-executed-motiur-rahman-nizami.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=second-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-05-11-3-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [VOA News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160512103204/http://www.voanews.com/content/amnesty-over-140-dead-in-nigeria-military-detention/3324731.html>); [Amnesty](<https://www.amnesty.org.uk/press-releases/nigeria-babies-among-149-dead-horrific-conditions-giwa-barracks-new-briefing>).

Context: West Fertilizer Company explosion.

<a id="event-2016-05-11-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** German Justice Minister Heiko Maas says he will propose legislation to annul homosexuality convictions, and create a “right to compensation.” A 19th-century law outlawed sexual relations between men. Homosexuality was decriminalized in 1969, but the law itself was not rescinded until 1994.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/german-minister-seeks-to-annul-convictions-for-homosexuality/2016/05/11/c094d2d0-175d-11e6-971a-dadf9ab18869_story.html>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/germany-set-to-annul-historical-convictions-of-gay-men/a-19250712>).

**Archived source account.** German chemical and pharmaceutical company Bayer bids to merge with American agrochemical and agricultural firm Monsanto.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-19-3-1"></a>

Context: EgyptAir Flight 804.

**Archived source account.** EgyptAir Flight 804 between Paris and Cairo disappears with 56 passengers and 10 crew onboard. The plane was at 37,000 feet when it disappeared ten minutes before entering Egyptian airspace over the Mediterranean Sea. It is later reported to have crashed off the Greek island of Karpathos. Locals reported seeing a fireball.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egyptair-airplane-idUSKCN0YA08W>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/05/19/egyptair-flight-from-paris-to-cairo-disappears-from-radar/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2016/may/19/egyptair-plane-cairo-paris-live-updates>).

<a id="event-2016-05-19-3-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Silk Way Airlines Antonov An-12 crash.

**Archived source account.** An Azerbaijani cargo airplane crashes during landing in southern Afghanistan, killing seven out of its nine crew members.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/azerbaijan-plane-crashes-in-afghanistan-7-dead/2016/05/19/ad01c53e-1d93-11e6-82c2-a7dcb313287d_story.html>); [Daily Sabah](<http://www.dailysabah.com/asia/2016/05/19/azerbaijani-cargo-plane-crashes-in-southern-afghanistan>).

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2016-05/19/c_135372534.htm>).

<a id="event-2016-05-19-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu asks Yisrael Beiteinu party leader and former Foreign Minister Avigdor Lieberman to be Defense Minister. Current defense minister and former army chief of staff Moshe Ya'alon's role in the future government is unclear. Leiberman is known for his hawkish and uncompromising views.

### 2016-05-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099328428](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%2022&oldid=1099328428>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights claims that over 60,000 people have died in Syrian government jails during the five year civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-detainees-idUSKCN0YD084>).

<a id="event-2016-05-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Northeast India / Insurgency in Manipur.

**Archived source account.** Rebels ambush and kill six Indian paramilitary soldiers in the state of Manipur, near the northeastern border with Myanmar.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/05/22/world/asia/ap-as-india-rebel-attack.html?_r=0>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/india/manipur-assam-rifles-officer-5-jawans-killed-in-ambush-by-militants/story-LL8SscHOsqrimh0Mctm0PL.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Iraqi civil war / Operation Breaking Terrorism, Siege of Fallujah (2016).

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi announces the start of a military operation to recapture Falluja from Islamic State of Iraq and Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/iraq-announces-operation-to-retake-isis-held-city-of-fallujah/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36354319>).

Context: 2016 Cannes Film Festival.

**Archived source account.** British film I, Daniel Blake, directed by Ken Loach, wins the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/film/live/2016/may/22/cannes-2016-palme-dor-winners-live>).

<a id="event-2016-05-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 12th Festival of Pacific Arts opens at Paseo Stadium in Guam.

Source citations (as archived): [Guam Daily Post](<http://www.postguam.com/news/local/th-festpac-kicks-off/article_3ecc65c4-2009-11e6-9577-9313a566f82e.html>); [Pacific Daily News](<http://www.guampdn.com/story/news/2016/05/22/canoe-arrivals-mark-beginning-festpac/84734934/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesia's Mount Sinabung erupts, killing at least six people in Sumatra.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-05-22/six-killed-by-hot-clouds-from-erupting-indonesian-volcano/7435464>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-22-3-1"></a>

Context: China-Taiwan Relations.

**Archived source account.** China threatens to cut off regular communication with Taiwan unless it acknowledges the "One China principle".

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2016/05/22/china-pressures-taiwans-president-tsai-ing-wen-to-acknowledge-one-china.html>); [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/r-one-china-principle-must-be-basis-for-relations-with-taiwan-xinhua-2016-5>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Nenzing shooting.

**Archived source account.** A man kills two and wounds 11 in an attack on a concert in the Austrian town of Nenzing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.9news.com.au/world/2016/05/22/16/29/gunman-reportedly-kills-two-people-at-concert-in-austria>).

<a id="event-2016-05-22-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least six people are killed in shootings at two nightclubs in the Mexican state of Veracruz.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/05/22/6-dead-in-pair-nightclub-shootings-on-mexico-gulf-coast.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-22-5-1"></a>

Context: Austrian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The second round of voting takes place to elect either Norbert Hofer or Alexander Van der Bellen as President of Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/05/21/austria-presidency-elections-norbert-hofer-alexander-van-der-bellen/84642124/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36351359>).

<a id="event-2016-05-22-5-3"></a>

Context: Vietnamese legislative election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Vietnam go to the polls to choose legislators for its Parliament. The only legal party in the country is the Communist Party, which has already chosen its members.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_VIETNAM_OBAMA_POLITICS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [Time](<http://time.com/4344416/vietnam-elections-independent-communist/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-22-5-5"></a>

Context: Tajikistani constitutional referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Tajikistan go to the polls for a referendum to make various amendments to the constitution which include, among other things, the elimination of term limits to allow President Emomali Rahmon and only him to run again for office and lowering the presidential age limit from 35 to 30, which observers believe will position Rahmon's son Rustam Emomali for future succession.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/tajikistan-referendum-/27749878.html>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2016-05-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA projects that 2016 will have the warmest global temperature average on record. This year would be the third record-breaking year in a row. Per NOAA annals, April marked the 12th record warmest month in a row.

Source citations (as archived): [Scientific American](<http://www.scientificamerican.com/article/99-percent-chance-2016-will-be-the-hottest-year-on-record/>).

### 2016-05-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131713366](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%2023&oldid=1131713366>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports nearly 150 people are killed and at least 200 wounded in a series of car bomb and suicide attacks in the Syrian cities of Jableh and Tartus in government-controlled territory that hosts Russian military bases. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant group claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/syria-multiple-bombs-rock-assad-government-strongholds-160523090721925.html>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/05/23/state-media-up-65-killed-syria-bombings/84766500/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-latakia-idUSKCN0YE0PB>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** At least 41 army recruits are killed and 60 others injured in a suicide car bomb attack in Aden, Yemen. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant group claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-idUSKCN0YE0LE>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** At least 13 suspected Al-Qaeda militants and two soldiers are killed in a raid in Aden, Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160523103304/http://www.voanews.com/content/militants-killed-in-yemen/3340892.html>); [National Yemen](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160524105407/http://nationalyemen.com/2016/05/23/al-mukalla-13-al-qaeda-fighters-killed-by-forces/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Iraq (2013–2017).

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi government begins Operation Breaking Terrorism, aimed at retaking the city of Fallujah, which has been under the control of the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant group since early 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/iraq-pm-declares-offensive-retake-fallujah-isil-160522220106703.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Three policemen are killed in Srinagar, India. Hizbul Mujahideen claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [News 18](<http://www.news18.com/news/india/two-policemen-shot-dead-in-srinagar-search-operation-underway-1246774.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/05/23/world/asia/ap-as-kashmir-rebel-attack.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-0-10"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban leadership council reportedly meets to determine a successor to Mullah Akhtar Mansour, killed this weekend during an American drone strike in Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-taliban-idUSKCN0YC0P6>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-05-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany's Bayer AG makes an unsolicited bid valued at $62 billion cash to takeover American company Monsanto to create the world's largest agricultural chemical company.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-05-23/germany-s-bayer-offers-62-billion-cash-to-acquire-monsanto>); [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/why-bayers-big-monsanto-bid-has-fallen-flat-1464013191>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An overnight fire at Pitakiatwittaya Christian elementary school's dormitory in the northern Chiang Rai Province in Thailand kills 18 girls between the ages of 5 and 12. The other 20 girls sleeping in the dorm are rescued, though five are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/22/asia/thailand-school-dorm-fire/>); [Facebook](<https://www.facebook.com/search/top/?q=Pitakiatwittaya>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-2-2"></a>

Context: Cyclone Roanu.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka's Disaster Management Centre reports 92 people are confirmed dead with 109 people still missing from landslides and floods resulting from Roanu. More than 500,000 have been driven from their homes.

Source citations (as archived): [EconomyNext](<http://www.economynext.com/Sri_Lanka_recalls_assembly_as_flood_toll_nears_100-3-5059-13.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Cyclone Roanu.

**Archived source account.** Bangladesh reports at least 26 deaths caused by drowning or homes collapsing with 500,000 evacuated during the storm. Maheshkhali Island officials are monitoring a badly damaged 17-mile stretch of mud embankment in danger of collapsing, allowing seawater to flood the communities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/deadly-cyclone-roanu-hits-asia>); [The Navhind Times](<http://www.navhindtimes.in/24-killed-5-lakh-evacuated-as-cyclone-roanu-hits-bangladesh/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed after a Cessna 182 light-aircraft crashes near Port Allen Airport on Hawaii's Kauai island.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/5-killed-in-small-plane-crash-on-kauai-in-hawaii/>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-05-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** Health officials are concerned about the spread of the Zika virus in Haiti, which suffered the worst epidemic of cholera in recent history following the deadly 2010 Haiti earthquake. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports there are 2,214 suspected cases as of April 23. But new research indicates the virus has been present since 2014. The actual infection rate remains unknown since the poor, densely populated nation lacks routine data systems that can track and document disease outbreaks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fa10763fec9d4326ae51dc09c3ea3b6f/concern-haiti-over-emerging-condition-linked-zika>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-23-4-1"></a>

Context: United States–Vietnam relations.

**Archived source account.** United States President Barack Obama ends the American arms embargo with Vietnam during his visit in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2016/05/23/in-historic-move-u-s-lifts-arms-sales-embargo-to-vietnam/?wpisrc=al_alert-national>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/05/23/obama-lifts-arms-export-embargo-vietnam/84766206/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-4-3"></a>

Context: World Humanitarian Summit.

**Archived source account.** The first-ever United Nations humanitarian summit opens in Istanbul, Turkey, to address the 125-million people crisis, the worst since World War II.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.deseretnews.com/article/765686665/World-Humanitarian-Summit-opens-in-Istanbul-to-tackle-crisis.html>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/humanitarian-summit-idINKCN0YE1JV>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis meets with the Grand Imam of al-Azhar Ahmed el-Tayeb in the Vatican.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/pope-historic-talks-grand-imam-al-azhar-160523124712606.html>); [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160524121338/http://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/pope-meets-al-azhar-imam-sign-renewed-relations-39301625>); [US News](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2016-05-23/pope-meets-with-al-azhar-imam-in-sign-of-renewed-relations>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-23-5-1"></a>

Context: Death of Freddie Gray.

**Archived source account.** Judge Barry Williams finds Baltimore, Maryland, Police Officer Edward Nero not guilty of all charges. Nero was accused of second-degree intentional assault, two counts of misconduct in office, and reckless endangerment. Community leaders and elected officials appeal for calm.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/23/us/freddie-gray-trial-officer-edward-nero/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-5-2"></a>

Context: Death of Freddie Gray.

**Archived source account.** The Baltimore Police Department says Nero remains on administrative duty while an internal investigation continues.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3605091/The-Latest-Officer-acquitted-Freddie-Gray-case.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-5-3"></a>

Context: Death of Freddie Gray.

**Archived source account.** Baltimore Mayor Stephanie Rawlings-Blake says the city is prepared to respond to any disturbance after today's acquittal.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.salon.com/2016/05/23/the_latest_mayor_baltimore_ready_in_case_of_disturbance/?google_editors_picks=true>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Threatening robocalls lead to mass evacuation of students in the United States and United Kingdom. None of the threats were found to be credible but disrupted General Certificate of Secondary Education tests in the UK.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/threatening-robo-calls-evacuate-thousands-students-u-s-u-k-n578971>).

<a id="event-2016-05-23-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Democratic Governor of Virginia Terry McAuliffe is being investigated by federal prosecutors over campaign contributions, including a foreign contribution from a Chinese businessman, and what they consider to be "suspicious personal finances", as part of a public integrity probe that has lasted for more than a year, according to officials. The United States Department of Justice would not confirm or deny the investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/officials-feds-investigating-virginia-governor/2016/05/23/ef6c2ebe-2126-11e6-aa84-42391ba52c91_story.html>).
