### 2016-05-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1236755196](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%2025&oldid=1236755196>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-25-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** The Afghan Taliban announces that Haibatullah Akhundzada will be its new leader replacing Akhtar Mansour who died recently in a drone strike. Sirajuddin Haqqani and Mullah Yaqoob are named as deputy leaders.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/afghan-taliban-haibatullah-akhunzada-leader-160525045301080.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-25-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomb attack kills at least 10 people and injures four people travelling on a bus for appeals court staff travelling west of Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/ten-killed-suicide-attack-near-afghan-capital-053017043.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-05-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Greek financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Eurozone agrees to a €10.3 billion ($11.48 billion) bailout package for Greece.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2016/may/24/eurozone-greek-bailout-debt-relief-business-live>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-25-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least five die after their overcrowded, repurposed trawler capsized in the southern Mediterranean Sea off the coast of Libya. The Italian navy rescued 562 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/refugee-boat-carrying-capsizes-libya-coast-160526045202245.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations, War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian pilot and parliamentarian Nadiya Savchenko, who has been detained in Russia since 2014, arrives home following a dramatic prisoner swap with Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-ukraine-crisis-savchenko-airplane-idUKKCN0YG14U>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, Hillary Clinton is criticized by the State Department’s inspector general for her usage of a private email server while she was secretary of state. The finding also concluded though that former secretary of state Colin Powell also had a private email server, as did former ambassador to Kenya Scott Gration. The inspector referred to the email server usage as "longstanding systemic weaknesses".

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/26/us/politics/state-department-hillary-clinton-emails.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-25-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Stanley Cup playoffs:.

**Archived source account.** The San Jose Sharks defeat the St. Louis Blues in the Western Conference Final in six games to advance to the Stanley Cup Finals for the first time in franchise history.

Source citations (as archived): [NHL](<https://www.nhl.com/gamecenter/stl-vs-sjs/2016/05/25/2015030326#game=2015030326,game_state=final>).

### 2016-05-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1291016132](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%2026&oldid=1291016132>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi civil war / Operation Breaking Terrorism.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi security forces and Shiite Popular Mobilization Forces recapture Al-Karmah, about 16 kilometers (10 miles) northeast of Fallujah.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/26/middleeast/iraq-karma-falluja/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-05-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists announce the discovery of a 2,400-year-old tomb which they believe to be that of Aristotle based on its grandiosity, and its location atop a hill in Stagira, the city of his birth.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2016/05/26/Archaeologists-say-theyve-discovered-Aristotles-tomb/4941464287698/?spt=hs&amp;or=sn>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/27/world/europe/greece-aristotle-tomb.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-1-2"></a>

Context: 89th Scripps National Spelling Bee.

**Archived source account.** The Scripps National Spelling Bee in the United States finishes with a tie between Jairam Hathwar and Nihar Janga. This is the third successive year the event has finished in a tie.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2016/may/26/scripps-national-spelling-bee-2016-finals-live>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two United States Navy FA-18's crash in the Atlantic Ocean near the Outer Banks off the coast of the US state of North Carolina. The four pilots safely ejected from the planes and are being examined in Sentara Norfolk General Hospital in Virginia.

Source citations (as archived): [Virginian-Pilot](<http://pilotonline.com/news/military/local/navy-two-f-a--s-crash-in-atlantic-ocean/article_bbffcdd9-0820-5603-aa9f-2e2120dbfd6a.html>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/05/26/US-fighter-jets-crash-off-North-Carolina-coast-4-on-board-rescued/3471464279219/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-2-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people drown in the southern Mediterranean Sea when a repurposed fishing boat sinks 35 nautical miles north of Zuwara, Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/may/26/migrant-boat-capsizes-in-mediterranean-italian-coastguard>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-05-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers at the United States Department of Defense report, in the journal Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy, the discovery in the United States of a strain of E. coli that includes the new gene MCR-1, which is resistant to colistin, a last-resort antibiotic.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<http://phenomena.nationalgeographic.com/2016/05/26/colistin-r-9/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2016/05/26/the-superbug-that-doctors-have-been-dreading-just-reached-the-u-s/?hpid=hp_rhp-top-table-main_tyh-superbug-255pm%3Ahomepage%2Fstory>); [Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy](<http://aac.asm.org/content/early/2016/05/25/AAC.01103-16.full.pdf+html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese state media Xinhua News Agency criticizes Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen as politically extreme and lacking emotional balance because she is unmarried and does not have children.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36375963>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/26/world/asia/china-taiwan-tsai-unmarried-single.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea plans to import arms worth about 3.5 trillion won (US$3 billion) this year to enhance its defense capabilities.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Security-Industry/2016/05/26/South-Korea-to-import-3-billion-worth-of-arms/8361464272886/?spt=hs&amp;or=si>); [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/national/2016/05/25/0301000000AEN20160525005500315.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Ethiopia-South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korean President Park Geun-hye, during her state visit to Ethiopia to work toward full-scale defense cooperation, pledges $1 million in aid for drought recovery. Park is expected to continue to Uganda and Kenya after this visit.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/05/26/South-Korea-builds-ties-with-Ethiopia-in-bid-to-deter-North/3491464285906/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesian President Joko Widodo issues an executive order (Perppu) making child sexual abuse punishable by chemical castration and extends the maximum penalty to death.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/05/26/Indonesia-to-punish-child-sex-abuse-offenders-with-chemical-castration/3971464259113/>); [Time](<http://time.com/4348788/indonesia-chemical-castration-sex-offenses/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ken Starr, the president of Baylor University, is stripped of his title after an investigation revealed the university mishandled accusations of sexual assault against its football players. The university's football coach, Art Briles, is also fired.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/27/sports/ncaafootball/baylor-art-briles-kenneth-starr-college-football.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A lawsuit brought against Google by Oracle Corporation accusing Google of using copyrighted code for the Android operating system is decided in Google's favor.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/27/technology/google-oracle-copyright-code.html?>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2016/may/26/google-wins-copyright-lawsuit-oracle-java-code>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bill that punishes hate crimes against law enforcement is signed by Louisiana Governor John Bel Edwards. It is the first state to pass such a law.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/27/us/louisiana-enacts-hate-crimes-law-to-protect-a-new-group-police.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Muslim mob is found to have attacked Coptic homes and stripped a woman in public in Minya Governorate, Egypt, on 20 May 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2016-05-26/muslim-mob-attacks-christian-homes-in-egyptian-province>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-26-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French labor unions, led by the CGT, implement a strike in protest of proposed reforms to labor laws.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36385778>).

<a id="event-2016-05-26-6-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

<a id="event-2016-05-26-7-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Stanley Cup playoffs:.

**Archived source account.** The Pittsburgh Penguins defeat the Tampa Bay Lightning in Game 7 of the Eastern Conference Final to advance to the Stanley Cup Finals; they will face the San Jose Sharks.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nhl/story/_/id/15755276/nhl-2016-stanley-cup-playoffs-pittsburgh-penguins-advance-stanley-cup-finals-years-failure-meet-expectations>).

### 2016-05-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1351316541](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%2027&oldid=1351316541>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi civil war, Operation Breaking Terrorism.

**Archived source account.** The United States reports 70 militants were killed, including ISIL commander Maher al-Bilawi, in a Fallujah airstrike on Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/05/28/Islamic-States-commander-in-Fallujah-killed-US-says/4991464448170/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Record rainfall and severe flooding in southeast Texas has killed at least two people with three others missing. On Thursday, a record 16.6 inches (42 cm) of rain fell in Brenham, west of Houston.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-texas-flooding-idUSKCN0YI27V>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-05-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** More than 150 prominent scientists worldwide send a letter to World Health Organization Director-General Margaret Chan calling for the postponement or relocation of the Rio de Janeiro 2016 Summer Olympics because of the widening Zika virus outbreak in Brazil, despite U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Director Tom Frieden's statement yesterday that "there is no public health reason to cancel or delay the Olympics."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/27/health/zika-virus-olympic-games-health-officials-postpone/>); [Rio Olympics Later](<http://rioolympicslater.org/>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/us-sport-olympics-zika-idINKCN0YI2CA>).

<a id="event-2016-05-27-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A preliminary study by the National Toxicology Program finds that cellphone radiation has the potential to increase the risk of tumor growth in male rats.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/28/health/cancer-study-radiation-cellphones.html>); [biorXiv](<http://biorxiv.org/content/early/2016/05/26/055699>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-27-3-1"></a>

Context: 42nd G7 summit.

**Archived source account.** The 42nd G7 summit held at Ise-Shima in Japan's Mie Prefecture concludes with a declaration that the United Kingdom leaving the European Union would pose a "serious threat to world growth".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-36394905?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

<a id="event-2016-05-27-3-2"></a>

Context: 42nd G7 summit.

**Archived source account.** Following the summit, Barack Obama becomes the first sitting President of the United States to visit Hiroshima, the site of the first use of an atomic bomb by the U.S. during World War II. Obama calls for nations to reconsider the development of nuclear weapons and eventually eliminate them.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/05/27/politics/obama-hiroshima-japan/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/obama-visits-hiroshima-more-than-seven-decades-after-the-worlds-first-atomic-strike/2016/05/27/c7d0d250-23b6-11e6-8690-f14ca9de2972_story.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/28/world/asia/obama-hiroshima-japan.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-27-3-4"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea fires warning shots after a North Korean patrol boat and a fishing boat cross the disputed west coast Northern Limit Line. The two vessels retreated.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea-ships-idUSKCN0YI00S>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Reynaldo Bignone, the last military President of Argentina, is sentenced to twenty years imprisonment for his role in the forced disappearance of more than 100 people in Operation Condor.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/7dd39e6ad03a42d893d6458cd2b25289/argentine-court-sentences-ex-dictator-operation-condor>).

<a id="event-2016-05-27-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the U.S., the Iowa Supreme Court rules juveniles, even those convicted of first-degree murder, can not be sentenced to life without parole, becoming the 19th state to ban such sentences. As of January, about 2,300 American juveniles were serving life-without-parole sentences.

Source citations (as archived): [The Des Moines Register](<http://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/news/crime-and-courts/2016/05/27/court-juvenile-killers-cant-get-life-without-parole/85025960/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/28/us/life-sentences-juveniles-iowa-isaiah-sweet.html?_r=0&amp;module=ArrowsNav&amp;contentCollection=U.S.&amp;action=keypress&amp;region=FixedLeft&amp;pgtype=article>); [The Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Justice/2016/0527/Iowa-Supreme-Court-bans-life-without-parole-sentences-for-all-juveniles>).

<a id="event-2016-05-27-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over 30 college students in Iran were arrested and punished with 99 lashes each for attending a co-ed graduation party.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/28/world/middleeast/iranian-students-lashes-party.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-27-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The legal team of Joaquín Guzmán (El Chapo), the leader of the Sinaloa Cartel, has challenged the foreign ministry of Mexico's decision to extradite him to the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2016/05/28/world/americas/28reuters-mexico-guzman.html>).

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/rodrigo-duterte-philippines-presidency-160527125454511.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2016/may/23/purdah-period-silence-officials-eu-referendum-friday>).

<a id="event-2016-05-27-5-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/donald-trump-urges-marco-rubio-to-reconsider-a-senate-bid-2016-5?r=US&amp;IR=T&amp;IR=T>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-27-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 NBA Playoffs.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the Cleveland Cavaliers defeat the Toronto Raptors 113–87 in Game 6 of the Eastern Conference Finals to win the series 4–2 and advance to the NBA Finals for the second straight season. The Cavaliers await the winner of the Western Conference Finals between the Golden State Warriors and Oklahoma City Thunder. Barring misfortune, the Cavs' LeBron James will become the eighth player to appear in six consecutive Finals and the first to do so without playing for the Boston Celtics.

<a id="event-2016-05-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's newly elected parliament, officially called the Islamic Consultative Assembly, is opened and new members will be sworn-in during the first session.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/irans-reformist-dominated-massively-overhauled-parliament-be-sworn-2374948>); [PressTV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2016/05/28/467752/Iran-Majlis-Parliament>).

<a id="event-2016-05-28-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Secretary General of NATO Anders Fogh Rasmussen is named an advisor for Ukrainian President Petro Poroshenko, a move described by a Russian deputy chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee as a "hostile gesture".

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/ukraine-rasmussen-advicer-nato/27762742.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-28-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anti-government protests erupt across Papua New Guinea against Prime Minister Peter O'Neill, calling on him to resign. Papua New Guinea has been in a state of political turmoil since 2014 when the Prime Minister was accused of fraud and corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/304996/png-protests-spread-to-the-provinces>).

<a id="event-2016-05-28-4-4"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Federal District Judge Gonzalo P. Curiel unseals documents requested by The Washington Post that had been filed with the court in connection with pending civil cases against Trump University, a former business of the Republican Party's presumptive presidential nominee Donald Trump. The judge noted that Trump's candidacy has increased interest in these cases, and that Trump's comments "... (have) placed the integrity of these court proceedings at issue."

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/judge-orders-release-of-internal-trump-university-documents/2016/05/28/2e960e5e-24f9-11e6-8690-f14ca9de2972_story.html>); [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/blogs/under-the-radar/2016/05/donald-trump-university-judge-unseals-files-223687>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/05/28/Trump-trashes-Mexican-judge-in-Trump-U-civil-trial/7441464457911/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>); [Politico²](<http://www.politico.com/f/?id=00000154-f8b3-da5b-afd4-fbb33c940001>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight Russian Olympic athletes from three different sports have tested positive for banned substances during a re-examination of blood samples taken during the 2012 London Olympics, according to the Russian Olympic Committee.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2016/05/28/sports/russia-doping-london-games-rio.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-28-5-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UEFA Champions League.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Real Madrid C.F. defeats Atlético Madrid in a penalty shoot-out to win the final.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2016/may/28/real-madrid-v-atletico-madrid-champions-league-final-live-san-siro>); [Eurosport](<http://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2015-2016/real-madrid-win-title-after-shootout-drama_sto5606494/story.shtml>).

<a id="event-2016-05-29-0-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160529191815/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/fighting-central-yemen-kills-32-39467306>); [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/05/29/fighting-in-central-yemen-kills-32.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3615204/South-Yemen-clashes-kill-39.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least three people are missing after heavy rains caused flooding in the U.S. states of Texas and Kansas. So far, four people have died in the flooding.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-05-29-US--Severe%20Weather/id-8d1f967eb44e49aa9fd30f329368d103>).

<a id="event-2016-05-29-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at a home for elderly people near the Ukrainian capital Kiev kills at least 16 people.

<a id="event-2016-05-29-1-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations fears that approximately 700 migrants have drowned in three Mediterranean Sea shipwrecks over the past few days.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-05-29-EU--Europe%20Migrants/id-d70017a1167d437f88f5d1129b57abf5>).

<a id="event-2016-05-29-1-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AccuWeather](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160530190617/http://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/will-bonnie-form-in-the-atlantic-and-impact-eastern-us-coast-during-memorial-day-weekend-rough-seas-rip-currents-heavy-rain/57683397>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-29-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In compliance with recent UN Security Council resolutons, President Yoweri Museveni of Uganda announces an end to security and military cooperation with North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea-uganda-idUSKCN0YK0E3>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican international football player Alan Pulido, who plays for Olympiacos F.C., is kidnapped by masked men near his home in Ciudad Victoria, Tamaulipas. He is later rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-36409366>); [AP](<http://english.sun.mv/37838/>).

<a id="event-2016-05-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, Gary Johnson presidential campaign, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Gary Johnson, former Governor of New Mexico, secures the nomination for the Libertarian Party in the U.S. presidential election. Johnson picks former Massachusetts governor, and former Republican, William Weld as his running mate.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2016/05/29/gary-johnson-wins-libertarian-presidential-nomination/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-29-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Indianapolis 500.

**Archived source account.** In motor sport, rookie Alexander Rossi wins the 100th Indianapolis 500.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<http://sports.usatoday.com/2016/05/29/indy-500-alexander-rossi-wins-100th-running/>).

### 2016-05-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131713530](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%2030&oldid=1131713530>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-30-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Iraq (2013–2017).

**Archived source account.** At least 24 people are killed in a series of attacks in and around Baghdad. ISIL has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160530080520/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/suicide-car-bombing-kills-people-baghdad-39474538>); [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-05-30-ML--Iraq/id-c00860b45d244b4f8cfb0859a7597eb2>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Iraq (2013–2017) / Operation Breaking Terrorism.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi forces reportedly enter the city of Fallujah. Tens of thousands of civilians are trapped in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/05/30/iraqi-forces-enter-isil-held-city-fallujah/85150894/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/may/30/iraqi-forces-enter-fallujah-in-attempt-to-drive-out-islamic-state>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** At least 11 Afghan policemen are killed in a suspected Taliban attack on security checkpoints in Helmand province.

Source citations (as archived): [The Statesman](<http://www.thestatesman.com/news/world/11-policemen-killed-in-afghan-checkpoints-attack/145461.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-0-7"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Two Turkish police officers are killed in a suspected Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK) bomb attack in the eastern province of Van.

Source citations (as archived): [Hurriyet Daily](<http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/two-police-officers-killed-in-pkk-bomb-attack-in-turkeys-east.aspx?pageID=238&amp;nID=99838&amp;NewsCatID=341>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Three Ukrainian Army soldiers are killed and eight more are injured around separatist-controlled Donetsk and government-controlled Mariupol by Russian-backed separatists.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/ukraine-fresh-fighting/27765575.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-05-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Bible Emoji, a new digital translation of all 66 books of the King James Version of the Bible which replaces some words with emojis, is announced by its anonymous creator.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Odd_News/2016/05/31/Bible-translated-into-emojis-for-millennials/7741464723388/?spt=hs&amp;or=on>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2016/may/30/emoji-bible-arrived-god-king-james>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/life-style/bible-emoji-translates-scripture-pictures-millennials-article-1.2654804>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floods in Baden-Württemberg in southwestern Germany following heavy rain that started Sunday night kill at least four people.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1704172/four-dead-in-flood-chaos-in-southern-germany>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hissene Habre, ex president of Chad, is sentenced to life in prison for ordering rape, sexual slavery and killings during his rule from 1982 to 1990.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36411466>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** More details emerge on the rescue of Olympiacos and Mexico international footballer Alan Pulido, kidnapped in Ciudad Victoria on May 28. He escaped by overpowering a captor left alone with him.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espnfc.us/mexico/story/2883505/mexico-alan-pulido-freed-himself-from-kidnappers-by-wrestling-away-gun>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Congress of the Philippines proclaims Rodrigo Duterte and Leni Robredo as President-elect and Vice President-elect of the Philippines, respectively. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Philippines](<http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2016/05/30/congress-proclamation-president-rodrigo-duterte-vice-president-leni-robredo.html>); [AP](<http://www.theolympian.com/news/nation-world/article80743862.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-4-3"></a>

Context: Syrian peace process.

**Archived source account.** Chief Syrian opposition negotiator of the High Negotiations Committee Mohammed Allush resigns over the failure of the UN-backed peace talks. Allush said that without any of the opposition demands met, peace talks were a "waste of time". In April, the HNC suspended talks with the Syrian government's delegation in Vienna.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/syria-saudi-peace/27764868.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-4-5"></a>

Context: Impeachment process against Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff.

**Archived source account.** Fabiano Silveira, Minister for Transparency, Supervision and Control, resigns after leaked recordings suggested he tried to derail the Petrobras corruption investigation. This anti-corruption ministry was created on May 12, 2016, when Vice President Michel Temer was sworn in as acting president. The same tapes led to the resignation of Planning Minister Romero Jucá last week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36414882>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-corruption-idUSKCN0YL1SB>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-4-7"></a>

Context: Haitian presidential election, 2015–16.

**Archived source account.** A special verification panel recommends throwing out the results of the Haiti presidential election on October 25, 2015, because it appeared to be tainted by significant voter fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2016-05-30/haiti-panel-recommends-throwing-out-results-of-disputed-vote>).

<a id="event-2016-05-30-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jordanian King Abdullah II dissolves the parliament and appoints a new prime minister, Hani Al-Mulki.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/jordan-king-names-new-pm-dissolves-parliament-116053000062_1.html>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/jordans-king-abdullah-dissolves-parliament-names-caretaker-prime-minister/2016/05/29/2676ed60-25d0-11e6-b989-4e5479715b54_story.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-05-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new study by University of Colorado Boulder researchers, published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, finds opioid medicines can paradoxically cause an increase in chronic pain in lab rats.

Source citations (as archived): [EurekAlert\!](<http://www.eurekalert.org/pub_releases/2016-05/uoca-npp052416.php>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-30-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 NBA Playoffs.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the Golden State Warriors defeat the Oklahoma City Thunder 96–88 in the deciding Game 7 of the Western Conference Finals, winning the series 4–3. The defending NBA champion Warriors advance to the NBA Finals, where they will face the Eastern Conference champion Cleveland Cavaliers for the second straight season.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nba/recap?gameId=400876756>).

### 2016-05-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359118810](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20May%2031&oldid=1359118810>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-05-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 23 people are killed in overnight air strikes in Idlib, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/05/31/middleeast/syria-hospital-strike/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36416265>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Suspect Taliban militants kill nine and kidnap 170 in an attack on three passenger buses in Kunduz, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/afghanistan-kidnapping-idINKCN0YM0SN>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/05/31/middleeast/afghanistan-travelers-mass-kidnap/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-05-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, a Delaware court rules Michael Dell and Silver Lake Partners underpriced their 2013 $24.9 billion buyout of Dell Inc. by about 22 percent, and may have to pay tens of millions to investors who opposed the deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/cms/s/0/b5f52e56-274d-11e6-8b18-91555f2f4fde.html#axzz4AID89y3z>); [Source](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-dell-buy>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-1-1"></a>

Context: In the United States, a Delaware court rules Michael Dell and Silver Lake Partners underpriced their 2013 $24.9 billion buyout of Dell Inc. by about 22 percent, and may have to pay tens of millions to investors who opposed the deal..

**Archived source account.** The Wall Street Journal reports that administrative mistakes by asset manager T. Rowe Price led it to vote in favor of the deal, even though it had vocally opposed it in the runup to the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/after-nearly-200-million-flub-t-rowe-price-seeks-a-solution-1464910176>); [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2016/06/04/computer-error-t-rowe-price-dell/?xid=gn_editorspicks&amp;google_editors_picks=true>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-05-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 17 army personnel are killed in a fire in an ammunitions depot in the Indian town of Pulgaon, Maharashtra.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/05/31/world/asia/ap-as-india-ammunitions-depot-fire.html?_r=0>); [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/india-news/massive-fire-at-ammunition-depot-in-maharashtras-pulgaon-19-injured-1413789>); [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-05-31/india-ammunition-depot-fire/7463700>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A five-storey apartment block collapses in Russian city of Mezhdurechensk, killing one man and injuring three.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/344927-apartment-building-collapse-siberia/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-05-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals rules (12-3) a warrant is not required for police to obtain a person's cellphone location data from wireless carriers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-mobilephones-idUSKCN0YM2CZ>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-05-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In an interview with the German broadsheet Frankfurter Allgemeine, the Tibetan spiritual leader Dalai Lama says that Germany has taken too many refugees and "from a moral standpoint" refugees should "only be accommodated temporarily" — with the goal of them returning home to rebuild their countries.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/europes-border-crisis/dalai-lama-thinks-europe-has-let-too-many-refugees-n583701>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-4-2"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea attempts again to launch a BM25 Musudan intermediate-range ballistic missile capable of striking South Korea or Japan but is unsuccessful.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/may/31/north-korea-makes-another-failed-attempt-to-launch-musudan-missile>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A recent Global Slavery Index report estimates the number of people born into servitude, trafficked for sex work, in debt bondage, or forced labour to be 45.8 million. India is reported to have the highest number at an estimated 18.4 million slaves, and North Korea the highest ratio, 4.4 percent of its population.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/slavery-index-data-idINL5N18M4DG>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-05-31/nearly-46-million-people-trapped-in-modern-slavery-report-finds>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-05-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Iranian legislative election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Ali Larijani is reelected chairman of the Iranian Parliament for a one year term while Masoud Pezeshkian and Ali Motahari are elected deputy chairpersons. All three elected members were supported by List of Hope in the recent election.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! news](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/iran-parliament-confirms-election-speaker-1-term-071210863.html>); [Xinhau net](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2016-05/31/c_135401743.htm>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/01/world/middleeast/iran-ali-larijani.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-5-3"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people take to the streets of Jayapura and other towns in Papua, Indonesia, in support of the Free Papua Movement and its effort to join the Melanesian Spearhead Group. Indonesia responded with a large police and military presence, with reports of police firing on demonstrators in Wamena and arresting dozens across the province.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/305303/more-mass-demos-in-west-papua>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mohamed Abdelaziz, the leader of the Polisario Front which fought for the independence of Western Sahara from Morocco, dies after leading the group since 1976.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/05/polisario-front-leader-mohamed-abdelaziz-dies-160531152322637.html>).

<a id="event-2016-05-31-5-6"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Conservative leaders seeking an alternative to the Republican Party's presumptive presidential nominee Donald Trump are urging Tennessee attorney and National Review writer David French to enter the 2016 presidential race as an independent candidate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2016/05/31/conservative-tennessee-attorney-david-french-is-urged-to-enter-presidential-race-as-independent/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-05-31-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Association football icon Pelé announces that he will sell 1,500 lots of his possessions via Julien's Auctions, which will include his medals, trophies, jerseys, and diplomatic gifts.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-36341546>).


## June

### 2016-06-01

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** United States-backed Syrian Democratic Forces begin an offensive to regain control of the city of Manbij in the Aleppo Governorate from ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20160601040520-o42uq>).

<a id="event-2016-06-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** Four UN peacekeepers are killed in a suspected Al-Qaeda attack in northern Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://europe.newsweek.com/mali-four-killed-suspected-al-qaeda-attack-un-bases-465313?rm=eu>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/mali-attack-peacekeepers-1.3610185>).

<a id="event-2016-06-01-0-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Operation Thonapa](<https://operationthonapa.com/31-years-later-we-found-the-flight-recorders-786d0f9fde61#.2e6ifal2c>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thai authorities remove all 137 tigers from the Tiger Temple in Kanchanaburi Province. The remains of 30 more tiger cubs, in addition to the 40 carcasses found earlier, were discovered Thursday. Five men have been charged with possession of endangered animal parts without permission.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/06/04/asia/thailand-temple-tigers-removed/>); [Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/general/999625/30-more-dead-cubs-found>).

<a id="event-2016-06-04-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nigeria’s information and culture minister says the government has recovered $9.1 billion in money and assets stolen from the oil sector.

Source citations (as archived): [HuffPost](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/nigeria-recovers-9-billion-dollars-stolen-money_us_5752daefe4b0c3752dcdc7bf>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-04-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, United States Virgin Islands Democratic caucuses, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Democratic Party in the Virgin Islands, which has seven unpledged delegates, holds its caucus with Hillary Clinton. The results, along with those from tomorrow's primary in Puerto Rico, could bring Hillary Clinton close to securing the nomination.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/hillary-clintons-improbable-path-to-clinching-the-nomination-this-weekend/2016/06/04/c93ae7f6-2a56-11e6-ae4a-3cdd5fe74204_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-04-3-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, United States Virgin Islands Democratic caucuses, 2016.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-06-04-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists report, in the AHA journal Stroke, that a small trial of stroke victims showed significant improvement following injection of stem cells directly into their brains. The study had been designed just to test whether the highly experimental therapy was safe. Such treatments were available in China for many years but treatment results were very inconclusive.

Source citations (as archived): [Tech Insider](<http://www.techinsider.io/using-stem-cells-to-treat-stroke-symptoms-2016-6>); [Stroke](<http://stroke.ahajournals.org/content/early/2016/06/02/STROKEAHA.116.012995.abstract>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/04/tennis/french-open-serena-williams-muguruza-tennis/>).

Context: 2016 Epsom Derby.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-05-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** New South Wales facing evacuations and a rising flood threat as heavy rain and high winds hit Sydney and Newcastle. Parts of Victoria and Tasmania are braced for wild weather.

Ballots of Peruvians living abroad will begin to arrive tonight. Mariano Cucho, the head of the electoral office, says the count may not be finalized until Thursday or Friday.

<a id="event-2016-06-07-3-0"></a>

The researchers suggest coverage reinforces fear of mental illness and the people who have it, and, because of the social stigma, discourages people from seeking treatment.

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes in rebel-held districts of Aleppo kill at least 15 people and wound dozens while three hospitals are hit including one of the few that still provides pediatric services. It is unclear who was responsible, though government forces, backed by the Russian Air Force, have run operations to regain control of the divided city.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36479415>); [Deccan Chronicle](<http://www.deccanchronicle.com/world/middle-east/090616/aleppo-air-strikes-kill-15-hospital-destroyed.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A road collapse at a major intersection near the Canadian Parliament in Ottawa, Ontario, forces evacuation of a mall, a hotel, the Shaw Convention Centre, and a book store because of the smell of gas. Power and water are now shut off.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/ottawa/sinkhole-rideau-street-downtown-ottawa-1.3621949>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-08-2-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c1f8c2078baf4e7c9777a85bd8db5c3f/refer-eritreas-human-rights-crimes-icc-un-group-says>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Papua New Guinea student protests.

**Archived source account.** Police open fire on University of Papua New Guinea students in Port Moresby protesting against the government of Prime Minister Peter O'Neill. Four people have been killed and seven injured. However, according to the police, nobody was killed while a university spokesperson claims police only fired tear gas.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-06-08/shooting-on-papua-new-guinea-university-campus/7489416>); [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/305888/png-students-injured-in-police-crackdown>).

<a id="event-2016-06-08-3-2"></a>

Context: Papua New Guinea student protests.

**Archived source account.** A Papua New Guinea court grants an injunction barring university students from protesting on campus. Thousands of students across the nation have been protesting and boycotting classes for weeks calling for Prime Minister Peter O'Neill's resignation over corruption allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-papua-protests-idUSKCN0YU2PI>).

<a id="event-2016-06-08-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eritrean Mered Medhanie, aka The General, leader of one of the largest criminal operations unsafely smuggling migrants from Africa to Europe for up to €5,000 (£3,900; $5,680), is extradited to Italy. Police say in one attempt at least 359 migrants died when their boat sank near the Italian island of Lampedusa in October 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36476147>).

<a id="event-2016-06-08-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Governor John Kasich signs a bill legalizing medical marijuana, making Ohio the 25th state in America to approve its use.

Source citations (as archived): [Cincinnati Enquirer](<http://www.cincinnati.com/story/news/politics/2016/06/08/john-kasich-just-legalized-medical-marijuana-ohio-now-what/85499176/>).

**Archived source account.** Hamilton sweeps the Tonys, winning 11 of Broadway's top awards including best musical, best actor (Leslie Odom, Jr.), best direction (Thomas Kail), best featured actress (Renée Elise Goldsberry), and best featured actor (Daveed Diggs). Creator Lin-Manuel Miranda won for best score and for best book of a musical.

Source citations (as archived): [Otago Daily Times](<http://www.odt.co.nz/entertainment/theatre/386700/hamilton-sweeps-tonys-11-awards>); [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2016/06/12/tony-award-winners-2016-complete-list-vs-predictions-updated-live/#38656ee9367c>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-1-4"></a>

Context: 70th Tony Awards.

**Archived source account.** Hamilton fell just short of The Producers record of 12 wins in 2001.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/arts/la-et-cm-tony-winners-20160609-snap-story.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-12-2-1"></a>

Context: European migration crisis.

**Archived source account.** Italy's Coast Guard picks up 1,230 migrants in the Mediterranean Sea. More than 4,000 people have been saved at sea in the past week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20160612195848-c04gw/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** In what is the deadliest mass shooting and the worst terror attack since 9/11 to occur in the United States, a mass shooting at a gay nightclub in the U.S. city of Orlando, Florida, kills at least 50 people, including the shooter, and injures 53.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-36512308>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/06/12/us/orlando-nightclub-shooting/>); [Australian Broadcasting Co.](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-06-13/live-blog-orlando-nightclub-shooting/7504096>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-2"></a>

Context: Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** ISIL's Amaq News Agency claims that the assault, "... was carried out by an Islamic State fighter".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-florida-shooting-claim-idUSKCN0YY0VU>); [CBS New York](<http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2016/06/12/orlando-nightclub-shooting/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** The FBI identifies the deceased gunman as Omar Mir Seddique Mateen, a 29-year-old American citizen born in New York to Afghani parents, and living in Port St. Lucie, Florida. Mateen called 9-1-1 during the attack and pledged allegiance to ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS New York](<http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2016/06/12/orlando-nightclub-shooting/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-4"></a>

Context: Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** Mateen's father, Seddique Mir Mateen, says, "We are saying we are apologizing for the whole incident. This had nothing to do with religion." Seddique says that during a recent outing in Miami, his son got very angry when he saw men kissing and touching each other. According to the elder Mateen, Omar said, "Look at that. In front of my son they are doing that."

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/orlando-nightclub-massacre/terror-hate-what-motivated-orlando-nightclub-shooter-n590496>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-5"></a>

Context: Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** The City of Orlando requests, via Twitter, citizens, "... hold off on vigils — they represent a serious strain on our limited resources, which we need to dedicate to law enforcement and victims."

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/orlando-nightclub-shooting-live-updates/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The scheduled L.A. Pride parade is held in West Hollywood Park in California. A 20-year-old man, whose car was filled with explosive materials and weapons, is arrested before he reached the parade area. He is misquoted as saying he wanted to harm people at the event.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Daily News](<http://www.dailynews.com/general-news/20160612/man-arrested-with-weapons-explosive-materials-wanted-to-harm-people-at-la-pride>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion at Shanghai Pudong International Airport injures at least three people; the explosive appears to be homemade.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jun/12/shanghai-airport-blast-injures-three>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lawyers for former President of Chad Hissène Habré, who was recently found guilty of crimes against humanity and sentenced to life in prison, appeal the verdict. However, a tribunal spokesman said the appeal process is not expected to be done before April 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/lawyers-appeal-chad-ruler-habre-life-sentence-160611195707044.html>).

#### Sports

Context: UEFA Euro 2016.

**Archived source account.** UEFA opens an inquiry into the Russian Football Union after massive fights between Russian and English hooligans during and after the match between Russia and England in Marseille. Dozens of injuries, including at least one Briton in critical condition, and multiple arson attacks occurred throughout the city.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36510550#>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-4-3"></a>

Context: 2016 KPMG Women's PGA Championship.

**Archived source account.** In golf, Brooke Henderson of Canada wins the 2016 KPMG Women's PGA Championship.

Source citations (as archived): [Seattle Times](<http://www.seattletimes.com/sports/golf/kpmg-womens-pga-championship-day-4-live-coverage-standings-updates-commentary-from-sahalee/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-12-4-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Stanley Cup Finals.

**Archived source account.** In ice hockey, the Pittsburgh Penguins win their fourth Stanley Cup title defeating the San Jose Sharks 4 games to 2 in the finals.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/blog/nhl/post/_/id/42669/rapid-reaction-pittsburgh-penguins-3-san-jose-sharks-1>).

### 2016-06-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104011483](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2013&oldid=1104011483>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** City officials in Orlando, Florida, continue to identify the bodies of the victims in yesterday's attack. So far, 33 of the reported 49 victims have been identified and their families notified.

Source citations (as archived): [City of Orlando](<http://www.cityoforlando.net/blog/victims/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Moro Conflict.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau says his government has "compelling reason to believe" that Robert Hall, who was held hostage in the Philippines, has been killed by his captors, presumably the same Abu Sayyaf militants who beheaded another Canadian, John Ridsdel, on 25 April 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/68666c34eafa45b1a6529d15ce88e5c5/canada-believes-canadian-hostage-killed-philippines>).

<a id="event-2016-06-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb injures at least nine people, three in serious condition, in the mainly-Kurdish southeast region in Turkey's Tunceli Province. The explosion occurred close to housing for courthouse employees in the town of Ovacik. There is no immediate claim of responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/car-bomb-rocks-eastern-turkey-160613113123297.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/eb4b085a570044829682fc15ae0b21dc/report-9-injured-car-bomb-explosion-southeast-turkey>).

<a id="event-2016-06-13-0-7"></a>

Context: June 2016 Magnanville stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A senior French police commander is killed by a knife-wielding 25-year-old man outside his home in Magnanville near Paris, France. The attacker, who retreated inside the house, is also killed when elite police commandos storm the residence after negotiations failed. The commander's partner, a female administrative police official, is found dead inside the home, while a young boy is rescued physically unharmed. The Islamic State, via its Amaq News Agency, claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160614004057/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id4573>); [Le Parisien](<http://www.leparisien.fr/yvelines-78/yvelines-un-policier-poignarde-a-mort-a-magnanville-13-06-2016-5880893.php>); [HuffPost](<http://www.huffingtonpost.ca/2016/06/13/magnanville-france-attack_n_10447526.html>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/france-crime-idINKCN0Z0099>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-06-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 in amusement parks.

**Archived source account.** Lightning Rod, the world's first launched wooden roller coaster, opens at the Dollywood amusement park in Pigeon Forge, Tennessee, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Knoxville News Sentinel](<https://archive.knoxnews.com/entertainment/pop-culture/after-weeks-of-anticipation-lightning-rod-coaster-opens-at-dollywood-352b1185-0d1b-12f4-e053-0100007-382693581.html/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-06-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Microsoft agrees to buy professional networking site LinkedIn for $26.2 billion (£18 billion).

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<http://www.cnet.com/au/news/microsoft-buys-linkedin-in-26-2bn-deal/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-36519766>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-13-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Police in northern Greece move more than 400 Syrians and Iraqis by bus from a makeshift camp near the Macedonian border to a shelter near the northern city of Thessaloniki. More than 50,000 migrants remain stranded in Greece following European border closures, and the European Union's agreement with Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fd5a0bb87e8d40009883aa00b105d6ce/greece-police-clear-more-migrant-camps-near-border>).

<a id="event-2016-06-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Germany–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Eleven Turkish-German members of Germany's Parliament, the Bundestag, who voted in support of declaring the Ottoman Turks slaughter of Armenians in 1915 a genocide, are under police protection. The legislators have faced heavy criticism from Turkish officials, as well as from Turkish Germans.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/06/12/11-German-MPs-under-police-protection-over-genocide-squabble-with-Turkey/5841465775367/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [UPI²](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/06/09/Turkey-plans-retaliatory-measures-for-German-genocide-resolution-Erdogan-says/8101465480660/?st_rec=5841465775367>).

<a id="event-2016-06-13-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Secretary General of NATO Jens Stoltenberg says that the military alliance plans on sending four multinational battalions to Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Poland in order to boost their defense. However, Stoltenberg said that the battalions will only be deployed on a rotational basis instead of being based permanently.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/nato-baltics-poland-russia-ukraine-battalions/27795258.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fiji's ambassador to the United Nations Peter Thomson is elected as President of the United Nations General Assembly for its 71st session.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160614120624/http://www.wral.com/un-elects-fiji-ambassador-to-top-general-assembly-post/15775240/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 22-year-old Dutch woman held in Qatar for nearly three months after telling police she had been raped is released following the court ruling of a one-year suspended prison sentence. The Associated Press reports it isn't clear "\[...\] what sentence was given to the man she accused of rape."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c9578c3beed745988b95fb277cf2c750/diplomat-qatar-frees-dutch-woman-held-after-rape-report>).

<a id="event-2016-06-13-5-2"></a>

Context: Trial of Oscar Pistorius.

**Archived source account.** South African Paralympic sprinting medalist Oscar Pistorius's sentencing hearing begins. He faces a minimum 15-year jail term since his original manslaughter charge for the 2013 killing of Reeva Steenkamp has been upgraded to murder. The hearing is set to last for five days.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/safrica-pistorius-sentencing-idINKCN0YZ07O>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1669727/oscar-pistorius-faces-sentencing-in-june>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-13-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Supreme Court strikes down a Puerto Rican law that would have allowed it to restructure the debts of its public utilities over the objections of creditors. Puerto Rico's agencies have a $2 billion debt payment due July 1 and has already defaulted on a $370 million debt payment for its Government Development Bank back on May 1.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2016-06-13/puerto-rico-debt-restructuring-law-voided-by-u-s-supreme-court>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-06-13-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An international team of scientists report in the journal Nature Communications the discovery of a material (SBMOF-1) that can clear nuclear waste gases, produced by reprocessing plants, more efficiently, cheaply, and safely than currently available methods.

Source citations (as archived): [R&amp;D Magazine](<http://www.rdmag.com/news/2016/06/new-material-can-clear-nuclear-waste-gases>); [The Statesman](<http://www.thestatesman.com/news/science-and-tech/new-material-can-remove-radioactive-waste-efficiently/148148.html>); [Nature Communications](<http://www.nature.com/ncomms/2016/160613/ncomms11831/full/ncomms11831.html>).

### 2016-06-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099404890](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2014&oldid=1099404890>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan skirmishes.

**Archived source account.** Afghan and Pakistani soldiers clash at the Torkham border crossing between the two countries, leaving one Afghan soldier and a Pakistani major killed. At least 22 other people were also injured. Tensions between Afghanistan and Pakistan have grown since the latter's attempts to build a gate at the crossing.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/afghan-soldier-killed-border-clash-pakistan-160613075159320.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-0-3"></a>

Context: June 2016 Magnanville stabbing.

**Archived source account.** The attacker is identified as Larossi Abballa, a 25-year-old man who, according to police sources, was a neighbor of the murdered couple. Abballa was one of eight men convicted in Paris in 2013 for making plans to travel to Pakistan for terrorist training, and then to commit terrorists acts. Abballa was sentenced to three years in prison. He was released after the trial as six months of the sentence was suspended, and he had already spent two years in jail awaiting trial.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/06/13/paris-hostage-situation-after-man-kills-policeman/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/15/world/europe/france-stabbing-police-magnanville-isis.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-0-4"></a>

Context: June 2016 Magnanville stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Abballa was recording the attack and posting it on Facebook Live, according to French officials.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/isis-france-police-commander-partner-death-paris-posts-facebook-live/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-0-6"></a>

Context: Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** Six of the wounded are critically ill, five remain in "guarded" condition, and 16 more are still hospitalized. Forty-four people were brought to the Orlando Regional Medical Center after the shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<http://www.providencejournal.com/news/20160614/six-people-injured-in-orlando-shooting-still-critically-ill-hospital-says>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Vietnamese air force Su-30MK2 fighter aircraft goes missing during a trial flight along the coast of Nghệ An Province

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.euronews.com/newswires/3206874-vietnamese-fighter-jet-goes-missing-along-south-china-sea-coast/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Cessna 208 Caravan plane crashes in the small town of Yahukimo in Papua, Indonesia, injuring at least seven people.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/306386/small-plane-crash-in-papua>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-14-2-1"></a>

Context: European Union-Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** \{\{Interlanguage link multi\|Hansjörg Haber\|de\}\}, the European Union's top envoy to Turkey, resigns effective August. Ömer Çelik, Turkish Minister of European Union Affairs, had complained that Haber had shown disrespect for Turkey's national values, and for President Tayyip Erdoğan. EU officials declined to comment on the reason for Haber's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Latina](<http://www.plenglish.com/index.php?option=com_content&amp;task=view&amp;id=4974181&amp;Itemid=1>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-2-2"></a>

Context: European Union-Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's EU accession process has been stalled over the EU's requirement that Turkey reform its counter-terrorism laws concerning their application against intellectuals, Kurdish sympathizers, and critics of Erdoğan. Tomorrow, EU envoys are scheduled to formally agree to open negotiations on financial and budget issues.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-turkey-envoy-idUSKCN0Z00U9>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An armed man, holding two people hostage in a Walmart in Amarillo, Texas, is shot and killed by a police SWAT unit. No other injuries are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-texas-hostages-idUSKCN0Z0251>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-3-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Alleged Russian hackers have penetrated the computer network of the Democratic National Committee (DNC) and have gained access to the entire database of research on Republican Party presidential candidate Donald Trump, according to committee officials and security experts. The DNC says that no financial, donor or personal information appears to have been accessed or taken, suggesting that the breach was traditional espionage, and not the work of criminal hackers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/russian-government-hackers-penetrated-dnc-stole-opposition-research-on-trump/2016/06/14/cf006cb4-316e-11e6-8ff7-7b6c1998b7a0_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit three-judge panel upholds the Federal Communications Commission's net neutrality rules that prohibit broadband providers from giving or selling access to faster internet service to selected customers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-internet-idUSKCN0Z01RR>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Egyptian Misdemeanor Court acquits 52 people charged with taking part in anti-government demonstrations in April. Thousands rallied on April 25 to protest the transfer of Red Sea islands Tiran and Sanafir to Saudi Arabia. Police arrested nearly 300 demonstrators; government reports indicate all have been released from prison.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160615122740/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/egypt-acquits-52-held-april-protests-president-39838977>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Los Angeles, California, police arrest a 21-year-old homeless man after five bodies of apparent transients are found in the wreckage of a vacant former medical building that burned down Monday night. Firefighters had been able to rescue three people.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-bodies-la-office-20160614-snap-story.html>); [LA Weekly](<http://www.laweekly.com/news/man-arrested-after-5-bodies-found-in-burned-building-7030451>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/06/14/Suspect-arrested-after-five-bodies-found-in-burned-building/1551465953465/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-14-4-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Rupert Murdoch-controlled tabloid The Sun, Britain's second biggest selling newspaper, endorses Brexit, saying that the people of UK should "Take back control and BeLeave in Britain".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/media/greenslade/2016/jun/14/the-suns-brexit-call-is-unsurprising-but-it-has-symbolic-significance>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-4-3"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2016-election/hillary-clinton-projected-winner-washington-d-c-democratic-primary-n592416?cid=eml_nbn_20160614>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-4-5"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election / 2016 Republican National Convention.

**Archived source account.** The American Civil Liberties Union sues the city of Cleveland, stating the security restrictions and rules for public demonstrations in the 3.3-square-mile zone surrounding Quicken Loans Arena violate the First Amendment to the United States Constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/06/17/ACLU-sues-Cleveland-over-GOP-convention-protest-restrictions/2391466190609/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-06-14-5-1"></a>

Context: UEFA Euro 2016.

**Archived source account.** UEFA fines the Russian Football Union €150,000 (US$168,000) for the violence that broke out between Russian and English supporters in Marseille on June 11. UEFA also warned that any further misconduct will disqualify the Russian team.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/uefa-russia-euro-2016-fined-disqualification/27797089.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-14-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In ice hockey, ESPN reports that the NHL will place an expansion team in Las Vegas, provided the team's backers can pay a US$500 million expansion fee. The team, which would enter the league no earlier than the 2017–18 season, would be the first major professional sports team in Las Vegas. The league's board of governors is scheduled to hold a formal vote on the expansion on June 22.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nhl/story/_/id/16203078/nhl-settles-las-vegas-quebec-city-expansion>).
