#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government airstrikes hit rebel-held areas in Aleppo, killing at least 34 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/aleppo-bombardment-kills-dozens-including-children-160615105639372.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A scaffolding on a bridge under construction near Werneck, Germany, collapses, killing at least one worker and injuring six more.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36543261>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-1-2"></a>

Context: EgyptAir Flight 804.

**Archived source account.** A deep sea search vessel discovers the wreckage of the lost aircraft in the Mediterranean Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/15/middleeast/egyptair-wreckage/index.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36543969>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-15-2-1"></a>

Context: European Union-Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey fails to meet the criteria set forth by the European Union in order to obtain visa-free travel to its member states. The EU promised to grant Turkey visa-free travel only if it met specific conditions on border security and human rights.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jun/15/turkey-misses-deadline-visa-free-travel-eu-ambassador-withdraw>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-2-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** NATO's defense ministers agree to boost support for Ukraine with a "comprehensive package of assistance", which will help it strengthen defense and to modernize its armed forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/ukraine-nato-agrees-assistance-package/27800812.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-2-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Palestine relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel announces plans for construction of a three-story residential building for Jewish settlers in a Palestinian neighborhood of East Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/israel-palestinians-settlements-idINKCN0Z11NJ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2014–16 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan police arrest at least 400 people in the city of Cumaná after food riots and looting broke out yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-violence-idUSKCN0Z11WW>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-3-3"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** The father of Cal State Long Beach student Nohemi Gonzalez, the only American killed in the November 13, 2015, Paris massacre, files suit in San Francisco, California, federal court against Twitter, Facebook, and Google, alleging the companies provided "material support" to the Islamic State and other extremist groups. While generally free of liability under U.S. law which provides a legal safe harbor for content posted, this case targets the behavior social media companies enable. The suit is very similar to a case brought against Twitter in January by the widow of a contractor killed in the November 9, 2015, attack in Jordan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.sfgate.com/business/technology/article/Father-of-Paris-attacks-victim-sues-social-media-8208997.php>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3643640/Father-Paris-attack-victim-23-sues-Google-Facebook-Twitter-claiming-let-terrorism-spread.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2016/jan/14/widow-american-killed-jordan-attack-sues-twitter-isis>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yōichi Masuzoe resigns as the Governor of the Japanese capital Tokyo over a political funding scandal. He was due to face a no-confidence motion in the Tokyo Metropolitan Assembly later today.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160616173221/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/reports-tokyo-governor-resign-funds-scandal-39863675>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-4-2"></a>

Context: Senator Murphy gun control filibuster.

**Archived source account.** United States Senator Chris Murphy (D-Conn) launches a filibuster on the Senate floor in an effort to pass gun control legislation in the wake of the Orlando nightclub shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2016/06/sen-chris-murphy-starts-talking-filibuster-over-gun-control-224369>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Canadian House of Commons approves a bill to make the lyrics in the country's national anthem gender neutral. The bill would change the words in O Canada from "in all thy sons command" to "in all of us command."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-anthem-idUSKCN0Z12S1>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, City Council approves a 1.5-cent-per-ounce tax on sugar-sweetened and diet beverages, effective January 1, 2017. This the first so-called sugary drinks tax in a major U.S. city.

Source citations (as archived): [Philadelphia Inquirer](<http://www.philly.com/philly/news/politics/20160617_Philadelphia_City_Council_to_vote_on_soda_tax.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-06-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists confirm a second detection of gravitational waves by LIGO.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2016/jun/15/gravitational-waves-detected-from-collision-of-second-set-of-black-holes-ligo>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-36540254>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-06-15-6-1"></a>

Context: Violence at UEFA Euro 2016.

**Archived source account.** Renewed clashes take place between English and Russian football fans in the French city of Lille following Russia's 2-1 defeat against Slovakia. Riot police fired tear gas at England supporters outside Gare de Lille Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/jun/15/england-and-russia-fans-brawl-in-lille-at-euro-2016>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-36543468>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-6-2"></a>

Context: Violence at UEFA Euro 2016.

**Archived source account.** Police arrest at least 36 people in Lille following clashes between French police and football fans at the tournament. French authorities report 16 people were taken to hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-36543468>).

<a id="event-2016-06-15-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In baseball, Ichiro Suzuki reaches a combined total of career hits of 4,257 spanning Major League Baseball and Nippon Professional Baseball. It passes Pete Rose's career total encompassing Major League Baseball only of 4,256 but the MLB is considered to be a higher quality competition.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/mlb/story/_/id/16233746/ichiro-suzuki-miami-marlins-career-hits-totals>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-16-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing kills at least 10 security force members in the village of Abu Qurayn, west of Sirte.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/libyan-forces-killed-suicide-attack-sirte-160616130054316.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States accuses Russia of bombing U.S.-backed forces in southern Syria near al-Tanf close to the Iraq and Jordan borders.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Examiner](<http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/pentagon-russia-bombed-u.s.-backed-rebels-in-syria/article/2594178>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of American diplomats send a memo, via the State Department’s dissent channel, critical of U.S. policy in Syria. The memo was signed by 51 mid- to high-level State Department officers involved with advising on Syrian policy, and calls for airstrikes against President Bashar al-Assad's government to stop its persistent violations of the United Nations-sponsored February ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/17/world/middleeast/syria-assad-obama-airstrikes-diplomats-memo.html?emc=edit_na_20160616&amp;nlid=66213151&amp;ref=cta&amp;_r=0>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-usa-cable-idUSKCN0Z3087>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flooding in southern Ghana caused by heavy rain leaves at least 10 people dead and the streets of Accra under water.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/floods-leave-dead-southern-ghana-160616104330811.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China cancels an invitation to a Taiwanese children's choir after it performed the island's national anthem at last month's inauguration of President Tsai Ing-wen; the Puzangalan Choir consisting of children from the Paiwan aboriginal tribe had been due to take part in a choral festival in Guangdong province in July.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0e78184955664314a5a332c431822211/report-china-cancels-visit-kids-who-sang-taiwan-anthem>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/17/world/asia/china-taiwan-puzangalan-choir.html?_r=0>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-36547305>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-2-2"></a>

Context: Violence at UEFA Euro 2016.

**Archived source account.** France deports twenty Russian football fans including Alexander Shprygin, the leader of the All-Russia Supporters Union, following violence at the England–Russia match in Marseille.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36546183>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-2-4"></a>

Context: Switzerland–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** Switzerland's Federal Assembly votes to officially withdraw the country's application to join the European Union. Following the vote, foreign minister Didier Burkhalter was quoted as saying that the government will now tell the EU to “consider the application as withdrawn”.

Source citations (as archived): [Malta Today](<http://www.maltatoday.com.mt/news/europe/66539/switzerland_withdraws_application_to_join_eu_#.V2L3kKKxWfg>); [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/06/16/switzerland-ends-bid-to-join-european-economic-area-after-24-years/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Causeway Bay Books disappearances, One country, two systems.

**Archived source account.** One of five Hong Kong booksellers who disappeared in 2015 says he was forced by Chinese agents into a confession of "illegal trading".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-36549266>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thai police raid the Dhammakaya Buddhist temple, north of Bangkok, to arrest Abbot Phra Dhammachayo, who is accused of conspiring to launder money by accepting stolen cash from a credit union. His followers deny the allegations and claim the charges are politically motivated.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-buddhism-idUSKCN0Z2096>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36545637>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Labour Party MP Jo Cox dies at Leeds General Infirmary after being shot and stabbed as she prepared to hold a meeting with constituents in Birstall, West Yorkshire, United Kingdom. A woman suffered serious injuries; a man was slightly wounded. West Yorkshire police have arrested a 52-year-old male suspect.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/jo-cox-british-lawmaker-shot-stabbed-yorkshire-reports-n593581>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/british-politician-reportedly-shot-town-hall-meeting/story?id=39902607>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-36550304>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-politics-attack-idUSKCN0Z21LS>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2016/jun/16/labour-mp-jo-cox-shot-in-west-yorkshire>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-3-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Nigerien authorities discover the bodies of 34 migrants, mostly children, left behind in the Sahara desert by people smugglers who were taking them to Algeria and then to Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jun/16/bodies-migrants-found-niger-desert-people-smugglers-algeria>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Ugandan soldier kills at least seven people in a shooting spree at a military police barracks in the capital, Kampala. The soldier, Sgt Isaac Obua, was then shot dead himself. He is reported to have been drunk.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-36553127>).

<a id="event-2016-06-16-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Kenyan lower court judge upholds the use of anal examinations to attempt to determine a suspect’s sexual orientation. Homosexual acts are a crime in Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160617135613/http://www.bigstory.ap.org/article/9e8b0edfbca54b08b70dfde154306c31/kenya-judge-upholds-use-anal-probes-define-sexuality>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/worldviews/wp/2016/06/16/kenyan-court-rules-anal-exams-to-test-sexual-orientation-are-legal/>).

Among them are four Kazakh gold medalists: Ilya Ilyin, Zulfiya Chinshanlo, Svetlana Podobedova and Maiya Maneza. The other athletes represent Azerbaijan, Belarus, Russia, and Ukraine. <a id="event-2016-06-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Over 50,000 people protest in Okinawa capital Naha against U.S. military presence on the Japanese island, spurred on by last month's arrest of an U.S. Marine veteran, civilian contractor for the rape and killing of a 20-year-old local woman.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-usa-okinawa-idUSKCN0Z5056>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/3b90c2d7835e417a85d0bbae70316e5b/massive-protest-okinawa-opposes-us-military-after-killing>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2016/05/20/outrage-in-japan-as-american-arrested-in-connection-with-death-of-woman-on-okinawa/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Clashes between the Mexican police and members of the radical Mexican teachers union National Coordinator of Education Workers in Oaxaca leaves at least six people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/06/20/at-least-6-killed-more-than-100-hurt-in-mexico-clashes-between-police-and-teachers.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Italian local elections, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Italian capital of Rome go to the polls for a runoff election to select a new Mayor of Rome with exit polls showing Virginia Raggi of the Five Star Movement will become the first female Mayor.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36569410>); [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20160620-rome-elects-first-female-mayor-setback-italian-pm-five-star-movement-raggi-renzi>).

<a id="event-2016-06-19-4-3"></a>

Context: Wukan protests, 2016's events:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people are reported to have spontaneously marched in southern China's village of Wukan in Guangdong province over the arrest of the village's democratically elected leader, 70-year-old Lin Zuluan, who had been planning meetings and protests about corruption, illegal land grabs, and the government's failure to return land to the people, per the 2011 agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fc4b2c90b3fa4c26https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2016_June_19&amp;action=edit&amp;editintro=Portal:Current_events/Edit_instructions#86d6597ec307dd90/chinese-villagers-protest-after-police-detain-elected>); [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1977349/villagers-china-vow-press-ahead-land-seizures-protest#>).

<a id="event-2016-06-19-4-4"></a>

Context: Wukan protests, 2016's events:.

**Archived source account.** City of Lufeng prosecutors said in a statement that Lin was being held on suspicion of taking bribes. Renmin University's Zhang Mingin, a political science professor, says the bribery charge was "strange" since a village chief does not have the authority to approve projects that could result in kickbacks.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2016-06-18/police-smother-chinese-village-ahead-of-planned-protest>).

<a id="event-2016-06-19-4-5"></a>

Context: Wukan protests, 2016's events:.

**Archived source account.** Plainclothes policemen and policemen in riot-control gear establish checkpoints, guard government buildings, and increase patrols on the streets of Wukan. The earlier operation to arrest Lin included hundreds of police.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1977349/villagers-china-vow-press-ahead-land-seizures-protest#>); [The Scotsman](<http://www.scotsman.com/news/world/chinese-police-take-control-of-village-ahead-of-protests-1-4158549>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-06-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In golf, American golfer Dustin Johnson wins the 2016 U.S. Open, his first major. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/news/article.cfm?c_id=4&amp;objectid=11659657>).

<a id="event-2016-06-19-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the Golden State Warriors in seven games to win the 2016 NBA Championship. Cleveland, winning its first NBA title in the franchise's 45-year history, also became the first NBA team to rally from a 3-1 deficit and win the crown. Tonight's victory also ends the 52-year title drought of Cleveland's major sports teams; in 1964, the Cleveland Browns shut out the Baltimore Colts for the NFL title. Cleveland's LeBron James is unanimously voted the Most Valuable Player of the NBA Finals, his third such award.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2016/jun/19/golden-state-warriors-cleveland-cavaliers-nba-finals-game-7-live-score>); [Ohio.com](<http://www.ohio.com/blogs/cleveland-cavaliers/cleveland-cavaliers-1.275356/cavs-win-first-nba-championship-lebron-james-named-mvp-in-93-89-win-over-warriors-1.691628>); [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nba/playoffs/2016/story/_/id/16351029/lebron-james-cleveland-cavaliers-named-unanimous-nba-finals-mvp>).

### 2016-06-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099526770](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2020&oldid=1099526770>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-20-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A minibus carrying private security guards explodes in Kabul resulting in the death of at least 12 people and injuring several others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters and NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/multiple-people-killed-minibus-explosion-kabul-afghanistan-n595341>).

<a id="event-2016-06-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing strikes Camp Taji, killing four Iraqi Army soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/world/306871/suicide-bombing-hits-camp-taji>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-06-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court reversed an appeals court ruling that would have narrowly interpreted the auto salesman's exemption from overtime pay rules mandated by statute under rules promulgated by the U.S. Labor Department, remanding the matter for further consideration.

Source citations (as archived): [slip opinion](<http://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/15pdf/15-415_mlho.pdf>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-20-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, the number of people displaced by conflicts in the world is at its highest level ever recorded, with an estimated 65.3 million people either being refugees, internally displaced or asylum seekers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-36573082>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in Bahrain.

**Archived source account.** Bahraini authorities strip Isa Qassim, the kingdom's most influential Shia cleric, of his citizenship after they accused him of promoting "sectarianism and violence".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36578000>).

<a id="event-2016-06-20-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to an environmental report by Global Witness, 2015 was the deadliest year ever for environmental activists, with the reported deaths of 185 activists, as a result of falling commodity prices prompting forceful land grabs by mining and foresting companies.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/deadliest-year-ever-for-environmental-activism/a-19339193>).

<a id="event-2016-06-20-3-4"></a>

Context: Gun politics in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court declines to review assault weapons bans in Connecticut and New York, as it did last December concerning Chicago, Illinois, city law. Five other states and Washington, D.C. have similar restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2016/06/20/supreme-court-leaves-state-assault-weapons-bans-in-place.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-20-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Croatian MPs vote to dissolve the Parliament, setting the stage for snap election, which are expected to take place in early September. This comes as Croatia is facing an escalating political crisis following the last election in November 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/croatia-dissolves-parliament-early-vote-160620122316755.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-20-4-2"></a>

Context: 2014–16 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** Per Venezuela's National Electoral Council's ruling, citizens across the country queue up for fingerprint validation of 1,850,000 signatures on referendum to recall President Nicolás Maduro. The opposition Democratic Unity Roundtable must validate 197,000 signatures (1 percent of registered voters) by Friday, in this first step of the recall referendum process.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-idUSKCN0Z61ZX>); [TeleSUR](<http://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Venezuela-Begins-Validating-Recall-Referendum-Signatures--20160620-0012.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-06-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Solar Impulse 2, a plane powered only by the sun, leaves New York on the 15th leg of its round-the-world journey, a 90-hour flight over the Atlantic Ocean to Western Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-solar-plane-idUSKCN0Z60P3>); [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/solar-plane-begins-trans-atlantic-flight-116062000957_1.html>).

### 2016-06-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363908198](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2021&oldid=1363908198>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Jordanian–Syrian border incidents during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A car-bomb explodes near a Jordanian Armed Forces outpost in the extreme north-eastern point of Rukban, a makeshift Syrian refugee camp, leaving 6 soldiers dead and 14 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36584885>).

<a id="event-2016-06-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Five Kenyan police officers are killed when Al-Shabaab militants ambush their convoy near El Wak, Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/kenya-police-killed-al-shabab-convoy-attack-160620184500898.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-21-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A 15-year-old Palestinian teen is shot and killed by Israel Defense Forces while traveling in his family's car through an area where stones had been thrown that injured two tourists and an Israeli. The IDF says an official investigation has been opened. Preliminary results indicate Mahmoud Rafat Baderan, the teen who was shot, was not involved in any stone throwing on the highway.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/1.726312>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people, all foreign holidaymakers, are killed and 23 are injured when their bus swerves off a highway en route to Belgrade, Serbia.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/serbia-bus-cash-dead-czechs-slovaks/27811664.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Japan places its military on high alert to be ready to shoot down any missile heading for its territory amid reports of a possible North Korean launch of an intermediate-range missile from its east coast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missile-idUSKCN0Z70AF>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/347588-korea-launch-japan-alert/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-21-2-3"></a>

Context: Egypt–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** An Egyptian court, while not final, reverses the decision by President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi to cede Tiran and Sanafir Island to Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/egypt-court-voids-red-sea-islands-transfer-saudi-160621101413590.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jean-Pierre Bemba, leader of the Movement for the Liberation of the Congo, and a former Congolese vice president, is sentenced to 18 years in prison by the International Criminal Court for war crimes, and for sexual violence crimes against humanity in neighboring Central African Republic during 2002 and 2003.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36586010>); [The Times](<http://www.timeslive.co.za/africa/2016/06/21/Jean-Pierre-Bemba-gets-18-years-for-Central-African-Republic-war-crimes>).

### 2016-06-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099528147](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2022&oldid=1099528147>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant declares war on the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/06/22/1595580/isis-releases-first-propaganda-video-philippines>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, airstrikes on ISIL-held Al-Raqqah kill at least 18 civilians. The group was unable to determine who carried out the airstrikes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36595166>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/lebanese-army-slowly-crushing-extremists-near-syria-border/2016/06/22/5a01865e-3845-11e6-af02-1df55f0c77ff_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Battle of Fallujah (2016).

**Archived source account.** The United Nations reports 80,000 civilians have fled Fallujah, as Iraqi Army and Shia militias retake most of the city from ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [The Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Middle-East/2016/0621/80-000-Fallujah-civilians-escape-IS-but-face-new-crisis-in-desert-camps>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Sectarianism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill Sufi devotional singer Amjad Sabri in Pakistan with a faction of the Pakistani Taliban claiming responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/23/world/asia/amjad-sabri-famed-sufi-singer-is-gunned-down-in-pakistan.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill a Nigerian driver and kidnap seven people near Calabar, Nigeria. The group, which was escorted by a security pickup that reportedly had four armed policemen, includes five expatriate and two Nigerian contractors working for Macmahon Holdings' United Cement Company plant in the Akpabuyo district. Police report two of the workers escaped. Police commissioner Jimoh Ozi-Obeh says no ransom has been received.

Source citations (as archived): [TimesLIVE](<http://www.timeslive.co.za/local/2016/06/23/Government-confirms-South-African-man-kidnapped-in-Nigeria>); [Daily Post](<http://dailypost.ng/2016/06/23/how-suspected-militants-kidnapped-5-foreigners-killed-nigerian-driver-in-calabar/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lightning strikes in the Indian states of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh kill at least 70 people, mostly farm labourers.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/india-lightning-kills-50-people-bihar-160622081051133.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A severe thunderstorm and tornado near Yancheng, Jiangsu Province, China, kills at least 98 people. See 2016 Jiangsu tornado.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-36607600>); [The Seattle Times](<http://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/china-state-media-say-51-killed-in-tornado-in-eastern-province-of-jiangsu-large-numbers-of-buildings-destroyed/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-22-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations, North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** South Korea reports that North Korea has tested two BM25 Musudan intermediate-range ballistic missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/21/asia/north-korea-missile/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-2-3"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Jordan declares its borders with Syria and Iraq are to be closed military zones following yesterday's suicide bomb attack in Rukban, Mafraq Governorate, that killed six soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-36593579>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-22-3-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016:.

**Archived source account.** European Commission president Jean-Claude Juncker warns the British voters, saying that there would be no re-negotiations with Britain whatever outcome of its membership referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/eu-referendum-reform-uk-brexit-vote-live-remain-jean-claude-juncker-european-union-a7095601.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-3-3"></a>

Context: 2016 House Democrats sit-in.

**Archived source account.** Georgia Representative John Lewis leads about 40 U.S. House of Representatives Democrats in a sit-in after the U.S. Senate failed to approve any of four gun control measures Monday night.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/house-democrats-hold-sit-gun-control-n597041>); [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2016/06/democrats-stage-sit-in-on-house-floor-to-force-gun-vote-224656>).

<a id="event-2016-06-22-3-4"></a>

<a id="event-2016-06-22-3-6"></a>

Context: Greek debt crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Central Bank reinstates the waiver that enables Greek banks to use the country's bonds as collateral for regular loans, for the first time in more than a year.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1ddb37c548c84e0391df8cec02b49e0a/ecb-restores-bond-waiver-lets-greek-banks-tap-credit>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eurozone-greece-ecb-idUSKCN0Z80YF>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-06-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** India's ISRO successfully launches 20 satellites in a single mission.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/home/science/India-sets-new-record-in-space-mission-PSLV-C34-successfully-injects-20-satellites-into-orbit/articleshow/52862382.cms>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-06-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In ice hockey, the NHL awards Las Vegas an expansion team to begin play in the 2017–18 season. The Board of Governors defers Quebec City's bid with the league, citing factors such as conference imbalance, difficulty of bringing two teams at the same time, and the weakening Canadian dollar.

Source citations (as archived): [NHL](<https://www.nhl.com/news/nhl-expands-to-las-vegas/c-281010682>).

### 2016-06-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099528675](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2023&oldid=1099528675>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** According to Médecins Sans Frontières, more than 1,200 people have died of starvation and illness at a refugee camp for those fleeing Boko Haram in northeastern Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jun/23/refugees-die-starvation-illness-nigeria-camp-bama-boko-haram>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Jiangsu tornado.

**Archived source account.** A tornado, accompanied by heavy rainfall and hailstones, kills at least 98 people and injures 800 in the eastern Chinese province of Jiangsu. One-hour rainfall reached 102 millimeters (about four inches) in Lianshui County.

Source citations (as archived): [JSTV](<http://weibo.com/1618051664/DBGLigdOj>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-storm-idUSKCN0Z91GE>); [China Radio International](<http://english.cri.cn/12394/2016/06/23/4081s931817.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-23-2-1"></a>

Context: Holy See–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis's visit to Armenia this weekend may stress relations with Turkey. The Pope is seeking to avoid reigniting the diplomatic dispute that arose last year when he described the 1915 mass killings of Armenians as a genocide. The Vatican prefers the Armenian phrase "Medz Yeghern," which roughly translates as "the great evil or calamity.",

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-armenia-idUSKCN0Z8128>); [PanARMENIAN.Net](<http://www.panarmenian.net/eng/news/215339/>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/pope-francis-visit-armenia-amid-genocide-spat-turkey-n596876>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-2-3"></a>

Context: South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations announces that peacekeepers in the country will be sent home over a "lack of responsiveness" during an attack on a UN-run refugee camp last February in Malakal that killed at least 40 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/send-peacekeepers-home-south-sudan-inaction-160623060004340.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-2-5"></a>

Context: European migration crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Italian Coast Guard rescues 4,500 migrants at sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/4-500-people-rescued-med-italy-coastguard-165330685.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-2-7"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council condemns North Korea's most recent ballistic missile launches as a grave violation of the international ban, and urges all countries "to redouble their efforts" to fully implement the March sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/northkorea-missiles-un-idINKCN0Z9299>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160624124733/http://www.bigstory.ap.org/article/7859731700274d999d9b13c9b5130116/un-strongly-condemns-latest-north-korean-missile-launches>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Supreme Court of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court, in a 4–3 decision, upholds the University of Texas's practice of considering race in college admissions. Justice Elena Kagan recused herself for prior work on the case as United States solicitor general.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-affirmativeaction-idUSKCN0Z91N3>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/87f9c6ae0150469f9204b5d79c7dc7ad/texas-affirmative-action-plan-survives-supreme-court-review>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/24/us/politics/supreme-court-affirmative-action-university-of-texas.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-3-2"></a>

Context: Supreme Court of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court deadlocks (4–4) in the challenge to President Barack Obama's executive order that set up the Deferred Action for Parents of Americans plan, which could have shielded up to five million illegal immigrants. The tie leaves in place an earlier ruling against the plan.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/supreme-court-tie-dooms-obama-immigration-policy-n582961>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/24/us/supreme-court-immigration-obama-dapa.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-3-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Summer Olympics.

**Archived source account.** The government of Kuwait sues the International Olympic Committee (IOC) for US$1.3 billion in damages over the suspension of its Olympic committee last October due to the government's interference in sports.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/kuwait-sues-ioc-1bn-olympic-suspension-160623101228231.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Baltimore police officer Caesar Goodson is cleared of all charges for the murder of Freddie Gray, a black detainee, on April 19, 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-36610395>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-3-8"></a>

Context: Viernheim shooting.

**Archived source account.** An unidentified man who had been reported to have fired shots inside a theater has been shot dead by police in Viernheim, Germany. No other fatalities were reported.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-36610068>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-23-4-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the United Kingdom go to the polls to vote in a referendum on whether the UK should leave the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/06/22/eu-referendum-final-day-live/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/uk-politics-36570120>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-4-2"></a>

Context: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Polling stations are closed, and ballots are being counted in centres around the UK with the result expected Friday morning.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-eu-referendum-36612368>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-4-4"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The government of Colombia and FARC rebels sign a ceasefire deal, putting an end to 50 years of conflict in the country between the two sides.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36611952>).

<a id="event-2016-06-23-4-6"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** A federal district judge, in a suit brought by the American Civil Liberties Union, rules Cleveland's regulations governing protests and marches during next month's Republican National Convention infringe on the right of free expression. Judge James Gwin orders both sides into mediation to begin negotiating new rules with another federal judge overseeing those talks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160624132432/http://www.bigstory.ap.org/article/46ed6df979d84d40a2c1d1801b227d1c/judge-scraps-clevelands-protest-rules-gop-convention>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-06-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Solar Impulse 2, a plane powered only by the Sun, lands safely in Seville, Spain, shortly after 7.30 a.m. local time after a flight of just over 71 hours. The 15th leg of the round-the-world journey had been expected to take up to 90 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-solar-plane-seville-landing-idUSKCN0Z90GB>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-solar-plane-idUSKCN0Z60P3>).

Context: 2016 NBA draft.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven Indonesian sailors are kidnapped off the coast of Sulu near Mindanao in the southern Philippines raising terrorism fears.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/06/24/world/asia/ap-as-indonesia-philippines-hostages.html>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://globalnation.inquirer.net/140404/authorities-verifying-report-asg-abducted-indonesian-sailors-anew>).

<a id="event-2016-06-24-0-3"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and 32 more are wounded by a bomb blast in Quetta.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/pakistan-quetta-bomb-kills-3/27817698.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Manbij offensive (2016).

**Archived source account.** The Britain-based Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports ISIL militants have kidnapped about 900 Syrian Kurdish civilians from Aleppo over the past three weeks in retaliation for the Kurdish and US-backed Syrian Democratic Forces attack on Manbij. The captives are being forced to build fortifications for the extremists. At least 26 of those abducted reportedly have been killed for refusing to follow ISIL orders.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/06/24/isis-captures-900-kurds-in-northern-syria-over-3-weeks.html>); [AP](<http://www.thenational.ae/world/middle-east/isil-abduct-900-kurdish-civilians-in-retaliation-for-attack-on-manbij>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-06-24-1-1"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** The British pound and FTSE 100 Index for the London Stock Exchange both fall in trading as early results from the United Kingdom European Union membership referendum show a stronger than expected result for Leave.,

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/live-blog/2016-05-05/brexit-live-results-of-uk-s-eu-referendum>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/06/23/eu-referendum-will-it-be-brexit-exit-poll-and-results-live/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-24-1-2"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** Asian markets drop as Leave campaign continues to lead in the Brexit referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/06/25/business/dealbook/brexit-asian-stocks-bonds.html?smid=tw-nytimes&amp;smtyp=cur&amp;_r=1>).

<a id="event-2016-06-24-1-3"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

<a id="event-2016-06-24-1-4"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** The Dow Jones ends the day down 611.21 points to 17,399.86, marking the biggest drop in 10 months.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/brexit-referendum/brexit-backlash-dow-opens-down-more-520-points-markets-reel-n598286>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2016/06/24/us-markets.html>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/usa-stocks-idINL1N19G2I3>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 West Virginia flood.

**Archived source account.** West Virginia police report powerful flash floods last night killed at least 26 people and swept away a toddler from Ravenswood. Up to 10 inches (25 cm) of rain fell in White Sulphur Springs in the southern part of the state. A state of emergency had been declared in 44 counties. Almost 500,000 customers are without power including thousands in Virginia.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/west-virginia-floods-4-dead-young-boy-missing-thousands-left-n598346>); [Good Morning America](<https://gma.yahoo.com/rescue-effort-underway-hundreds-trapped-wv-mall-officials-095605302--abc-news-topstories.html#>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2016/06/24/2-dead-floods-sweep-west-virginia/86329316/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis, in his first speech upon arrival at the presidential palace of Serzh Sargsyan in the Armenian capital Yerevan, denounces the planned genocide of Armenians by Ottoman-era Turks a century ago, though the word "genocide" was not included in his prepared speech.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/6279f5487d144d8d965c4030837a252a/pope-bringing-message-peace-armenia-and-beyond>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/parallels/2016/06/24/483238766/in-armenia-visit-pope-aims-for-reconciliation-in-a-tense-region>).

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** Spain's Foreign Minister José García-Margallo y Marfil says Spain will seek to jointly govern Gibraltar with Britain. Gibraltar, which is at the southern end of the Iberian Peninsula bordering Spain, overwhelmingly voted in favour of Britain remaining in the EU.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-gibraltar-idUSKCN0ZA184?il=0>).

<a id="event-2016-06-24-3-4"></a>

Context: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom votes, 52% to 48%, to leave the European Union. Prime Minister David Cameron, who called the referendum three years ago, announces his resignation indicating he will leave office by October.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant urges its supporters in Indonesia and Malaysia to go to the Philippines and fight against newly-elected president Rodrigo Duterte.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and three more injured as hundreds of Syrian Kurds flee Aleppo Province villages controlled by the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant, which continues to abduct and enslave Kurds. Yesterday, the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reported ISIL militants have kidnapped about 900 civilians over the past three weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/06/25/world/middleeast/ap-ml-syria.html?_r=0&amp;module=ArrowsNav&amp;contentCollection=Middle%20East&amp;action=keypress&amp;region=FixedLeft&amp;pgtype=article>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/06/24/isis-captures-900-kurds-in-northern-syria-over-3-weeks.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160625143824/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/suspected-rebels-kill-indian-soldiers-ambush-kashmir-40125271>).

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** A suspected Al-Shabab suicide bomber blows open the gate of Mogadishu's Nasa-Hablod hotel in Somalia, before militant fighters storm the building. Officials said at least 15 were killed, 25 injured, and an unknown number of guests were taken hostage.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/bomb-detonated-outside-somali-hotel-gunmen-try-storming-building-report-n598891>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/30e6c2e3a8d340cfaa9e3852b7cd103b/huge-explosion-outside-hotel-somali-capital-police-say>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/25/africa/mogadishu-hotel-explosion-gunfire/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-26-4-4"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Heidi Alexander, Gloria De Piero, Ian Murray, Lilian Greenwood, Lucy Powell, Kerry McCarthy, Seema Malhotra, Vernon Coaker, Charlie Falconer, Karl Turner and Chris Bryant resign en masse from the Labour Shadow Cabinet of Jeremy Corbyn in protest at Jeremy Corbyn's leadership over the EU referendum, and the firing of Hilary Benn.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-36632956>).

<a id="event-2016-06-26-4-5"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The petition calling for a second referendum passes three million signatures.

Source citations (as archived): [Parliament UK](<https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/131215>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-06-26-5-1"></a>

Context: Copa América Centenario.

**Archived source account.** In football, Chile wins the Copa América, defeating Argentina in a penalty shootout after regular time and extra time end scoreless.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/news/copa-america-final-live-score-8290131>).

<a id="event-2016-06-26-5-2"></a>

Context: Copa América Centenario.

**Archived source account.** Argentina star Lionel Messi, who became Argentina's all-time leading goalscorer during the Copa, announces his retirement from international football after the game.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-06-27/lionel-messi-done-with-international-football-copa-america/7547432>).

### 2016-06-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076139209](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2027&oldid=1076139209>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber attacks the Lebanese village of Qaa near the Syrian border, with at least six people dead and 13 people injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36637378>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and 72 are injured following a grenade attack on a concert at the Mahamasina Municipal Stadium in Madagascar's capital, Antananarivo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-madagascar-blast-idUSKCN0ZD0KF>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-06-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** The value of the British pound initially falls by more than 2% as Asian markets open to a decline.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-global-markets-idUSKCN0ZC14U>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-1-2"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** A number of analysts, including Ralf Preusser from Bank of America and Ric Deverell from Credit Suisse, believe that the United Kingdom economy is heading into a recession.

Source citations (as archived): [Poundsterlinglive](<https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/usd/5095-pound-to-dollar-exchange-rate-222311>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-1-3"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** The Dow Jones drops by more than 300 points in early trading, but rebounds a bit to close at a loss of 260.51.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2016/06/27/us-markets.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-1-4"></a>

Context: Brexit impact.

**Archived source account.** Standard &amp; Poor's downgrades the UK credit rating from AAA to AA with a negative outlook. Fitch follows by downgrading UK from AA+ to AA.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2016/jun/27/pound-shares-markets-brexit-crisis-osborne-lew-business-live>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-1-6"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** Volkswagen faces settlement costs of $15 billion to settle lawsuits in the United States resulting from the rigging of emissions tests.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-06-27/volkswagen-said-to-face-15-billion-tab-in-u-s-settlement>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Singapore Airlines Boeing 777-300ER en route to Milan's Malpensa Airport makes an emergency landing at Singapore's Changi Airport after the pilots received an engine oil warning message, whereafter the plane's right engine caught fire. Singapore Changi Airport's aircraft rescue and firefighting services extinguished the fire and Singapore Airlines confirmed that all 222 passengers and 19 crew members evacuated safely.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/27/asia/singapore-airlines-engine-fire/index.html>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/business/aviation/singapore-airlines-boeing-in-flames-at-changi-after-turnback-from-milan-flight-20160627-gpsl5n.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 West Virginia flood.

**Archived source account.** Two men initially thought to have died when a camper was swept away in Greenbrier County are found alive, lowering the death toll from the disaster to 20 confirmed fatalities and three others missing and presumed dead.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/06/27/2-campers-presumed-dead-found-alive-after-west-virginia-floods.html?intcmp=hplnws>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-27-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** India formally joins the Missile Technology Control Regime (MTCR).

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/India-formally-joins-elite-missile-club-Missile-Technology-Control-Regime/articleshow/52934162.cms>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-3-2"></a>

Context: Russia–Turkey relations, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan writes Russian President Vladimir Putin to offer condolences to the family of the deceased Russian pilot of the Sukhoi Su-24 warplane shot down last November. The Kremlin has insisted on a personal apology for months. A Turkish spokesman says this is a step toward improving bilateral relations between the two countries.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/turkey-apologizes-for-shooting-down-russian-warplane-last-year/2016/06/27/d969e0ea-3c6d-11e6-9e16-4cf01a41decb_story.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jun/27/kremlin-says-erdogan-apologises-russian-jet-turkish>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-3-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Turkish Prime Minister Binali Yıldırım announce their countries have agreed on a pact to normalize diplomatic relations that have been strained for six years since the Gaza flotilla raid when nine Turkish activists were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Middle-East/2016/0627/After-a-six-year-chill-Turkey-and-Israel-agree-to-normalize-relations>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/la-fg-israel-turkey-20160627-snap-story.html>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/after-years-of-chilly-ties-israel-and-turkey-announce-normalization/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Moldovan Prime Minister Vlad Filat is sentenced to prison for nine years after being found guilty of corruption and abuse of power.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/moldova-former-prime-minister-filat-jailed-9-years/27823377.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-4-2"></a>

Context: Whole Woman's Health v. Hellerstedt.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States strikes down a law that would have required abortion clinics in Texas to upgrade in order to meet new "hospital-like" standards. Supporters of abortion rights said that the proposed law would force nearly all abortion clinics in the state to shut down, while their opponents argued for women's health benefits.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/06/27/politics/supreme-court-abortion-texas/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-27-5-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union:.

**Archived source account.** Peter Altmaier, German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s chief of staff, warns Britain of dire consequences of exit from the European Union, saying in a newspaper interview that UK leaders should not rule out the possibility of another referendum on the same issue.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3661258/Bitter-Brexit-losers-gang-scupper-EU-pull-17-million-voted-for.html>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-06-26/give-u-k-leaders-time-to-rethink-brexit-vote-merkel-aide-says>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-5-2"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union:.

**Archived source account.** Joining their 12 colleagues from the day before, Luciana Berger, Angela Eagle, Maria Eagle, Kate Green, Nia Griffith, John Healey, Lisa Nandy and Owen Smith resign from the Labour Shadow Cabinet of Jeremy Corbyn, alongside 18 junior shadow ministers and 9 additional frontbenchers, while Angela Smith and Steve Bassam of the House of Lords leadership will boycott attending Shadow Cabinet meetings, all in protest at Jeremy Corbyn's leadership over the EU referendum, and the firing of Hilary Benn.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2016/jun/26/labour-shadow-cabinet-resignations-jeremy-corbyn-who-has-gone>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-5-3"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union:.

**Archived source account.** The European Union refuses informal talks with the United Kingdom until they trigger Article 50 to leave.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-eu-referendum-36644211?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-06-27-6-1"></a>

Context: UEFA Euro 2016.

**Archived source account.** Underdogs Iceland defeat England 2-1 at the Allianz Riviera in Nice to reach the quarter-finals of the UEFA European Championship.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/36573171>).

<a id="event-2016-06-27-6-2"></a>

Context: UEFA Euro 2016.

**Archived source account.** Roy Hodgson announces his resignation as England manager following the team's defeat to Iceland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/36647032>).

### 2016-06-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076138850](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2028&oldid=1076138850>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Three Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant bombings in Yemen's southern port city of Al Mukalla kill 38 government forces and injure 24 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-idUSKCN0ZD292>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 12 people are killed and 32 more are injured in a suicide bombing in Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/twelve-killed-suicide-bombing-mosque-abu-ghraib-near-baghdad-islamic-state/27824606.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Atatürk Airport attack, Turkey–ISIL conflict.

**Archived source account.** Suspected ISIL militants attack Turkey's Istanbul Atatürk Airport. Turkish Prime Minister Binali Yıldırım says 36 people were killed, as were the three suicide bombers. Justice Minister Bekir Bozdağ says 147 were wounded.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-36658187>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jun/28/turkey-airport-explosions-ataturak-istanbul>); [AP](<https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2016/06/28/explosions-rock-istanbul-airport-say-turkish-officials.html>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/istanbul-airport-attack-several-killed-in-explosions/news-story/b4e50bc0f121945dcba758ac1b2fe24f>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160629093845/http://bigstory.ap.org/article/4f2da830f3dc423e92d07e89623bca52/suicide-blasts-kill-dozens-istanbul-airport>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rebels of the New Syrian Army begin an offensive to capture the eastern town of al-Bukamal, currently held by ISIL militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/syrian-rebels-recapturing-islamic-state-town/27826764.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-0-9"></a>

Context: Balochistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill four police officers and four paramilitary soldiers in separate attacks in the city of Quetta.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160629052229/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/gunmen-kill-policemen-pakistans-quetta-city-40209031>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-0-11"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

**Archived source account.** Turkish Armed Forces state two soldiers are killed and three wounded in a pair of attacks by Kurdistan Workers' Party fighters in Diyarbakır Province in the country's southeast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-kurds-idUSKCN0ZF0DJ>); [Daily Sabah](<http://www.dailysabah.com/war-on-terror/2016/06/29/pkk-car-bomb-attack-injures-8-in-southeast>); [Azeri-Press Agency \{APA\}](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160630171750/http://en.apa.az/world-news/asia-news/soldier-martyred-in-pkk-attack-in-southeast-turkey-6934.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-06-28-1-1"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** Volkswagen and the United States Justice Department agree on a $14.7 billion settlement for its emissions-cheating program. The breakdown: $10 billion to consumers to cover buybacks and fixes; $2 billion for green energy funds investment; and, $2.7 billion to offset diesel emissions. In addition, VW agrees on a settlement with 44 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico that will cost at least $600 million. As for Europe, Volkswagen says its diesel vehicles don't violate European Union emissions standards.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-volkswagen-emissions-settlement-idUSKCN0ZD2S5>); [Nasdaq](<http://www.nasdaq.com/article/vw-is-set-for-near15-billion-emissions-settlement-20160628-00272>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** IKEA is to recall 27 million Malm chests of drawers in North America due to the danger they pose to children. Since 2014, at least three children have died when the drawers toppled over on them.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-36648589>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Toyota is recalling 1.43 million hybrids worldwide—Toyota Prius, Toyota Prius Plug-in, and Lexus CT200h—from model years 2010-2012 because of a possible airbag inflator defect. The company says it is not aware of any injuries or deaths related to this issue.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-toyota-recall-usa-idUSKCN0ZE30W>); [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/business/articles/2016-06-28/toyota-recalls-143-million-vehicles-for-defective-air-bags>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-28-2-1"></a>

Context: EgyptAir Flight 804.

**Archived source account.** One of the flight recorders of EgyptAir Flight 804 has been fully repaired in Paris after being found in the Mediterranean Sea and will now be sent to Egypt to be analyzed.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/06/28/flight-recorder-of-crashed-egyptair-flight-is-repaired/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three crew members are missing and one worker is injured following the head-on collision of two BNSF Railway freight trains near the American town of Panhandle, Texas. Officials, concerned that flames from box car fires could cause a fast-moving grass fire, order an evacuation of some nearby areas.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160701172312/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/3-missing-1-injured-in-head-on-train-collision-in-texas/ar-AAhJaBR?li=BBnb7Kz>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A huge explosion completely destroys a house and damages 24 others in Mississauga, Canada. At least one person is dead and 13 others are injured, according to Mississauga Fire and Emergency Services. Thousands of residents are forced to evacuate and many spend the night at a local community shelter.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/mississauga-house-explosion-1.3656811>); [CP24](<http://www.cp24.com/news/too-early-to-tell-what-caused-deadly-mississauga-house-explosion-ofm-1.2966223>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bolivia, Ethiopia, Kazakhstan, and Sweden are elected to be non-permanent members in the United Nations Security Council.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/sweden-wins-seat-security-council-ballot-40190680>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-28-4-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament's first debate on the UK's vote to leave is marked by bitter exchanges as prominent pro-Brexit figure Nigel Farage is booed and heckled by members of the European Parliament and European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker is heckled after saying that he is neither a robot nor a bureaucrat.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-eu-referendum-36648664>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-4-2"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Labour party leader Jeremy Corbyn refuses to resign after losing a vote of no confidence, with 80% of voting members of the Parliamentary Labour Party voting against him. Critics which include fellow MPs cite his failure to do more in the effort for the UK to remain in the EU as the main issue.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2016/jun/28/brexit-live-cameron-eu-leaders-brussels-corbyn-confidence>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-4-3"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister David Cameron will turn over his office no later than 9 September 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3663868/Wish-weren-t-Dave-Latest-humiliation-PM-arrives-Brussels-explain-let-Brexit-happen-EU-hastily-runs-Union-flag.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-4-4"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Scotland's First Minister Nicola Sturgeon schedules a meeting Wednesday with European Parliament President Martin Schulz about remaining in the EU, and intends to discuss the Scottish issue with the European Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4385307/brexit-nicola-sturgeon-referendum-scotland-martin-schulz-eu/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-scotland-idUSKCN0ZE1HR>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following a South African Constitutional Court order, the National Treasury reports President Jacob Zuma should pay back $500,000, the public funds spent upgrading his private residence.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/africa/south-africa/zuma-told-to-pay-back-500-000-in-public-funds-1.1853930>); [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/zuma-should-pay-back-500-000-of-public-funds-sa-treasury-116062701099_1.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-06-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Durham and Oxford universities' geologists, working with a helium exploration company, discover an at least 54 billion cubic foot field of helium in the Tanzanian East African Rift Valley. Previously, helium has only been found in small quantities. This field, found using a new exploration approach connected to volcanic activity, could potentially meet global demand for several years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-36651048>); [Phys.org](<http://phys.org/news/2016-06-huge-helium-discovery-life-saving.html>); [Goldschmidt conference](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160626051609/http://goldschmidt.info/2016/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-28-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A massive collapse of a mountain in Glacier Bay National Park in Southeast Alaska leaves an estimated 130 million tons of rock and soil on top of Lamplugh Glacier. The collapse was the largest seen in many years.

Source citations (as archived): [Alaska Dispatch News](<http://www.adn.com/alaska-news/2016/07/02/massive-landslide-crashes-onto-glacier-in-southeast-alaska/>).

### 2016-06-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131713891](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2029&oldid=1131713891>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Istanbul airport attack.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the attack on the Istanbul Atatürk Airport rises to 42.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/29/europe/turkey-istanbul-ataturk-airport-attack/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people are killed and nine others are wounded following a car bomb attack in Tell Abyad, near the Syria–Turkey border, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3665711/Car-bomb-kills-10-Kurdish-held-Syrian-border-town.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** New Syrian Army rebels fail to capture the border town of Al-Bukamal from ISIL militants, with an ISIL affiliated news source claiming the group killed 40 rebels and captured 15 more in a counter-attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-border-idUSKCN0ZF0AW>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** Kenyan army forces kill five suspected Al-Shabaab militants, four during a clash at a military camp in Lamu County, and another in Malindi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kenya-security-idUSKCN0ZF1X5>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-06-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Toyota, which on Tuesday announced a recall of 1.43 million hybrids because of an airbag problem, today announces the recall of 2.87 million vehicles worldwide, produced between April 2006 and August 2015, because of a possible problem with their evaporative fuel emissions control unit.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-autos-toyota-recall-idUSKCN0ZF0CX>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Lesedi La Rona diamond, the largest uncut diamond in the world, went on sale at an auction in Mayfair with it expected to sell at £52 million, or US$70 million. However, the diamond only managed to draw a high bid of US$61 million, falling short of the reserve price to sell it.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-36668388>); [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/business/lesedi-la-rona-diamond-auction-1.3658464>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The London FTSE index recovers from its losses after the result of the European Union membership referendum, closing at its highest level since April.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-britain-stocks-idUKKCN0ZF21N>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vietnamese Ministry of Defense says eight bodies from a Coast Guard plane that crashed June 16, 2016, have been found. The search continues for the ninth crew member. The CASA C-212 Aviocar was on a search and rescue mission for the then-missing pilot of a crashed Su30-MK2 fighter jet; the pilot's body was found on the 17th.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0f745702dd88481f99c6c603f191561d/vietnam-recovers-8-bodies-missing-search-plane>); [Tuổi Trẻ](<http://tuoitrenews.vn/society/35605/bodies-of-vietnamese-coast-guard-flight-crew-brought-ashore>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-2-2"></a>

Context: EgyptAir Flight 804.

**Archived source account.** Data from one of the flight recorders from EgyptAir Flight 804 shows that there was smoke on board when the Airbus A320 crashed into the water. Soot has also been found on the wreckage.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-06-30/egypt-air-black-box-confirms-smoke-on-board-before-crash/7555864>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Philippines v. China.

**Archived source account.** On his final day as President of the Philippines, Benigno Aquino III says he was right when he sued China over the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/137939-president-aquino-west-philippine-sea-china-dispute>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-3-3"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** European Union leaders advise the United Kingdom that, after their EU exit, to retain access to the bloc's lucrative single market, the UK must allow free movement for EU workers. German Chancellor Angela Merkel and French President François Hollande reiterated that freedom of movement of EU citizens is non-negotiable.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36659900>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-wrapup-idUSKCN0ZF29S>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-29-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A prosecutor in Michigan, United States, is considering whether the words of an African grey parrot could be used to try the woman accused of killing the pet parrot's owner.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2016/jun/27/parrot-murder-trial-martin-duran-dont-shoot>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-4-2"></a>

Context: Luxembourg Leaks.

**Archived source account.** Antoine Deltour and Raphael Halet, two whistleblowers who revealed the Luxembourg Leaks financial scandal, are found guilty of leaking the documents and are given a 12 and nine month suspended sentence and fined €1,500 and €1,000 respectively, while Edouard Perrin, the journalist who was given the leaks, is acquitted of all charges.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36662636>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anthony Sawina faces five counts of second degree assault after he allegedly taunts and then shoots into a car at 5 Muslim men, injuring 2 in Dinkytown near the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. US representative Keith Ellison has called for a Department of Justice investigation into the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/man-faces-up-to-7-years-for-shooting-muslims-on-their-way-to-prayer-a7155431.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-29-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Mongolian legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Mongolia go to the polls for a legislative election at a time of economic slowdown.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jun/29/mongolians-head-to-polls-for-election-amid-economic-slowdown>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-5-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Conservative Party (UK) leadership election.
