**Archived source account.** The process to elect a new leader of the Conservative Party to replace outgoing Prime Minister David Cameron begins in the United Kingdom. The Secretary of State for Work and Pensions Stephen Crabb is the first Conservative Party politician to announce his official candidacy for leader.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-36618738>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-5-5"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister David Cameron tells the House of Commons that legal experts advise that the UK-wide Brexit result binds the entire nation, even though Northern Ireland and Scotland voted to stay in the EU. Yesterday, both Scottish and Northern Irish representatives told the European Parliament's plenary session they will leave the UK if that is the required price to keep their homelands fully connected to Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [The News Letter](<http://www.newsletter.co.uk/news/northern-ireland-news/pm-says-legal-advice-is-clear-scotland-and-ni-bound-by-brexit-vote-1-7455432>); [New Europe](<https://www.neweurope.eu/article/scottish-north-irish-meps-want-countries-stay-eu/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-5-7"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, 2016 Republican National Convention.

**Archived source account.** The Cleveland Board of Control approves changes to convention security rules negotiated with the ACLU, per Federal District Judge James Gwin's June 23 court order.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160629220124/http://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/285997-cleveland-changes-restrictions-for-rnc-protest-area>); [The Plain Dealer](<http://www.cleveland.com/rnc-2016/index.ssf/2016/06/cleveland_officials_approve_ne.html#incart_2box>).

<a id="event-2016-06-29-5-9"></a>

Context: North American Leaders' Summit aka the Three Amigos Summit.

**Archived source account.** Takes place in Ottawa, Canada, as US President Barack Obama and Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto meet with Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau. President Obama later gives a special address to the Parliament of Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2016/06/29/climate-deal-caps-north-american-leaders-summit.html>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/trudeau-obama-ottawa-meeing-macdonald-1.3658538>).

### 2016-06-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1286331273](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20June%2030&oldid=1286331273>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-06-30-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** An Afghan National Security Forces convoy outside Kabul is attacked in a coordinated ambush including suicide bombers and heavy machine guns resulting in over 40 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36671676#>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed and 50 are wounded following two suicide bombings in Cameroon's Far North Region.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/06/30/world/africa/ap-af-cameroon-boko-haram.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** According to reports, at least 250 ISIL militants were killed during fighting in the city of Fallujah while fighting Iraqi Army forces with assistance from U.S. airstrikes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/06/30/hundreds-of-isil-fighters-killed-in-falluja-reports/>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-0-7"></a>

Context: 2016 Istanbul airport attack.

**Archived source account.** A Turkish official reports the three suspected Islamic State suicide bombers who killed 44 people and wounded 238 others were Russian, Uzbek, and Kyrgyz nationals.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-blast-raids-idUSKCN0ZG0RM>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A 17-year-old Palestinian stabs and kills a sleeping 13-year-old Israeli and American citizen girl Hallel Yaffa Ariel in her bedroom. The assailant is fatally shot by security guards. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu blamed "incitement-driven terrorists" while the U.S. State Department condemned the "outrageous terrorist attack."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.postbulletin.com/news/world/palestinian-kills-israeli-girl-sleeping-in-her-bedroom/article_55bfca06-268a-5bf0-9f2e-6766f32c14cb.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0ZG0R4>); [Fox](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/06/30/israeli-girl-13-stabbed-to-death-in-bedroom-by-palestinian-attacker.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-06-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hershey Company rejects a $23 billion takeover bid by rival Mondelez International, maker of Oreo cookies and Cadbury chocolates.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/hershey-says-its-board-has-unanimously-rejected-a-takeover-offer-from-oreo-maker-mondelez-and-that-it-provided-no-basis-for-further-discussion/2016/06/30/ce93ff36-3ef0-11e6-9e16-4cf01a41decb_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-1-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The roughly $1.9 billion July 1 debt-service bill included roughly $800 million in general-obligation debt. Treasury subsequently records suspension of $779 million general-obligation debt service.

Editorial date: 2016-06-30. Checked: 2026-10-22. The source compresses total debt service and general-obligation debt into a misleading single amount. The opened June 3 CRS report is prospective; these passages do not establish all June 30 authorization details or default on the entire $1.9 billion.

Evidence: [Congressional Research Service](<https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R44095.html>); [Puerto Rico Department of the Treasury](<https://hacienda.pr.gov/sites/default/files/estados2018_0.pdf>).

Original source account: The Governor of Puerto Rico authorizes the suspension of payments on the general obligation debt of that commonwealth, assuring a default on the $1.9 billion of debt payments due the following day.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-06-30-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people drown off the coast of Libya when their dinghy sinks. The Italian Navy managed to rescue over 100 more people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36672474>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-06-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Armenia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Armenia's parliament, by a 102–8 vote, ratifies an agreement to create an Armenia–Russia joint Air Defense system.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-russia-defence-idUSKCN0ZG2AS>); [Armenpress](<https://armenpress.am/eng/news/852784/armenian-lawmakers-ratify-agreement-on-forming-armenia-russia-joint-air-defense-system.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations agrees to appoint an observer to investigate violence against LGBT people, despite opposition from various countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/un-lgbt-obeserver-opposed-russia-china-muslim-countries/27831343.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-06-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian, Italian, and U.S. police seize 11 tonnes of cocaine smuggled to various countries and arrest 33 people across Colombia and Italy after the discovery of seven laboratories in the Colombian jungle run by local organized criminal groups and 'Ndrangheta.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-cocaine-idUSKCN0ZG1Y1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Conservative Party (UK) leadership election.

**Archived source account.** British home secretary Theresa May enters into the Tory leadership contest, saying that Article 50 of the EU Treaty should not be invoked before the end of this year, implying that formal Brexit negotiations with the EU institutions be put on hold until 2017 at the earliest.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/theresa-may-joins-race-to-replace-david-cameron-1467275742>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Conservative Party (UK) leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Former Mayor of London Boris Johnson rules himself out of running in the Tory leadership contest, a move believed to be influenced by Michael Gove's announcement earlier in the day to run for the leadership.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-36672591>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-4"></a>

Context: Presidential transition of Rodrigo Duterte.

**Archived source account.** Rodrigo Duterte is inaugurated as President of the Philippines and Leni Robredo as Vice President.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Manila Bulletin](<http://www.mb.com.ph/pnp-activates-task-force-for-duterte-robredo-inauguration-on-thursday/>); [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/in-rodrigo-dutertes-philippines-suspects-have-the-right-to-remain-silentforever-1467224121>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-6"></a>

Context: Political reshuffle in the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** Luo Huining leaves his position as party chief of Qinghai and becomes party chief of Shanxi province, replacing Wang Rulin.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1982979/hubei-governor-tipped-party-head-qinghai-province-it>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-7"></a>

Context: Political reshuffle in the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** Qiang Wei leaves his post as party chief of Jiangxi; Governor Lu Xinshe becomes the new party chief of Jiangxi.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1982979/hubei-governor-tipped-party-head-qinghai-province-it>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-8"></a>

Context: Political reshuffle in the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** Hubei governor Wang Guosheng becomes party chief of Qinghai province.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1982979/hubei-governor-tipped-party-head-qinghai-province-it>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-9"></a>

Context: Political reshuffle in the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** Lu Wei is replaced as head of the Cyberspace Administration of China by Xu Lin.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1982987/chinas-powerful-internet-tsar-steps-aside-another-xi>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bosnia and Herzegovina officially releases its first census report since the end of the Bosnian War after multiple delays, showing that the country had lost one fifth of its population from 4.4 million to 3.5 million between then and 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/bosnia-census/27830764.html>).

<a id="event-2016-06-30-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian Defense Minister Sergey Shoygu dismisses 50 high-ranking Navy officers, including Baltic Fleet Commander Viktor Kravchuk and Chief of Staff Sergei Popov, following a month-long inspection that found incompetence, deficiencies in training, and misinformation regarding the state of the fleet.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/06/30/Russia-dismisses-50-high-ranking-officers-of-Baltic-Fleet/1261467292656/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-military-sackings-idUSKCN0ZF1DB>).


## July

### 2016-07-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076138646](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%201&oldid=1076138646>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Gulshan attack.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen storm a restaurant, exchange fire with security, and take at least twenty hostages in the Gulshan neighborhood of Dhaka, Bangladesh. Two policemen are killed. The Islamic State claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/shooting-hostage-situation-underway-bangladesh/story?id=40283510>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/07/01/asia/bangladesh-dhaka-shooting/index.html>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2016/07/01/86604614/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** At least six people are shot and killed and several people wounded by suspected Al-Shabaab militants who ambushed two buses in Mandera, Kenya, near the Somalian border.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/07/children-killed-attack-buses-northern-kenya-160701111427927.html>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160701111229/http://bigstory.ap.org/article/df8a0c558c314c6790cfcd3a06c15ecb/6-killed-extremist-attack-2-buses-say-kenyan-official>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian woman, in what was construed to be an attempt to stab Israeli Border Police officers at the entrance to the Tomb of the Patriarchs in Hebron, is shot and later dies.

Source citations (as archived): [PNN](<http://english.pnn.ps/2016/07/01/israel-kills-palestinian-woman-in-hebron-and-a-man-in-qalandia/>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/relative-of-kiryat-arba-killer-tries-to-stab-cop-in-hebron-is-shot-dead/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** In response to violence in the Hebron area, including the killing yesterday of a 13-year-old Jewish girl asleep in her home in the Kiryat Arba settlement by a Palestinian assailant, the Israel Defense Forces places a closure on Hebron, brings additional troops to the area and announces a cut to tax funds it collects for the Palestinian Authority, saying it would deduct the amount the Palestinian leadership pays to the families of militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/06/israel-punishes-hebron-village-teens-killing-160630173527433.html>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-slaps-closure-on-hebron-withholds-pa-tax-funds-after-attacks/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A 63 year old Palestinian man dies during a clash at the Qalandiya checkpoint; Palestinian sources claim his death was due to tear gas inhalation while Israeli sources say the man suffered a fatal heart attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Ma'an](<http://www.maannews.com/Content.aspx?id=772079>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-dies-in-qalandiya-riot-idf-denies-tear-gas-was-cause/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-0-8"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Rabbi Michael Mark is murdered and his two children badly injured when terrorists shoot at his car on the highway south of Hebron.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Initial-report-shooting-attack-in-Hebron-459253>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/2-israelis-badly-hurt-in-shooting-attack-near-hebron/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian militants fire two rockets into Israel from the Gaza Strip; one explodes outside a preschool in the town of Sderot, causing damage to property but no injuries, and the second rocket exploded in an open area in the Sha'ar Hanegev region.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/rocket-fired-from-gaza-hits-vacant-israeli-preschool/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-07-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British–American Academy Award–winning film actress Olivia de Havilland, one of the last leading movie stars of the Golden Age of Hollywood, celebrates her 100th birthday.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/06/30/entertainment/cnnphotos-tbt-olivia-de-havilland-100th-birthday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people attend a ceremony at the Thiepval Memorial in Picardy, France, to mark the centenary of the start of the Battle of the Somme.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-36674451>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-07-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four Hungarian Defence Force soldiers are killed and one is injured following an explosion at a military firing range in eastern Hungary.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hungary-blast-idUSKCN0ZH56V>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-07-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Taiwan's navy mistakenly launches a supersonic Hsiung Feng III missile towards China, killing one person and injuring three in a Taiwanese fishing boat.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36680899>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/01/taiwanese-warship-missile-china-hsiung-feng-iii>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-3-2"></a>

Context: Russia–European Union relations, Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Union extends economic sanctions on Russia until 31 January 2017 over Moscow's continued support for separatist rebels in eastern Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-sanctions-idUSKCN0ZH4OE>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canada announces that it will deploy 1,000 soldiers of the Canadian Armed Forces to Latvia to bolster one of the four NATO battalions stationed there.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/01/canada-to-send-1000-soldiers-to-boost-nato-presence-on-russia-border>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-3-5"></a>

Context: Israel-Palestine relations.

**Archived source account.** The report of the diplomatic Quartet to the Security Council — the United Nations, Russia, the United States, and the European Union — calls on Israel to end settlement construction and expansion policy, and calls on Palestinians to act decisively to stop incitement to violence and to clearly condemn terrorist acts. Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process Nickolay Mladenov tells the UNSC, “The main objective of this report is not about assigning blame... (rather) it focuses on the major threats to achieving a negotiated peace."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160701171055/http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b305be251e754682b2ba460c20c641cc/mideast-mediators-questions-israels-commitment-2-states>); [UN News Centre](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=54370#.V3ad-TUVYl0>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/quartets-10-recommendations-to-revive-israel-palestinian-peace-talks/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yanghee Lee, the United Nations special human rights envoy to overwhelmingly Buddhist Myanmar, says more than 100,000 of the Muslim Rohingya minority remain in squalid camps they were forced to four years ago by violence. The government does not recognize most of these people as citizens, and has treated even long-term residents as illegal immigrants. Lee is encouraged by last March's peaceful transition to a democratically elected and civilian-led government.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/79d17090c23e41f5902b2727eb869cd1/un-human-rights-envoy-displaced-rohingya-still-suffering>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-3-8"></a>

Context: Finland–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Following his meeting at Finnish President Sauli Niinistö's residence, Russian President Vladimir Putin says that Russia would respect Finland's choice whether to join NATO, though as part of NATO's military infrastructure, Finnish Defence Forces would overnight be at the borders of the Russian Federation. Putin and Niinistö call for improved security in Baltic airspace where Russian and Western aircraft have had close encounters in recent months.

Source citations (as archived): [Oneindia](<http://www.oneindia.com/international/putin-visits-finland-discusses-nato-issues-2142853.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-finland-nato-putin-idUSKCN0ZH5IV>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in the Philippines; Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Philippines President Rodrigo Duterte urges Filipino citizens to murder people suspected of using illegal drugs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/01/philippines-president-rodrigo-duterte-urges-people-to-kill-drug-addicts>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U Gambira, a former Burmese monk and one of the most visible leaders during Myanmar's 2007 Saffron Revolution, is released from prison after having the charges against him dropped.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36680830>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Austrian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Austria’s highest court orders a repeat of the presidential elections narrowly lost in May by right-wing populist Freedom Party of Austria candidate Norbert Hofer. The margin of votes was less than 1%.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/07/01/austria-court-orders-presidential-election-re-run-after-far-righ/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-5-3"></a>

Context: Causeway Bay Books disappearances.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people take to the streets of Hong Kong, demanding answers over China's alleged abduction of five booksellers in late 2015 and that Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying resign from office.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/01/hong-kong-protesters-call-for-leader-to-stand-down>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The new Belarusian ruble replaces the old Belarusian ruble during redenomination. (in Russian)

Source citations (as archived): [Belarus segodnya](<http://www.sb.by/obshchestvo/article/dva-rublya-za-dollar.html>); [Construction.RU](<http://russianconstruction.com/news-1/24224-belarus-carries-out-denomination-of-its-national-currency.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-01-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paris, France, implements a pollution-reduction program that bans residents from driving cars built before 1997, and motorcycles built before 2000, on weekdays inside the city limits between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/parallels/2016/07/01/484381708/to-fight-pollution-paris-imposes-weekday-ban-on-old-cars>).

### 2016-07-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1118623029](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%202&oldid=1118623029>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-02-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Gulshan attack.

**Archived source account.** 13 hostages were rescued following a standoff with the Rapid Action Battalion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/bangladesh-attack-minister-idINKCN0ZI06U>).

<a id="event-2016-07-02-0-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Gulshan attack.

**Archived source account.** Twenty hostages and two policemen were killed, and six gunmen are dead with one captured alive.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/07/02/asia/bangladesh-dhaka-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-02-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and dozens more are wounded in a suicide bombing in Jalalabad, Nangarhar Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/afghanistan-suicide-bombing/27834148.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** According to The Pentagon, two senior ISIL leaders have been killed by a United States-led coalition airstrike in Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/01/airstrike-kills-two-isis-military-leaders-in-iraq>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36690806>).

<a id="event-2016-07-02-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government airstrikes in Damascus kill at least 30 people. According to the rebels, the airstrikes were revenge for the killing of a Syrian Air Force pilot by Al-Nusra Front yesterday. The airstrikes reportedly targeted a medical centre and a school.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/02/syrian-civilians-killed-in-apparent-revenge-bombing-for-pilot-death>).

<a id="event-2016-07-02-0-10"></a>

Context: 2016 Istanbul airport attack.

**Archived source account.** Turkish police arrest a total of 41 people in connection with the Istanbul Atatürk Airport terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI.com](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/07/02/Turkish-police-arrest-11-more-in-connection-with-airport-bombing/1361467484576/?spt=hts&amp;or=5>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A lone gunman opened fire at a café in Žitište, Serbia, killing five people and injuring 20 more. The perpetrator was arrested shortly afterward while attempting to flee the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/serbia-cafe-shooting/27834067.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four children are stabbed to death by their mother in Memphis, Tennessee. The mother was taken into custody.

Source citations (as archived): [Local 8 News](<http://www.local8now.com/content/news/Four-Tennessee-children-stabbed-to-death-385241141.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Australian federal election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Australians vote to elect a government for the next three years. Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull, leader of the conservative Liberal Party-led Coalition, dissolved both houses of Parliament in May in a bid for a Senate more friendly to his agenda. The final result showed the Coalition with a bare 1 seat majority in the House with 76 seats and the Australian Labor Party with 69 seats.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/australia-election-idINKCN0ZI00H>); [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/federal-politics/federal-election-2016-opinion/federal-election-2016-will-malcolm-and-bill-survive-its-all-about-the-margin-20160702-gpwzds.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-02-2-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** In pro-EU rallies, thousands of people protest in London against the United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union and ask that Article 50 not be invoked.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2016/jul/02/brexit-news-live-thousands-march-for-europe-in-post-referendum-protest>).

### 2016-07-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363907701](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%203&oldid=1363907701>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Twin bombings in a pair of crowded commercial areas in Baghdad kill at least 125 people. ISIL claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/08faa2dc3b614585a79191344901ba03/officials-bombing-central-baghdad-kills-least-18>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/baghdad-iraq-bombing-attack-isis-latest-dead-toll-a7116681.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36696568>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-07-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Libya's National Oil Corporation agrees to merge with the rival company of the same name in the east of the country after being split by the two rival governments.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-energy-idUSKCN0ZJ0H7>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-07-03-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 31 people are killed and several more remain missing after flash floods ravage the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/07/dozens-dead-flash-floods-sweep-pakistan-160703061450868.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-03-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rescue workers in Russia's Irkutsk Oblast discover the remains of an Ilyushin Il-76 cargo plane which went missing last Friday after going on a firefighting mission. Six people have been killed in the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-crash-idUSKCN0ZJ0DF>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-07-03-3-1"></a>

Context: Switzerland–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union warns Switzerland that it will lose access to its single market if it goes through with its plan to impose restrictions on the free movement of EU citizens. In a referendum held back on February 9, 2014, Swiss voters approved limiting the movement of economic migrants from the EU in the country. Current laws allow migrants to enter Switzerland without visas.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/03/eu-swiss-single-market-access-no-free-movement-citizens>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in the Philippines; Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed by the Philippine National Police within a week after Rodrigo Duterte took office as president and made statements encouraging the murder of illegal drug addicts.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/philippine-police-kill-10/2925508.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-03-5-1"></a>

Context: French presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy resigns as leader of The Republicans party and announces his candidacy for President again.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/03/nicolas-sarkozy-confirms-return-bid-for-french-presidency>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-07-03-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Formula One season.

**Archived source account.** Lewis Hamilton wins the Austrian Grand Prix at the Red Bull Ring in Spielberg, Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/36698196>).

<a id="event-2016-07-03-6-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Summer Olympics.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Olympic Committee appeals the ban of its track and field team from participating in the upcoming summer Olympics by the International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF), because of large scale doping, with the Court of Arbitration for Sport. A hearing on the case will take place on July 19.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-appeals-olympic-track-ban/27835550.html>).

### 2016-07-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1366366153](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%204&oldid=1366366153>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia confirms it has suffered its first bombing by the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant during the previous week raising fears about the spread of influence of the militant group.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/07/05/world/asia/malaysia-isis-grenade-attack.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-0-3"></a>

Context: CPP–NPA–NDF rebellion; Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** The Communist Party of the Philippines agrees to fight drug lords after its legal wing Bagong Alyansang Makabayan joins the government cabinet of Rodrigo Duterte.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/story/572319/news/nation/communists-answer-duterte-s-call-to-join-fight-vs-drugs>); [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/07/04/1599429/bayan-maintain-presence-streets-despite-duterte-alliance>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Israel–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel's military attacks two Syrian Army targets in Syrian territory from the Golan Heights after a fire from the fighting damages a security fence on the border.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-israel-idUSKCN0ZK0O5>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-0-7"></a>

Context: 2016 Saudi Arabia bombings.

**Archived source account.** A suspected suicide bomber detonates his belt near the U.S. consulate in Jeddah, killing himself and wounding two guards.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36700635>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-0-8"></a>

Context: 2016 Saudi Arabia bombings.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber detonates a device near the security headquarters of the Prophet's Mosque in Medina, Saudi Arabia, killing four security guards.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3674066/Suicide-bomber-strikes-near-main-mosque-Medina-Saudi-Arabia--Arabiya.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-36706761>); [Pakistan Today](<http://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2016/07/04/foreign/suicide-bomber-hits-mosque-in-saudi-arabia-casualties-feared/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-0-10"></a>

Context: July 2016 Baghdad bombings.

**Archived source account.** The Baghdad Provincial Council deputy head reports the death toll has passed 200, with at least 225 more injured. Iraqi Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi, visiting the Kerrada site, is jeered by onlookers who blame his government for not stopping ISIL-related bloodshed.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/07/04/Death-toll-in-Baghdad-bombing-climbs-past-200/4141467636768/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-07-04-1-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Standard Life Investments suspends trading in its UK property fund, in response to increased withdrawal calls since the vote, to protect the interests of all investors in the fund.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-36708844>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-07-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flooding caused by torrential rain in China kills at least 180 people, mostly along the Yangtze river.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36702293>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-07-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Blockade of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** A Turkish ship carrying humanitarian aid for the Gaza Strip docks at the Israeli port city of Ashdod, the first warming move between the two countries since relations began to improve. Relations between Turkey and Israel were tense since the 2010 Gaza flotilla raid but ended last week when Turkey agreed to normalize ties in a diplomatic treaty.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/04/turkish-ship-carrying-humanitarian-aid-for-gaza-reaches-isreal>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu says Turkey's cooperation with Russia in combating the Islamic State in Syria does not include Russia's use of its Incirlik Air Base, which some have interpreted from his comments yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-turkey-russia-idUSKCN0ZK0QH>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-04-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight members of the Cuba men's national volleyball team, which is supposed to participate in the 2016 Summer Olympics, are arrested for aggravated group rape in Tampere, Finland, with two later being released.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36702336>); [YLE](<http://yle.fi/uutiset/two_cuban_volleyballers_released_six_still_held/9002057>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ling Jihua, former top aide to paramount leader Hu Jintao, is sentenced to life in prison for illegally obtaining state secrets and taking over $11 million in bribes. Ling's misfortunes started when he was accused of trying to cover up a scandal connected to his 23-year-old son's deadly crash in a Ferrari in 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/07/04/Former-Jintao-aid-Ling-Jihua-jailed-in-China-on-corruption-charges/4291467638647/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-04-5-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Nigel Farage resigns as leader of the UK Independence Party (UKIP) but says he and other MEPs/MPs of the party would continue to carry out their term in the European Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/world/307929/farage-stands-down-as-ukip-leader>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Riots break out in Harare, the capital of Zimbabwe, after police attempt to disperse a protest by the city's taxi drivers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zimbabwe-protests-idUSKCN0ZK1DO>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-5-4"></a>

Context: Australian federal election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The election deadlock continues as neither Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull nor opposition leader Bill Shorten has the minimum number of Lower House seats (76) needed to form a government. Shorten leads Turnbull, 71-67, with only six seats undecided.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/07/04/Australian-PM-Malcolm-Turnbull-urged-to-quit-after-cliff-hanger-election/2641467662987/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [Newstalk ZB](<http://www.newstalkzb.co.nz/news/world/vote-counting-continues-in-australias-neck-and-neck-election/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-5-6"></a>

Context: Political reshuffle in the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** Zhejiang governor Li Qiang is transferred to neighbouring Jiangsu province to serve as party chief. He is succeeded as Zhejiang governor by Xinjiang deputy party chief Che Jun.

Source citations (as archived): [Sina](<http://news.sina.com.cn/c/nd/2016-07-04/doc-ifxtsatn8067292.shtml>).

<a id="event-2016-07-04-5-7"></a>

Context: Political reshuffle in the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** Xian Hui is named acting Chairwoman of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, succeeding Liu Hui. It is the first time in the history of the People's Republic that a woman has succeeded another woman in a provincial government leadership position.

Source citations (as archived): [Sina](<http://news.sina.com.cn/c/nd/2016-07-01/doc-ifxtsatn7871098.shtml>).

### 2016-07-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076138434](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%205&oldid=1076138434>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi forces, backed by U.S. airstrikes, advance north towards ISIL-held Qayyarah Airfield West south of Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-mosul-idUSKCN0ZL1FS>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations reports a mortar attack on a camp for displaced Iraqis south of Baghdad kills three people, including two children, and injures 13 others, two critically.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/07/05/world/middleeast/ap-ml-iraq-the-latest.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber attacks a police station in Solo, Indonesia, killing himself and injuring a police officer. Solo is the birthplace of President Joko Widodo.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4392782/indonesia-suicide-bomber-solo-surakarta-terrorism/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-security-idUSKCN0ZL039?il=0>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-0-6"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Allied Democratic Forces rebels hack nine people to death in the village of Oicha, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-violence-idUSKCN0ZL1IN>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, ISIL involvement.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomb explosion in Kurdish-controlled Al-Hasakah in northeastern Syria kills at least 16 people, including three children and two women. ISIL claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-hasaka-idUSKCN0ZL2BO>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-07-05-1-1"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Central Bank of Russia announces it will start buying the Chinese yuan in an attempt to diversify its foreign-currency reserves away from the Euro and the U.S. dollar and to become less vulnerable to Western sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-buying-chinese-yuan-diversify-away-dollar-euro-less-vulnerable-western-sanctions/27838381.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-07-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are killed and eight are injured after a helicopter carrying Turkish Armed Forces personnel crashes in Turkey's northern Giresun Province, on the Black Sea coast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-crash-idUSKCN0ZL1ZR>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in the Philippines; Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of petty criminals and alleged drug addicts die in the Philippines within a few days after Rodrigo Duterte took the presidency. He actively encouraged extrajudicial killing of drug addicts and petty criminals before and after the election.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/07/rodrigo-duterte-drug-war-160704152252796.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/01/philippines-president-rodrigo-duterte-urges-people-to-kill-drug-addicts>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests occur in the city of Baton Rouge, Louisiana, U.S., after a man, Alton Sterling, is fatally shot by a police officer.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2016/jul/06/protests-in-baton-rouge-after-louisiana-police-shoot-alton-sterling-dead>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-05-4-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán announces that the country will hold a referendum on October 2 where voters will get to choose whether or not to accept European Union-imposed quotas on the distribution of migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36711693>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-4-3"></a>

Context: Hillary Clinton email investigation.

**Archived source account.** The FBI recommends, with numerous reservations about her actions, no charges be filed against Hillary Clinton over her emails.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-36711711>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/07/06/us/politics/hillary-clinton-fbi-email-comey.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-4-5"></a>

Context: July 2016 Baghdad bombings.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Interior Minister Mohammed Salem Al-Ghabban says he has submitted his resignation. Al-Ghabban cited a lack of "coordination among security systems" demonstrated by Sunday's bombings in Baghdad that killed over 200 people and injured at least 175 others. No report yet that Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi has accepted this resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/07/05/middleeast/iraq-interior-minister-resigns/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/07/05/world/middleeast/ap-ml-iraq-the-latest.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-4-7"></a>

Context: 2016 Conservative Party (UK) leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Home Secretary Theresa May gets 165 votes after the first ballot of Conservative members of parliament to select a new Leader and the next Prime Minister. Her nearest rival, Minister of State for Energy Andrea Leadsom, picked up 66 votes. Secretary of State for Justice Michael Gove won 48 votes, and Secretary of State for Work and Pensions Stephen Crabb got 34 votes. Former Secretary of State for Defence Liam Fox is eliminated from consideration as he received just 16. Later, Crabb pulled out of the race and endorsed front-runner Theresa May. Fox also endorsed May.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/britain-eu-wrapup-idINKCN0ZL1EM>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1722116/may-wins-first-tory-vote-as-fox-and-crabb-out>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-crabb-idUSKCN0ZL2GI>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-07-05-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA's Juno spacecraft reaches Jupiter and enters into its orbit after a five-year flight.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-36710768>).

<a id="event-2016-07-05-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cybersecurity software maker Check Point reports HummingBad malware has infected at least 10 million Android devices, mostly in China and India. Check Point says a team of developers based in Beijing is behind HummingBad which gives hackers administrative-level access to infected devices. Apple devices have been hit by similar malware.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4393240/hummingbad-china-chinese-malware-android/>).

### 2016-07-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1137071073](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%206&oldid=1137071073>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-06-0-1"></a>

Context: CPP-NPA-NDF rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Twenty Philippine Army soldiers are under investigation after they are suspected of mutilating the body of a New People's Army member. The communist militant's eyes were gouged, his tongue was cut off and his throat was slit.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/story/572529/news/regions/20-soldiers-under-probe-in-cotabato-for-mutilating-rebel-s-corpse>).

<a id="event-2016-07-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A suicide car bomb, that targeted the Central Security headquarters in the port city of Aden, Yemen, kills at least 26 people. Following the blast, militants stormed the compound and clashed with soldiers. No group immediately claimed responsibility but it is similar to an Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant attack on the port of Al Mukalla.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/07/06/world/middleeast/ap-ml-yemen.html?_r=0>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-blast-idUSKCN0ZM090?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-07-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The price of nickel swings wildly after Philippines environment secretary Gina Lopez announces plans to close existing mines in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/cms/s/0/50fa98ae-42c5-11e6-9b66-0712b3873ae1.html#axzz4DaMnuTPy>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-07-05/nickel-retreats-after-rising-to-eight-month-high-on-philippines>).

<a id="event-2016-07-06-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Business magnate and former Italian prime minister Silvio Berlusconi sells leading football club A.C. Milan to a Chinese consortium for an eventual €400 million.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-36721010>).

<a id="event-2016-07-06-1-3"></a>

Context: Australian federal election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Standard &amp; Poor's drops Australia's debt outlook from stable to negative following the country's surprisingly close election this weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2016/jul/07/standard-poors-lowers-australias-credit-rating-outlook-to-negative>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-07-06-2-1"></a>

Context: International reactions to Philippines v. China.

**Archived source account.** China threatens the United States regarding the South China Sea and it will not accept a verdict in the Permanent Court of Arbitration.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Go](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160706141940/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/china-paper-warns-us-price-pay-south-china-40366906>); [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/timdaiss/2016/07/06/u-s-needs-attitude-adjustment-in-south-china-sea-claims-beijing/#232263403d0a>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Oscar Pistorius trial.

**Archived source account.** South African athlete Oscar Pistorius is sentenced to six years imprisonment for the murder of Reeva Steenkamp.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/07/06/africa/oscar-pistorius-sentence/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-06-4-1"></a>

Context: Iraq Inquiry.

**Archived source account.** A report about the United Kingdom's involvement in the Iraq War is released. The chairman of the inquiry, Sir John Chilcot, said that the invasion was not a "last resort" and was based on "flawed intelligence and assessments". The inquiry was announced on 15 June 2009 by then-Prime Minister Gordon Brown. The final hearing was held on 2 February 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2016/jul/06/chilcot-report-live-inquiry-war-iraq>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-36712735#>); [BBC²](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/uk-36714717#>).

<a id="event-2016-07-06-4-3"></a>

Context: Hillary Clinton email controversy.

**Archived source account.** Loretta Lynch, the Attorney General of the United States, closes the investigation into Hillary Clinton's use of a personal email system to conduct official business without charges being laid.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/07/06/politics/loretta-lynch-hillary-clinton-emails-no-charges/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-06-4-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Zimbabwe protests.

**Archived source account.** National "Stay Away" protests, organized over the Internet via the WhatsApp social messaging platform, take place in Zimbabwe, following fears of an economic collapse amid calls for President Robert Mugabe's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-36724874>).

### 2016-07-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1298430354](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%207&oldid=1298430354>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** A group of radical Islamists hurl homemade bombs at police officers in the Kishoreganj District in central Bangladesh killing at least one officer and injuring several others.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160707051356/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/blast-kills-police-officer-bangladesh-injures-40396393>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Eastern Bloc of the FARC-EP, a unit of the FARC rebel group, announces its rejection of the recent ceasefire signed by its leader Timoleón Jiménez and the Colombian government of President Juan Manuel Santos, declaring it will not lay down its arms and demobilize and will continue to fight the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/07/colombian-farc-rebel-unit-not-disarm-under-peace-deal>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** At least 35 people are killed and 60 others injured in an attack on a Shiite mausoleum located in north of Baghdad. Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant have claimed responsibility.,

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/07/07/at-least-20-reported-killed-in-terror-attack-on-iraqi-shiite-holy-site.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-security-idUSKCN0ZN2LC>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-07-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French food company Danone agrees to buy American company WhiteWave Foods for $10 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/07/08/business/dealbook/danone-whitewave-deal.html?em_pos=small&amp;emc=edit_dk_20160707&amp;nl=dealbook&amp;nl_art=0&amp;nlid=66213151&amp;ref=headline&amp;te=1>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-07-07-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan and China brace for the impact of Typhoon Nepartak, the first major typhoon of 2016. Thousands of people have been evacuated in Taiwan while over 35,000 military personnel have been placed on standby to help with relief efforts.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/07/06/world/super-typhoon-nepartak-taiwan/index.html>); [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-07-07/thousands-flee-as-super-typhoon-nepartak-barrels-towards-taiwan/7577330>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Typhoon Nepartak is expected to make landfall on mainland China on Friday and will make flooding worse. Nearly 200 people have died in flood waters in China in the past week with 41 people missing, 1.6 million relocated and almost 50,000 houses collapsed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/07/07/china-taiwan-brace-for-super-typhoon-after-dozens-killed-in-floo/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five workers are killed after a wall collapses on them at a recycling plant in Birmingham, England.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-36736571>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A section of a Taiwanese commuter train car explodes near Songshan Station, injuring at least 21 people, some of them seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/07/07/world/asia/ap-as-taiwan-train-blast.html?_r=0>); [CNA](<http://focustaiwan.tw/news/asoc/201607070032.aspx>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-07-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry arrives in Kiev, Ukraine, where he is expected to discuss ways of ending the conflict in the east of the country. The visit, along with his visit to Georgia yesterday, comes ahead of the NATO summit in Warsaw that will take place tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/kerry-meeting-ukraine-leaders-in-kyiv/27843304.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-3-3"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States tentatively approves eight, of 12 that applied, airlines for flights from 10 U.S. cities to Havana as early as this fall: Alaska Airlines, American Airlines, Delta Air Lines, Frontier Airlines, JetBlue Airways, Southwest Airlines, Spirit Airlines, and United Airlines. Last month, flights were approved from five U.S. cities to nine other international airports.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cuba-idUSKCN0ZN1EF>); [US DOT](<https://www.transportation.gov/briefing-room/us-transportation-secretary-foxx-proposes-us-airlines-and-cities-new-scheduled-service>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-07-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in the Philippines; Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines House of Representatives seeks to investigate the rise in deaths of suspected drug dealers in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/story/572789/news/nation/solon-seeks-house-probe-on-killings-of-suspected-drug-offenders>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-4-3"></a>

Context: Rape in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Germany's parliament passes a new law saying that it is rape to have sex with a person who says "No" to the sex. Under the previous law, sex was not considered rape unless the victim fought back. The new law also classifies groping as a sex crime, makes it easier to deport migrants who commit sex offences, and makes it easier to prosecute assaults committed by a large group.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36726095>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A French court sentences two former Rwandan mayors of the town of Kabarondo to life in prison on charges of crimes against humanity and genocide committed during the Rwandan Genocide in 1994. During the genocide, Hutu extremists massacred over 2,000 Tutsi who sought refuge in the town.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36732357>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-4-6"></a>

Context: Vatican leaks scandal, Journalistic freedom.

**Archived source account.** In a so-called VatiLeaks case, a Vatican City Court dismisses charges of publishing confidential information against two Italian journalists stating it lacked jurisdiction in this case. Emiliano Fittipaldi and Gianluigi Nuzzi wrote books on the inner workings of the Vatican. The court did convict a Vatican priest to 18 months, and assessed a 10-month suspended sentence on an Italian communications expert, for conspiring to pass documents to the journalists; a fifth defendant was cleared of all charges.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b8863e02a4a0482baac8b1c33389a864/vatican-judges-weigh-fate-5-accused-leaks-scandal>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/07/vatileaks-journalists-cleared-vatican-court-trial-catholic-church>); [Catholic News](<http://www.catholicnews.com/services/englishnews/2016/vatileaks-citing-freedom-of-press-vatican-court-acquits-journalists.cfm>); [Vatican Radio](<http://www.archivioradiovaticana.va/storico/2016/07/07/court_clears_journalists,_convicts_two_in_vatileaks_trial/en-1242752>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-4-8"></a>

Context: Shooting of Philando Castile.

**Archived source account.** Minnesota Governor Mark Dayton requests a Justice Department investigation of last night's fatal police shooting of Philando Castile (an African-American) during a traffic stop. Castile's girlfriend, Lavish Reynolds, streamed the incident live over Facebook. It showed Castile had been shot several times and was slumped against Reynolds; he died in Minneapolis's Hennepin County Medical Center.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/07/08/us/philando-castile-falcon-heights-shooting.html?_r=0&amp;module=ArrowsNav&amp;contentCollection=U.S.&amp;action=keypress&amp;region=FixedLeft&amp;pgtype=article>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/police-shooting-during-traffic-stop-leaves-minnesota-man-dead-family/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-4-9"></a>

Context: Shooting of Philando Castile.

**Archived source account.** Gov. Dayton says, "Would this have happened if those passengers, the driver and the passengers, were white? I don't think it would have. So I'm forced to confront, and I think all of us in Minnesota are forced to confront, that this kind of racism exists."

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/theto-way/2016/07/07/485066807/police-stop-ends-in-black-mans-death-aftermath-is-livestreamed-online-video>); [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/police-fatally-shoot-man-during-traffic-stop-in-minnesota-1467875899>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-4-11"></a>

Context: 2016 shooting of Dallas police officers.

**Archived source account.** Eleven police officers are shot, with five dying of gunshot wounds in Dallas, Texas during a protest against two black men killed within a day of each other. Police kill the shooter with a bomb delivered on a bomb defusing robot.,

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2016/07/07/two-cops-shot-during-protests-in-dallas/>); [KTLA](<http://ktla.com/2016/07/07/shot-fired-during-large-protest-in-dallas-two-officers-wounded-report/>); [NBC DFW](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160708022300/http://www.nbcdfw.com/news/local/Protests-in-Dallas-Over-Alton-Sterling-Death-385784431.html>); [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-07-08/dallas-police-shot-dead-by-snipers/7581276>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-07-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Zimbabwe protests.

**Archived source account.** Zimbabwean authorities arrest dozens of protesters as anti-government protests spread across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/07/zimbabwe-shuts-protest-economic-collapse-160706153213733.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-5-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Australian federal election.

**Archived source account.** Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull's Liberal/National coalition, behind Bill Shorten's Labor Party in the first 48 hours following Saturday's election, is now ahead of Labor in the Lower House, 74–71 seats; 76 seats are needed to form a government. Minor parties and independents have won five seats; mail-in and absentee votes are still being counted. Turnbull is on the road today seeking support from a small handful of independent and small party lawmakers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-election-idUSKCN0ZN06L?il=0>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/federal-election-2016/federal-election-2016-live-count-continues-as-turnbull-courts-independents/news-story/fd3f384a00a488b09788741eda3cb648>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3676475/Australian-government-hopes-win-votes-counted.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-5-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Conservative Party (UK) leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Conservative Party members of parliament vote in a second ballot to choose the next leader of the party to replace outgoing Prime Minister David Cameron. The Home Secretary Theresa May secured the highest number votes with 199, while Department of Energy and Climate Change minister Andrea Leadsom received the second highest amount, with 84. The Secretary of State for Justice Michael Gove received just 46 votes and is eliminated from the race, meaning a run-off contest will now take place between May and Leadsom, with the result to be announced on September 9.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3678833/UK-Conservatives-choose-final-2-leadership-contenders.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/uk-politics-36570120?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

<a id="event-2016-07-07-5-7"></a>

Context: Hillary Clinton email scandal.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of State reopens an investigation into the possible mishandling of classified information by former Secretary of State and presumptive Democratic Party presidential nominee Hillary Clinton and her top aides.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/nation-politics/apnewsbreak-state-department-reopens-clinton-emails-probe/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-07-07-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists manage to extract one last image from the Hitomi x-ray spacecraft, which broke up last March while orbiting Earth. Before it died, the spacecraft captured an image which measured the X-ray activity of the Perseus Cluster.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36732336>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-07-07-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Attorneys for 80-year old American pro football legend and Hall of Famer Paul Hornung, who has dementia, sue Riddell sports equipment manufacturer, stating its helmets failed to protect Hornung from brain injury. The suit says Hornung suffered multiple concussions as a player and his neurodegenerative disease has been linked to repetitive head trauma.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/142e1624a3ad485d895e6bc6b1911fd4/nfl-hall-famer-paul-hornung-sues-helmet-maker-riddell>).

### 2016-07-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1283554362](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%208&oldid=1283554362>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the North Caucasus.

**Archived source account.** At least eight unidentified militants and one security officer are killed in ongoing clashes in rural Dagestan, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-daghestan-militants-killed-clashes/27845905.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-0-3"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** According to a Nigerian Army spokesman, a Boko Haram suicide bomber kills six people inside a mosque in the town of Damboa, Borno State. A second suicide bomber attempted to enter the same mosque but failed to gain entry and detonated his belt, killing only himself.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-violence-idUSKCN0ZO1KT>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes hit Darkush in Idlib Province near the Turkish border, killing at least 23 people, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights. At least 25 died when rebels shelled government-held areas of Aleppo. Friday is the last day of a 72-hour Syrian Army-sponsored ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idlib-idUSKCN0ZO1BZ>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idlib-idUSKCN0ZO1BZ>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-0-7"></a>

Context: South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Five soldiers between the two rival Sudan People's Liberation Army factions are killed in clashes in the capital Juba, with reports of heavy gunfire continuing, despite President Salva Kiir Mayardit and rebel leader Riek Machar having reached a peace deal back in April.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36744636>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-07-08-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Typhoon Nepartak hits eastern Taiwan causing three deaths so far, 124 injuries, thousands of people to be evacuated, disrupting transport and power supplies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-asia-storm-taiwan-idUSKCN0ZO08G?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/07/06/world/super-typhoon-nepartak-taiwan/>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2016-07-08-2-1"></a>

Context: Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The death of an elderly Utah woman with a Zika virus infection in late June is the first reported Zika-related death in the continental United States. The woman had traveled to an area where Zika is spreading. The exact cause of death has not been determined; the lady had an underlying medical condition.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/zika-virus-outbreak/zika-patient-dies-utah-1st-related-death-continental-u-s-n606206>); [Time](<http://time.com/4398952/zika-death-utah-continental-us/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-07-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Abdul Sattar Edhi, Pakistani philanthropist and Chairman of the Edhi Foundation, passes away in Karachi at Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn News](<http://www.dawn.com/news/1267583>); [Pakistan Today](<http://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2016/07/08/national/edhi-sahib-put-on-ventilator-prayers-needed/>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-3-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Warsaw summit.

**Archived source account.** NATO members gather in Warsaw, Poland, for a two-day summit. Much of the focus will be on Russia and NATO's commitments in bolstering its presence in Eastern Europe. Other issues to be discussed will include Europe's migrant crises, ISIL extremists, and the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/nato-summit-obama-oped-concrete-commitments/27845816.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-3-4"></a>

Context: South Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** American and South Korean military officials agree to deploy a U.S. Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) missile defense system in the country to counter North Korea's growing threats and use of ballistic missile and nuclear tests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/08/south-korea-and-us-agree-to-deploy-thaad-missile-defence-system>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-07-08-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in the Philippines; Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** The left-wing political party, Bagong Alyansang Makabayan, which is part of the current government, asks Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte to investigate the recent vigilante killings of suspected drug pushers.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/story/572919/news/nation/militant-group-bayan-asks-duterte-to-probe-killing-of-drug-suspects>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-4-2"></a>

Context: Human rights in the Philippines; Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Opposition senator and human rights lawyer Leila de Lima has condemned the killings and urged the Philippine Congress to investigate.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/duterte-crime-war-out-of/2941446.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-4-4"></a>

Context: 2016 shooting of Dallas police officers.

**Archived source account.** Police kill Micah X Johnson, the gunman believed responsible for the killing of five police officers and shooting of seven more in Dallas, Texas following a standoff.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-dallas-police-shooting-20160708-snap-story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Zimbabwe protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests in Harare and elsewhere in the country continue despite police intimidation and pleas by President Robert Mugabe for them to stop.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America Zimbabwe](<http://www.voazimbabwe.com/a/protest-leaders-defiant-as-police-orders/3409664.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-5-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Zimbabwe protests.

**Archived source account.** President Mugabe, in a live national television broadcast from a stadium in Bindura, blames Western sanctions for his country's inability to pay government workers on time.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/zimbabwe-leader-blames-wests-sanctions-for-late-salaries/2016/07/08/d1378f0a-4535-11e6-a76d-3550dba926ac_story.html>); [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/govt-workers-not-payed-due-west-sanctions-says-183704292.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-08-5-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Zimbabwe protests.

**Archived source account.** \#ThisFlag protest leader Pastor Evan Mawarire says the movement, which uses WhatsApp, Facebook, and Twitter, will hold a two-day strike next week if demands, that include sacking corrupt ministers, payment of delayed salaries, lifting of roadblocks that residents say are used by police to extract bribes, etc., are not met. A drought has aggravated the country's situation as have banks that have a daily withdrawal ceiling as low as $50.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160709134018/http://www.cnbcafrica.com/news/southern-africa/2016/07/08/zimbabwe-social-media-anti-mugabe-protests/>); [Ventures Africa](<https://venturesafrica.com/zimbabwe-and-mugabe-till-death-do-them-part-literally/>).

### 2016-07-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076138201](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20July%209&oldid=1076138201>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-07-09-0-2"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir / 2016 Kashmir unrest.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and dozens more are wounded when protesters clash with Indian Army soldiers. The protesters defied an army curfew and took part in the funeral of a top rebel commander of Hizbul Mujahideen.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/deadly-clashes-erupt-in-kashmir-after-killing-of-top-rebel-leader/27849062.html>).

<a id="event-2016-07-09-0-4"></a>

<a id="event-2016-07-17-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Open Championship.

**Archived source account.** In golf, Henrik Stenson wins the 2016 Open Championship defeating Phil Mickelson after a closely fought battle in the final round at the Royal Troon Golf Club in Scotland. Stenson's total of 264, 20 under par, is the lowest stroke total ever recorded in any major championship and ties Jason Day's performance at last year's PGA Championship for the lowest score in relation to par at a major. It is also Stenson's first victory in a major tournament.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2016/jul/17/henrik-stenson-phil-mickelson-open>).

One may be Abu Wardah Santoso, leader of ISIL-connected Mujahidin Indonesia Timur, and the country's "most wanted man." Forensic tests will be carried out. Three others, including two women, escaped.

The dinghies were 17 miles east of Tripoli, Libya. Cause of death is unknown, though an MSF official says it could be that fumes from mixed fuel and water rendered the people unconscious. The MSF ship is expected to arrive in the Sicilian port of Trapani on Friday.

The South Coast Air Quality Management District issues an alert for unhealthy air quality in affected areas.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-07-24-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Democratic National Convention.

**Archived source account.** Debbie Wasserman Schultz resigns from her position as Chairperson of the Democratic National Committee. Her resignation will take effect upon the close of the convention. Donna Brazile will serve as interim chair.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/international/nepal-prime-minister-oli-resigns-ahead-of-notrust-vote/article8894064.ece>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nepal-politics-idUSKCN1040M0?il=0>).

Evidence: [GoKunming](<https://www.gokunming.com/en/blog/item/3799/chen-hao-named-yunnan-party-chief-and-governor>); [DailyO / Jayadeva Ranade](<https://www.dailyo.in/politics/china-xi-jinping-chinese-communist-party-tibet-pla-xinjiang-uyghur-12713>).

#### Science and Technology

<a id="event-2016-08-28-4-0"></a>

Two scramjet engines were mounted alongside of a two-stage, solid fueled rocket called Advanced Technology Vehicle (ATV), which is an advanced sounding rocket. Scramjet engines were then ignited when ATV achieved a speed of Mach 6 (7350 km/hr) at an altitude of 20 km.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/national/isro-successfully-testfires-scramjet-rocket-engine/article9042486.ece>).

<a id="event-2016-09-08-6-0"></a>

If successful, OSIRIS-REx will be the first U.S. spacecraft to return samples from an asteroid.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/09/08/us/osiris-rex-nasa-asteroid-mission/index.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2016/sep/08/nasa-space-mission-launch-bennu-asteroid-osiris-rex>).
