Context: 2016 Tanzanian earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 5.7 earthquake occurs in northern Tanzania, near Lake Victoria, killing at least 13 people and injuring 200 others. Tanzanian authorities report significant damage in the town of Bukoba. The governments of Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, and Uganda report tremors.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-37330418>); [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3783308/At-11-dead-100-injured-Tanzania-earthquake-police.html>).

<a id="event-2016-09-10-2-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/entertainment/news/145870-maritoni-fernandez-sister-aurora-moynihan-shot-dead>).

### 2016-09-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076129561](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20September%2013&oldid=1076129561>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-09-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Israel–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** Syria reports its air defense shot down an Israeli warplane that attacked a Syrian army position in al-Quneitra, near the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights. The Israel Defense Forces say that missiles were fired at their aircraft but none hit.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-syria-idUSKCN11J0EY>); [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/syria-ceasefire-takes-effect-under-us-russia-deal-160557425.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/09/13/middleeast/syria-israel-warplane-denial/>).

<a id="event-2016-09-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Terrorist incidents in Pakistan in 2016.

**Archived source account.** Two attackers of Eid al-Adha prayers in an Imambargah at Shikapur district, Sindh, injure at least ten people including five policemen. One assailant blew himself up and authorities arrested the other one.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Pakistan](<https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/pakistan/three-injured-as-suicide-bombers-storm-shikarpur-imambargah/>); [The Express Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/1181600/several-feared-injured-blast-eidul-azha-prayers-shikarpur-imambargah/>).

<a id="event-2016-09-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorist incidents in Pakistan in 2016.

**Archived source account.** A roadside blast in the Balochistan Province kills two policemen and injures eight people.

Source citations (as archived): [The News International](<https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/150038-Roadside-blast-kills-two-cops-in-Quetta>); [First Post](<http://www.firstpost.com/world/pakistan-2-policemen-killed-23-injured-in-eid-bombings-in-balochistan-sindh-3003342.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-09-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan issues land and sea warnings for Typhoon Meranti which is expected to hit tomorrow the southern part of the island.

Source citations (as archived): [Focus Taiwan](<http://focustaiwan.tw/news/asoc/201609130005.aspx>).

<a id="event-2016-09-13-1-3"></a>

Context: 2016 North Korean floods.

**Archived source account.** The Red Cross warns that North Korea faces a "major, complex disaster" after recent floods kill scores of people and leave more than 100,000 homeless.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-09-13/north-korea-floods-a-major-complex-disaster-red-cross/7839126>).

<a id="event-2016-09-13-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 6.0 magnitude earthquake hits near the Colombian city of Medellin.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Express](<http://www.express.co.uk/news/world/710404/Earthquake-Colombia-Medellin-Pablo-Escobar-terremoto-magnitude-South-America>).

<a id="event-2016-09-13-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** One crew member of the MS Harmony of the Seas, the world's largest cruise ship, is killed and four other crew members are injured after a lifeboat fell on them during a training exercise on the ship that was docked in Marseille, France.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/09/13/europe/crew-killed-harmony-of-the-seas/>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/harmony-of-the-seas-cruise-liner-death-accident-worlds-biggest-toll-injured-latest-live-news-a7242216.html>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2016-09-13-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Health of the Philippines discover an additional two cases of Zika virus infections bringing the total to eight.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/philippines-reports-2-new-zika-cases-brings-total-to-8>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-09-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Hungarian migrant quota referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Luxembourg's foreign minister Jean Asselborn calls for Hungary to be expelled from the European Union for its treatment of migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-37347352>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-09-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Proceedings begin in the trial of Maurice "Hank" Greenberg, former chairman of the giant insurance company AIG, on charges of accounting fraud. The 2005 indictment accuses Greenberg and AIG's former CFO of setting up bogus reinsurance transactions to conceal the insurer's financial difficulties in 2000 and 2001.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greenberg-aig-case-idUSKCN11J12H>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/09/12/business/dealbook/after-11-years-case-of-aigs-ex-chief-is-going-to-trial.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-09-13-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Imprisoned former American Army intelligence analyst and transgender person Chelsea Manning, who is serving a 35-year sentence at Fort Leavenworth, will have the military provide the costs of gender reassignment surgery. She was convicted by court-martial in July 2013 of violations of the Espionage Act and other offenses, after disclosing to WikiLeaks nearly three-quarters of a million classified or unclassified but sensitive military and diplomatic documents.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/09/13/politics/chelsea-manning-gender-reassignment-surgery/>).

<a id="event-2016-09-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Cuban-born American arsonist who torched 87 people in March 1990 at The Bronx Happy Land fire, Julio González, dies in prison at the age of 61.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/arsonist-torched-87-people-happy-land-club-died-prison-article-1.2791168>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-09-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte accuses the Liberal Party of former president Benigno Aquino III and their allies of orchestrating an impeachment complaint against him regarding his anti-drug campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [Interaksyon](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160913165221/http://www.interaksyon.com/article/132358/watch--duterte-accuses-yellow-forces-of-using-human-rights-to-sow-intrigue>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-09-13-6-1"></a>

Context: Proto-Human language and language acquisition.

**Archived source account.** Researchers from the Americas and Europe discover that sounds in 40–100 basic vocabulary words in around 3,700 languages are similar.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/science/2016/09/12/humans-may-speak-a-universal-language-say-scientists/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-09-13-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Anti-Doping Agency reveals that Russian hackers broke into one of its databases and published confidential medical information on several prominent American female athletes who competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics, among them, gymnast Simone Biles, tennis players Venus and Serena Williams, and basketball player Elena Delle Donne. The named individuals all received "therapeutic use exemptions" from WADA allowing them to use otherwise banned substances to treat documented medical conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/17538070/wada-says-russian-hackers-published-athletes-medical-data>).

<a id="event-2016-09-14-6-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-09-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Rodrigo Duterte, Davao Death Squad.

The witness also revealed that Duterte's son Paolo may also have been involved in the murders as an accomplice to his father.,,

Source citations (as archived): [Interaksyon](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160916204709/http://www.interaksyon.com/article/132449/dds-member-links-duterte-son-paolo-to-murders>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-09-15/witness-says-philippine-president-ordered-killings>); [AP](<http://wtop.com/asia/2016/09/witness-says-philippine-president-ordered-killings/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/09/14/world/asia/ap-as-philippines-duterte-killings.html?_r=0>); [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/146292-duterte-ordered-killing-jun-pala-senate-witness>).

**Archived source account.** Texas authorities agree to pay $1.9 million to the family of Sandra Bland, the woman who was found hanged in a jail cell in Waller County, Texas, in July 2015. A grand jury did not issue an indictment.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/sandra-bland-family-reaches-million-settlement-texas-authorities/>).

<a id="event-2016-09-17-1-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016.

<a id="event-2016-09-17-1-3"></a>

<a id="event-2016-09-17-3-0"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Kashmir insurgency / 2016 Uri attack.

**Archived source account.** Four Jaish-e-Mohammed militants attack an Indian Army base near the Pakistan border with at least 17 soldiers and four militants killed.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.co.uk/9-soldiers-killed-heavily-armed-militants-storm-indian-army-headquarters-near-pakistan-border-1581891>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-37399969>).

O.J. Simpson: American Crime Story winning the Emmy for Outstanding Limited Series.

### 2016-09-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087148805](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20September%2019&oldid=1087148805>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-09-19-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 New York and New Jersey bombings.

**Archived source account.** A bomb squad robot detonates an explosive device at a transit station in Elizabeth, New Jersey. There has been a previous explosion in Seaside Park. No one is hurt.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/nyc-explosion-fbi-cops-investigate-vehicle-interest-n-y-new-n650306>).

<a id="event-2016-09-19-0-2"></a>

Context: 2016 New York and New Jersey bombings.

**Archived source account.** Linden, New Jersey police shoot and arrest Ahmad Khan Rahami, the suspected perpetrator. Two police officers are reportedly injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/09/20/nyregion/nyc-nj-explosions-ahmad-khan-rahami.html>).

<a id="event-2016-09-19-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Afghan officials say yesterday's U.S. airstrikes killed up to eight Afghan policemen in Lashkar Gah, Uruzgan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-airstrike-idUSKCN11P0OG>).

<a id="event-2016-09-19-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Democratic Republic of the Congo protest calling for the resignation of President Joseph Kabila turns violent in Kinshasa, leaving at least 17 people dead, including three police officers. Opposition groups say that 50 people died.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Point](<http://www.lepoint.fr/monde/kinshasa-au-moins-31-morts-lors-de-violences-et-de-pillages-19-09-2016-2069636_24.php>); [DNA](<http://www.dna.fr/actualite/2016/09/19/flambee-de-violence-a-kinshasa-au-moins-31-morts>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-37406407>).

<a id="event-2016-09-19-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Hours after the Syrian military declares the end of the ceasefire, an airstrike hits a convoy of United Nations OCHA aid trucks near the town of Urum al-Kubra, in the Aleppo Governorate, with the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reporting that at least 12 people have been killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-37413411>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-09-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Bangladesh Bank heist.

**Archived source account.** A court in the Philippines orders the central bank to return US$15 million back to Bangladesh.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyber-heist-philippines-idUSKCN11P0TL>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-09-19-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Southeastern United States gasoline shortage.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. states of North Carolina and Virginia declare a state of emergency over gas shortages as a result of the Colonial pipeline leak in Shelby County, Alabama.

Source citations (as archived): [WTKR](<http://wtkr.com/2016/09/19/virginia-north-carolina-declare-state-of-emergency-over-gas-shortages/>).

<a id="event-2016-09-19-2-3"></a>

Context: 2016 California wildfires, Soberanes Fire.

**Archived source account.** The cost, so far, of battling the wildfire on California's scenic Big Sur coast is $206.7 million — the costliest in U.S. history, according to the National Interagency Fire Center. The blaze, which was first reported on July 22, is currently 67 percent contained.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/98b399b5f6044767807b27a95ada7bcb/california-wildfire-becomes-costliest-ever-fight-200m>).

<a id="event-2016-09-19-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Southeast Asian haze.

**Archived source account.** In 2015, more than 100,000 people in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore may have died as a result of forest fires in Southeast Asia. The continued poor air quality also continues to affect the health of more than 42 million Indonesians.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/study-estimates-100000-premature-deaths-from-indonesia-haze/2016/09/19/a62d7d6e-7e20-11e6-ad0e-ab0d12c779b1_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-09-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican authorities find the bodies of two priests who were kidnapped yesterday in Poza Rica, Veracruz. Authorities find the third abducted person, the driver, alive.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/3247ebf1313241c88a1bafc2ea2f9021/2-priests-found-dead-after-being-kidnapped-mexico>).

<a id="event-2016-09-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cambodian prime minister Hun Sen says that he will continue his campaign against protests from the Cambodian opposition while Kem Sokha of the Cambodian National Rescue Party vows to remain as their leader.

Source citations (as archived): [Australian Broadcasting Corporation](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-09-19/cambodia%27s-government-threatens-to-crush-opposition-protests/7853610>).

### 2016-09-20

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-09-20-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A day after street violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo between protesters opposed to President Joseph Kabila and security forces left at least 44 dead, armed men in military uniforms burn down the headquarters of the main opposition Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS) in Kinshasa, DR Congo, killing at least two people.

<a id="event-2016-09-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Citing irreconcilable differences, Angelina Jolie files for divorce from Brad Pitt and seeks full custody of their six children. The couple married in 2014 and had been in a relationship since 2005.

<a id="event-2016-09-20-2-1"></a>

<a id="event-2016-09-20-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Mi-8 transport helicopter crashes near the eastern Libyan city of Tobruk, killing at least six people.

**Archived source account.** Authorities diagnose six more cases of the Zika virus in the provinces of Cebu and Iloilo in the Visayas and Laguna province near Metro Manila, Philippines.

<a id="event-2016-09-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Accession of Bosnia and Herzegovina to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Union's 28 member states formally accept Bosnia and Herzegovina's membership application. The European Commission (EC) will now determine whether Bosnia meets the criteria to join the union, a process that is expected to take a year.

<a id="event-2016-09-20-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In his final speech as President of the United States to the United Nations General Assembly, Barack Obama calls for a renewed commitment to collaborative efforts in facing many of the challenges confronting “an integrated world” community.

<a id="event-2016-09-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court sentences five members of the Cuba men's national volleyball team to prison for a gang rape of a Finnish woman that took place in Tampere, Finland, in July 2016 during the FIVB Volleyball World League.

Source citations (as archived): [Yle](<http://yle.fi/uutiset/five_cuban_volleyball_players_convicted_of_tampere_rape_one_acquitted/9179017>).

<a id="event-2016-09-22-0-3"></a>

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-09-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate and House of Representatives override the veto of President Barack Obama in regards to the Justice Against Sponsors of Terrorism Act. The action is the first such congressional veto override to Obama.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2016/09/28/495709481/sept-11-lawsuits-vote-today-could-be-first-reversal-of-an-obama-veto>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/saarc-summit-collapses-after-india-and-3-other-members-pull-out/story-kIMWfSqirGLzB6MEfuS3CN.html>).

### 2016-10-07

<a id="event-2016-10-07-1-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [MIT Technology Review](<https://www.technologyreview.com/s/602586/algorithms-probably-caused-a-flash-crash-of-the-british-pound/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-07-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Nobel Peace Prize.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize committee awards Colombian president Juan Manuel Santos the Nobel Peace Prize for his resolute efforts to bring the country's more than 50-year-long civil war to an end, a war that has cost the lives of at least 220 thousand Colombians and displaced close to six million people.,

Source citations (as archived): [Nobel Prize](<https://www.nobelprize.org/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2016/oct/07/nobel-peace-prize-2016-announcement-live>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/10/07/1631266/philippines-us-halt-plans-joint-south-china-sea-patrols>).

<a id="event-2016-10-08-6-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Bisping defeated Henderson and retained the UFC middleweight title in Manchester. The bout took place early Sunday, October 9 locally.

Editorial date: 2016-10-08. Checked: 2026-10-22. The source uses October 8 US event billing. Sky reports the local Sunday timing, so the date convention is disclosed without changing archival placement.

Evidence: [Sky Sports](<https://www.skysports.com/mma/news/19828/10610948/michael-bisping-retains-ufc-middleweight-title-with-win-over-dan-henderson-in-manchester>).

Original source account: UFC 204 happened in Manchester, England. Michael Bisping defeated Dan Henderson in the main event to retain his middleweight championship.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/10/asia/china-building-collapse/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-11-2-2"></a>

Context: Hurricane Matthew.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations launches an emergency appeal for almost U.S.$120 million in life-saving help for 750,000 survivors in Haiti at risk of starvation and/or cholera.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/hurricane-matthew/haiti-needs-massive-response-halt-cholera-crisis-after-matthew-u-n664191>).

<a id="event-2016-10-11-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jordanian student pilot Feras Freitekh kills himself and attempts to kill his flight instructor, when their small Piper PA-34 Seneca airplane crashes in East Hartford Connecticut. Investigators conclude the crash was an intentional act motivated by suicide based on the surviving instructor who said there was an argument and struggle for control. The FBI investigates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-connecticut-crash-idUSKCN12D2J0>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2016-10-11-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Zika virus epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization warns that the Zika virus will continue to spread across Asia with cases already reported in Singapore and Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-37615427>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court hears arguments in a patent dispute between Apple Inc. and Samsung concerning both company's smart phone designs (Samsung Electronics v. Apple (15-777)).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/usa-court-iphone-idUSL1N1CG0HZ>).

<a id="event-2016-10-11-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Obama administration through the U.S. Department of Justice announces that they will file criminal contempt of court charges against Maricopa County, Arizona sheriff Joe Arpaio for violating a judge's order to stop immigration patrols that led to a court finding of racial profiling. The charges carry a maximum penalty of six months in jail.,

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/10/11/497577585/feds-will-press-criminal-contempt-charges-against-ariz-sheriff-arpaio>); [Arizona Central](<http://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/phoenix/2016/10/11/department-justice-charge-arpaio-criminal-contempt/91901204/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-11-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Office of the Chief Medical Examiner in Oklahoma City reports that an unarmed black man, Terence Crutcher, shot dead on September 16, by a white police officer, Betty Jo Shelby, had acute PCP intoxication. Authorities charged her with first-degree manslaughter.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/10/11/autopsy-oklahoma-police-victim-had-pcp-in-system-when-died.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-10-11-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers announce that 2014 UZ224 is the third most distant Solar System object known from our Sun, currently over 90 times the Earth's distance from the Sun (90.8 AU or 8.44 billion miles), after Eris (96.2 AU) and V774104 (~103 AU).

Source citations (as archived): [The International Astronomical Union Minor Planet Center](<http://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K16/K16TA4.html>).

### 2016-10-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122811](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2012&oldid=1076122811>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi rejects Turkey's claim that Turkish forces must be included in an operation to retake the militant-held city of Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [The Military Times](<http://www.militarytimes.com/articles/iraqi-pm-rejects-turkish-claim-to-take-part-in-mosul-campaign>).

<a id="event-2016-10-12-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan, Violence against Shia Muslims.

**Archived source account.** A bomb explosion among crowds of Shiite Muslims gathered to mark Ashura, one of their holiest commemorations, kills at least 12 people and wounds 28 others. Also, authorities revise the death toll to 17 from yesterday's attack on a Kabul Shiite shrine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/deadly-blast-targets-shiite-worshipers-in-afghanistan-amid-widening-security/2016/10/12/a7b5dda2-907c-11e6-9c52-0b10449e33c4_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Rohingya insurgency in Western Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** The four-day death toll from fighting in Rakhine State stands at 39, including 13 army and police personnel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-border-idUSKCN12D0BN>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-10-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American popstar Janet Jackson announces that she is pregnant with her first child at the age of 50.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/12/entertainment/janet-jackson-pregnant/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-10-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** John Stumpf resigns as CEO and chairman of Wells Fargo amid a scandal over its sales practices.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-37639648>).

<a id="event-2016-10-12-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. firm Concentrix, which is used by the British government to cut tax credit payments, suffers a data protection breach where some claimants have had their personal information such as bank statements, self assessment details, and National Insurance numbers sent to other claimants.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-37631613>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Burundi.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Burundi votes overwhelmingly to withdraw Burundi from the Dutch-based International Criminal Court.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-icc-idUSKCN12C1LH>).

### 2016-10-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122776](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2013&oldid=1076122776>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military launches Tomahawk cruise missiles from the USS Nitze against Houthi-controlled radar sites in Yemen following two incidents in which, according to U.S. military, missiles were fired on United States Navy vessels in the Red Sea.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-missiles-idUSKCN12C294>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/u-s-launches-strikes-yemen-after-missiles-aimed-american-ships-n665506?cid=eml_nbn_20161012>).

<a id="event-2016-10-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Boko Haram.

**Archived source account.** Negotiations between the Nigerian president's administration and Islamist militants free 21 of the 270 schoolgirls kidnapped in 2014 by Boko Haram in Chibok, Nigeria (leaving 218 victims still unaccounted for).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-37641101>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-10-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American singer-songwriter Bob Dylan wins the Nobel Prize in Literature.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/10/13/497780610/bob-dylan-titan-of-american-music-wins-the-2016-nobel-prize-in-literature>).

<a id="event-2016-10-13-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** UNESCO declares the Western Wall an "Islamic site" and refrains from mentioning its connection to Jewish culture. Over half the voting countries chose to abstain.

Source citations (as archived): [The International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/palestine-wins-victory-against-israel-jerusalem-holy-site-declared-muslim-not-jewish-2431205>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2016-10-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Obama administration's Treasury Department, in a move against corporate tax inversions, enacts regulations to combat a key tax-reduction technique known as earnings stripping.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-tax-inversions-idUSKCN12D2YC>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-13-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Nicole impacts Bermuda at Category 3 strength, making it the strongest hurricane to effect the British Overseas Territory since Hurricane Fabian in 2003.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/major-hurricane-nicole-atlantic-bermuda>); [The Alabama Media Group](<http://www.al.com/news/index.ssf/2016/10/hurricane_nicole_path_update_b.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Hurricane Matthew.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in North Carolina rises to 22 as flood waters continue to rise. Governor Pat McCrory says places that had a foot of water in the morning, were under 12 feet of water.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-storm-matthew-idUSKCN12D31X>).

<a id="event-2016-10-13-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A plane crash near Kelowna, BC, kills Canadian politician and former Premier of Alberta Jim Prentice along with three others.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/calgary/jim-prentice-plane-crash-killed-1.3804941>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Maldives leaves the Commonwealth of Nations after 34 years, claiming that it has been "unfairly and unjustly" treated by the intergovernmental organization.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/10/13/maldives-leaves-commonwealth-as-it-claims-unfair-treatment-in-ro/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-13-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly officially appoints former Portuguese Prime Minister António Guterres its next Secretary-General.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-37648265>); [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-n-general-assembly-appoints-antonio-guterres-as-next-secretary-general-1476399026>).

<a id="event-2016-10-13-4-3"></a>

Context: Proposed second Scottish independence referendum, Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Scottish leader Nicola Sturgeon will introduce a bill launching a new referendum to determine the final status of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-37634338>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cyberthieves inject 5,925 online web retailers with website software malicious code that is stealing the credit card details of customers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-37643754>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-10-13-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The King of Thailand Bhumibol Adulyadej dies at the age of 88. He was the world's longest currently serving monarch.

Source citations (as archived): [The Canberra Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20161015123000/http://www.canberratimes.com.au/world/thai-king-bhumibol-adulyadej-dies-at-88-20140826-108vr7.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-13-6-2"></a>

Context: Colombian peace process.

**Archived source account.** Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos extends his ceasefire with the FARC rebels through the end of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-peace-idUSKCN12E01R>).

### 2016-10-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122741](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2014&oldid=1076122741>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A suspected ISIL attack on a security checkpoint in North Sinai Governorate, Egypt, leaves at least 12 Egyptian military personnel and 15 terrorists dead.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-insurgency-idUSKBN12E14Q>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/14/world/egypt-sinai-attack/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-14-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An explosion that targeted a funeral in Ma'rib for a top Yemeni army commander, kills five people, including the deceased's brother, and injures 15 more.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/10/14/blast-hits-funeral-army-officer-in-yemen-5-killed.html>); [The Indian Express](<http://indianexpress.com/article/world/world-news/explosion-kills-at-least-four-at-funeral-in-yemen-marib-sources-3082998/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus crashes and catches fire carrying tourists returning from a China tour on the Gyeongbu Expressway near Ulsan, South Korea, leaving ten people killed and nine injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/32cf206a948842b18fdb42e251e78fa7/10-killed-south-korea-after-bus-fire-highway>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2016-10-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Surgeons separate craniopagus conjoined twin boys in New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-37660003>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A London-based trader who traded on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Navinder Singh Sarao, accused of contributing to the 2010 Wall Street "flash crash" by placing bogus orders to spoof the market, fails in his legal bid to stop extradition and will now be sent to the United States to face trial where he is wanted by U.S. authorities on 22 criminal counts of wire fraud, commodities fraud, and market manipulation. A judge initially approved his extradition in March, and today his bid to launch an appeal against that decision was rejected, ending his 18-month legal fight. He will now be extradited within 28 days.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-flashcrash-trader-extradition-idUSKBN12E196>).

<a id="event-2016-10-14-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A retrial court finds Welsh footballer Ched Evans not guilty. He had previously been sentenced to five years imprisonment for rape in 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-37659009>).

<a id="event-2016-10-14-3-3"></a>

Context: Volkswagen diesel emissions cheating scandal.

**Archived source account.** Volkswagen agrees to pay $175 million to United States lawyers suing the German automaker on behalf of the owners of 475,000 polluting vehicles.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-volkswagen-emissions-idUSKBN12E2AH>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-10-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Death and funeral of Bhumibol Adulyadej.

**Archived source account.** Thailand declares today a government holiday for mourning King Bhumibol Adulyadej's death.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-king-holiday-idUSKCN12E06M?il=0>).

<a id="event-2016-10-14-4-2"></a>

Context: Death and funeral of Bhumibol Adulyadej.

**Archived source account.** Per Section 24 of the Constitution, Thailand formally confirms as the Regent pro tempore Prem Tinsulanonda, the President of the Privy Council and the former confidant of King Bhumibol Adulyadej.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/general/1110645/prem-becomes-regent-pro-tempore>); [The Irrawaddy](<http://www.irrawaddy.com/asia/late-thai-kings-confidant-confirmed-temporary-regent.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-14-4-4"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** President Barack Obama issues an executive order on Cuba lifting monetary limits on the amount of Cuban products, including cigars and rum, which Americans can bring back for personal use, allowing Cubans and Americans to engage in joint medical research, and allowing Cubans to buy certain U.S. consumer goods online.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/10/15/world/americas/obama-cuba-trade-embargo.html?_r=0>); [The Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/cuba/article108195527.html>); [The Havana Times](<http://www.havanatimes.org/?p=121556>).

### 2016-10-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122700](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2015&oldid=1076122700>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), 2016 October Baghdad attacks.

**Archived source account.** Attacks targeting a Shi'ite Muslim gathering, a police check-point, and the family of an anti-Islamic State Sunni paramilitary leader, kill at least 55 people in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-idUSKBN12F06W>).

<a id="event-2016-10-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), 2016 October Baghdad attacks.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility as a response to take back launching of its stronghold Mosul by the Iraqi forces.

Source citations (as archived): [TeleSUR](<http://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Nearly-60-People-Killed-in-Iraq-by-Islamic-State-Group-Attacks-20161015-0005.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-15-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian border patrol officers open fire on a North Korean fishing vessel, leaving one fisherman dead, and eight others injured.

<a id="event-2016-10-15-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia accepts the finding of the Joint Incidents Assessment Team, a setup of coalition states to investigate complaints against coalitions conduct in Decisive Storm, that the October 8 coalition’s bombardment at a funeral ceremony in Sana'a, in which over 140 people were killed and more than 600 injured, was based on wrong information.,

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<http://www.arabnews.com/node/998181/middle-east>); [Samaa TV](<http://www.samaa.tv/international/2016/10/saudi-led-coalition-says-it-wrongly-targeted-yemen-funeral/>).

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkish-backed rebels advance on the symbolic ISIL-controlled town of Dabiq, in northern Syria. ISIL believes Dabiq is the location where an apocalyptic battle will take place shortly before the end of the world.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-37666240>).

<a id="event-2016-10-15-0-9"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** The United States Navy's USS Mason is fired on for the third time in a week from territory controlled by Houthi forces in Yemen, while in international waters of the Red Sea. The ship deployed countermeasures and was not struck, according to U.S. officials.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/uss-mason-fired-again-coast-yemen-officials-n666971>).

<a id="event-2016-10-15-0-11"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian government airstrikes on jihadist targets in North Sinai Governorate, leave at least 100 terrorists killed and 40 others wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua Net](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2016-10/15/c_135756798.htm>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-10-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A wildlife sanctuary for rescued elephants opens in Brazil.

<a id="event-2016-10-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Google introduces a so-called "fact checking" feature on its news aggregate service to combat alleged political bias.

Source citations (as archived): [The Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/business/la-fi-tn-google-news-20161014-snap-story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-15-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Transportation Department's emergency order banning Samsung Galaxy Note 7 from aircraft in the United States goes into effect.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-samsung-elec-smartphones-idUSKBN12E2BC>).

**Archived source account.** A stampede among Hindu pilgrims headed to Varanasi, India, kills at least 24 people and injures at least 20.,

<a id="event-2016-10-15-3-3"></a>

<a id="event-2016-10-15-4-3"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** The United States Defense Department reports its Strategic Command systems detected a failed North Korean ballistic missile launch near the city of Kusong in North Pyongan Province.

**Archived source account.** Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin sign several agreements including a $12.9 billion defense and energy deal. Russian state oil major Rosneft pays for a controlling stake in both India's Essar Oil and port facilities that it already owns.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-russia-idUSKBN12F0BP>).

**Archived source account.** A gun battle that started when three armed men returned to a restaurant in Los Angeles, leaves 3 people dead and 12 others wounded. Police set up a dragnet for the suspects.

<a id="event-2016-10-15-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in China detain 75 people in connection with a service that determined the female gender of unborn babies for the purpose of abortion. Authorities say that at least 300 people were involved in the illegal service in the eastern Chinese province of Zhejiang. Expectant parents wanting male children smuggled fetal blood samples to Hong Kong for gender testing. China ended its one-child policy last year.

<a id="event-2016-10-15-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Judge Vivien Rose of London's High Court, finds in favor of Goldman Sachs, that the bank is not liable for the failure of highly speculative trades made by the sovereign wealth fund of Libya.

Context: Montreal Protocol.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-37665529>).

<a id="event-2016-10-16-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2016-10-16-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis declares seven new saints.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican Radio](<http://en.radiovaticana.va>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The collapse of a footbridge connecting the islands of Lembongan and Ceningan, near Bali, Indonesia, leaves 9 dead and 30 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/10/16/world/asia/ap-as-indonesia-bridge-collapses.html?_r=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United States and the United Kingdom call for, "within hours," an immediate and unconditional ceasefire in Yemen to end the violence following last week's Saudi airstrikes, based on bad information, that killed around 140 people.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-britain-usa-idUSKBN12G0MX>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/oct/16/britain-and-us-call-for-yemen-ceasefire-within-hours>).

<a id="event-2016-10-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An arsonist firebombs a Republican Party office in Hillsborough, North Carolina, and leaves a graffiti message reading, "Nazi Republicans get out of town or else."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/16/politics/north-carolina-gop-office-vandalized/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-10-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Montenegrin parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** With over 95 percent of votes counted, Prime Minister Milo Đukanović's Democratic Party of Socialists receives the most votes in this quadrennial election, but, by five seats, fails to gain an absolute majority. Djukanovic says he will seek a coalition with parties of national minorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-space-mars-idUSKBN12F0U7>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-10-16-7-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-10-17-1-3"></a>

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations announces that the warring parties in Yemen have agreed to a 72-hour ceasefire starting October 19 at 23:59 AST (4:59 EDT).,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/07bd4b085e334b6e88199b81c92656a5/un-announces-agreement-72-hour-yemen-cease-fire>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-idUSKCN12I2GX>).

<a id="event-2016-10-17-2-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The European Union condemns Russia's air campaign in Syria, saying it may be guilty of war crimes, and it vowed to impose more sanctions on President Bashar al-Assad's government. The bloc's 28 foreign ministers sought to show their anger at the Russian-backed campaign, which has killed several hundred people including dozens of children since the collapse of a truce brokered by Russia and the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-eu-idUSKBN12G103>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-17-3-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-florida-zimmerman-idUSKBN12H1S2>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-10-17-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American conservative undercover video producer James O'Keefe releases a series of videos allegedly showing conversations with, among others, Scott Foval, the former national field director of Americans United for Change, speaking about his hiring of people to sabotage rallies for Donald Trump by staging fights in them in a process Foval called "bird dogging".

Source citations (as archived): [Salon](<http://www.salon.com/2016/10/18/james-okeefe-releases-another-project-veritas-video-claiming-hillary-clinton-campaign-is-bird-dogging/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-10-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Shenzhou program.

**Archived source account.** China launches Shenzhou 11, the country's sixth manned spaceflight mission and the first one to the Tiangong-2 space laboratory, with two taikonauts on a 30-day mission.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-space-idUSKBN12G00X?il=0>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/7e93f5e407b34699b9c955f8968155a8/china-launches-crewed-mission-dock-space-station>).

<a id="event-2016-10-17-5-3"></a>

Context: NASA's Commercial Resupply Services.

**Archived source account.** Orbital ATK Antares 230 rocket launches carrying an unmanned resupply spacecraft, the Cygnus CRS OA-5 cargo ship, to the International Space Station from NASA's Wallops Flight Facility in Virginia. The mission returns the Antares rocket to flight after an anomaly on October 28, 2014, caused an Antares-series rocket to explode seconds after liftoff.,

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<http://www.space.com/34394-orbital-atk-antares-rocket-return-to-flight.html>); [NASA](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NX31vCePp1o>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-10-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Applications of nanotechnology.

**Archived source account.** While attempting to create a nanotechnology-based, catalyst-mediated series of chemical reactions to turn carbon dioxide (a greenhouse gas) into a usable fuel, scientists at the Department of Energy’s Oak Ridge National Laboratory instead discover a single-step process using the surface area of tiny spikes of copper and carbon as a catalyst to turn carbon dioxide into ethanol. The reaction may serve as a method to alleviate possible climate change by both decreasing \{\{chem\|C\|O\|2\}\} in the atmosphere and by using the ethanol as an additive to fuels to increase efficiency and thereby decrease consumption.,

Source citations (as archived): [Popular Mechanics](<http://www.popularmechanics.com/science/green-tech/a23417/convert-co2-into-ethanol/>); [The Oak Ridge National Laboratory](<https://www.ornl.gov/news/nano-spike-catalysts-convert-carbon-dioxide-directly-ethanol>).

### 2016-10-19

#### Disasters and accidents

**Archived source account.** The Philippine government places more than two dozen provinces on alert before Typhoon Haima makes landfall over Luzon. Haima, downgraded by the Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System to a Category 4 storm, landfalls Cagayan province in the island's northeast. Weather forecasters expect the storm to impact up to 2.7 million people before veering northwest toward the Chinese coast on October 21.,,

### 2016-10-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122474](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2020&oldid=1076122474>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Turkish military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkish jets hit Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) militia with 26 airstrikes in three recently-captured-from-ISIL villages west of al-Bab and northeast of Aleppo. The Turkish General Staff says between 160 and 200 have been killed, while the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports 11 dead and dozens of people wounded.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-kurds-idUSKCN12K0ER>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2016/10/20/turkish-media-strikes-kill-up-200-kurdish-militants-syria/92450020/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-20-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Typhoon Haima, the second tropical cyclone to hit the Philippines in less than a week, kills at least seven people and causes flooding, landslides, and power outages before heading out to sea.,,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/10/20/world/asia/ap-as-asia-typhoon.html?_r=0>); [The Epoch Times](<http://www.theepochtimes.com/n3/2174861-typhoon-haima-leaves-at-least-7-dead-in-northern-philippines/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-37707593>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Philippines–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Philippines president Rodrigo Duterte says he plans to cut ties with his country's former colonial ruler, the United States, while strengthening ties with China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/oct/20/philippines-president-duterte-says-time-to-say-goodbye-to-america>).

<a id="event-2016-10-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Canada–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union calls an emergency two-day meeting about the planned EU-Canada free trade agreement, approved by all 28 EU member governments but held up by the "non" vote in Wallonia, one of Belgium's five sub-federal administrations.,,

Source citations (as archived): [NASDAQ](<http://www.nasdaq.com/article/eu-calls-emergency-meeting-to-save-canadian-free-trade-deal-cm696011>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-canada-trade-idUSKCN12K1Z3>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/10/21/world/europe/brexit-migration-walloons-eus-list-of-crises-keeps-growing.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2016-10-20-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Africa will notify the United Nations that the country is withdrawing from the International Criminal Court (ICC). This separation would take effect one year from when notice is formally received by the U.N. Secretary-General. Last week, Burundi's parliament voted to leave the ICC, but the required paperwork has not yet reached the U.N.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-safrica-icc-idUSKCN12L025>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian prosecutors file homicide charges against 21 people employed by the companies Samarco, Vale, and BHP Billiton for the November 2015 iron ore mine dam burst in the state of Minas Gerais that killed 19 people and polluted waterways.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-37723057>).

<a id="event-2016-10-20-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following his October 5 arrest, U.S. federal prosecutors in Baltimore charge Harold T. Martin III, a former National Security Agency contractor, for violating the Espionage Act, specifically, with felony theft of government property. Prosecutors state that, over a 20-year time period, Martin stole at least 50 terabytes of data and "six full bankers boxes" of classified and other documents. The prosecutors state that Martin had an “arsenal” of weapons in his home.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/government-alleges-massive-theft-by-nsa-contractor/2016/10/20/e021c380-96cc-11e6-bb29-bf2701dbe0a3_story.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-10-20-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The journal Scientific Reports publishes research from a team, led by Australian Age of Dinosaurs Museum's Stephen Poropat, reporting the discovery of a new Australian dinosaur species, Savannasaurus elliottorum, using fossils first found in 2005 at Winton, Queensland, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2016/10/20/13351870/new-dinosaur-species-savannasaurus-australia-discovery-titanosaur-sauropod>).

**Archived source account.** Per Wästberg, a member of the Swedish Academy, says that songwriter and artist Bob Dylan has not yet indicated whether he intends to accept the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-37740379>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/music/2016/oct/22/bob-dylan-criticised-as-impolite-and-arrogant-by-nobel-academy-member>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-10-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British American Tobacco offers to buy out U.S. cigarette maker Reynolds American Inc in a $47 billion takeover that would create the world's biggest listed tobacco company.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-reynolds-m-a-bat-idUSKCN12L0JO>).

<a id="event-2016-10-21-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** AT&amp;T reportedly agrees in principle to buy Time Warner for about $85 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-time-warner-m-a-at-t-idUSKCN12L1Y0?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.6 earthquake hits Tottori Prefecture in western Japan. Local media report that there are 14 injuries in Kurayoshi. Tottori is Japan's least populous prefecture.,

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-10-21/magnitude-6-6-quake-hits-western-japan-causing-strong-shaking>); [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20161021131633/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id5355>).

<a id="event-2016-10-21-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A chemical spill at the MGP Ingredients plant in Atchison, Kansas, United States, injures 26 people and leads to evacuations. The spill of sodium hypochlorite and sulfuric acid produces a toxic fog.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kansas City Star](<http://www.kansascity.com/news/local/article109613237.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities evacuate London City Airport after a chemical incident, but, after some remediation, police later declare the airport safe.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/10/21/europe/london-city-airport-evacuated/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-21-3-4"></a>

Context: 2016 Eséka train derailment.

**Archived source account.** A passenger train derails in central Cameroon, killing at least 53 people and injuring 575 others.,

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<http://www.africanews.com/2016/10/21/about-10-dead-scores-injured-as-train-derails-in-cameroon/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cameroon-derailment-idUSKCN12L1XA>).

<a id="event-2016-10-21-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Mil Mi-8 helicopter crashes and leaves at least 19 dead and three others injured on the Yamal Peninsula in Russia's Extreme North.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/a/at-least-19-dead-helicopter-crash-russia-yamal-peninsula/28068597.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Africa formally begins the process of withdrawing from the International Criminal Court amid a dispute over the country's refusal to arrest Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir at last year's African Union summit in Johannesburg.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-37724724>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The pursuit of a car jacking suspect in Albuquerque, New Mexico, United States, leaves four police officers injured and hospitalized.

Source citations (as archived): [The Albuquerque Journal](<https://www.abqjournal.com/872211/officers-in-crash-taken-to-hospital-early-friday-morning.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-21-5-2"></a>

Context: October 2016 Dyn cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** A series of cyberattacks utilizing distributed denial-of-service attacks, targeting networks operated by DNS provider Dyn, makes major Internet platforms and services unavailable to large swaths of users in Europe and North America. Affected companies include Amazon, Twitter, Spotify, Reddit, PayPal, Netflix, and Airbnb.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/denial-of-service-web-attack-affects-amazon-twitter-others-1477056080>).

<a id="event-2016-10-21-5-4"></a>

Context: 2014 Iguala mass kidnapping.

**Archived source account.** After two years on the run, Mexican officials arrest the former police chief of a Mexican city, Felipe Flores, capturing him in Iguala in the southern state of Guerrero. The city is where 43 students disappeared in September 2014. The police arrested the students and then handed them over to a drug cartel who killed them and incinerated their bodies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-37735267>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-10-21-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Tennessee Valley Authority completes the Watts Bar Nuclear Plant, the first U.S. nuclear reactor to enter commercial operation in 20 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/20/us/tennessee-nuclear-power-plant/index.html>).

### 2016-10-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364375755](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2022&oldid=1364375755>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), Battle of Mosul (2016–2017).

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant executes at least 284 people in Mosul.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/10/22/middleeast/iraq-isis-mosul/>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/363735-isis-executes-mosul-civilians/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Eséka train derailment.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the October 21 crash of a Camrail train rises to at least 73 people with another 600 wounded.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/10/22/498963468/at-least-70-die-in-train-derailment-in-cameroon-hundreds-injured>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/10/22/498963468/at-least-70-die-in-train-derailment-in-cameroon-hundreds-injured>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Philippines–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Philippine Foreign Affairs Secretary Perfecto Yasay states that the United States remains our "closest friend," but that the Philippines wants to break away and forge closer ties with other nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-china-idUSKCN12M0HP>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 174 inmates escape in Arcahaie, Haiti, leaving one guard dead. Authorities seek the fugitives with support from UN peacekeepers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-haiti-prison-idUSKCN12M0VP>).

<a id="event-2016-10-22-3-2"></a>

Context: October 2016 Dyn cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** Security analysts state that the October 21 denial-of-service attacks on Internet performance management company Dyn was perpetrated using Mirai malware-created botnets that used consumer internet of things (IoT) smart devices, such as digital video recorders, cable set-top boxes, routers, etc. Technology experts warn that the security included with IoT is weak, or sometimes even nonexistent.,

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/news/2016/10/22/household-smart-devices-hijacked-massive-internet-attack/92583398/>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/2016/10/22/Hackers-used-smart-home-devices-to-carry-out-Dyn-cyberattack/2061477141377/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2016-10-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** A public poll on the internet in Russia selects the cartoon wolf Zabivaka as the official mascot of the 2018 FIFA World Cup, which the country will host in June and July 2018.,

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2016-10/22/c_135773310.htm>); [FIFA](<https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/news/y=2016/m=10/news=wolf-chosen-2018-fifa-world-cup-official-mascot-and-named-zabivaka-2845435.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-22-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In rugby union, the New Zealand All Blacks win a record 18th consecutive test match, defeating the Australian Wallabies 37–10 at Eden Park, Kingsland, Auckland, New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-10-22/wallabies-thwarted-again-by-record-breaking-all-blacks/7957500>).

<a id="event-2016-10-22-4-4"></a>

Context: Major League Baseball.

**Archived source account.** The Chicago Cubs defeat the Los Angeles Dodgers and win the National League Championship Series 4–2, advancing to the World Series for the first time since 1945.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/recap?gameId=361022116>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/22/us/chicago-cubs-world-series-bid/index.html?adkey=bn>).

<a id="event-2016-10-22-4-6"></a>

Context: College football.

**Archived source account.** The unranked Penn State Nittany Lions upset the \#2 Ohio State Buckeyes, 24-21, at Beaver Stadium.

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<https://gopsusports.com/news/2016/10/23/penn-state-stuns-no-2-ohio-state-24-21>).

<a id="event-2016-10-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of Brexit, UK Independence Party leadership election, November 2016.

**Archived source account.** Suzanne Evans, former UK Independence Party (UKIP) deputy chairman, and Paul Nuttall, President of the Initiative for Direct Democracy in Europe and Member of the European Parliament, each announce their candidacy for the UKIP leadership position, now held on interim basis by Nigel Farage. Other confirmed candidates are Bill Etheridge, Raheem Kassam, and Peter Whittle.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lithuania-election-idUSKCN12N0DM>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_LITHUANIA_ELECTION?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

Context: 2015–16 Spanish government formation 2016 PSOE crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/10/23/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-politics.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-socialist-idUSKCN12N0IU>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Wendy Demchick-Alloy, a Montgomery County court judge in Norristown, sentences former Pennsylvania Attorney General Kathleen Kane to serve 10 to 23 months in county jail for leaking confidential grand jury information and then lying about it to investigators. Specifically, she was convicted on August 15 on charges of perjury, false swearing, obstruction of justice, official oppression, and conspiracy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pennsylvania-kane-idUSKCN12O133>).

### 2016-10-26

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** A militant group affiliated with ISIL seizes the coastal town of Qandala in the autonomous Puntland region.
