<a id="event-2016-10-26-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Ghor Province Governor's spokesman claims ISIL insurgents killed 26-42 civilians in his governed province, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-kidnapping-idUSKCN12Q0HY>).

<a id="event-2016-10-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Syrian or Russian warplanes conduct airstrikes on a residential area and a school in Haas village in rebel-held Idlib Governorate, killing at least 26 civilians, most of them children.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-attack-idUSKCN12Q19D>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A series of earthquakes strikes a region of Central Italy already impacted by a major quake in August. Many buildings are damaged or destroyed across several towns.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/27/europe/italy-earthquake/>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2016-10-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A research team led by an evolutionary biologist at the University of Arizona publishes a paper in Nature on the genetic history of HIV proving that Gaëtan Dugas, the Canadian flight attendant who had been identified for years as "Patient Zero" of the AIDS epidemic in the U.S., did not spread the virus to the country. The study indicates that HIV first spread to the U.S. from the Caribbean around 1970.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-37767179>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/10/27/health/hiv-patient-zero-genetic-analysis.html?_r=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gambia says it will join South Africa and Burundi in withdrawing from the International Criminal Court, accusing the court of ignoring "Western war crimes" like the Kunduz hospital airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-37771592>).

<a id="event-2016-10-26-3-2"></a>

Context: NATO–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia withdraws a request to refuel three of its warships, including the flagship of the Russian Navy, Admiral Kuznetsov, en route to Syria, at the Spanish port of Ceuta following NATO pressure on the Spanish government to not allow the warships to dock.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-37779204>).

<a id="event-2016-10-26-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** For the first time in 25 years, the United States abstains in a United Nations vote calling for an end to its Cuban economic embargo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cuba-un-idUSKCN12Q259>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/10/26/499469386/for-first-time-u-s-abstains-on-u-n-resolution-condemning-cuba-embargo>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-10-26-4-1"></a>

Context: 2014–16 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** An unknown gunman shoots a Venezuelan police officer dead. Two other officers sustain injuries during protests against the Government of Venezuela. Approximately 120 Opposition supporters also sustain injuries during the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20161027003653-0fp68>).

### 2016-10-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122241](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2027&oldid=1076122241>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-10-27-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan's Prince Mikasa, the oldest member of the Imperial Family, dies at the age of 100.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-royals-prince-misaka-idUSKCN12R07B>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Republican Party vice presidential candidate Mike Pence's campaign plane skids off the runway at LaGuardia Airport with no injuries reported. The runway is said to have sustained damage causing the closure of the airport; a planned fundraiser was also canceled.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-pence-idUSKCN12S007?il=0>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/27/politics/plane-carrying-pence-skids-off-runway/?sr=google_news>); [ABC](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/mike-pence-plane-skids-off-runway-nycs-laguardia/story?id=43120056>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Canada–European Union relations, Belgium–Canada relations.

**Archived source account.** Belgian politicians, including those from the dissident Wallonia region, agree on Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement language that addresses Walloon concerns. This ends the deadlock on CETA, though the revised text must again be approved by the other 27 EU member states.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-canada-trade-idUSKCN12R0XQ>).

<a id="event-2016-10-27-2-3"></a>

Context: India-Pakistan relations.

**Archived source account.** India and Pakistan each expel a diplomat from the other country as tensions grow over Kashmir.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/10/27/world/asia/ap-as-pakistan-india.html?_r=0>); [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20161101180618/http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/reuters/india--pakistan-to-expel-diplomats-amid-kashmir-tension/42549152>).

<a id="event-2016-10-27-2-5"></a>

Context: Philippines–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The San Francisco Police Department halts a training program between itself and the Philippine National Police over allegations of civil rights violations committed under the guise of the Philippine Drug War.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/move-ph/balikbayan/150331-san-francisco-police-pnp-drug-war>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Occupation of the Malheur National Wildlife Refuge.

**Archived source account.** Seven members of the militia who occupied the wildlife refuge, including the leader Ammon Bundy, was acquitted of all federal charges related to the takeover.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/10/28/us/bundy-brothers-acquitted-in-takeover-of-oregon-wildlife-refuge.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-37795012>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-10-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA announces the return of the final piece of data collected during New Horizons' flyby of Pluto in July 2015. The data, taking about five hours at light speed to travel across 5.5 billion kilometers (3.4 billion miles), arrived at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory on the morning of October 25.

Source citations (as archived): [NASA](<http://www.nasa.gov/feature/new-horizons-returns-last-bits-of-2015-flyby-data-to-earth>).

### 2016-10-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122188](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2028&oldid=1076122188>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / Battle of Mosul (2016–2017).

**Archived source account.** The UN reports 232 civilians have been murdered in and near Mosul by the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/10/28/middleeast/iraq-mosul-isis/>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/u-n-says-isis-executes-230-people-uses-tens-thousands-n674446>).

<a id="event-2016-10-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Aleppo offensive.

**Archived source account.** More than 15 civilians are reported killed and another 100 injured as Syria's Army of Conquest and other jihadist rebels launch an offensive to break the government-led siege on eastern Aleppo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/mideast-crisis-syria-offensive-idINKCN12S0UJ>); [ARA News](<http://aranews.net/2016/10/syria-rebels-launch-offensive-break-regime-siege-eastern-aleppo/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Aleppo offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin rejects the Russian military’s request to resume airstrikes in eastern Aleppo, instead letting the humanitarian pause continue.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/364565-russia-putin-resume-airstrikes/>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/mideast-crisis-syria-aleppo-putin-idINR4N1CR024>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-28-1-1"></a>

Context: American Airlines Flight 383 (2016).

**Archived source account.** An American Airlines Boeing 767 catches fire after an aborted takeoff at Chicago's O'Hare International Airport. Seven passengers and one flight attendant were injured, and taken to area hospitals.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/28/us/ohare-aircraft-incident/index.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-28-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire destroys the historic Royal Clarence Hotel in Exeter, Devon, which is described as the oldest hotel in England.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-devon-37796576>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At an annual meeting of the Convention for the Conservation of Antarctic Marine Living Resources in Hobart, Australia, twenty-four countries and the European Union agree to create the world's largest marine park in Antarctica's Ross Sea. The marine park will cover more than 12 percent of the Southern Ocean, and will be protected from commercial fishing for 35 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-environment-antarctic-park-idUSKCN12S02C>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Datu Saudi-Ampatuan mayor Samsudin Dimaukom, publicly accused by Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte of involvement in the illegal drug trade, is killed, along with nine others, by Philippine police at a highway checkpoint in what police describe as an anti-drug operation.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/10/29/world/asia/philippines-duterte-mayor-police.html?_r=0>); [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/nation/2016/10/28/1638270/2-security-killed-along-narco-mayor-just-hired-private-firm>).

<a id="event-2016-10-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Bernard Madoff.

**Archived source account.** Irving Picard, a court-appointed trustee liquidating the Madoff asset management firm, says that he has reached a settlement with the family of the late Stanley Chais, in connection with monies that had been funneled from California investors, through Chais, into Madoff's Ponzi scheme.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-madoff-chais-idUSKCN12S1Y1>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2016-10-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Hillary Clinton email controversy.

**Archived source account.** James Comey informs Congress that "the FBI has learned of the existence of emails that appear pertinent to the investigation." He says the FBI has not yet assessed the importance or significance of these emails.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/28/politics/fbi-reviewing-new-emails-in-clinton-probe-director-tells-senate-judiciary-committee/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-28-4-2"></a>

Context: Hillary Clinton email controversy.

**Archived source account.** Representatives in the Trump and Clinton campaigns call for Comey to reveal more information about this new investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [Observer](<http://observer.com/2016/10/hillary-clinton-demands-fbi-release-newly-discovered-anthony-weiner-emails/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Hillary Clinton email controversy.

**Archived source account.** Law enforcement officials say the emails in question were found during the course of an investigation into illicit texts sent to a fifteen year old girl by former Congressman Anthony Weiner, on electronic devices formerly shared by Weiner and his estranged wife, Huma Abedin.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/10/29/us/politics/fbi-hillary-clinton-email.html>).

### 2016-10-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076122157](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20October%2029&oldid=1076122157>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Sectarianism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and several other civilians injured as armed terrorists, targeting Shia Muslims, open fire on participants of a Majlis at a home in the Nazimabad district of Karachi, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Samaa TV](<http://www.samaa.tv/pakistan/2016/10/five-killed-in-gun-attack-on-karachi-majlis/>); [The Express Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/1214380/five-killed-firing-nazimabad-majlis/>).

<a id="event-2016-10-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Boko Haram suicide bombers kill at least eight people in the Nigerian city of Maiduguri.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AF_NIGERIA_BOKO_HARAM_SUICIDE_BOMBS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2016-10-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Two prisons in Al Hudaydah, Yemen, are bombed by Saudi Arabian jets, leaving at least 60 dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-strike-idUSKCN12U03R>); [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/10/29/world/middleeast/ap-ml-yemen-airstrikes.html?_r=0>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-37813569>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-10-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rain and flooding in Egypt kills at least 18 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Naharnet](<http://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/219344-rains-floods-kill-18-in-egypt>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-10-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Turkey-United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department orders family members of employees at the U.S. Consulate General in Istanbul to leave as extremist groups threaten to kill or kidnap U.S. citizens and Westerners.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/u-s-orders-family-members-leave-consulate-istanbul-n675151>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-10-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Choi Soon-sil gate.

**Archived source account.** South Korean prosecutors raid the presidential Blue House in Seoul amid continuing fallout over President Park Geun-hye's influence-peddling scandal involving cult leader Choi Soon-sil.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-koreas-prosecutors-raid-homes-offices-of-presidential-aides-in-probe-over>).

<a id="event-2016-10-29-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The New York City Metropolitan Opera cancels its Saturday performances as a man, during an afternoon intermission, sprinkled an unidentified powder, suspected to be cremated ashes, into the orchestra pit. One person was exposed and requested medical attention.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-new-york-opera-idUSKCN12U00S>); [CBS News/AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/suspicious-powder-found-at-nyc-met-opera-nypd-says/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-10-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Spanish government formation.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish Parliament votes to allow Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy to lead a People's Party minority government after a ten month interregnum.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-37813195>).

<a id="event-2016-10-29-4-3"></a>

Context: Icelandic parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** With about 25 percent of the votes counted, the Independence Party is receiving about 30 percent of the ballots cast. The Pirate Party, which led in most of this month's polls, is getting about 13 percent.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/9defc6ffb7d244d481864dd4d1489e50/pirates-aim-gains-icelanders-choose-new-government>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-10-29-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Japan Series.

**Archived source account.** In baseball, the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters defeat the Hiroshima Toyo Carp to win the Japan Series.,

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<http://kyodonews.net/news/2016/10/29/86060>); [The Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/2016/10/30/baseball/japanese-baseball/fighters-wrap-japan-series-title-dramatic-eighth-inning-fireworks/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-10-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dubai based Abraaj Group agreed to sell its majority shares in K-Electric to China’s state-backed Shanghai Electric Power Company with a transaction of US $ 1.77 billion.

<a id="event-2016-10-30-2-1"></a>

Context: October 2016 Central Italy earthquakes.

<a id="event-2016-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Zika virus outbreak timeline.

**Archived source account.** Vietnam reports its first microcephaly case likely to be linked to the Zika virus.

<a id="event-2016-10-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Canada–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau and EU officials sign the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-37814884>).

<a id="event-2016-10-30-4-3"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations and Nigeria come to an agreement to release 876 children being held due to suspicions that they are tied to Boko Haram.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org/item/20161028150607-d5f59/?source%3DreOtherNews3>).

<a id="event-2016-10-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States orders all civilian staff family members to leave its consulate in Istanbul, Turkey, due to increasing threats from terrorist organizations.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-10-30-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Turkish purges.

**Archived source account.** Turkey dismisses another 10,000 civil servants and closes 15 more media outlets for alleged ties to terrorist organizations and cleric Fethullah Gülen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-dismissals-idUSKBN12U04L>).

<a id="event-2016-10-30-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Agricultural Bank of China chief executive Jiang Chaoliang is appointed Communist Party Secretary of Hubei province, filling the vacancy left by Li Hongzhong.

Source citations (as archived): [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2016-10/29/content_27214977.htm>).

<a id="event-2016-10-30-6-4"></a>

Context: Moldovan presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Moldova go to the polls for a presidential election. A run off election will be held on November 13 between Igor Dodon and Maia Sandu after no candidate achieved a majority of votes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/10/31/moldovan-presidential-election-goes-to-runoff.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-30-6-6"></a>

Context: Icelandic parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Iceland’s incumbent, centre-right Independence Party surprised pollsters by winning 29 percent of the vote (21 seats), thereby putting leader Bjarni Benediktsson in position to organize another coalition government. The Progressive Party, the current ruling partner, garnered 11.5% and eight positions, a loss of 11 seats. The new Pirate Party didn't perform as predicted with 14.5% of the ballots, though it did get 10 seats, an increase of seven more positions in the 63-seat parliament (Althing).

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/iceland-s-radical-pirate-party-falls-short-parliamentary-election-n675516>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-10-30/pirate-party-surge-falls-short-as-icelanders-back-stability>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/oct/30/iceland-elections-ruling-centre-right-party-pirate-party>); [Iceland Review](<http://icelandreview.com/news/2016/10/29/election-facts>).

<a id="event-2016-10-30-6-7"></a>

Context: Icelandic parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Sigurður Ingi Jóhannsson, leader of the Progressive Party, resigns.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/iceland-prime-minister-resigns-sigurdur-ingi-johannsson-pirate-party-a7387846.html>).

<a id="event-2016-10-30-6-8"></a>

Context: Icelandic parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Icelandic voters elect 30 women to parliament, the most ever for the island nation. Voter turnout was under 80 percent, the lowest ever.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/10/30/499973354/women-win-30-seats-in-icelands-parliament-more-than-any-party>); [New York](<http://nymag.com/thecut/2016/10/women-now-make-up-almost-half-of-icelands-parliament.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-10-30-7-1"></a>

Context: 2016 World Series.

**Archived source account.** The Chicago Cubs defeat the Cleveland Indians 3 runs to 2 at Illinois' Wrigley Field in Game 5 of the 2016 World Series to avoid elimination and force a Game 6 with the series standing at 3 games to 2 in favor of the Cleveland Indians. It is the Cubs' first-ever win of a World Series game at the stadium since October 1945.

Source citations (as archived): [MLB](<http://m.mlb.com/news/article/207629726/cubs-edge-indians-to-keep-title-hopes-alive/>).

### 2016-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1170533461](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20November%201&oldid=1170533461>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

Context: Battle of Mosul (2016).

<a id="event-2016-11-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Battle of Mosul (2016).

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-iraq-mosul-islamic-state-20161101-story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-01-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The predominantly African American Hopewell Missionary Baptist Church in Greenville Mississippi burned down to brick walls and spray painted with "Vote Trump" in what appeared to be a political hate crime. Andrew McClinton, a black member of the church was arrested, charged and later pleaded guilty to burning the church in a race hoax

Dozens other workers remain missing as many injured are transferred to hospitals in nearby Karachi.

<a id="event-2016-11-01-1-2"></a>

<a id="event-2016-11-01-3-5"></a>

Context: United States elections, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/democrats-accuse-gop-donald-trump-of-voter-intimidation-in-four-states/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-intimidation-idUSKBN12V28G>).

<a id="event-2016-11-01-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iranian parliament approves three President Hassan Rouhani's new designated ministers, including Reza Salehi Amiri, Fakhruddin Danesh-Ashtiani and Masoud Soltanifar as culture, education and sports ministers respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-politics-cabinet-idUSKBN12W4AJ?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>); [PressTV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2016/11/01/491659/Iran-Parliament-Hassan-Rouhani-Massoud-Soltanifar-Fakhroddin-Ahmadi-Danesh-Ashtiani-Reza-Salehi-Amiri>).

**Archived source account.** In thoroughbred horse racing, Almandin, ridden by Kerrin McEvoy, trained by Robert Hickmott and owned by five-time winner Lloyd Williams, wins the 156th Melbourne Cup.

### 2016-11-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076121935](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20November%202&oldid=1076121935>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-11-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

**Archived source account.** New analysis by the Australian Transport Safety Bureau suggests that no-one was controlling Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 as it plunged into the southern Indian Ocean in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/11/01/new-mh370-analysis-suggests-no-one-at-controls-during-crash.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-02-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese state media reports that all 33 miners trapped underground have been found dead on Monday after a gas explosion at Jinshangou Coal Mine in Laisu Town of Yongchuan District in Chongqing, and preliminary investigations have been started.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_CHINA_MINE_EXPLOSION_THE_LATEST_ASOL-?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2016-11/02/c_135800829.htm>).

#### International relations

Context: Philippines–United States relations, Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** United States State Department blocks the sale of firearms to the Philippines due to concerns of human rights violations.,

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-11-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Park Geun-hye seeks to appoint Kim Byong-joon as the new Prime Minister of South Korea in a bid to restore confidence after a political scandal. Kim Byong-joon replaces sacked prime minister Hwang Kyo-ahn.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_SKOREA_POLITICS_ASOL-?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/11/02/asia/south-korea-park-guen-hye-choi-soon-sil/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-11-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 shootings of Des Moines police officers.

**Archived source account.** Two police officers are shot and killed in separate "ambush-style" attacks in Urbandale and Des Moines, Iowa. A suspect in both shootings was identified and was captured by police two hours later.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/11/02/us/iowa-police-shooting/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2016-11-02-4-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-11-02-4-2"></a>

Context: 2016 World Series.

**Archived source account.** In American Major League Baseball, the Chicago Cubs defeat the Cleveland Indians 8–7 in 10 innings, winning the Series 4–3 and claiming their first MLB title since 1908. The Cubs' Ben Zobrist is named series MVP. Cubs win game 7 and the title in the early hours of November 3rd, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/recap?gameId=361102105>).

### 2016-11-03

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** Muslim rebel group Moro National Liberation Front leader Nur Misuari meets with Philippines president Rodrigo Duterte in Malacañang Palace after receiving a reprieve from previous crimes of rebellion.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/839619/misuari-already-in-manila-to-meet-duterte>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-11-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 22 people have been killed and 65 injured following a collision of the Bahauddin Zakaria Express with a stationary train at Juma Goth Train station, Karachi, Pakistan.

<a id="event-2016-11-03-2-1"></a>

Context: India-Pakistan relations.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan accuses eight Indian diplomats of espionage and terrorism amid rising tensions concerning Kashmir. India said it rejects these allegations. The six Pakistani diplomats withdrawn from India last week were reported to have been accused of spying.

<a id="event-2016-11-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Todd Kohlhepp.

### 2016-11-04

<a id="event-2016-11-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a boat accident near Singapore reaches 54. The victims are mostly Indonesian migrant workers.

#### Health

<a id="event-2016-11-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Tobacco smoke.

**Archived source account.** A research team at Los Alamos National Laboratory quantifies the molecular damage inflicted on DNA and discloses that every 50 cigarettes smoked generates an average of one DNA mutation in each lung cell.

Source citations (as archived): [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2111320-every-50-cigarettes-smoked-cause-one-dna-mutation-per-lung-cell/>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/science/sciencenow/la-sci-sn-smoking-cancer-mutations-20161103-story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-04-5-1"></a>

Context: Fort Lee lane closure scandal.

**Archived source account.** Two former associates of New Jersey Governor Chris Christie, former deputy chief of staff Bridget Kelly and ex-Port Authority executive Bill Baroni, are found guilty on all seven counts by a federal jury from their roles in the so-called Bridgegate scandal that created crippling traffic near the George Washington Bridge in September 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/11/05/nyregion/bridgegate-conviction.html>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2016-11-04/christie-allies-guilty-of-plotting-bridge-jams-to-punish-mayor>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/christie-associates-found-guilty-roles-bridgegate-article-1.2858140>).

Context: Todd Kohlhepp.

**Archived source account.** A body, later identified as the boyfriend of a missing woman rescued on the previous day, was discovered on Kohlhepp's property.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/kala-brown-freed-south-carolina-captive-boyfriend-had-answered-cleaning-job-ad-to-property/>).

<a id="event-2016-11-04-6-1"></a>

Context: Palauan presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent President of Palau Tommy Remengesau narrowly leads his brother-in-law, Surangel Whipps Jr., by 78 votes. Final results are expected to be announced later in November.

Context: 2016 South Korean political scandal.

**Archived source account.** The President of South Korea Park Geun-hye accepts full blame for the scandal over the influence of religious figure Choi Soon-sil in Park's administration and vows to accept the results of an independent investigation into her actions.

NDTV denies the charges, and says it will challenge this unprecedented order.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/11/04/world/asia/ap-as-india-news-channel-ban.html?_r=0>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/1-day-ban-on-TV-channel-over-terror-coverage/articleshow/55235279.cms>).

Context: Donald Trump presidential campaign, 2016.

**Archived source account.** A study of former fashion model and current wife of presidential candidate Donald Trump Melania Trump's work history shows that she was an illegal worker in the United States before she received legal authorization.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2016/11/05/melania-trump-modeled-in-us-prior-to-getting-work-visa.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-04-6-9"></a>

Context: Donald Trump presidential campaign, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The National Enquirer reportedly paid former Playboy model Karen McDougal US$150,000 for a story about an alleged affair she had with Donald Trump in 2006. The tabloid however suppressed the story.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2016/11/05/national-enquirer-paid-150g-for-trump-affair-story-then-suppressed-it.html>).

Context: Spanish general election, 2016 2015–16 Spanish government formation.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/elpais/2016/11/04/inenglish/1478246610_894323.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-11-09-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election and 2016 United States elections.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Trump defeated Clinton in the Electoral College; Clinton led the national popular vote. The National Archives records the eventual certified electoral result.

Editorial date: 2016-11-09. Checked: 2026-10-22. The result and split vote are supported. The fifth-occurrence ranking, 2000 comparison and exact moment of president-elect status are not established by these two opened tables. Electoral votes were cast later, not on November 9.

Evidence: [US National Archives](<https://www.archives.gov/electoral-college/2016>); [University of California Santa Barbara, American Presidency Project](<https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/statistics/elections/2016>).

Original source account: Donald Trump, the Republican nominee for the 2016 presidential election, becomes the president-elect of the United States after defeating Hillary Clinton, the Democratic nominee in the electoral college. It is the fifth time in United States history where the winning candidate lost the popular vote, the last such defeat occurring in 2000 when George W. Bush defeated Al Gore.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

**Archived source account.** 2016 Bagram Airfield bombing: An explosion at NATO's Bagram Airfield kills four Americans and injures at least 16 U.S. service members and a Polish soldier. The Taliban claims responsibility.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast-idUSKBN137037>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/taliban-claims-us-base-attack-in-afghanistan/news-story/d3e89ac00e4619626911a7641f826388>).

<a id="event-2016-11-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Six Vietnamese sailors are kidnapped by the Abu Sayyaf off the coast of the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/gunmen-philippines-kidnap-six-vietnamese-sailors-near-abu-sayyaf-heartland-519985>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-11-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunshots are fired in Crossgates Mall in Guilderland, New York. Police report the mall has been cleared; they are looking for one suspect.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/authorities-reports-of-shots-fired-at-new-york-mall/2016/11/12/89425dc4-a91c-11e6-ba46-53db57f0e351_story.html>); [WTEN-TV](<http://news10.com/2016/11/12/breaking-active-shooters-in-crossgates-mall/>).

<a id="event-2016-11-12-1-2"></a>

Context: Killing of Cecil the lion.

**Archived source account.** A Zimbabwe high court judge drops charges against Theo Bronkhorst, the professional hunter who led the expedition that resulted in the death of the lion named Cecil, because the prosecutor's filing was not properly constituted, and was "too vague to enable (the defendant) to mount a proper defense."

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/11/12/Zimbabwe-court-drops-charges-against-hunter-in-Cecil-the-lion-death/3511478970996/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [News24](<http://www.news24.com/Africa/Zimbabwe/charges-against-cecil-the-lion-hunter-dropped-lawyer-20161110>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-11-12-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016 South Korean protests.

**Archived source account.** As many as 1,000,000 people march on the presidential Blue House in Seoul, South Korea, calling for the resignation of President Park Geun-hye amid an ongoing corruption scandal. It is the largest protest in South Korea since the protests against U.S. beef imports in 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/south-koreans-gather-en-masse-for-protest-against-president/2016/11/12/602cf658-a85c-11e6-ba46-53db57f0e351_story.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-37958037>); [Newsis](<http://www.newsis.com/ar_detail/view.html?ar_id=NISX20161112_0014513219&amp;cID=10201&amp;pID=10200>).

<a id="event-2016-11-12-2-3"></a>

Context: Anti-Trump protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests against American president-elect Donald Trump continue in his hometown New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/11/13/us/trump-protest-rallies.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-12-2-5"></a>

Context: Colombia ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Colombia and rebel group FARC announce a new peace deal after an earlier agreement was rejected by a referendum six weeks ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Noticias Caracol](<http://noticias.caracoltv.com/acuerdo-final/gobierno-y-farc-ya-tienen-listo-el-nuevo-acuerdo-de-paz>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-37965392>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-idUSKBN13804H?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch says that Kurdish Regional Government forces have destroyed Arab homes and villages in northern Iraq in what may amount to a war crime.

<a id="event-2016-11-13-0-6"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / Battle of Mosul (2016–2017).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says an explosion from a suspected airstrike at a border crossing in Kurdish-held Afrin Canton kills 12 people.

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** A new class action lawsuit, filed on Tuesday in U.S. federal court in Illinois, claims the Volkswagen Group used emission defeat devices in at least six of its Audi V6 gasoline engines.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/2016/11/13/New-emissions-scandal-linked-to-Audi-gasoline-models/1591479062166/?spt=hts&amp;or=2>); [Auto Week](<http://autoweek.com/article/vw-diesel-scandal/lawsuit-audi-used-defeat-devices-several-gas-engined-models>); [Industry Week](<http://www.industryweek.com/regulations/audi-hit-fresh-emissions-cheating-lawsuit>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Australia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Australia and the United States reach a deal to relocate asylum seekers from Nauru and Papua New Guinea's Manus Island to the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<https://au.news.yahoo.com/a/33192355/one-off-deal-to-send-refugees-to-us/#page1>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-11-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte threatens to suspend the country's habeas corpus "if forced to" by what he says the worsening lawlessness in the country. He mentioned in the same speech, the alleged widespread illegal drug trade in the country, the rebellion in Mindanao, and the worsening campaign against the militant Maute group.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/843695/duterte-warns-of-suspension-of-habeas-corpus-writ>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Bulgarian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Bulgarians head to the polls in a presidential runoff between BSP backed Rumen Radev, of the socialist opposition, and Tsetska Tsacheva, Chairwoman of the National Assembly, from incumbent prime-minister Boyko Borisov's conservative GERB. Exit polls by Alpha Research and Gallup International show Radev with about 58 percent of the vote with Tsacheva getting around 35 percent.

Source citations (as archived): [novinite.com](<http://www.novinite.com/articles/177385/Turnout+in+Bulgaria&#x27;s+Runoff+at+13%3A00+Slightly+Higher+Than+in+1st+Round>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bulgaria-election-exitpoll-idUSKBN1380Q7>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-3"></a>

Context: Moldovan presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Moldova head to the polls in the country's presidential runoff between two opposition candidates, Igor Dodon, from the pro-Russian socialist PSRM, and Maia Sandu, from the pro-EU liberal PAS, with Dodon expected to win. Preliminary results, in this first Moldovan election where the president is chosen by national votes rather than by parliament, will be announced Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [ABCNEWS](<https://web.archive.org/web/20161113204407/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pro-russia-candidate-favorite-moldova-presidential-runoff-43501034>); [Voice of America](<http://www.voanews.com/a/moldova-election-results/3594270.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-5"></a>

Context: 2016 South Korean political scandal.

**Archived source account.** A South Korean official says prosecutors will question President Park Geun-hye, no later than Wednesday, about the political corruption scandal. This will be the first time a sitting president is questioned by prosecutors in a criminal case.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-politics-probe-idUSKBN138012>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-7"></a>

Context: Presidential transition of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** President-elect of the United States Donald Trump says he plans to deport or imprison up to 3 million illegal migrants, targeting those with criminal records.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/election-us-2016-37969112>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-9"></a>

Context: Presidential transition of Donald Trump / Proposed cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** President-elect Donald Trump names Republican National Committee chairman Reince Priebus as his White House Chief of Staff.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-37970146>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-10"></a>

Context: Presidential transition of Donald Trump / Proposed cabinet of Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/donald-trump-makes-extreme-right-stephen-bannon-his-chief-strategist-10657033>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-12"></a>

Context: Presidential transition of Donald Trump / United States–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** European Union foreign ministers hold an emergency meeting to assess the impact of the election of Donald Trump as U.S. president on EU-U.S. relations. U.K. and French foreign ministers do not participate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/eu-foreign-ministers-meet-to-figure-out-what-to-do-now-that-trump-has-won/2016/11/13/c0c95ed8-a9bb-11e6-8f19-21a1c65d2043_story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-14"></a>

Context: Presidential transition of Donald Trump / Protests against Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Trump's campaign manager Kellyanne Conway asks outgoing U.S. President Barack Obama and former U.S. First Lady and Democratic Party presidential nominee Hillary Clinton to discourage the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/the-fix/wp/2016/11/13/kellyanne-conway-its-up-to-hillary-clinton-obama-to-calm-anti-trump-protesters/>).

<a id="event-2016-11-13-5-16"></a>

Context: 2016 Turkish purges.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Defense Ministry announces about 300 Turkish naval officers, suspected of having ties to the failed government coup, have been suspended or dismissed.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/11/13/Turkey-suspends-dismisses-300-naval-personnel-over-coup-attempt/5711479064094/?spt=hts&amp;or=1>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-11-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Brexit aftermath.

**Archived source account.** There is no plan for Brexit, according to a critical leaked memo from the consulting firm Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited. The document indicates Whitehall is working on 500 Brexit-related projects. Both Deloitte and the British Government confirm the document is an internal working document from Deloitte that was compiled without government approval or assistance.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-international-criminal-court-icc-leaves-pulls-out-withdraws-putin-assad-syria-war-aleppo-a7420676.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-16-3-0"></a>

<a id="event-2016-11-17-1-1"></a>

Context: The 17th Annual Latin Grammy Awards are held at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada..

**Editorial account; source review complete.** La Bicicleta won Record and Song of the Year at the 2016 Latin Grammys. The recording credits Carlos Vives and Shakira; the songwriting award also credits Andres Castro.

Editorial date: 2016-11-17. Checked: 2026-10-22. The award results are supported. The separate songwriting credit avoids implying that the performers were the sole award recipients.

Evidence: [Latin Recording Academy](<https://www.latingrammy.com/en/awards/17th-annual-latin-grammy-awards-2016/>).

Original source account: "La Bicicleta" by Carlos Vives and Shakira wins the Latin Grammy Awards for Song of the Year and Record of the Year.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2016-11-17-1-2"></a>

Context: The 17th Annual Latin Grammy Awards are held at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada..

**Editorial account; source review complete.** The Academy lists Juan Gabriel and Los Duo 2 as Album of the Year winner. His awards were posthumous.

Editorial date: 2016-11-17. Checked: 2026-10-22. The Academy album title differs from the source display; original source spelling is retained.

Evidence: [Latin Recording Academy](<https://www.latingrammy.com/en/awards/17th-annual-latin-grammy-awards-2016/>); [Associated Press via Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/juan-gabriel-becomes-a-posthumous-double-winner-at-latin-grammys>).

Original source account: Juan Gabriel posthumously wins the Latin Grammy Award for Album of the Year for Los Dúo, Vol. 2

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2016-11-24-3-5"></a>

Context: Haitian presidential election, 2016–17.

**Archived source account.** Tensions spread in Haiti after both Maryse Narcisse of the Fanmi Lavalas party and Jovenel Moise of the Haitian Tèt Kale Party declare themselves winners.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/slideshow/tension-mounts-haiti-ahead-election-results-n687646>).

<a id="event-2016-11-24-3-7"></a>

Context: Austrian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Freedom Party of Austria presidential candidate Norbert Hofer intends to hold a referendum on European Union membership if elected.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38075644>).

<a id="event-2016-11-24-3-9"></a>

Context: Grenadian constitutional referendum, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Grenada choose whether they should be more independent from the British legal system, among other amendments.

Source citations (as archived): [Jamaica Observer](<http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/news/Grenadians-vote-on-referendum-today_81407>).

### 2016-11-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1255819651](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20November%2025&oldid=1255819651>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-11-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Legality of cannabis.

**Archived source account.** Legal sales of recreational-use marijuana, authorized by Alaska ballot measure 2 in 2014, begin in Juneau, the state capital of Alaska.

Source citations (as archived): [Juneau Empire](<http://juneauempire.com/local/2016-11-24/juneaus-first-marijuana-sale-goes-without-hitch>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia tells its partners in the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries that it will not attend a planned November 28 meeting in Vienna, out of unhappiness about intransigence from Iraq and Iran with regard to production cuts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-opec-saudi-idUSKBN13K1IU>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-11-25-1-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Manila announces the cancellation of 20 flights due to bad weather in the Philippines caused by Tropical Storm Marce.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA Network](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/story/590171/news/nation/canceled-flights-for-friday-nov-25-2016>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-1-3"></a>

Context: Semnan–Damghan train collision.

**Archived source account.** Two passenger trains collide in Iran's Semnan Province resulting in at least 44 deaths and 100 people injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-train-crash-idUSKBN13K0JV?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/11/25/world/middleeast/ap-ml-iran-train-collison.html>); [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3970524/Iran-state-TV-Train-collision-kills-5-20-reported-injured.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-1-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and two others injured after a fire breaks out in a migrant camp on the Greek island of Lesbos. The cause is currently under investigation, although some believe the fire was deliberately started in protest of poor living conditions, after a 66-year-old woman and a six-year-old child were killed in a gas explosion.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/11/25/two-dead-two-injured-fire-breaks-greek-migrant-camp>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/nov/25/fire-breaks-out-at-lesvos-migrant-camp-moria>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-1-6"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Protesters clash with police and gendarmerie members at the Harmanli refugee camp in Bulgaria following a quarantine placed on the camp amid fears of a disease outbreak. Prime Minister Boyko Borisov says five detainees would immediately be deported as a threat to national security.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/refugees-clash-with-authorities-in-bulgarian-greek-camps/a-36518439>); [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/11/25/bulgaria-pm-migrants-held-in-camp-clashes-will-be-deported.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-1-8"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people have died of extreme cold weather in the Darzab District of Afghanistan's Jozjan Province. All of the victims were displaced as a result of the ongoing civil conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_AFGHANISTAN_ASOL-?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-1-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heavy rains lead to widespread flooding across northern Italy as several rivers have overflowed. One person is missing, presumed drowned.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/11/heavy-rain-floods-northern-italy-161125092401356.html>); [EuroNews](<http://www.euronews.com/2016/11/24/torrential-rains-cause-widespread-flooding-in-northern-italy>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-11-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Accession of Turkey to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan threatens to open Turkey's borders to allow refugees and migrants to reach Europe after the European Parliament votes to temporarily freeze talks of Turkey's accession to the EU.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/11/turkey-threatens-eu-refugee-surge-161125123835003.html>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/erdogan-threatens-to-open-turkeys-border-with-europe-to-migrants-10671408>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-2-3"></a>

Context: United States–Yemen relations.

**Archived source account.** WikiLeaks releases 500 internal documents and emails allegedly from the American Embassy in Sana'a, Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.co.uk/wikileaks-releases-500-files-allegedly-showing-us-arming-funding-yemeni-forces-1593474>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Norway rejects NSA whistleblower Edward Snowden's extradition lawsuit against the Norwegian government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-security-snowden-lawsuit-idUSKBN13K1TR?il=0>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Sindh province of Pakistan passes a law against forced religious conversions, carrying a minimum five-year sentence and a maximum sentence of life imprisonment, following criticism over protection of minorities in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/11/pakistan-sindh-province-outlaws-forced-conversions-161125053322877.html>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The far-right mayor of the Hungarian border village of Ásotthalom, László Toroczkai, bans the open expression of Islam, including the construction of mosques and wearing of veils and headscarves, and the promotion of same-sex marriages.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/368202-burqas-mosques-gay-banned-hungarian>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-3-4"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Supreme Court questions the demolition of convicted terrorists' homes by the Israeli government after claims that the practice is used against Palestinians and not Israelis. The government has 30 days to respond before the court makes a decision on the practice.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/368111-palestinian-jewish-terrorists-homes>).

<a id="event-2016-11-25-3-6"></a>

Context: English football sexual abuse scandal.

**Archived source account.** Four police forces in England say they are actively investigating allegations of child sexual abuse in association football. Several ex-players have gone public with allegations against former Crewe Alexandra and Manchester City coach Barry Bennell.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-38107910?ocid=socialflow_twitter&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbcnews&amp;ns_source=twitter>).

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

<a id="event-2016-11-25-4-4"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election / Presidential transition of Donald Trump.

<a id="event-2016-11-25-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian Minister Geddel Vieira Lima resigns following allegations he and President Michel Temer pressured a fellow cabinet minister into approving a real estate project.

**Archived source account.** Government forces have captured most of Hanano, the largest rebel-controlled district in eastern Aleppo, and have begun pushing into neighboring 'Ard Al-Hamra and Jabal Badro districts.

<a id="event-2016-11-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The chief executive of Royal Dutch Shell, Ben van Beurden, denies the claim that his company's balance sheet contains any assets that will be "stranded," that is that will have to be written off, due to the Paris Climate Accord.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-11-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are dead, one person is missing and three others are rescued after a chartered fishing boat capsizes due to large waves in Kaipara Harbour, New Zealand.

<a id="event-2016-11-26-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 influenza A virus subtype H5N8 outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Avian flu virus H5N8 outbreaks are reported in birds in India, Germany, Finland, Ireland, the Netherlands, and several other European nations. The World Health Organization advised on 17 November that human infection is possible, but unlikely, based on information available.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-birdflu-india-idUSKBN13K1U9>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/11/25/world/europe/ap-eu-germany-bird-flu.html?_r=0>); [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/r-finland-confirms-h5n8-bird-flu-found-in-aland-islands-2016-11>); [Agriland](<http://www.agriland.ie/farming-news/over-215000-birds-destroyed-due-to-bird-flu-outbreaks-across-europe/#>); [Phys.org](<http://phys.org/news/2016-11-sweden-slaughters-hens-bird-flu.html>); [WHO](<http://www.who.int/influenza/human_animal_interface/avian_influenza/riskassessment_AH5N8_201611/en/>).

Context: Semnan–Damghan train collision.

**Archived source account.** Iran arrests three railway officials in connection with yesterday's deadly train crash in Semnan that killed 45 and injured 103 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/iran-arrests-three-over-deadly-train-crash-114903268.html>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2016/11/26/495238/Iran-Semnan-train-accident-Leader>).

<a id="event-2016-11-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cuban state television announces that former President Fidel Castro has died at age 90.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-38114953>).

<a id="event-2016-11-26-5-2"></a>

Context: 2016 South Korean protests.

**Archived source account.** South Koreans take to the streets en masse demanding the resignation of President Park Geun-hye amidst a corruption scandal. Around 1.5 million people rallied in the capital Seoul, while another 400,000 people demonstrated in provincial cities.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/11/south-koreans-urge-resignation-scandal-hit-president-161126132707796.html>).

Context: 2016 Kuwaiti general election.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait, where citizens make up around 30 percent of the emirate's 4.4 million population, votes in a snap election following parliament's dissolution on 16 October amid the impact of falling oil prices. This is the first election the opposition has not boycotted in nearly four years.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3973258/Polls-open-Kuwait-opposition-returns.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2016/11/26/politics/clinton-campaign-recount/index.html>).

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Aerocivil attributes the LaMia Avro RJ85 crash near its Rionegro destination to fuel exhaustion. The impact was at Cerro Gordo at 02:59 UTC November 29, corresponding to November 28 in Colombia.

Editorial date: 2016-11-28. Checked: 2026-10-22. The later investigative finding supports the cause. The destination airport serves Medellin; it is in Rionegro. The UTC/local distinction explains the report date without changing the source entry.

Evidence: [Colombia Aerocivil / GRIAA, report hosted by Airgways](<https://airgways.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/377593630-aerocivil-col-informe-final-sobre-el-accidente-de-la-empresa-lamia.pdf>).

Original source account: LaMia Flight 2933, an Avro RJ85, crashes after running out of fuel at Cerro Gordo en route to Medellín, Colombia

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/M/ML_YEMEN?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-38356058>).

<a id="event-2016-12-18-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A rock throwing 19-year old Palestinian is killed by IDF troops amid clashes in the West Bank village of Beit Rima.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<http://www.dailysabah.com/mideast/2016/12/18/israeli-soldiers-murder-palestinian-teen-for-throwing-a-rock>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/1.759664>).

<a id="event-2016-12-18-0-8"></a>

Context: 2016 Al-Karak attack.

**Archived source account.** Unknown militants stage a number of attacks across the city of Al-Karak in Jordan, killing five people and injuring at least 10 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/12/jordan-police-patrols-attacked-al-karak-161218131120902.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-12-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifth Harmony announces Camila Cabello's departure from the group.

Source citations (as archived): [Billboard](<https://www.billboard.com/articles/news/7625544/camila-cabello-leaves-fifth-harmony/>).

<a id="event-2016-12-18-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Stephanie Del Valle of Puerto Rico is named as Miss World 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/12/19/miss-world-2016-puerto-ricos-stephanie-del-valle-wins/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-12-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 49 people die in Irkutsk, Russia after consuming hawthorn-scented bath essence as if it were alcohol. The product has been found to contain methanol.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/19/world/europe/russia-bath-lotion-deaths.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38363441>).

<a id="event-2016-12-18-2-2"></a>

Context: 2016 Indonesian Air Force Lockheed C-130 Hercules crash.

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian military Lockheed C-130 Hercules transport plane crashes in Papua province killing all 13 people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20161218214428/http://www.startribune.com/indonesian-military-plane-crashes-in-papua-killing-all-13/407255046/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-12-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Gambian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Leaders from the West African bloc ECOWAS and from the Organization of Islamic Cooperation plead with Gambian long-time President Yahya Jammeh who lost in the recently held elections to step aside or face consequences.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/12/jammeh-step-west-african-leaders-161217134207866.html>); [Quartz](<http://qz.com/865333/muslim-countries-are-asking-gambias-president-yahya-jammeh-to-step-down/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-12-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Ivorian parliamentary election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Côte d'Ivoire votes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Voice of America](<http://www.voanews.com/a/ivory-coast-parliament-election/3640999.html>).

### 2016-12-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090028979](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20December%2019&oldid=1090028979>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-12-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Assassination of Andrei Karlov.

**Archived source account.** The Russian ambassador to Turkey Andrei Karlov is killed in a gun attack at an art gallery in Ankara. Russia calls the assassin, 22-year old police officer, Mevlüt Mert Altıntaş, a "terrorist". Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu goes to Moscow for a planned trilateral meeting on Syria, saying "the incident will not impact relations between Turkey and Russia".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-russia-diplomacy-idUSKBN1481RE>); [Daily Mirror UK](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/russian-ambassador-turkey-seriously-injured-9485836>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/19/world/europe/russia-ambassador-shot-ankara-turkey-report.html?emc=edit_na_20161219&amp;nlid=66213151&amp;ref=cta&amp;mtrref=undefined&amp;gwh=74A8E94235139A73843132F7D50EDAF4&amp;gwt=pay>); [Sputnik](<https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201612201048770286-iran-closes-consulates-turkey/>).

<a id="event-2016-12-19-0-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Berlin truck attack.

**Archived source account.** Twelve are killed and more than 50 others are injured as a truck rams into a packed Christmas market in Breitscheidplatz, Berlin, Germany. A suspect has been arrested in connection with the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Aljazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/12/lorry-ploughs-christmas-market-crowd-berlin-161219193437792.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-truck-idUSKBN148287?il=0>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-12-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Regulators in the European Union initiate a "public consultation" on Big Data looking at whether more regulation or supervision of the collection of high volumes of information on individuals is appropriate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-regulations-big-data-idUSKBN14816Y>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-12-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Companies shut down production in Beijing and cars are taken off the road after a red alert for smog is issued in northern China. Dozens of cities have closed schools due to the smog.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_CHINA_POLLUTION?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2016-12-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Polish protesters block the parliament in order to prevent the possibility of legalizing restrictions on press freedom.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/monkey-cage/wp/2016/12/19/why-are-there-protests-in-poland-here-are-the-five-things-you-need-to-know/>).

<a id="event-2016-12-19-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Paris finds International Monetary Fund Managing Director Christine Lagarde guilty of negligence in a 404 million euro "misuse of public funds" case. The court ruled that Lagarde won't be fined, won't serve any jail time, or receive a criminal record. The IMF Executive Board "looks forward to continuing to work with" her.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/19/business/imf-trial-christine-lagarde-france-verdict.html?_r=0>); [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2016/12/19/news/christine-lagarde-trial-guilty-verdict/?iid=TL_Popular>); [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2016/12/19/imf-chief-christine-lagarde-job/>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/12/19/imf-chief-christine-lagarde-found-negligence/>).

<a id="event-2016-12-19-3-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Zürich attack.

**Archived source account.** Three people are shot by a gunman at an Islamic centre near the Zürich Hauptbahnhof train station. A manhunt was conducted for the assailant, a 24-year-old Swiss citizen of Ghanaian descent, whose body was found close to the Islamic centre.

Source citations (as archived): [GlobalNews](<http://globalnews.ca/news/3135958/3-injured-in-shooting-at-zurich-islamic-centre-reports/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2016-12-19-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Amidst a concerted effort to persuade electors to choose another candidate, Donald Trump earns the required Electoral College votes to be selected as the next President of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/19/us/politics/electoral-college-vote.html>).

<a id="event-2016-12-19-4-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** A record number of electors break ranks and do not vote for their assigned candidate. Two electors from Texas vote for John Kasich and Ron Paul. Some of the electors from Washington cast three votes for Colin Powell and one vote for Faith Spotted Eagle. One elector from Hawaii votes for Bernie Sanders.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2016/12/electoral-college-electors-232836>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2016-12-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** ALPHA, a CERN experiment, has observed for the first time the spectrum of antihydrogen.

Source citations (as archived): [CERN](<https://home.cern/about/updates/2016/12/alpha-observes-light-spectrum-antimatter-first-time>).

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The People's Republic of China returns a United States unmanned underwater drone that it seized in the South China Sea last week.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2016/12/20/politics/china-drone-return/index.html>).

### 2016-12-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1255819861](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2016%20December%2021&oldid=1255819861>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-12-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian police kill three people in a gunfight south of Jakarta after a bomb is found. Fourteen people are arrested in connection to alleged involvement in plans for suicide bomb attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-security-idUSKBN14A09Q?il=0>); [Reuters²](<http://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2016/12/21/indonesia-police-arrest-three-over-suspected-suicide-bomb-plot/>).

<a id="event-2016-12-21-0-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Berlin truck attack.

**Archived source account.** German officials offer a reward of up to 100,000 euros ($104,000) for 24-year-old Tunisian asylum-seeker Anis Amri, whose identifying information was found in the truck used in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/germany-truck-tunisia-idINKBN14A0YX>).

<a id="event-2016-12-21-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed in a Taliban attack on Afghan Member of Parliament Mir Wali's home in Helmand Province. At least three security guards and two civilians were killed in the assault; Wali and others were injured. The gunmen are holding a number of occupants hostage.

Source citations (as archived): [PressTV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2016/12/21/500888/Afghanistan-Kabul-Wali>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack-idUSKBN14A1W1>).

<a id="event-2016-12-21-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Northern Raqqa offensive.

**Archived source account.** U.S.-backed Syrian Democratic Forces advance to eight kilometers (five miles) from the largest prison held by ISIL near the Tabqa Dam.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/us-backed-alliance-advances-in-north-syria-near-isis-jail>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-12-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Musician James Taylor cancels a concert in Manila to protest the ongoing drug war.

Source citations (as archived): [Billboard](<http://www.billboard.com/articles/news/7632352/james-taylor-cancels-philippines-concert-president-duterte-drug-war>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2016-12-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Financial Industry Regulatory Authority fines several companies, including Wells Fargo, RBC Capital Markets, and LPL Financial, a combined $14.4 million for record-keeping problems that could have allowed company and customer documents to be altered.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wells-fargo-finra-idUSKBN14A1S4?il=0>).

<a id="event-2016-12-21-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Uber suspends tests of its self-driving cars in San Francisco, California, after the California Department of Motor Vehicles revoked the registration of the vehicles in the state in response to two red-light violations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-38400224>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2016-12-21-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 San Pablito Market fireworks explosion.

**Archived source account.** Authorities say the death toll is now 31, and that 47 of the 60 people injured remain hospitalized.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/mexico-americas/la-fg-mexico-fireworks-explosion-20161221-story.html>).

<a id="event-2016-12-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sindh Government officials declare a health emergency in Malir, Karachi, as thousands of patients have been affected by the mysterious Chikungunya virus. The government states the aedes aegypti mosquito is responsible for spreading the Chikungunya virus in Pakistan's largest city.

Source citations (as archived): [Geo tv](<https://www.geo.tv/latest/124382-More-patients-arrive-at-Karachi-hospital-with-symptoms-of-mysterious-virus>); [Daily Pakistan](<https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/headline/emergency-declared-in-malir-as-thousands-fear-falling-victim-to-mysterious-chikungunya-virus/>); [Dunya News tv](<http://dunyanews.tv/en/Pakistan/366408-Aedes-aegypti-mosquito-responsible-for-Chikungun>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2016-12-21-5-1"></a>

Context: China–Mongolia relations.

**Archived source account.** Mongolia bans the 14th Dalai Lama from leisure in the country after China cancels a Mongolian loan.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/12/21/world/asia/ap-as-mongolia-china-dalai-lama.html>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20161222041321/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/mongolia-dalai-lama-allowed-future-visits-44319702>).

Context: International recognition of Taiwan, One-China policy.

**Archived source account.** São Tomé and Príncipe breaks relations with the island country of Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-38388181>).

<a id="event-2016-12-21-5-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations, 2016 United States election interference by Russia.

**Archived source account.** The Kremlin says almost all communications channels with the United States are frozen. The U.S. State Department says the dialogue with Russia continues despite their differences.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-usa-peskov-idUSKBN14A1LJ>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2016/12/21/world/europe/ap-eu-russia-us.html?_r=0>).

### 2016-12-29

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-12-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin says a ceasefire has been brokered between the Syrian government and rebel forces. The ceasefire is said to be guaranteed by Russia and Turkey and would exclude UN-denominated terror organizations such as ISIL and al-Nusra. The FSA says it would abide by the truce, while Ahrar al-Sham expresses "reservations".

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/story/2016-12-29/putin-syria-ceasefire-agreed-between-government-and-rebel-forces/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-ceasefire-idUSKBN14I17I>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2016-12-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Czartoryski Museum.

**Archived source account.** The Polish government buys the internationally-known Czartoryski collection of art. Based in the city of Kraków and consisting of around 86,000 pieces, this features works by Leonardo da Vinci, Rembrandt and Pierre-Auguste Renoir.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38462474>).

<a id="event-2016-12-29-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The academic Phil Scraton refuses an OBE granted to him by Elizabeth II in her 2017 New Year Honours list for his work on the Hillsborough disaster. Professor Scraton wrote Hillsborough: The Truth, first published in 1990 and seen as the definitive account of the disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-merseyside-38457928>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/dec/29/hillsborough-prof-phil-scraton-turns-down-obe>).

Russian President Vladimir Putin rejects Lavrov's recommendation and expresses a desire to restore relations between the two countries.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/30/world/europe/russia-diplomats-us-hacking.html>); [Newshub](<http://www.newshub.co.nz/home/world/2016/12/no-tit-for-tat-from-russia-after-diplomat-expulsion.html>).

<a id="event-2016-12-30-2-2"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Burlington Electric Department says that a code associated with a broad Russian hacking campaign dubbed "Grizzly Steppe" by the U.S. Government has been detected on a laptop associated with a Vermont electric utility but not connected to the grid.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2016-12-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / December 2016 Baghdad bombings.

**Archived source account.** A pair of bomb blasts targeting a market in central Baghdad kills at least 27 people and injures over 50.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/M/ML_IRAQ?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/12/31/double-suicide-bombing-baghdad-markets-kills-27/>).

<a id="event-2016-12-31-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Withdrawal of U.S. troops from Afghanistan.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** On July 6, President Obama announced plans to retain approximately 8,400 US troops in Afghanistan into 2017, through the end of his administration. This does not support the source’s unqualified December 31 withdrawal assertion.

Editorial date: 2016-12-31. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: the opened official statement contradicts treating an old total-withdrawal timetable as settled 2016 policy. Confirm actual year-end deployment separately; preserve the source wording and date.

Evidence: [Obama White House / US National Archives](<https://obamawhitehouse.archives.gov/the-press-office/2016/07/06/statement-president-afghanistan/>).

Original source account: United States troops withdraw from Afghanistan after 15 years.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.
